title: Articled Assistant
description:
About Us

At Ketan Parekh & Co., we believe in building well-rounded financial professionals, not just desk-bound executors. We are an established Chartered Accountancy firm offering high-impact services across Statutory & Internal Audits, Income Tax Return Filing & Advisory, GST Compliance, and Corporate Advisory.

Our philosophy is simple: we provide our articles and trainees with end-to-end, hands-on exposure across diverse industries, ensuring you gain the deep operational knowledge required to excel in your professional exams and your future corporate career.

With operational touchpoints across both the Central Line (Vikhroli) and the Western Line (Dahisar), we offer excellent connectivity for candidates commuting from different parts of Mumbai.

What You Will Learn & Do (The Exposure)

You won’t be confined to a single spreadsheet. From day one, you will get 360-degree exposure to real-world business finance:

* Audit & Assurance: Leading and assisting in Statutory, Internal, and Stock Audits for diverse client profiles across Mumbai.
* Direct & Indirect Taxation: Hands-on involvement in Income Tax Return (ITR) filing, GST reconciliations, tax compliance, and advisory.
* Process & Risk Advisory: Learning how to design execution systems, standardize workflows, and manage critical field assignments like physical asset verifications.
* Client Management: Directly interacting with business owners and management teams to gather data, analyze financial health, and present findings.

Our New Stipend Structure

We believe in rewarding competence and value your qualifications. Our new, tier-based stipend policy is transparently structured as follows:

Candidate ProfileFirst Year (FY)Second Year (SY)Third Year (TY)

Graduate + CA/CMA Intermediate FY ₹9,000 / mo - SY ₹12,000 / mo

Undergraduate + CA/CMA Intermediate FY ₹7,500 / mo - SY ₹10,000 / mo

Graduate (Fresher) FY ₹7,500 / mo SY ₹9,000 / mo

Undergraduate (Above age 18) FY ₹5,000 / mo SY ₹6,500 / mo TY ₹7,500 / mo

💡
*Note: Out-of-pocket traveling expenses incurred during client field audits are reimbursed separately.*

* What We Are Looking For
  Qualifications: Open to CA/CMA Intermediate students (Graduates or Undergraduates) as well as fresh Graduates/Undergraduates looking for rigorous practical training.
* Location Convenience: Based in Mumbai with easy commuting access to the Central Line (Vikhroli) or Western Line (Dahisar).
* Tech-Savvy Mindset: Strong baseline in MS Office (especially Excel). An interest in how technology and automation integrate with audit workflows is a plus.
* Core Traits: High analytical ability, strong communication skills, a proactive attitude toward learning, and unquestionable integrity.
* Why Choose Ketan Parekh & Co.?
  No Pigeonholing: You will rotate through different domains (Taxation, Audit, Compliance) rather than being stuck in just one department.
* Commute-Friendly Locations: Easily accessible sites on both major railway lines, reducing your travel stress.
* Exam-First Culture: We deeply respect the grit it takes to clear professional finals. We offer a structured, supportive exam leave policy to give you the best shot at success.
* Direct Mentorship: Work closely alongside Partners and seasoned seniors who are committed to mentoring you through complex assignments.

title: Accounts asst. - Joining in 15 days - Mumbai Location
description:
**Company Description**
Transcon Freight Systems Pvt Ltd is a logistics specialist providing comprehensive transportation solutions for diverse industries and clients. Headquartered in Mumbai, India, the company operates with a global presence, with offices in Houston, USA, and Antwerp, Belgium. Transcon focuses on reliable, efficient, and customer-centric freight and logistics services across international markets. Team members collaborate with global counterparts to support smooth operations and high-quality service delivery.

**Role Description**
The Accounts Assistant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai, with an expected joining date within 15 days. The role involves supporting day-to-day accounting activities, including managing petty cash, assisting with ledger entries, processing invoices, and reconciling accounts. The Accounts Assistant will help with credit control tasks such as tracking outstanding payments, following up with clients, and preparing basic financial reports. The role also includes coordinating with internal teams and external partners for documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring compliance with company finance procedures. This position requires consistent communication with the finance team and timely completion of assigned tasks to support smooth accounting operations.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Accounting and Finance skills, including basic bookkeeping, invoice processing, and account reconciliation.
* Basic accounting in tally. Billing, Invoice booking, expense booking, trip costing etc.
* Knowledge of TDS, GST working and return filing
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to interact with internal teams, external stakeholders, and support documentation clarity.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Excel and other accounting software tools, with attention to detail and accuracy in data entry.
* Relevant academic background in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance (e.g., B.Com or equivalent) is preferred.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai, manage deadlines, and maintain confidentiality of financial information.
* Prior experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or a related industry will be an added advantage.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Assistant Manager – Fractional CFO Services**

KEMANEXA CONSULTING LLP | Mumbai (in-office) | Full-time

**Experience:**
0–3 years

**About us**

KEMANEXA CONSULTING LLP is a Mumbai-based Management Consulting firm working with mid-market businesses on finance, accounting, tax and management consulting. Our Fractional CFO practice works as the finance leadership team for growing companies. We build their MIS, run their cash forecasts, advise on working capital and borrowings, fill in the process gaps and sit in their monthly management reviews.

**The role**

You’ll work directly with the engagement partner across a portfolio of client companies. This is not a compliance-only role. You’ll prepare the numbers that founders and partners use to run their business, and you’ll present them in the room.

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare monthly management P&Ls, budget vs actual reports and variance commentary
* Analyse gross margin by customer and product, and flag loss-making accounts
* Build and roll forward 13-week cash flow forecasts, and track how accurate they turn out
* Maintain working capital dashboards: debtor, inventory and creditor days, and the cash conversion cycle
* Prepare debtor ageing against agreed credit terms and coordinate follow-up with client sales teams
* Track borrowings: limits, utilisation, interest cost and covenant compliance
* Help prepare quarterly financial statements, budget re-forecasts and risk registers
* Prepare packs for monthly client review meetings, take the minutes and follow up on action points

**What we’re looking for**

* CA (newly qualified or up to 3 years post-qualification), or CA/CMA Inter with relevant experience
* Strong Excel skills: modelling, lookups, pivots and clean, presentable workbooks
* A good grasp of accounting, GST and income tax
* Clear written and spoken English. You’ll be explaining numbers to business owners.
* Comfortable handling several clients and deadlines at once

**Good to have**

* Experience with MIS, FP&A or statutory audit
* Exposure to Tally, Zoho Books or other accounting software
* Familiarity with Power BI or similar dashboard tools

**What you’ll get**

* Direct exposure to CFO-level work across several industries early in your career
* Close mentoring from a CA, MBA and ACCA-qualified partner
* Structured learning in MIS, Budgeting, treasury and financial planning

title: Analyst - Investment Research
description:
**About Us**
WHY LINEDATA ?
  
  
Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow.
  
  
With more than 1,350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. Together, we tackle future-focused topics like Al and the digitalization of finance, delivering smart solutions for our customers.
  
  
Whether you're just beginning your career or are an experienced professional, Linedata offers exposure to large-scale client projects, internal mobility and opportunities to develop your skills alongside leading experts.
  
  
**ANALYST – VALUATION**
**MUMBAI, INDIA**
At Linedata we believe finance matters to our society as much as energy to life and fueling financial transformation is vital for development and leadership. We humanize technology. We are passionate experts who provide the investment management and credit communities with innovative, user-friendly products which help their businesses grow in over 50 countries.
  
  
We employ more than 1300 employees representing 40 nationalities spread throughout our offices in 14 countries. We believe in mobility, diversity & team work.
  
  
Our mission is to continue to find new ways to create and build flexible, mission critical software and services and to stay on the cutting edge of the financial software space.
  
  
**JOIN THE MOVEMENT**
We are transforming the financial services community which is in constant evolution. Like professional dancers we are experts in our field and are defining new pathways for financial services to serve the world. With our agility we make technology simple & accessible for our users. We all work together to achieve the best solutions for our clients.
  
  
Tell us what your ambitions are, we will choreograph your career and take it to the next level!
  
  
**THE ROLE**
You will join a team of analysts working closely with senior investment professionals of a global asset manager. You will be responsible for providing valuation and monitoring services for the portfolio investments of the Client. The role spans across different aspects of valuation – initiating/maintaining financial models and preparing valuation memos across sectors. You are also expected to proactively engage with different stakeholders to ensure well informed and timely investment decision making by the Client. You are required to take complete ownership of the deliverables and demonstrate high-quality standards with utmost integrity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Performing valuation on a range of (illiquid) investments across various industries
* Preparing and updating valuation models, detailed memos, and presentations
* Independently gathering data pertinent to the investments/models
* Addressing client queries in a clear and concise manner
* Prioritizing and executing multiple assignments, including ad-hoc projects, within tight deadlines
* Adhering to high-quality standards and industry best practices

**Skills Required**

* Sound experience in valuation and financial modelling (discounted cash flows, market multiples, market transactions) (up to 2 years)
* Exposure to US/European primary and secondary markets
* Strong excel modelling and analytical skills
* High level of attention to detail
* Ability to independently execute assignments under tight deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Team player with a professional demeanour

**Advantageous Skills**

* Knowledge of third-party databases such as Bloomberg, CapIQ, Thomson Reuters, etc.
* Hands-on experience on VBA macros
* Sector knowledge - Real Estate, Shipping, Aircraft, and Oil & Gas

Academic Requirements
  
  

* MBA or equivalent qualification in finance from a reputed institution
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or Economics & CFA (Level II completed)

title: Channel SE - Identity Security
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
******Job Summary**
:****
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Channel Domain Consultant to join our team to support the North Asia region. In this critical partner-facing role, the Channel Systems Engineer will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for PANW Idira Identity Security products and solutions. The individual will foster and nurture relationships with technical partners, including System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), Managed Service Providers (MSP), and other strategic partners. This role requires a combination of technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills to enable and guide partners in delivering best-in-class Identity Security Management solutions including Human Identity Security, Machine Identity Security, Agentic AI Identity Security.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for driving partner Activation, ecosystem integrations, technical solution design, and supporting partners throughout the sales lifecycle. They will also play a key role in the development and execution of technical go-to-market (GTM) strategies.
  
  
******Key Responsibilities:******
****Partner Activation & Ecosystem Integration:****

* Foster and build strong relationships with technical partners (SI, VAR, MSP) to expand the reach and success of solutions.
* Lead partner Activation efforts by creating training and certification pathways, including developing and improving certification processes.
* Collaborate with Technical Alliances to ensure the correct integration and development of technical selling plans.
* Work on partner onboarding and knowledge transfer, ensuring partners are equipped with the tools, knowledge, and resources to successfully position and sell products.
* Develop and implement Activation programs that educate and empower partners to be self-sufficient in selling and supporting solutions.

******Solution Design & Technical Strategy:******

* Gather and analyze end-customer requirements from partners, translating business needs into technical solutions and system architectures.
* Provide technical leadership by designing and delivering tailored solutions architectures for partner-engaged end-customer projects.
* Work with channel partners on customer meetings and joint solution documentation, ensuring high-quality technical outcomes.
* Break down complex technical concepts into simple, customer-driven outcomes and messaging, enabling partners to effectively communicate these solutions to end-customers.
* Support partners in technical sales presentations, white-boarding sessions, and other customer-facing activities.
* Develop joint value propositions for solutions, ensuring alignment with business challenges and technical requirements across a variety of customer personas and segments.

******Marketplace & GTM Strategy:******

* Lead the creation and execution of technical go-to-market strategies for Idira platforms, ensuring the correct approach for product integration and sales.
* Drive partner Activation in marketplace scenarios, including marketplace certifications, architecture validation, and joint product promotion.
* Ensure the technical messaging and positioning for products is clear, impactful, and aligned with market needs.

******Channel Partner Support & Collaboration:******

* Provide ongoing support to channel partners in the form of product demos, technical consultations, and sales training.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure alignment between product development, partner sales teams, and marketing.
* Provide and Maintain a NFR demo environment for all Idira solutions, ensuring partners have access to the necessary resources for their sales efforts.

****Qualifications****

* 3+ years of experience in Partner Solution Consulting, pre-sales engineering, or a similar technical role within the technology industry
* Proficiency with PAM, IAM, Endpoint security solution experience with CyberArk’s / Idira’s solutions preferred
* Strong understanding on AI and AI agent cybersecurity (at least one of the major AI platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, Microsoft)
* Proficiency in Active Directory / Entra ID administration, Unix/Linux systems, and related technologies.
* Proficiency with cloud services (at least one of the major cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud or Azure) admin and security experience
* Proficiency with CI/CD application development security experience
* Strong understanding of machine identity management, public key infrastructure (PKI), and encryption technologies.
* Strong understanding of security concepts and regulatory compliance.
* Strong presentation and demonstration skills for both technical and executive audiences.
* Proven experience in technical sales, solution architect, or partner Activation role, ideally within the cybersecurity, identity management, or cloud technologies space.
* Strong experience in designing and delivering technical solutions and translating customer requirements into actionable and scalable solutions.
* Experience working with System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), and Managed Service Providers (MSP) to enable technical solutions and partner sales.
* Strong experience in designing and delivering technical solutions and translating customer requirements into actionable and scalable solutions.
* Ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders at all levels.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for simplifying complex technical topics.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product management.
* Experience identity management solutions are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives and projects effectively.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Analyst, Sustainable Procurement
description:
**Job Summary**
Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Global Operations: Ensuring excellence in execution—from procurement to supply chain and reliability—delivering quality, safety, efficiency and sustainability across the value chain.
  
  
The role is based either in Hyderabad or Mumbai, India (Hybrid role). Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
  
  
**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

* Support the execution of IFF's supplier sustainability and responsible sourcing programs.
* Conduct supplier sustainability assessments using internal tools and external platforms and identify areas for improvement.
* Support supplier engagement activities, including onboarding, data collection, sustainability reviews, and follow-up communications.
* Assist with supplier visits and sustainability reviews to validate practices and support continuous improvement efforts.
* Track supplier corrective actions and monitor progress against agreed improvement plans.
* Maintain sustainability-related datasets, including supplier assessment results, traceability information, and action plan trackers.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, and analyses to support procurement and sustainability teams in decision-making.
* Conduct research on sustainability trends, supplier engagement approaches, and responsible sourcing best practices.
* Support internal awareness and knowledge sharing on sustainable procurement topics.

**What Makes You The Right Fit**

* Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline required; Master's degree preferred.
* Early-career professional with experience gained through internships, graduate programs, or up to 3 years of relevant professional experience.
* Exposure to supplier assessments, sustainability programs, responsible sourcing initiatives, or data analysis is preferred.
* Experience working with suppliers or supporting cross-functional projects is an advantage.
* Proficiency with Excel is required.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage data accurately.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn about sustainability and responsible sourcing practices.
* Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Exposure to supplier engagement or experience working with suppliers in Asia (India, Southeast Asia, China) is an advantage.
* Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualization tools is a plus.
* Asian languages (Hindi, Mandarin, etc.) are considered a plus.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Multinational and supporting environment
* Training opportunities

**Ideal Candidate**

* Mandatory (Experience 3): Must have designed and implemented network security solutions for DC / DR / Cloud and branch-office environments.
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must have strong conceptual knowledge of networking and network security, experience across Windows / Linux / Unix, and hands-on packet capture and analysis (Wireshark / pcap) with troubleshooting across OSI Layers 1–7.
* Mandatory (Tech skill 2): Must have experience managing policies and exceptions, and incident / problem / service-request / change / configuration / capacity management, using network monitoring tools to isolate events before service degradation.

* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have experience investigating, isolating, and resolving incidents with RCA, coordinating helpdesk / IT / application teams on high-severity incidents, and ensuring ticket closure within SLA with SLA reporting.
* Mandatory (Experience 5): Must have OEM coordination experience (TAC, RMA, replacement, reconfiguration), patch updates / upgrades per bank compliance and audit requirements, timely closure of compliance / audit points, daily performance checks, and periodic audits.
* Mandatory (Skill): Must be able to create technical documentation, as-built diagrams, inventory / security documentation, SOPs / runbooks, and maintain the ITSM knowledge base.
* Mandatory (Leadership): Must be able to guide, lead, and mentor a junior (L1) team, and set expectations for ad hoc activities with the client SPOC.
* Mandatory (Communication): Must have exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a strong sense of ownership and a demonstrated ability to solve complex issues under pressure.
* Mandatory (Domain): Banking-industry experience preferred; strong candidates with the same technical experience from another industry are acceptable.
* Mandatory (Note): Must be comfortable with a 24/7 NOC rotational shift environment at the client site (IDFC Bank, Airoli, Navi Mumbai), able to work in a fast-paced
* Preferred (Certification): Product certification in Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco ASA, or Fortinet

Experience: 4–7 years · Work from office · 6 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

title: Community Manager
description:
Community Manager – Sorano Mumbai

**Department:**
Marketing & Brand Experience

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Brand:**
Sorano – Italian Fine Dining & Bar

**Reporting To:**
Head of Marketing / Business Head

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Sorano

Sorano is an Italian fine-dining destination built around exceptional food, crafted beverages, thoughtful hospitality, and memorable guest experiences. With the upcoming opening of our new Mumbai property, we are looking for a dynamic and well-connected
**Community Manager**
who can establish Sorano as a preferred destination for Mumbai’s social, lifestyle, food, and nightlife communities.

The role will focus on building meaningful relationships, driving footfall, creating buzz around the new property, and developing a loyal community of guests across both the restaurant and bar.

Role Overview

The Community Manager will lead on-ground community building, local partnerships, guest engagement, curated experiences, and community-led marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate should have strong networking skills, a good understanding of Mumbai’s social and lifestyle scene, and the ability to convert relationships into guest visits, events, and repeat business.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Pre-Opening & Launch Activities**

* Develop and execute a community-building plan ahead of Sorano Mumbai’s launch.
* Identify and connect with relevant communities, influencers, food enthusiasts, lifestyle personalities, corporate groups, and local networks.
* Build a database of potential guests, tastemakers, creators, and strategic partners.
* Plan pre-opening previews, exclusive tastings, invite-only evenings, and launch engagement initiatives.
* Generate local buzz and establish Sorano as a must-visit dining and bar destination.

**2. Community Building & Networking**

* Build and maintain relationships with Mumbai’s social, lifestyle, culinary, nightlife, and corporate communities.
* Develop networks with entrepreneurs, CXOs, premium residential communities, art and fashion circles, and hospitality professionals.
* Create a strong base of repeat guests and brand advocates.
* Organise community meet-ups, curated gatherings, exclusive experiences, and special-interest events.
* Represent Sorano at relevant industry, lifestyle, and networking events.

**3. Restaurant & Bar Engagement**

* Develop initiatives to drive footfall during both dining and bar service periods.
* Build relationships with cocktail enthusiasts, mixology communities, nightlife networks, and relevant beverage partners.
* Conceptualise bar takeovers, cocktail experiences, guest bartender collaborations, sundowner events, and themed evenings in coordination with the bar team.
* Support curated dining experiences, chef's tables, wine or beverage pairings, and special menus.
* Work with the restaurant and bar teams to ensure community initiatives translate into quality guest experiences and repeat visits.

**4. Partnerships & Collaborations**

* Identify and execute collaborations with premium brands across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, automotive, art, music, and luxury categories.
* Build partnerships with hotels, concierge teams, corporate offices, premium residential developments, and event organisers.
* Explore corporate dining, private celebrations, brand events, and community-led revenue opportunities.
* Develop mutually beneficial partnerships that enhance Sorano’s positioning and commercial performance.

**5. Influencer & PR Coordination**

* Identify relevant local creators and influencers aligned with Sorano’s positioning.
* Coordinate influencer visits, hosted experiences, content collaborations, and relationship management.
* Work closely with the marketing and PR teams on campaigns, launch activities, and brand visibility.
* Track the effectiveness of collaborations through reservations, guest visits, content reach, and attributable revenue.
* Ensure all outreach and collaborations maintain the brand’s premium positioning.

**6. Guest Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain a structured guest and community database.
* Track preferences, occasions, feedback, repeat visits, and engagement opportunities.
* Coordinate with the reservations and operations teams to ensure seamless experiences for VIPs, regular guests, and community partners.
* Develop initiatives for guest retention, birthday and anniversary occasions, and personalised engagement.
* Collect guest feedback and share actionable insights with the management team.

**7. Events & Experiences**

* Plan and execute community-led events, exclusive dinners, cocktail evenings, networking sessions, and festive activations.
* Coordinate with operations, chefs, bar teams, marketing, and external partners for smooth execution.
* Ensure every event meets brand standards, guest experience expectations, and agreed commercial objectives.
* Maintain post-event reports covering attendance, spend, feedback, leads, and revenue.

**8. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Submit weekly and monthly reports on community engagement, partnerships, events, influencer activity, guest acquisition, and revenue generated.
* Track reservation conversions, repeat guest visits, event performance, and customer acquisition through community initiatives.
* Maintain a calendar of upcoming activations, partnerships, and key Mumbai social events.
* Work within approved budgets and measure return on investment for community initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Successful execution of the pre-opening community and launch plan.
* Growth of a qualified local guest and community database.
* Number and quality of strategic partnerships established.
* Reservations and footfall generated through community initiatives.
* Repeat guest visits and guest retention.
* Revenue generated through events, collaborations, and community-led bookings.
* Effectiveness of influencer collaborations and measurable conversions.
* Event execution quality, guest satisfaction, and adherence to budgets.
* Consistency of reporting and cross-functional coordination.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* 3–6 years of experience in community management, hospitality marketing, lifestyle marketing, PR, events, or guest relations.
* Prior experience in premium restaurants, luxury hospitality, nightlife, bars, or lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Strong understanding of Mumbai’s dining, social, nightlife, and lifestyle ecosystem.
* An established network of relevant local contacts will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication, networking, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong event planning, coordination, negotiation, and execution abilities.
* Commercially minded, with the ability to connect community engagement to reservations and revenue.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced hospitality environment, including evenings, weekends, and special events.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is outgoing, resourceful, socially aware, and commercially driven. The candidate should be equally comfortable networking with high-value guests, developing brand partnerships, coordinating a cocktail evening, and working closely with the operations team to ensure flawless execution.

**This is not just a social media role.**
It is a hands-on, relationship-driven position focused on building Sorano Mumbai’s community, strengthening brand presence, and driving measurable business results.

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, existing network, and suitability for the role.

title: General Manager - Celviq Daily Skincare
description:
**About Celviq and the role**

Celviq Daily Skincare is an Indian D2C skincare startup selling primarily through its own website and online marketplaces. The company is scaling from a pilot team to a full organisation across 14 departments.

The GM / Business Head is the single point of accountability for the business. The role converts the founders' vision into an annual operating plan, then delivers revenue, margin and brand growth through the functional heads, agencies and supply partners.

**Role purpose**

•        Own the full business lifecycle: product concept, formulation, sourcing, manufacturing, launch, sale, delivery and repeat purchase.

•        Deliver the annual P&L: revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA and cash.

•        Build Celviq into a trusted, compliant and digitally native skincare brand.

•        Build the leadership team, culture and governance needed to scale.

1. Key responsibilities

**1. Strategy, P&L and business planning**

•        Build the 3-year business plan and annual operating plan (AOP) with the founders and Board.

•        Own the P&L: revenue, COGS, gross margin, marketing spend, contribution margin, EBITDA and working capital.

•        Set quarterly targets for each function and run monthly business reviews against them.

•        Prepare Board decks and investor updates, and support fundraising with the Finance Head.

•        Decide channel mix, pricing, discounting and SKU portfolio based on unit economics.

**2. E-commerce and D2C growth**

•        Grow sales across the brand website, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Purplle and quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart).

•        Own marketplace performance: listings, content, ratings, Buy Box, ads (sponsored products, DSP) and account health.

•        Drive website conversion, average order value, repeat rate and customer lifetime value.

•        Manage performance marketing ROAS, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and payback period.

•        Oversee fulfilment, returns, COD/RTO control and customer service standards.

**3. Product, quality and R&D**

•        Approve the new product development roadmap with the QA/R&D Head.

•        Ensure formulations, testing (stability, safety, dermatological) and claims meet brand and regulatory standards.

•        Ensure compliance with the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, Cosmetics Rules 2020, BIS standards and Legal Metrology labelling.

•        Drive product quality metrics: complaint rate, batch rejection and recalls.

**4. Supply chain, procurement and manufacturing partners**

•        Oversee contract manufacturers, packaging and raw-material suppliers through the Procurement Head.

•        Negotiate key commercial terms, MOQs and payment terms for strategic vendors.

•        Own demand planning, inventory days, stock-outs and dead-stock levels.

•        Manage warehousing and 3PL logistics partners against cost and delivery SLAs.

**5. Brand and marketing**

•        Approve brand positioning, identity and communication with the Branding and Marketing Head.

•        Approve the annual marketing budget and its split across performance, influencer, content and offline.

•        Track brand health: share of search, social engagement, reviews and NPS.

**6. Functional leadership: Finance, Legal, IT, HR and Admin**

•        Finance and Accounts: monthly closing, MIS, budgets, cash flow, GST and statutory compliance, audits.

•        Legal: contracts, trademarks, IP, regulatory licences and dispute management.

•        IT: e-commerce stack (website, OMS, WMS, ERP, CRM), data and analytics, cybersecurity.

•        HR and Admin: manpower plan, hiring of key roles, performance management, culture, Labour Code compliance and facilities.

**7. Agencies, vendors and partners**

•        Appoint, brief and review creative, digital, PR, influencer and marketplace agencies.

•        Set agency KPIs and retainers, and run quarterly performance reviews.

•        Maintain a vendor governance process: onboarding, contracts, SLAs and periodic audits.

**8. Governance, risk and culture**

•        Set and enforce the delegation of authority, approval matrix and internal controls.

•        Identify and mitigate business, regulatory, financial and reputational risks.

•        Build a performance-driven, ethical and customer-first culture.

•        Act as the company's senior representative with investors, partners and regulators.

**Team and span of control**

The role leads 8 functional heads directly and manages external agencies, vendors and suppliers through them.

Direct report -What the GM holds them accountable for

QA / R&D Head -NPD pipeline, formulation quality, testing, regulatory approvals

Procurement Head -Vendor base, cost of materials, contract manufacturing, inventory

Branding and Marketing Head -Brand equity, performance marketing ROAS, CAC, agency output

E-commerce / Marketplace lead -Channel revenue, conversion, marketplace health, quick-commerce

IT Head E-commerce tech stack, systems uptime, data and analytics

HR and Admin Head -Manpower plan, hiring, performance, culture, compliance, facilities

Legal Head -Contracts, IP, licences, regulatory and dispute risk

Finance and Accounts Head -MIS, budgets, cash, taxation, audits, statutory compliance

**External partners managed:**
contract manufacturers, packaging and raw-material suppliers, 3PL and warehousing partners, marketplaces, creative and digital agencies, PR and influencer agencies, and technology vendors.

Open question: confirm whether E-commerce is a separate head or sits under Marketing.

**Qualifications, experience and competencies**

**Education**

•        Graduate in any discipline; MBA or PGDM from a reputed institute preferred.

•        A science, pharmacy or cosmetic technology background is an added advantage.

**Experience**

•        15+ years in consumer businesses, with 5+ years as GM, Business Head, BU Head or CEO with full P&L ownership.

•        Proven record scaling a D2C or e-commerce-led brand in beauty, personal care, skincare, FMCG or wellness.

•        Hands-on experience with marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa) and quick-commerce.

•        Experience managing contract manufacturers and a multi-vendor supply chain.

•        Startup or high-growth experience; exposure to investor reporting or fundraising preferred.

**Knowledge**

•        E-commerce unit economics: CAC, LTV, ROAS, contribution margin, payback.

•        Indian cosmetics regulation, labelling and claims compliance.

•        Financial statements, budgeting and working-capital management.

•        E-commerce technology: Shopify or similar, OMS, WMS, ERP, analytics tools.

**Competencies**

•        Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.

•        Data-driven decision making.

•        Leading and developing senior leaders across diverse functions.

•        Commercial negotiation with vendors, agencies and partners.

•        Consumer and brand sense in beauty and personal care.

•        Integrity, ownership and comfort with ambiguity.

•        Clear communication with the Board, investors and teams.

**Authority and first-year success**

**Decision rights**
(limits as per the Board-approved delegation of authority)

•        Approves functional budgets and spends within the AOP.

•        Hires, appraises and exits roles below the functional-head level; recommends functional-head appointments to the Board.

•        Appoints and terminates agencies and vendors within approved limits.

•        Approves pricing, promotions and SKU launches within margin guardrails.

•        Escalates to the Board: AOP changes, capex, fundraising, new entities and high-value contracts.

**What success looks like**

1.      
**First 90 days:**
assess every function, channel and vendor; fix the MIS and review cadence; present a 12-month business plan to the Board.

2.      
**By 6 months:**
leadership team complete; channel unit economics positive at contribution level; product launch calendar running on schedule.

3.      
**By 12 months:**
AOP revenue and margin delivered; scalable systems, processes and governance in place; a strong brand and team ready for the next growth stage.

KRA / KPI will be discussed accordingly post joining

title: Planning & Billing Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
Planning & Billing Engineer
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
This role is responsible for planning, monitoring, billing, and cost control activities for commercial construction projects. The incumbent will support project execution by preparing project schedules, tracking progress, managing client and contractor billing, monitoring budgets, and ensuring timely project reporting and financial control.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**

* Prepare and maintain detailed project schedules, baseline programs, and milestone tracking for commercial construction projects.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedules and generate periodic progress reports, dashboards, and MIS.
* Prepare, verify, and process client RA bills, subcontractor bills, and quantity reconciliations.
* Coordinate with site teams, contractors, consultants, and clients for progress measurement and billing approvals.
* Prepare BOQs, quantity take-offs, rate analysis, cost estimates, and budget tracking reports.
* Monitor project costs, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions to ensure budget compliance.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts, resource planning reports, and project progress presentations.
* Track project productivity, material consumption, and work progress against planned targets.
* Support change order management, variation claims, and contractual documentation.
* Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of project records, billing registers, and planning reports.
* Coordinate with Civil, MEP, and commercial teams to ensure seamless project execution and reporting.
* Assist project leadership in project reviews, forecasting, and achieving timely project completion.

**About You**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in Planning & Billing functions within commercial construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling techniques, billing processes, and cost control methodologies.
* Experience in preparation of BOQ, quantity surveying, client billing, subcontractor billing, and project reporting.
* Proficient in Primavera P6, MS Project, Advanced Excel, AutoCAD, and construction planning tools.
* Good understanding of construction contracts, project budgeting, and commercial management processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple project priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.
* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering is mandatory.

**Why join Cushman & Wakefield?**
As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from;
  
  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to providing work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
  
  
We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Executive -Andheri East
description:
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Payable & Receivable Executive to manage the day-to-day finance operations of the company. You will own the end-to-end payables and receivables cycle, from vendor invoice processing and payments to customer billing and collections, while ensuring accuracy, statutory compliance and timely reporting.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesAccounts Payable
  
  

* Verify, code and process vendor invoices with proper three-way matching (PO, GRN, invoice).
* Prepare and execute vendor payments on schedule via NEFT/RTGS/UPI and other banking channels, after required approvals.
* Maintain vendor master data, including bank details, GST and PAN, and ensure KYC and documentation are complete.
* Reconcile vendor statements with the books and resolve discrepancies or disputes promptly.
* Track payment due dates, manage the payment calendar and avoid late payment penalties.
* Ensure correct TDS deduction, GST input credit eligibility and timely deposit of statutory dues.
* Process employee expense claims and petty cash, where applicable.

Accounts Receivable
  
  

* Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and debit notes accurately and on time.
* Monitor outstanding receivables, maintain ageing reports and follow up with customers for timely collections.
* Perform cash application: match receipts to invoices and update the ledgers.
* Coordinate with sales and operations teams to resolve billing queries and disputes.
* Escalate overdue and doubtful accounts to management with recommended actions.
* Reconcile customer ledgers and share account statements and balance confirmations.

Operations & Monitoring
  
  

* Post daily accounting entries in the ERP/accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, SAP or similar).
* Perform bank reconciliations (daily/weekly/monthly) and clear reconciling items.
* Monitor cash flow, payment schedules and receivable inflows; provide regular cash position updates.
* Prepare MIS reports: payables ageing, receivables ageing, vendor outstanding, DSO and collection summaries.
* Support month-end and year-end closing, including provisions, accruals and ledger scrutiny.
* Assist with GST, TDS and other statutory filings and coordinate with external CAs and auditors.
* Support internal and statutory audits by providing documents and clarifications.
* Improve and document AP/AR processes and internal controls.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent; CA Inter, MBA (Finance) or similar is a plus.
* 4–15 years of experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable or general accounting.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and basic Indian accounting and taxation norms.
* Proficiency in Tally / Zoho Books / SAP or similar accounting software.
* Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliations).
* Good understanding of banking operations and online payment processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with good analytical and numerical ability.
* Clear communication skills for dealing with vendors, customers and internal teams.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience handling a high volume of vendor payments and collections.
* Exposure to ERP systems and automation of finance workflows.
* High integrity and discretion in handling confidential financial information.
* Proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem solving.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Timeliness and accuracy of vendor payments
* Reduction in overdue receivables and DSO
* Accuracy of reconciliations and month-end closing timelines
* Zero statutory penalties or late filings
* Quality and timeliness of MIS reporting

title: Forward Deployed Architect { Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
**a hands-on senior technical architect**
on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end-to-end design and delivery of AI-driven business transformation projects.
  
  
You'll work closely with pre-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands-on coding to build proofs-of-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
  
  
As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
  
  
This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world business impact.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design & Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype & Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof-of-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long-term scalability.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 7+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Principal Economist
description:
**Job Description**
You will work as part of international, multidisciplinary teams providing robust, impartial and influential advice across the policy lifecycle, from policy development and appraisal through implementation, monitoring, evaluation and review. The role combines economic analysis, quantitative modelling, research and clear communication to help public- and private-sector clients understand the economic, environmental and social implications of policy and investment decisions.
  
  
Depending on your experience, you may lead defined workstreams, manage tasks or smaller projects, support and review the work of colleagues, contribute to proposals and help strengthen WSP’s global Policy & Economics offering
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Undertake economic appraisal and policy analysis, including cost-benefit analysis, cost-effectiveness analysis, socio-economic analysis, regulatory impact assessment, feasibility assessment and evaluation.
* Develop quantitative evidence through data collection, validation and analysis; econometric or statistical analysis; scenario and sensitivity analysis; market assessment; and economic or financial modelling.
* Assess the distributional, competitiveness, fiscal, social and environmental implications of policies, programmes, regulations and investments.
* Support climate-policy and decarbonisation assignments, which may include carbon pricing, emissions trading, carbon leakage, transition pathways, investment economics and the cost-effectiveness of policy measures.
* Contribute to ex-ante appraisal and ex-post evaluation, including the development of theories of change, evaluation frameworks, indicators and evidence-based recommendations.
* Plan and deliver primary and secondary research, stakeholder engagement, surveys, interviews and consultations, where relevant.
* Prepare clear, concise and defensible reports, policy briefs, presentations, models and other client deliverables in English.
* Work collaboratively with specialists across environmental science, engineering, climate, natural capital, infrastructure, finance and other disciplines on global projects.
* Contribute to project management, quality assurance, commercial delivery and adherence to agreed scope, budget and programme.
* Support proposals, capability development and knowledge sharing; take a active role in client relationships, opportunity development and technical leadership.

**Sector And Thematic Experience**
Experience across multiple sectors or policy areas would be useful. We do not expect candidates to cover every area; applications are welcomed from economists who bring strong depth in one or more fields and an ability to apply their economics skills across unfamiliar topics.
  
  

* Climate change, net zero and decarbonisation, including carbon pricing and climate-policy instruments
* Energy, power, industry and industrial decarbonisation
* Transport, infrastructure, cities and the built environment
* Water, wastewater and wider environmental regulation
* Waste, resources, circular economy and sustainable consumption
* Air quality, industrial emissions, chemicals, health and safety policy
* Natural capital, biodiversity, ecosystem services and nature-related policy
* Sustainable finance, green investment, taxonomy and transition-related analysis

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch

The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.

At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every

aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.

With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

How will we do it?

There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:

Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.

Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.

Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.

Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:

* Individuals & Families
* Landlords & Second Home Owners
* Developers & RWAs
* Corporates

*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family*

A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences & behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family & its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient & a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family & thus, the most important link between the company & the customer.

*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager*

1. Customer Onboarding

* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold & onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.

2. Solution Deployment

* Define & agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day-to-day chores, & undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.

3. Partner Management

* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.

4. Customer Lifecycle Management

* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight & transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.

5. Customer Feedback & Service Improvement

* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify & work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise & highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.

Who are we looking for?

* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start-up
* Self-motivated & loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, & is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity & uncertainty
* Focused on problem-solving, has a solution-oriented mindset
* Hard-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

Business Applications | Finance Systems·Full-Time·India

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're building a best-in-class NetSuite environment that supports Finance, Accounting, Revenue, Procurement, and Sales Operations across a growing, global business. We're looking for a Senior NetSuite Administrator to own and evolve that environment, translating business needs into scalable solutions, troubleshooting to root cause, and leveraging AI tools to work faster and more accurately whilst maintaining the controls a financial system of record demands.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own day-to-day NetSuite administration, including forms, fields, records, workflows, approvals, roles, permissions, and segregation of duties. Evaluate enhancement requests and recommend the right solution, whether native functionality, configuration, workflow, reporting, or development.
* Support the full Order-to-Cash lifecycle: sales orders, invoicing, billing schedules, credit memos, cash application, and AR. Own the Salesforce-to-NetSuite integration from the NetSuite side, maintaining key fields, resolving sync failures, and improving data feeds.
* Administer Advanced Revenue Management (ARM): understand how source transactions flow into Revenue Elements, Arrangements, Plans, and recognition journals. Configure recognition rules, troubleshoot allocation and recognition dates, lead corrections, and build reconciliations that validate revenue data.
* Maintain Fixed Assets: asset types, depreciation methods, capitalisation, transfers, disposals, and write-offs. Reconcile Fixed Assets to the GL and support month-end and year-end close.
* Support and improve Procure-to-Pay: vendor setup, purchase requests and orders, approval workflows, item receipts, vendor bills and credits, and payments. Strengthen three-way match and related controls in partnership with Procurement, AP, and Finance.
* Build Saved Searches, Workbooks, dashboards, and KPIs for Finance, Accounting, Revenue, Procurement, and management. Create exception reports that catch data quality and process issues early.
* Lead requirements-gathering sessions, document current and future-state processes, and recommend scalable improvements. Support new entities, subsidiaries, products, and integrations as the company grows.
* Develop test scenarios, run UAT, assess downstream impacts, and maintain approvals, test evidence, deployment records, and rollback plans. Communicate changes clearly and validate after deployment.
* Leverage AI tools, including the NetSuite AI connector where approved, to query data, trace root cause, draft SuiteQL, scripts, workflows, test cases, and documentation. Apply AI to detect anomalies, speed up reconciliations and period-end close, and automate repetitive work such as validation and ticket triage. Ensure every AI-assisted change is validated, protects sensitive data, uses only approved tools, and maintains SOX-ready evidence.

* 5+ years of solid, hands-on NetSuite administration experience in a complex, cross-functional environment, supporting Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Advanced Revenue Management, Fixed Assets, reconciliations, and period-end activities.
* Advanced skills in configuration, roles and permissions, workflows, Saved Searches, Workbooks, and change deployment.
* Practical, demonstrated use of generative AI tools in technical, analytical, or finance-systems work, with sound judgement on validation and data protection.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including with senior leaders and nontechnical audiences.
* Strong ownership and follow-through: you track open items, escalate blockers, and close the loop.
* Ability to prioritise competing requests and work with limited supervision.
* Preferred: NetSuite Administrator, SuiteFoundation, or ERP Consultant certification or equivalent experience. Salesforce-to-NetSuite and middleware integration experience. Multi-subsidiary, multi-currency, multi-book global NetSuite experience. Experience with NetSuite AI capabilities, SuiteScript, or SOX control environments.

* Monitor and tune SQL performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, Explain Plan, SQL Trace, wait events, SGA/PGA and session analysis.
* Manage RMAN backup, restore and recovery, database cloning/refresh, migrations and point-in-time recovery.
* Configure and support Data Guard, replication, DR architectures, ASM and RAC environments where applicable.
* Plan and execute Oracle Release Updates/security patching and troubleshoot archive log, corruption, storage and recovery issues.

PostgreSQL Database Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot PostgreSQL databases and clusters.
* Manage roles, privileges, schemas, tablespaces, extensions and configuration files including postgresql.conf and pg\_hba.conf.
* Tune queries, connections, memory, locks, transactions, indexes, checkpoints, autovacuum and database/storage growth.
* Manage pg\_dump/pg\_restore, pg\_basebackup, WAL archiving and Point-in-Time Recovery.
* Configure and support streaming replication and HA solutions such as Patroni, repmgr or equivalent where implemented.
* Perform major/minor upgrades, migrations, refreshes and troubleshoot replication lag, deadlocks, blocking and table/index bloat.

Microsoft SQL Server Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Manage databases, logins/users, permissions, database files, TempDB, SQL Agent jobs and maintenance activities.
* Configure and support Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, log shipping and replication where applicable.
* Manage full, differential and transaction-log backups and point-in-time recovery.
* Monitor and troubleshoot blocking, deadlocks, CPU/memory pressure, disk latency, waits and long-running queries.
* Perform query tuning, index/statistics management, SQL Server cumulative updates and integration with Active Directory authentication.

Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery
  
  

* Define and maintain database backup standards, retention, restore procedures and recovery runbooks.
* Coordinate with enterprise backup teams and regularly validate restore capability for Oracle, PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
* Participate in DR drills and validate RPO, RTO, replication status and application-consistent recovery.

Performance, Capacity & Availability
  
  

* Proactively monitor Linux and database performance across CPU, memory, disk, storage latency, network and SQL workloads.
* Perform capacity forecasting for database growth, tablespaces, file systems, transaction logs, WAL/archive logs and infrastructure resources.
* Work with application teams to optimize SQL and recommend scaling or configuration improvements.

Security, Compliance & Lifecycle
  
  

* Implement Linux/database hardening, least-privilege access, privileged/service account reviews and vulnerability remediation.
* Plan and execute Linux patching, Oracle Release Updates, PostgreSQL updates and SQL Server Cumulative Updates.
* Track end-of-support versions and develop upgrade/migration plans; support audit evidence and compliance closure.

Monitoring, Incident & Problem Management
  
  

* Configure proactive monitoring and alerts for availability, resource utilization, storage capacity, replication, backup failures, locks and database growth.
* Own troubleshooting of P1/P2 production incidents, perform RCA and drive corrective/preventive actions.
* Participate in on-call support for business-critical production systems.

Automation, Change & Documentation
  
  

* Automate repeatable activities using Bash/Shell, SQL, PL/SQL and PowerShell; Python/Ansible exposure is desirable.
* Follow ITIL change management, prepare implementation/rollback/validation plans and participate in CAB as required.
* Maintain server/database inventory, architecture/topology diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, backup/DR procedures, patch schedules and capacity reports.

**Qualifications & Competencies**
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong hands-on Linux administration: RHEL / Oracle Linux, LVM, multipathing, NFS, SAN/NAS, systemd, SSH, TCP/IP, DNS, NTP and Shell scripting.
* Strong Oracle DBA skills: RMAN, Data Guard, AWR/ASH/ADDM, SQL tuning, patching, recovery, ASM; RAC knowledge preferred.
* Strong PostgreSQL skills: streaming replication, WAL, PITR, pg\_dump/pg\_restore, pg\_basebackup, Vacuum/Autovacuum, query optimization and upgrades.
* Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: Always On, backup/recovery, SQL Agent, performance tuning, indexes/statistics, blocking/deadlock analysis and patching.
