title: Assistant Manager - IT Infrastructure & Operations
description:
Skechers India is looking for a technically proficient and proactive Assistant Manager – IT Infrastructure & Operations to manage and support IT infrastructure at its National Distribution Centre (NDC) in Taloja, Navi Mumbai.
  
  
The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning, availability, and reliability of IT systems, networking infrastructure, warehouse technology devices, and end-user computing equipment critical to distribution center operations.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, effective troubleshooting capabilities, vendor coordination, and the ability to provide remote IT support to retail stores. The ideal candidate should have prior experience in warehouse or distribution center IT environments and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, business-critical operational setup.
  
  
**Designation:**
Assistant Manager
  
  
**Role:**
IT Infrastructure & Operations/ System Engineering
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology (IT)
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**Location:**
National Distribution Centre (NDC), Taloja, Navi Mumbai
  
  
**Reporting Manager:**
Manager – IT (Infrastructure & Operations)
  
  
**Experience:**
5+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's or Postgraduate Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Infrastructure Management & Operations
* Manage, maintain, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure across the National Distribution Centre.
* Ensure uninterrupted functioning of desktops, laptops, workstations, printers, scanners, monitors, and peripheral devices.
* Execute IT hardware installations, system upgrades, preventive maintenance, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, identify potential issues, and implement timely corrective measures.
* Support business continuity by minimizing IT-related disruptions to warehouse operations.
* Warehouse Technology & Device Support
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Zebra handheld terminals, barcode scanners, mobile computing devices, and thermal/label printers.
* Provide technical support for warehouse-specific IT equipment used in inventory management, scanning, dispatch, and logistics operations.
* Troubleshoot device connectivity, printing errors, hardware failures, and configuration-related issues.
* Coordinate with warehouse operations teams to ensure the availability and reliability of business-critical devices.
* Work with external vendors for device repairs, replacements, maintenance, and technical escalations.
* Network & Server Infrastructure
* Provide Level 1 technical support for LAN/WAN connectivity, network switches, Wi-Fi, VPN, and related networking infrastructure.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of Windows Servers, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity and system performance issues, escalating complex incidents to relevant teams.
* Coordinate with internal IT teams and service providers to ensure stable network connectivity across the distribution centre.
* Support routine infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, and configuration activities.
* End-User Support & IT Service Management
* Provide timely technical assistance to NDC employees and remote support to retail stores.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, system access, and connectivity-related issues.
* Manage IT support requests, track incidents, and ensure resolution within defined service-level expectations.
* Coordinate with relevant technical teams for escalations and recurring issues.
* Maintain service documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of IT support processes.
* Identity & Endpoint Management
* Support endpoint device enrollment, configuration, compliance, and troubleshooting using Microsoft Intune.
* Assist with user identity and access management through Okta, including Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
* Support user account provisioning, access-related troubleshooting, and device management activities in accordance with company IT policies.
* Coordinate with centralized IT teams to maintain endpoint security and access control standards.
* CCTV, Surveillance & Audio-Visual Systems
* Manage and troubleshoot CCTV infrastructure, Network Video Recorders (NVRs), IP cameras, and associated surveillance equipment.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and resolution of surveillance system issues.
* Support video conferencing platforms, meeting room displays, audio-visual equipment, and related connectivity.
* Liaise with vendors for installation, maintenance, and technical support of surveillance and AV systems.
* IT Asset Management & Vendor Coordination
* Maintain accurate records of IT assets, hardware allocation, warranties, and infrastructure inventory.
* Track IT equipment movement, replacement, and maintenance requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), warranty claims, repairs, installations, and infrastructure projects.
* Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of vendor-dependent technical issues.
* Prepare infrastructure status reports, asset records, and technical documentation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Support
* Work closely with Warehouse Operations, Supply Chain, Administration, Retail Operations, and central IT teams.
* Provide technical support during infrastructure changes, new installations, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants and technology partners for infrastructure-related activities.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve IT system reliability, operational efficiency, and user experience.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Postgraduate Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in IT Infrastructure, System Engineering, or IT Operations.
* Prior experience supporting IT infrastructure in a warehouse, logistics facility, distribution centre, or supply chain environment is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience supporting Zebra devices, handheld terminals, barcode scanners, and thermal/label printers.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, switches, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity.
* Practical exposure to Microsoft Intune, Okta, CCTV/NVR systems, and video conferencing equipment.
* Microsoft, CompTIA, or networking certifications will be an added advantage.

**Key Technical Skills**

* IT Infrastructure: Desktop and laptop support, Windows operating systems, hardware troubleshooting, and peripheral management.
* Warehouse IT Systems: Zebra devices, handheld terminals, barcode scanners, and thermal/label printers.
* Networking: LAN/WAN, switches, wireless connectivity, VPN, and Level 1 network troubleshooting.
* Server Administration: Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file server support.
* Endpoint & Identity Management: Microsoft Intune, Okta, SSO, MFA, and user access management.
* Surveillance & AV: CCTV, NVR, IP cameras, video conferencing, and meeting room equipment.
* IT Operations: Incident resolution, preventive maintenance, IT asset management, technical documentation, and vendor coordination.

**Key Behavioral Competencies**

* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a solution-oriented approach.
* Operational Ownership: Ability to independently manage day-to-day IT infrastructure requirements.
* Communication: Effective verbal and written communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to collaborate with internal departments, external vendors, and technical support teams.
* Time Management: Capability to prioritize multiple support requests and resolve critical issues promptly.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic warehouse and distribution centre environment.
* Accountability: High attention to detail, responsiveness, and commitment to maintaining system availability.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Availability and reliability of critical IT infrastructure and warehouse devices.
* Timely resolution of IT incidents and end-user support requests.
* Reduction in recurring hardware, printer, scanner, and network-related issues.
* Effectiveness of preventive maintenance and infrastructure support activities.
* Accuracy of IT asset records and infrastructure documentation.
* Timely resolution of vendor-related issues and maintenance requests.
* Adherence to IT security policies, operational procedures, and service-level expectations.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on IT Infrastructure professional with strong technical troubleshooting skills and experience supporting technology operations within a warehouse or distribution center.
  
  
The individual should have practical expertise in Zebra devices, barcode scanners, thermal printers, Windows systems, networking, and end-user support, along with working knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Okta, and surveillance infrastructure.
  
  
The candidate must be self-motivated, responsive, and capable of independently managing infrastructure-related issues while collaborating effectively with warehouse teams, corporate IT, and external service providers.
  
  
**Role Objective**
To ensure seamless, secure, and reliable IT infrastructure operations at Skechers India's National Distribution Centre by delivering effective technical support, maintaining business-critical warehouse technology, minimizing system downtime, and enabling uninterrupted supply chain and retail operations.
  
  
**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

* Strong experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA system administration.

* Experience with SAP installations, upgrades, kernel patching, and support packages.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Transport Management System (TMS).
* Working knowledge of SAP HANA database administration and performance monitoring.
* Experience in SAP system monitoring, troubleshooting, client administration, and system refreshes.
* Knowledge of SAP backup, recovery, and Disaster Recovery procedures.
* Understanding of SAP security, user administration, roles, and authorizations.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

**Educational Qualification**

* Good communication and coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve technical issues within defined timelines.

title: Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering
description:
**Do you enjoy working with cutting-edge technology?**
**Would you like to help shape the future of our global energy?**

**Join our team!**
Our Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team is responsible for the assembly of high-quality and innovative products.
  
  
**Partner with the best**
HPC Cloud Architects’ primary responsibilities are to establish the approach for integrating information applications, projects and programs and ensuring alignment with business strategies and drivers, and priorities relevant to Baker Hughes High-Performance Computing (HPC) portfolio.
  
  
As a Cloud DevOps Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:
  
  
  

* Architectural Design: Design and architect high-performance computing clusters and platforms on public cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). This includes selecting appropriate compute resources (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs), storage systems, and high-speed networking solutions.
* Solution Implementation: Implement and deploy cloud HPC solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible. This involves configuring virtual networks, setting up distributed file systems (like Lustre, GPFS, or Ceph), and deploying cluster management and job scheduling software (e.g., Slurm, PBS).
* Performance Optimization: Conduct performance analysis and benchmarking to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the HPC stack. Tune application code for parallel processing using paradigms like MPI (Message Passing Interface) and OpenMP, and optimize hardware and software configurations to maximize performance.
* Collaboration and Consultation: Work as a technical advisor to researchers, engineers, and data scientists, helping them migrate their workloads to the cloud, adopt best practices, and troubleshoot application-specific issues.
* Automation and Management: Develop and maintain automated solutions for provisioning, software deployment, monitoring, and scaling HPC resources. Implement robust backup, disaster recovery, and security protocols to ensure the integrity and availability of the systems.
* Strategic Planning: Stay current with emerging cloud and HPC technologies, influencing product roadmaps and developing strategic plans for the organization's cloud HPC adoption and growth.

**Fuel your passion**
To be successful in this role, you will have
  
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 10 + years’ experience
* Extensive experience with HPC system design and management, including hands-on experience with hardware (CPUs, GPUs, InfiniBand) and software (compilers, schedulers, parallel programming libraries).
* Deep understanding of parallel computing concepts and programming models (MPI, OpenMP, CUDA).
* Proficiency in performance analysis tools and techniques.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud services relevant to HPC, such as compute instances, high-performance storage, and networking.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with distributed file systems (Lustre, GPFS, Ceph) and job schedulers (Slurm, PBS).

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
  
  
**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Senior Proxy Engineer (Netskope / McAfee)

Bachelor's Degree

description:
Remarketing Manager – OTT, Lifecycle & Growth Marketing

**Rusk Media | Mumbai, Maharashtra | On-site**

**About Rusk Media**

Rusk Media is building the future of entertainment for the next generation. We create and distribute youth-first entertainment across the AVOD, SVOD and OTT ecosystem, combining original IPs, branded entertainment and digital-first storytelling. We are focused on building engaging entertainment experiences while continuously growing our audience and subscriber base.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a data-driven
**Remarketing Manager**
to own audience re-engagement, retention and monetisation initiatives across our digital entertainment ecosystem.

The role will focus on developing audience segmentation strategies, designing personalised and behaviour-driven campaigns, and driving repeat content consumption and subscriber conversions. The candidate will be responsible for engaging existing, inactive and at-risk users through targeted campaigns across the user lifecycle, ultimately improving retention, reactivation and revenue.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, remarketing, marketing automation and performance optimisation, preferably within OTT, media, entertainment or consumer internet businesses.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Remarketing & Lifecycle Strategy**

* Develop and execute remarketing strategies across different stages of the user lifecycle.
* Build audience segmentation frameworks based on user behaviour, engagement patterns, viewing history and subscription status.
* Identify inactive, dormant and at-risk users and develop targeted reactivation strategies.
* Create campaigns to improve repeat engagement and long-term user retention.

**2. Personalisation & Campaign Management**

* Design personalised, show-specific, genre-based and behaviour-driven campaigns to drive content discovery and consumption.
* Develop targeted campaigns based on viewing preferences, user activity, content interests and engagement history.
* Plan and execute campaigns across relevant channels such as Push Notifications, Email, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM channels.
* Ensure relevant content recommendations and messaging are delivered to the right audience at the right time.

**3. Retention & Monetisation**

* Drive repeat viewership, active users (DAU/MAU), subscriber conversions and subscription renewals.
* Develop strategies to improve user retention and reduce churn.
* Identify opportunities to monetise existing users through targeted campaigns, personalised content recommendations and subscription-led initiatives.
* Improve the overall user lifecycle journey from engagement and repeat consumption to subscription and renewal.

**4. Performance Tracking & Optimisation**

* Track and analyse campaign performance across reactivation, repeat views, conversions, retention and incremental revenue.
* Monitor campaign ROI and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
* Analyse user cohorts, engagement patterns and drop-off points to identify retention opportunities.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve campaign targeting and performance.

**5. Experimentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Conduct A/B testing across messaging, creatives, audience cohorts, campaign frequency, timing and offers.
* Experiment with different engagement strategies to improve campaign response and conversion rates.
* Identify successful campaign approaches and scale them across relevant audience segments.
* Work closely with Product, Data Analytics and Content teams to improve user engagement and lifecycle performance.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 4–7 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, remarketing, retention or growth marketing.
* Prior experience in OTT, media, entertainment, gaming, e-commerce or consumer internet businesses is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in audience segmentation, campaign automation, personalised marketing and user reactivation.
* Strong understanding of Push Notifications, Email Marketing, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM communication channels.
* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation and customer engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, user cohorts and engagement metrics.
* Understanding of user acquisition, retention, churn, subscriber conversion and monetisation metrics.
* Ability to independently plan, execute and optimise multiple campaigns.

**Key Success Metrics**

* User reactivation and repeat engagement
* DAU / MAU growth
* Repeat viewership and content consumption
* Subscriber conversion and renewals
* User retention and churn reduction
* Campaign ROI and incremental revenue

Write short category reports and summaries for pitches and strategy work.

Support research for new and existing clients when needed.

Street smart, with a sharp eye for small patterns that repeat across videos

Understands the Indian creator ecosystem, including creator types, tiers and what makes a reel work

Curious, and keeps asking why a video worked

Careful and structured with data, comfortable in Google Sheets

Honest about what the data does and does not say, and flags gaps instead of guessing

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Sia’s AI Factory (AIF), embedded directly within a client’s engineering, product, or service team. This role combines hands-on software engineering with client-facing delivery to close platform gaps and deliver production use cases. You will work within the client’s codebase and engineering standards, owning agreed deliverables from understanding requirements through deployment and handover.

* Document technical decisions and operational procedures, and provide knowledge transfer so the client’s team can maintain and operate the solution.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience: 3–6 years of software development experience, with a strong focus on Python backend development in production.

* Strong Python skills and experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or a comparable framework, including API design and system integrations.

* Ability to understand unfamiliar codebases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute production-quality code.

* Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, a cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing.

* Practical experience with RAG, LLM applications, or tool-calling workflows, including an understanding of retrieval, evaluation, and AI safety considerations.

* Comfort working within an embedded client team, clarifying ambiguous requirements, and taking ownership of agreed deliverables.

* Experience working within governed enterprise environments, including approved libraries and services, data access controls, and security review processes.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Internal Audit & Controls – Thematic, Forensic & Technology Audit
description:
**Join Our Internal Audit Team!**

We are expanding our team and looking for talented, motivated, and detail-oriented professionals to join our
**Internal Audit Department**
.

**Department:**
Internal Audit & Controls

**Qualification:**
CA/CIA/CMA/CISA/CFE

**1. Role Overview**

The role involves conducting risk-based internal audits, thematic audits, forensic reviews and technology-related audits across the organisation's business functions. The candidate should possess strong regulatory knowledge of the securities and capital markets industry, with in-depth understanding of retail broking operations, regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* **Thematic Audits:**
  Independently plan and execute thematic audits based on emerging risks, regulatory developments, business trends, control gaps and recurring audit observations.
* **Forensic Audits & Investigations:**
  Conduct preliminary investigations, transaction reviews, data analysis and forensic assessments relating to suspected fraud, employee misconduct, control circumvention, conflicts of interest and other irregularities.
* **Retail Broking Audits:**
  Conduct detailed audits of retail broking operations, including client onboarding, KYC, client funds and securities, RMS, dealing room operations, order execution, client complaints, surveillance, settlement and exchange-related compliance.
* **Business & Regulatory Audits:**
  Conduct audits across Institutional Broking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, AIF, Internal Audit, PMS and other applicable business functions, considering their respective regulatory and operational requirements.
* **Systems & Cyber Audits:**
  Assess IT general controls, application controls, user access management, privileged access, change management, information security, cybersecurity and data protection controls.
* **ISO & Control Frameworks:**
  Evaluate adherence to applicable ISO standards, information security frameworks, documented policies, procedures and internal control requirements.
* **Regulatory Compliance:**
  Assess compliance with applicable SEBI regulations, stock exchange and depository requirements, circulars, internal policies and other relevant regulatory obligations.
* **Risk Assessment & Reporting:**
  Identify control weaknesses, assess inherent and residual risks, establish root causes and recommend practical corrective actions.
* **Audit Closure & ATR Monitoring:**
  Track audit observations, validate management action plans, monitor overdue items and assess the effectiveness of corrective actions.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Prepare audit reports, thematic review findings, risk summaries and presentations for senior management and relevant governance forums.
* **Data Analytics:**
  Use data-driven techniques to identify unusual transactions, patterns, exceptions and potential control failures.

**3. Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* Demonstrable experience in thematic audits —
  **mandatory**
  .
* Strong and in-depth knowledge of retail broking operations and the Indian securities market.
* Working knowledge of regulatory requirements applicable to retail and institutional broking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, AIF and PMS.
* Experience in forensic audits, investigations, fraud risk assessment or transaction reviews.
* Exposure to system audits, cybersecurity reviews, IT general controls and application controls.
* Knowledge of ISO standards and information security/control frameworks.
* Strong analytical, documentation, report-writing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage audits from planning and execution through reporting and closure.
* Proficiency in Excel and audit data analysis; experience with analytics or audit automation tools is an advantage.

**4. Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates with experience in a stockbroker, securities firm, financial services organisation, Big Four or reputed risk advisory/internal audit firm will be preferred.
* Candidates should demonstrate professional scepticism, integrity, independence, sound judgement and the ability to challenge business practices constructively.

We’re not looking for someone who “does content.”

We’re looking for someone who
*thinks in content*
. Breathes it. Obsesses over it.

If your brain automatically rewrites ads while scrolling Instagram… this is for you.

We would prefer young blokes with less than 4 years experience, even if you are in your college but can deliver, just ping us. You never know!

  .

We don’t care:

We care:

  **come up with 10 solid hooks in 10 minutes?**

  **break down why something goes viral?**

  **turn a boring product into something people want to watch?**

Basically — can you

.

* Writing like a human, not like a brand guideline PDF

  **internet culture, memes, and timing**

  **insanely curious**
  — going 5 layers deeper than surface-level ideas

If you need step-by-step instructions daily — not for you.

We want to see how you think — not just what you’ve done.

:

The Delivery Team is a diverse group of early-to-mid career professionals with a solid foundation of utility experience and knowledge. **Key Responsibilities**
The Testing Engineer is responsible for executing system-level testing activities to validate that solutions meet defined functional and non-functional requirements. This role ensures quality assurance through structured test execution, comprehensive test case development, traceability management, and disciplined defect lifecycle management. The Testing Engineer works closely with project teams, SMEs, and vendors to drive issue resolution and maintain transparency into system quality through effective reporting.
  
  
**System Test Execution**

* Execute system, integration, and acceptance test cases in accordance with approved test plans and schedules

**Defect Management and Triage Facilitation**

* Log, track, and manage defects through a centralized defect management tool

* Collaborate with developers, SMEs, and vendors to support defect resolution, retesting, and closure
* Ensure defects are properly linked to originating test cases and requirements

**Test Reporting & Quality Metrics**

* Produce regular test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality metrics for project stakeholders
* Track and communicate test progress, risks, and system readiness
* Provide insights into defect trends, coverage status, and exit criteria readiness

**Advanced Technology & Automation Skills**

* Demonstrate fluency in AI technologies, large language model (LLM) APIs, autonomous agent development, and software testing automation frameworks to enhance testing efficiency and quality

title: Organizational Psychologist

Holistic Mind Therapy is a mental health organisation committed to providing ethical, compassionate, and professional psychological services. We believe that a healthy workplace, effective leadership, and employee well-being are essential for organisational growth.

We are looking for an Industrial Psychologist who can manage our HR operations, improve employee performance, strengthen workplace culture, and develop effective systems to support the organisation's growth.

The Industrial Psychologist will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, training, policy implementation, and exit formalities.

The ideal candidate should understand human behaviour in organisational settings and be able to apply psychological principles to improve employee productivity, workplace relationships, motivation, and overall organisational effectiveness.

* Manage the complete recruitment process, from identifying hiring requirements to candidate selection and onboarding.
* Prepare job descriptions, screen applications, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate subsequent interview rounds.
* Develop structured interview processes and selection criteria.
* Assess candidates for role suitability, behavioural competencies, and organisational fit using appropriate methods.
* Maintain recruitment records and build a pipeline of potential candidates.

* Maintain HR records and ensure timely completion of administrative processes.

* Work with team members to improve efficiency, ownership, time management, and consistency.

* Conduct employee check-ins and engagement initiatives.
* Identify concerns related to workplace stress, communication, interpersonal conflicts, and job satisfaction.
* Support conflict resolution and facilitate constructive workplace communication.
* Recommend interventions to improve employee morale, retention, and organisational culture.

5. Learning and Development

* Plan and coordinate employee training, induction, and development initiatives.

* Establish clear systems for accountability, reporting, feedback, and performance monitoring.
* Ensure HR practices comply with applicable employment laws and workplace requirements.
* Prepare periodic reports on recruitment, performance, retention, engagement, and other relevant HR metrics.

**About Dreamtime Learning**

Dreamtime Learning is reimagining education through the Online School, Dreamtime Hubs, PoweredBy Dreamtime, and the Dreamtime Community.

We believe learning extends beyond classrooms. The Dreamtime Community brings children, parents, educators, schools, and experts together through events, workshops, evening classes, partnerships, and innovative learning experiences.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Head of Dreamtime Community to transform this vision into a vibrant, growing, and financially sustainable movement.

**The Opportunity**

This is a builder's role for someone who enjoys creating something from the ground up. You will shape the community strategy, build partnerships, design online and offline experiences, launch evening learning programs, and develop new revenue streams.

The long-term vision is to build strong Dreamtime Communities across cities, eventually creating physical community spaces wherever the movement reaches sufficient scale.

1.
**Community Building & Events**

Build and manage an annual calendar of online and offline community events.

Organise workshops, webinars, competitions, showcases, meetups, and family engagement activities.

Grow community participation, engagement, and repeat attendance.

**2. Partnerships & External Collaboration**

Build relationships with schools, international institutions, specialist instructors, and organisations.

Develop collaborations across arts, sports, robotics, animation, and other learning disciplines.

Establish long-term partnerships that expand Dreamtime's reach and offerings.

**3. Learning Programs – Free & Paid**

Curate and commission engaging learning experiences for children and families.

Develop free community initiatives to build awareness and paid programs to generate revenue.

Ensure programs reflect Dreamtime Learning's philosophy and educational values.

**4. Evening Community Classes**

Launch and scale evening classes for children who are not enrolled in Dreamtime's Online School or Hubs.

Develop learning cohorts, drive enrolments, and improve retention.

Create pathways for families to engage more deeply with Dreamtime Learning.

**5. B2B Partnerships & Revenue Generation**

Identify and acquire schools, institutions, and organisations for community learning programs.

Build a pipeline of prospective partners and convert opportunities into revenue-generating partnerships.

Own partnership negotiations, relationship management, and commercial outcomes.

**6. Community-to-Enrolment Conversion**

Develop initiatives that convert community participation into Online School enrolments.

Track leads, referrals, and enrolments attributable to events and campaigns.

Work with internal teams to strengthen the community-to-enrolment journey.

**7. Community Growth & Expansion**

Build a measurable, engaged, and active Dreamtime Community.

Monitor participation, growth, retention, revenue, and program performance.

Identify cities with the potential to support dedicated physical Dreamtime Community spaces.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience in community building, event management, partnerships, business development, or audience growth.

* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to own revenue targets.
* Excellent planning, coordination, and execution skills.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias for action.
* A genuine interest in education, children's learning, and building meaningful communities.

* Community growth, engagement, and repeat participation.
* Delivery of planned online and offline events.
* Evening class enrolments and learner retention.
* Number and quality of active partnerships.
* Revenue generated through paid programs, events, and B2B partnerships.

What you would prioritise in your first 90 days at Dreamtime Community.

**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. **About the Role**

You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

title: Product Design Engineer
description:
**This is a Cactus International position and is located in India.**

**JOB SUMMARY:**

the UX engineer / product design engineer is responsible for designing, validating, and delivering user-centered digital experiences that effectively support business processes and product goals. this role combines deep user experience design expertise with strong design-system thinking and practical technical knowledge to ensure solutions are intuitive for end users and feasible for engineering teams.

the ideal candidate is a primeng-first designer with extensive experience using primeng v19+, figma, and enterprise ux principles to create scalable, reusable, and consistent experiences. they must be capable of translating business requirements into production-ready designs using standard primeng components, minimizing customization while maximizing usability, maintainability, and development efficiency.

This role plays a critical part in improving user adoption, reducing workflow friction, driving consistency across products, and transforming business data into meaningful dashboard-driven insights.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, ROLES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Essential duties and responsibilities include the following.

* Conduct user research activities including stakeholder interviews, contextual inquiries, surveys, workshops, and usability testing to understand user needs, behaviors, pain points, and business objectives.
* Analyze business processes and translate requirements into user journeys, workflow diagrams, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
* Design intuitive, accessible, responsive, and visually appealing enterprise applications using a PrimeNG-first design approach.

* Develop and maintain reusable design systems, Figma component libraries, templates, and UX patterns to ensure consistency and scalability.
* Promote design reusability, standardization, and uniform user experiences across products and modules.
* Transform traditional data tables and operational reports into meaningful dashboard experiences with actionable insights and KPI-driven visualizations.
* Ensure solutions meet accessibility standards (WCAG), responsiveness requirements, and enterprise design standards.
* Partner with development teams to ensure accurate design-to-code implementation and component compliance.
* Support image, icon, and visual asset preparation for digital products using appropriate design tools.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, demos, retrospectives, and design reviews.
* Continuously evaluate user feedback, product usage patterns, and stakeholder input to identify optimization opportunities.
* Advocate for component-driven design, reusable UX patterns, and design system adoption across teams.
* Ensure minimal customization of PrimeNG components and maximize the use of standard platform capabilities.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree in User Experience Design, Human‑Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

**EXPERIENCE**

* 5-8 years of professional experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, Product Design Engineering, or UX Engineering roles.
* Proven experience designing enterprise software, SaaS platforms, industrial applications, ERP systems, operational systems, or other complex business applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Figma and design system management.
* Proven experience designing solutions using PrimeNG v19+ components and patterns.
* Experience transforming business requirements into production-ready designs.
* Experience conducting user research and usability testing activities.
* Experience creating reusable design systems and component libraries.
* Experience converting operational data and tabular information into dashboard-driven user experiences.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum product teams.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, and Business Stakeholders.
* Experience supporting design-to-development workflows and implementation reviews.
* Understanding of enterprise software development practices and front-end implementation considerations.

**CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

* UX Certification (NN/g, HFI, UXQB, or equivalent)
* Human-Centered Design Certifications

**JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:**

**Job Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, usability heuristics, interaction design standards, and design thinking methodologies.
* Deep knowledge of PrimeNG v19+ components, capabilities, and implementation patterns.
* Understanding of component-driven design systems and reusable UX architecture.
* Knowledge of business process modeling and how digital systems support operational workflows.
* Strong understanding of dashboard design, information hierarchy, and data visualization principles.

* Understanding of Agile software delivery methodologies.

title: UI Path Automation Test Engineer
description:

UI path Developer for Testing Automation for thick clients will design, build and execute automated test solutions for the application platform using UiPath Test Suite, covering functional, regression, integration and upgrade testing. The role is responsible for converting the existing manual regression pack into a reusable, maintainable automation suite, integrating it into CI/CD pipelines, and providing reliable, repeatable test coverage across Loan IQ releases, enhancements and interfacing applications.

**Responsibilities:**

Test Automation Design & Development:

* Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts and reusable components using UiPath Studio / UiPath Test Suite.
* Build and maintain an object repository and data-driven automation framework covering thick client and web-based screens (thick client automation).
* Automate the regression pack across core modules – Customer, Deal, Facility, Outstanding, Drawdowns, Payments, Fees, Interest, Accruals, Notices and Batch processing.
* Parameterise test data and manage test data set-up to enable repeatable execution across SIT, UAT and pre-production environments

Test Execution & Defect Management:

* Plan and execute automated regression, smoke and sanity cycles for Loan IQ patches, hot fixes, version upgrades and enhancement releases.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Title:**
Technical Systems Administrator (Zoho / Asterisk Telephony / Employee Monitoring)

**Location:**
On-site – Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Systems Administrator to own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and reliability of three core platforms that power our contact center, recruiting, and back-office operations: the
**Zoho ecosystem (including Zoho Learn LMS)**
, our
**Asterisk-based telephony and dialer environment**
, and our
**employee monitoring and productivity software**
.

You will be the go-to technical owner for these systems on-site in Navi Mumbai — keeping users productive, agents dialing, training on track, and data flowing accurately between platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1) Zoho Ecosystem & Zoho Learn LMS Administration**

* Administer Zoho One apps including Zoho CRM, Zoho Recruit, Zoho Creator, Zoho Desk, Zoho People, and Zoho Analytics: users, roles, profiles, permissions, and data-sharing rules.
* Configure and maintain Zoho Learn LMS: courses, learning paths, manuals, quizzes/assessments, certifications, enrollments, and completion tracking for agent onboarding and ongoing training.
* Build and maintain workflow rules, blueprints, layouts, custom fields, approval processes, and Zoho Flow automations; write and troubleshoot Deluge scripts and custom functions.
* Manage integrations between Zoho apps and third-party systems using Zoho REST APIs and webhooks; monitor sync health and resolve data issues.
* Produce training-compliance and user-adoption reports and dashboards; run data imports, cleanups, and deduplication.

**2) Telephony Dialer Administration – Asterisk**

* Install, configure, and maintain Asterisk PBX and Asterisk-based dialer platforms (e.g., VICIdial, FreePBX, GoAutoDial) on Linux servers.
* Manage SIP trunks, carriers, extensions, IVRs, inbound groups, queues, campaigns, lists, dispositions, and call routing/dial plans.
* Configure predictive, progressive, and preview dialing modes; tune dial levels, drop rates, and AMD settings to balance productivity and compliance.
* Monitor call quality (latency, jitter, packet loss); troubleshoot one-way audio, registration, NAT, and codec issues; analyze CDRs and SIP traces.
* Maintain call recording storage, DNC list management, time-zone calling windows, and caller ID configuration; perform backups, patching, and security hardening (fail2ban, firewall rules).

**3) Employee Monitoring & Productivity Software Administration**

* Deploy, configure, and administer employee monitoring and productivity platforms (e.g., Teramind, ActivTrak, Hubstaff, Time Doctor, Insightful, or similar).
* Roll out and maintain endpoint agents across Windows/macOS workstations; manage groups, policies, productive/unproductive app and website classifications, and alert rules.
* Build and distribute daily/weekly productivity, attendance, idle-time, and utilization reports for team leads and management.
* Investigate policy alerts and data anomalies; partner with HR and operations on usage policies, data-privacy settings, and audit requests.
* Integrate monitoring data with Zoho People/Analytics and payroll/attendance workflows where applicable.

**Cross-Functional**

* Serve as on-site Tier 2/Tier 3 support for these platforms; manage tickets, escalations, and vendor support cases.
* Write and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and system documentation; train end users and team leads.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, access reviews, and data-security best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  3–5+ years of hands-on systems administration experience in a contact center, BPO, or multi-platform business environment.
* **Zoho:**
  Proven administration experience across Zoho One applications; working knowledge of Deluge scripting, workflows, and Zoho APIs. Zoho Learn experience strongly preferred.
* **Telephony:**
  Practical experience administering Asterisk and/or Asterisk-based dialers (VICIdial, FreePBX, GoAutoDial), SIP, and VoIP troubleshooting.
* **Linux:**
  Comfort with Linux server administration (CentOS/Rocky/Ubuntu), command line, MySQL/MariaDB basics, and shell scripting.
* **Monitoring Software:**
  Experience deploying and managing at least one employee monitoring or workforce productivity platform.
* **Networking:**
  Solid understanding of TCP/IP, NAT, firewalls, VLANs, and QoS for voice traffic.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to work on-site in Navi Mumbai.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Zoho Certified Administrator/Developer, Asterisk (dCAP) or VICIdial certification, or Linux certifications (RHCSA, LPIC).
* Experience with LMS content design, SCORM, or training program administration.
* Familiarity with outbound calling compliance (TCPA, DNC, calling-hour rules) and data-privacy frameworks.
* Scripting or development experience in PHP, Python, or JavaScript for integrations and automation.
* Background supporting US-based clients or operating in a 24/7 contact center environment.

**Why Join Us**

* Own critical systems end-to-end with real impact on daily operations.
* Work across a modern stack spanning CRM, LMS, telephony, and workforce analytics.
* Growth path into senior systems, telephony engineering, or platform architecture roles.

description:
**Job Summary**

**Responsibilities**

* Lead complex consulting engagements for financial institutions focused on modernizing cross border payment flows using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards to achieve measurable gains in efficiency and compliance.

* Provide detailed advisory on migration strategies from existing SWIFT MT based processes toward ISO XML 20022 formats ensuring continuity of business operations and minimal disruption to clients.
* Drive design of target state payment messaging architectures that integrate SWIFT services core banking systems and downstream applications to support scalable and resilient transaction processing.
* Coordinate with product owners architects and operations teams to define functional and nonfunctional requirements for new or enhanced payment and messaging solutions aligned to client priorities.

* Guide testing strategies for payment messaging transformations including creation of test scenarios validation of message mapping and resolution of defects impacting transaction quality or timeliness.
* Analyze operational and financial metrics related to payment volumes straight through processing rates and exception handling to recommend targeted process improvements.
* Collaborate with risk and compliance stakeholders to ensure that SWIFT payment and messaging solutions adhere to regulatory expectations information security standards and industry best practices.
* Present concise and insightful findings to client management teams highlighting business impacts associated with messaging changes and providing clear recommendations for phased implementation.
* Support internal capability development by sharing knowledge on SWIFT MT standards ISO XML 20022 message structures and leading practices in payment transformation across consulting teams.

**Qualifications**

* Possess a strong foundation in SWIFT MT messages including understanding of core financial message types their fields and associated processing flows across correspondent banking networks.
* Demonstrate practical experience with ISO XML 20022 messages covering payment initiation clearing settlement and reporting structures as applied to real world implementations for financial institutions.
* Apply working knowledge of SWIFT payment and messages platforms including connectivity options and interface mechanisms to advise on optimal integration approaches with client systems.
* Bring proven consulting experience within financial services or payments domains spanning at least nine years with responsibility for delivering complex client projects and achieving defined outcomes.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Waystone is a leading provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to the asset management industry. With over 25 years’ experience, we support many of the world’s largest asset managers, providing a comprehensive range of specialist services from a global network of offices.
  
  
The Platform Engineering team builds and operates Waystone’s engineering platform, spanning cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, on-call and our internal developer portal. We provide the secure, automated foundations that the firm’s regulated services run on. We are looking for a Platform Engineer to help scale this platform through standardised, automated and compliant patterns, accelerating delivery for our development delivery teams while raising operational resilience across the estate.
  
  
We are a cross-skilled team by design: rather than narrow specialisation, we want every engineer able to work across the platform, giving us broader coverage, resilience and shared ownership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Take ownership of larger, moderately complex pieces of platform work, setting objectives and delivering against project goals with a direct impact on team results.
* Design, implement and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure patterns and reusable Terraform modules across Azure, AWS and OCI, with a primary focus on Azure.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) libraries to ensure consistent, compliant and repeatable environments across all cloud providers.
* Build and support CI/CD and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy and ArgoCD, and configuration management using Ansible and Octopus Deploy.
* Support and enable development delivery teams – provisioning autonomous environments and reducing deployment friction while maintaining guardrails and separation of duties.
* Provide operational support for containerised and micro-service workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), maintaining high availability and reliability.
* Manage core infrastructure lifecycle tasks – vulnerability remediation and patching, upgrades, scaling and decommissioning across the Windows and Linux estate.
* Drive the adoption of cloud governance policies, security standards and architectural best practice, and help maintain continuous compliance evidence against the firm’s obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DORA).
* Contribute to observability and monitoring across the estate, and to incident response and on-call, including troubleshooting and root cause analysis that drives systemic improvement.
* Support disaster recovery testing to validate recovery plans and ensure rapid, reliable restoration of services.
* Identify and recommend improvements to systems, processes and infrastructure patterns to improve operational resilience, performance and cost efficiency.
* Explain and advocate technical approaches to development delivery teams and colleagues across IT, influencing platform practices and standards at an operational level.
* Provide guidance, code review and support to junior engineers, helping them develop across the platform.
* Document infrastructure blueprints, standards and standard operating procedures in Confluence and our internal Platform Portal to enable self-service.
* Participate in the on-call rota to support critical infrastructure services.

**Essential Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (e.g. B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with a minimum of three years’ experience as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role.
* Strong experience designing and implementing infrastructure in Azure and AWS.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Experience building and debugging CI/CD and deployment pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps or similar).
* Strong Windows OS management in cloud environments; solid Linux fundamentals (deeper experience a plus).
* Proficient in a scripting language such as PowerShell, with experience automating operational workflows.
* Sound understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management (Entra ID / IAM) and network security.
* Understanding of application architectures and CI/CD workflows, and how infrastructure aligns with them.
* Experience working closely with development delivery teams in an agile environment, using tooling such as Jira and Confluence to manage and track work.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
* AI-literate, with the ability to adopt and apply AI-assisted engineering tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants and agents) to accelerate delivery, automation and documentation, and a willingness to keep pace with an evolving AI toolset.
* Able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams – balancing project delivery, BAU and support commitments – prioritising effectively and working independently across competing demands.
* Comfortable collaborating with UK-based colleagues across time zones as part of a global team.
* Able to participate in the on-call rota – on-call is a requirement of this role.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience operating in a regulated financial services or otherwise highly governed environment.
* Certification in Azure, AWS or DevOps practices.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (AKS), ArgoCD and containerised services.
* Experience with Ansible for configuration management and DR tooling.
* Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-management best practice.
* Experience integrating AI or agentic tooling into engineering workflows (e.g. IaC generation, automated remediation, or documentation).
* Exposure to compliance-evidence or governance tooling and incident-management tooling.

Additional Information
  
  

* Participation in the on-call rota is a requirement of this role; standing on-call allowances apply.
* Opportunities for professional growth, including certifications in Azure, AWS and DevOps practices, within a deliberately cross-skilled team.
* You will join a global, collaborative team that values innovation, ownership and continuous learning, with a direct impact on the resilience of the firm’s platforms.

* Prepare SOP's, technical validation evidence and deployment-related documentation.
* Support the migration and deployment of integrations across Development, Test/UAT and Production environments.

* Maintain technical documentation, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides and knowledge-based articles.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in enterprise application integration, Oracle Cloud integration development/support or a comparable technical role.
* Hands-on experience developing, testing and supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Practical experience with application-driven, scheduled and file-based OIC integration patterns.
* Experience configuring and working with OIC components such as Connections, Integrations, Lookups, Packages and Schedules.
* Working knowledge and practical experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and/or HCM integrations.
* Strong practical experience with REST APIs, SOAP web services and SFTP/file-based integration mechanisms.
* Good working knowledge of XML and JSON, including data mapping, transformation and validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and integration-support activities.
* Practical experience using tools such as Postman for REST/SOAP API testing and request/response analysis.
* Experience troubleshooting OIC integrations using Activity Streams, error messages, payloads and application logs.
* Good understanding of integration fault handling, exception management, transaction recovery, reprocessing and reconciliation.
* Experience supporting production incidents and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for integration-related issues.
* Practical exposure to SIT, UAT, regression testing, deployment and post-production validation activities.
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP APIs and BI Publisher (BIP) integration/reporting patterns.
* Exposure to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and enterprise authentication/connectivity concepts would be advantageous.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare clear technical documentation, SOPs, support runbooks and troubleshooting guidance.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities independently, take ownership of technical issues and work effectively within established change, release and operational processes.

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
Repligen is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Support Engineer II to join our dedicated Service team. This role is responsible for providing technical support to customers, field service engineers, commercial teams, and internal stakeholders using Repligen bioprocessing products and technologies.
  
  
As a Technical Support Engineer II, you will help ensure customer success by responding to technical inquiries, supporting troubleshooting activities, documenting customer issues, and collaborating with internal teams to drive cases toward resolution. This position is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, excellent communication skills, and an interest in developing expertise in bioprocessing equipment, service support, and customer-facing technical problem solving.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support:**
Provide timely and effective technical support to customers and Repligen team members via phone, email, video conferencing, and other communication channels. Support troubleshooting of product hardware, software, process, and system-related inquiries.
  
  
Product Knowledge: Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of Repligen’s product portfolio, bioprocessing applications, system components, operating software, and related technologies.
  
  
**Customer Engagement:**
Communicate professionally with customers and internal stakeholders to understand reported issues, gather necessary information, provide updates, and support a positive customer experience.
  
  
**Troubleshooting and Problem Solving**
: Assist in analyzing and diagnosing technical issues, identifying possible causes, recommending next steps, and guiding customers or internal teams through the resolution process.
  
  
**Case Management and Documentation:**
Manage support cases using Salesforce to document customer inquiries, troubleshooting steps, technical findings, communications, and resolution details. Ensure case records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with internal procedures.
  
  
**Technical Documentation:**
Assist in creating, reviewing, and updating technical documentation, including troubleshooting guides, FAQs, technical notes, work instructions, manuals, and internal knowledge articles.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
Work closely with Technical Support, Field Service, Service Scheduling, Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Sales, and other internal teams to support customer issue resolution and communicate product feedback.
  
  
**Service Coordination:**
Support coordination of follow-up activities, including replacement part requests, RMA support, field service dispatch requests, and escalation of unresolved or complex technical issues.
  
  
**Training and Development:**
Participate in product training, technical workshops, and internal knowledge-sharing activities to build technical proficiency and improve customer support capability.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Identify recurring customer issues, documentation gaps, support process improvements, and opportunities to improve the customer and field service support experience.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree and or equivalent related experience in a relevant field (e.g., Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Life Sciences or Engineering related).
* A minimum of 3 years of experience supporting bioprocessing equipment, biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations, process development, applications, technical support, field service, or related life sciences activities.
* Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues using a structured and logical approach.
* Experience with or knowledge of tangential flow filtration (TFF), automation platforms, and related life sciences technologies is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with Repligen's Systems portfolio including KrosFlo KR2i, KMPi, RS Systems, FS15, FS500, and related filtration and process control technologies is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal/written communications skills and attention to detail are required.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM/service management systems to manage customer support activities.
* Experience with creating and updating technical documentation (Protocols, manuals, SOPs, work instructions, etc.)
* Experience installing, configuring, troubleshooting, or supporting software applications associated with bioprocessing equipment and automated manufacturing systems is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to interpret software alarms, system diagnostics, event logs, communication errors, and equipment-generated data to support technical investigations and issue resolution.
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals, Windows operating systems, software deployment, and remote support tools is beneficial.
* Familiarity with, or proficiency in, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and other life sciences related regulations is highly beneficial.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work well within a global, cross functional team.
* Ability to prioritize and work independently to achieve defined goals.
* Must be fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven experience supporting customers throughout Asia-Pacific markets.
* Additional proficiency in Japanese, Mandarin Chinese, or Korean is considered an advantage.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for customer site visits and training.

title: ACI NOC L2 Engineer  | BFSI | Immediate
description:
ACI Noc L2 Engineer | BFSI
  
  
Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
  
  
Shift: 24×7 rotational shifts
  
  
Priority - BFSI Domain
  
  
Role: Data Center – Cisco ACI L2 Engineer
  
  
Certification- CCNP
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled DC-ACI L2 Engineer with hands-on experience in Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI), data center networking, Cisco Nexus switches, VXLAN, and IP/MPLS technologies. The candidate will be responsible for supporting, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing data center network infrastructure while ensuring high availability and performance.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Cisco data center products, ACI architecture, routing and switching protocols, and ACI migration activities. The candidate must be comfortable working in customer environments and collaborating with cross-functional technical teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Plan, design, implement, operate, troubleshoot, and optimize Cisco networking and data center infrastructure.
* Provide L2 technical support for Cisco ACI networks, data center operations, and related networking technologies.
* Configure and troubleshoot Cisco ACI components, including Tenants, VRFs, Bridge Domains (BDs), Endpoint Groups (EPGs), Contracts, Subnets, and L2Out/L3Out.
* Support VXLAN-based data center fabrics, ACI migrations, and network modernization projects.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues involving routing, switching, virtualization, security, firewalls, load balancers, and related infrastructure.
* Support hardware and software upgrades, Proofs of Concept (POCs), and network change activities.
* Work with Cisco TAC, third-party vendors, and internal technical teams to resolve critical incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis, incident management, configuration changes, and network optimization.
* Maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, change records, and operational procedures.
* Ensure network availability, performance, and compliance with customer requirements.
* Work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment and participate in customer-facing technical coordination.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Cisco ACI & Data Center Networking – Mandatory
* Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and VXLAN technologies.
* Knowledge of ACI architecture and components: Tenant, VRF, BD, EPG, Subnet, Contracts, L2Out, and L3Out.
* Experience in ACI migration, implementation, troubleshooting, and data center operations.
* Knowledge of Cisco Nexus product families, including Nexus 9000, 7000, 5000, 3000, 2000, and 1000 series.
* Understanding of vPC, VDC, MEC, orphan port management, and redundancy mechanisms.
* Routing & Switching
* Strong understanding of BGP, OSPF, Static Routing, BFD, PIM, and multicast routing.
* Knowledge of VLANs, STP, VTP, ACLs, HSRP, VRRP, and IP SLA.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, IPSec, PPP, SNMP, IGMP, and Spanning Tree Protocol.
* Strong knowledge of IP/MPLS and data center migration concepts.
* Cisco Networking Platforms
* Cisco ASR 9000 series – IOS XR.
* Cisco ASR 1000 series – IOS/IOS XE.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus platforms and data center switching technologies.
* Multi-Vendor Networking
* Working knowledge of Cisco, Huawei, and Arista networking devices.
* Exposure to Aruba wireless solutions is an added advantage.
* Additional Advantageous Skills
* Experience with L4–L7 load balancing solutions.
* Knowledge of firewalls and network security technologies.
* Experience with virtualization and cross-functional data center infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Exposure to Proof of Concepts (POCs), software/hardware upgrades, and network migration projects.

**Required Qualifications**

* Relevant degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Relevant Cisco networking certifications such as CCNA or CCNP are preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical teams in a customer-facing environment.

Key Mandatory Skills
  
  
Cisco ACI | VXLAN | Cisco Nexus | IP/MPLS | ACI Migration | Data Center Operations | Routing & Switching
  
  
Candidates must have hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and VXLAN and be comfortable working in 24×7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Skills: switching,routing,cisco,data center,nexus,mpls,noc,network operations center (noc),aci
