description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our India Digital team at Marsh Business and Client Services function. This role will be based in Mumbai while requiring traveling across cities for client and internal meetings. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Digital Client Experience Leader Insurance Operations
  
  

* This is fantastic opportunity to drive the digital agenda for one of the worlds leading Insurance Broker, across our Specialty, Corporate & Risk Management businesses
* This role is responsible for working closely with regional and global digital team to understand the various digital offerings which needs to be marketed and rolled out for Marsh clients in India.
* You will work closely with our brokers and client teams for driving better Client outcomes and greater efficiency through deployment of digital technology

**We will rely on you to:**

* Partner with multiple digital teams across Marsh to understand our digital value proposition thereby build compelling value proposition for Indian clients.
* Collaborate with relevant business stakeholders to understand their focus areas and client needs, using these insights to design and tailor fit-for-purpose digital campaigns that support the business and align with the overall digital marketing strategy.
* Build compelling marketing propositions and plans that helps drive adoption of digital solutions.
* Work closely with the cross functional teams to leverage all aspects of digital agenda to enable enhanced client / prospect engagement, enhancing UX and engagement levels across the tools thus deliver an impactful client journey.
* Drive internal digital and AI initiatives targeted towards colleague adoption of digital and AI tools
* Foster collaboration across the various cross functional teams, regionally and globally ensuring successful outcomes.
* Actively engage key internal stakeholders, including client executive teams, to create advocates, generate engagement, and amplify campaign activity, ensuring strategic alignment with Go-to-Market strategies, sales materials, and Request for Proposal language to drive commercial success.
* Monitor and communicate progress against digital goals at both client and campaign levels.
* Build awareness and understanding of the wider marketplace to identify opportunities for timely and topical initiatives on digital and AI.
* Responsible for supporting the business in creating and updating digital value propositions and product and solutions collateral.

**What you need to have:**

* Minimum 15 years experience overall. Experience working in a medium to large, complex, and matrixed environment, collaborating with a wide variety of stakeholders to develop and execute digital and communications strategies, campaigns, and tactics.
* Extensive experience in roll out of digital tools, digital analytics, and proving ROI, enabling maximized commercial success.
* Significant stakeholder management experience with gravitas and credibility
* Team-oriented and highly motivated self-starter with a proven track record for collaboration within and across teams.
* Strong track record of independent leadership and influencing skills with proven experience of acting as a change agent to transform the ways of working

**What makes you stand out:**

* You will be comfortable managing multiple complex stakeholder groups to support the delivery of results
* You will be digital literate, with a good understanding and track record of implementing new digital tools.
* Ability to understand, tailor, and communicate complex business, legal, and technical issues for various audiences.
* Proven ability to build a team without direct reporting lines through coaching, credibility, and leadership.
* Proven ability to serve as a trusted and influential advisor and counselor to senior executives, cultivating meaningful relationships with senior leaders and individuals of influence.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Brand Manager in Mumbai
description:
We are looking for a creative, strategic, and highly organised Brand Manager for Real Estate to manage branding, marketing campaigns, and client servicing for our real estate clients. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of residential and commercial real estate marketing, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects while coordinating with internal creative teams and clients.

* Develop and execute branding and marketing strategies for real estate projects.
* Maintain brand consistency across digital, print, outdoor, and on-ground marketing.
* Understand project positioning, target audiences, USPs, and market competition.
* Contribute creative campaign ideas for project launches, promotions, and brand-building activities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned real estate clients.

* Conduct regular client meetings, presentations, and campaign reviews.
* Manage client feedback, approvals, and expectations professionally.

* Ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with business objectives.
* Work closely with graphic designers, video editors, copywriters, and digital marketing teams.

* Review creatives, videos, captions, brochures, and other marketing materials before client submission.
* Ensure timely execution of deliverables and revisions.
* Understand residential and commercial real estate projects, including project specifications, amenities, location advantages, and target buyers.
* Coordinate marketing communication for project launches, leasing campaigns, and property sales.
* Develop marketing collateral such as brochures, presentations, hoardings, digital creatives, and site branding.
* Ensure marketing communication follows applicable RERA advertising requirements.
* Maintain project trackers, deadlines, and approval records.
* Prepare weekly progress updates and monthly marketing reports.
* Monitor campaign performance with the digital marketing team.
* Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility, campaign effectiveness, and client satisfaction.

title: Search Industry Manager, Consumer Packaged Goods
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of industry experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, business development, or digital marketing, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.
* Experience working with advertisers, agencies, or clients.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in stakeholder management.
* Experience in cross-functional project management.
* Experience in Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)/Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) industry.
* Experience in developing relationships with executive-level stakeholders.
* Understanding of cross-functional media businesses and operations.
* Excellent problem-solving skills.

**About The Job**
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
  
  
Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies, and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives and drive successful collaboration.
* Design and pitch powerful, data-driven AI-powered performance solutions (Search) tailored to customer needs. Leverage in-depth knowledge of Google’s advertising offerings and compelling storytelling to effectively navigate objections, secure investment, and exceed revenue targets.
* Lead the execution of strategic initiatives to drive adoption and revenue for AI-powered performance solutions (Search), optimizing clients advertising efforts.
* Analyze and optimize marketing Return on Investment (ROI) by monitoring and assessing the performance of AI-powered performance (Search) campaigns, delivering data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Keep abreast of industry trends and innovations in digital marketing, providing proactive insights and recommendations to ensure the team and clients remain at the forefront of an evolving landscape.

title: Manager - Design
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Campaign brainstorming and creative direction: Lead ideation sessions to develop fresh sale campaign concepts based on business objectives, customer preferences, seasonal themes, and previous campaign learnings. Create mood boards and visual directions, and translate selected ideas into cohesive campaign designs.
* Sale campaign execution: Oversee campaigns from concept to final delivery, defining imagery, typography, colours, product presentation, and offer hierarchy. Ensure the campaign identity works consistently across platform placements and supporting communication.
* Platform creative management: Own homepage banners, category pages, store pages, cover widgets, promotional tiles, and product-led creatives. Maintain a fresh, engaging visual experience with clear messaging, prominent offers, and effective calls to action.
* Daily operations and delivery: Plan and manage everyday creative requirements alongside major campaigns. Allocate resources, prioritise requests, consolidate feedback, and coordinate approvals and handoffs to meet launch timelines.
* CTR tracking and creative optimisation: Regularly monitor click-through rates across key creatives and placements. Identify performance trends, test design variations, and apply learnings to improve layouts, imagery, messaging, and customer engagement.
* AI adoption and automation: Explore and implement AI tools for concept visualisation, image generation, creative adaptations, and production support. Build a phased approach towards automation through reusable templates, bulk creation, and streamlined workflows, while ensuring brand consistency and product accuracy.
* Team leadership and development: Guide designers and interns through clear briefs, constructive feedback, and design reviews. Manage workload and build team capabilities in campaign design, performance-led thinking, and AI-assisted production.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Brand, Product, CRM, and Operations teams to align creative execution with business priorities. Clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and ensure smooth implementation across the platform.
* Quality and process improvement: Maintain high standards of visual quality, content accuracy, and platform compliance. Develop SOPs, organise asset libraries, and improve production processes to reduce turnaround time, errors, and rework.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Strong visual design, art direction, typography, and layout skills.
* Experience in e-commerce creatives, sale campaigns, and high-volume production.
* Ability to interpret CTR data and translate insights into design improvements.
* Proficiency in design software and working knowledge of AI and automation tools.
* Strong team leadership, stakeholder communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to balance creative quality, business goals, and delivery timelines.

title: Art Director
description:
**Job Description:**
Art Director

**Department:**
Social

**Primary Location:**
Mumbai

**Job Profile Summary:**
An experienced and highly skilled Art Director specializing in digital and motion content, responsible for the end-to-end creation and editing of over 20 high-quality video assets monthly across social media platforms. Proven ability to transform raw footage into polished content, including short-form motion graphics, interviews, and long-form productions, consistently meeting tight deadlines and maintaining exceptional quality standards. Expertly coordinates visual content with creative and marketing teams to ensure cohesive and compelling narratives, driving significant audience engagement and supporting brand goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and edit a minimum of 20 high-quality videos per month for social media platforms, including short videos, GIFs, Reels, and other content developed from scratch.
* Transform raw footage into polished video content, producing at least 5-7 distinct pieces monthly, such as interviews and entertainment-based videos, ready for broadcast.
* Develop 10-15 short-form motion graphics videos quarterly that captivate and engage the audience, measured by specific engagement metrics.
* Edit long-format content, including podcasts and documentaries, delivering one to two full-length productions every quarter, ensuring seamless narrative flow and professional quality.
* Utilize advanced skills in Adobe After Effects to create dynamic motion graphics and visual effects, contributing to all motion-based projects and elevating visual storytelling.
* Enhance video content with animations, transitions, and other visual elements, integrating at least 3-5 distinct visual enhancements per video to significantly improve viewer engagement.
* Use Adobe Photoshop to create and edit visual elements required for video projects, including thumbnails, overlays, and other graphics, supporting all video content with bespoke assets.
* Stay updated with and proficient in newly emerging AI tools, integrating at least one new AI-driven technique or tool annually to streamline and enhance video production and editing processes.
* Work closely with the creative team, including designers, writers, and marketing professionals, participating in daily or weekly collaborative sessions to ensure cohesive and compelling video content.
* Manage 5-8 multiple projects simultaneously, consistently ensuring deadlines are met and quality standards are maintained across all deliverables.
* Contribute to content strategy by proposing at least 3-5 innovative video ideas and formats quarterly that align with the brand’s goals and audience preferences.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, focused on making Spotify Premium an increasingly desirable music experience in India. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, music, and strategy, the team works closely with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to grow Premium through cultural relevance and artist-led initiatives.
  
  
In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Define and execute the Premium desirability strategy for India, using artist-led and culturally relevant initiatives to drive consideration and conversion.
* Own the artist and partner flywheel for Premium growth, evolving artist advocacy, fan experiences, and partnership programs toward measurable Premium outcomes.
* Shape and execute the Premium opportunity within existing in-person activations, including film partnerships, bespoke music events, festivals, and other relevant cultural moments.
* Partner with local Music & Podcasts, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to identify and activate artists, creators, and partners that can help grow Premium.
* Design and run desirability initiatives with clear success metrics, using performance data and audience behaviour to understand what works and continuously improve the strategy.
* Own the fandom value opportunity for Premium end-to-end, from identifying opportunities to partnering with Product on fan-facing Premium features and experiences.
* Develop business cases and evaluate the impact of desirability, artist, and partner initiatives to inform where we invest and scale.
* Capture and share learnings that strengthen the India Premium Growth playbook, contribute to cross-regional Growth initiatives, and support adjacent growth priorities when business needs require it.
* Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience across growth, marketing, partnerships, strategy, or related roles in a digital consumer business such as streaming, music, entertainment, media, or technology.
* You have strong experience with music and fandom and understand how fan communities form, what drives engagement, and how fandom can translate into measurable business outcomes.
* You understand growth marketing and connect cultural and creative ideas to measurable outcomes such as consideration, conversion, and subscriber growth.
* You have experience independently owning and scaling artist-led campaigns, partnerships, live experiences, or similarly complex consumer initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
* You are comfortable using data and audience insights to make decisions, test hypotheses, measure impact, and refine your approach.
* You work effectively across functions and can influence outcomes without direct authority, particularly when collaborating with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, Product, and other teams.
* You are curious about cultural trends and user behaviour in India and enjoy testing, learning, and iterating to understand what drives Premium consideration and conversion.
* Experience working directly with artists, labels, fan platforms, music or entertainment marketing, or Product teams on consumer-facing experiences can help you succeed in this role.

Where You’ll Be
  
  

* This role is based in Mumbai
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
  
  
Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

* Working knowledge of Python for analysis, automation and model development is preferred.
* Experience building dashboards and management reporting using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools.
* Practical experience with customer segmentation, lifecycle journeys, campaign setup, campaign measurement and funnel development.
* Demonstrable experience in data science, data profiling & transformation, modelling and translating analytical and modelling outputs into actionable customer lifecycle intervention

Full-time, in-office role
  
  
Vile Parle, Mumbai
  
  
Company: Pinnacle (Tokyo Plast International)
  
  
**Role Overview**
Pinnacle is looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial and ownership-driven Brand Manager to lead the overall development and growth of its consumer lifestyle brand across coolers, drinkware, to-go products and tableware. The individual will take end-to-end ownership of the brand, covering strategy, positioning, integrated marketing campaigns, digital presence, consumer engagement and D2C growth. They will also be responsible for building and leading a capable brand team, managing external partners and ensuring consistent execution across all consumer touchpoints. We are looking for someone who has hands-on experience in building and scaling a D2C consumer brand and can combine creative thinking, strategic planning and commercial understanding to build a distinctive, aspirational and globally competitive brand.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Brand Strategy & Positioning
* Define and execute Pinnacle’s brand strategy, positioning, identity and long-term growth roadmap.
* Strengthen brand awareness, differentiation and consumer affinity across categories and markets.
* Ensure consistent brand communication across all consumer touchpoints.
* D2C & Marketing Growth
* Develop strategies to build Pinnacle’s D2C presence, customer acquisition, retention and repeat purchases.
* Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, e-commerce, influencer marketing, retail and offline channels.
* Drive product launches, brand collaborations, seasonal campaigns and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Work with e-commerce and performance marketing teams to improve marketing effectiveness and business growth.
* Creative Direction & Brand Communication
* Own the brand’s creative direction, storytelling and content strategy.
* Oversee packaging, product launches, photography, videos, advertising, social media and other brand communication.
* Maintain consistent brand identity, quality and positioning across all channels.
* Team Building & Leadership
* Build and lead the brand team, identifying the right talent and capabilities required for growth.
* Manage creative agencies, freelancers, influencers and other external partners.
* Establish clear processes, budgets, KPIs and accountability for effective execution.
* Performance & Business Impact
* Monitor brand and marketing performance, consumer insights and competitive activity.
* Track relevant D2C and marketing metrics, including customer acquisition, conversion, retention and return on marketing investment.
* Work closely with product development, sales, e-commerce, exports and management to align brand initiatives with business objectives.

**Candidate Profile**
**Mandatory Requirement:**
Hands-on experience in building and growing a D2C consumer brand.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Also Have**

* Experience in brand management, integrated marketing and end-to-end brand ownership.
* Experience in consumer products, lifestyle, fashion, accessories, outdoor or drinkware categories preferred.
* Strong understanding of D2C marketing, customer acquisition, retention, digital channels and consumer behaviour.
* Proven ability to conceptualise and execute campaigns, manage budgets and measure results.
* Experience building or managing teams, agencies and creative partners.
* Strong strategic thinking, creative judgement, commercial acumen and leadership skills.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to take ownership and drive initiatives independently.

**Key Expectation**
To take complete ownership of Pinnacle’s brand strategy and growth, build the right team and systems, and translate the brand vision into impactful campaigns, a stronger D2C presence and measurable business results.

title: Assistant General Manager - Digital Commerce & MarTech Application Management
description:
The Assistant General Manager – Digital Commerce & MarTech Application Management will lead the technology ecosystem supporting Skechers India’s digital commerce, customer engagement and omnichannel operations.
  
  
The role will own the application roadmap, delivery and ongoing management of Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, campaign microsites, and Vinculum Order Management System. It will ensure these platforms operate as a connected, secure, and scalable ecosystem, enabling seamless customer experiences and supporting online revenue growth, conversion, and retention.
  
  
The incumbent will partner with Digital Commerce, Marketing, Retail, Supply Chain, Finance, and global and local IT teams to translate business priorities into technology solutions.
  
  
**Designation:**
Assistant General Manager
  
  
**Role:**
Lead – Digital Commerce & MarTech Application Management
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai – Head Office (Andheri East)
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 years
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Associate Director - IT
  
  
**Direct reports:**
2 — Business Analyst and Application Support
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Commerce — Salesforce Commerce Cloud
* Own the SFCC B2C storefront roadmap, application enhancements, releases, availability, performance, and security.
* Lead development across SFRA and PWA Kit/headless architectures, covering catalogue, pricing, promotions, search, checkout, and customer accounts.
* Partner with business teams on site speed, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, A/B testing, and personalization.
* Manage cartridges and third-party integrations, including payments, tax, fraud prevention, ratings and reviews, search, and customer support tools.
* Ensure readiness for peak trading periods through load testing, capacity planning, release controls, and coordinated production support.
* Marketing Technology — Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Lead SFMC architecture and operations across Email Studio, Mobile Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder and Data Extensions.
* Enable customer lifecycle journeys, including welcome, cart and browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, loyalty and transactional communications.
* Integrate SFMC with commerce, CRM, and customer data platforms to support event-driven engagement and consistent customer profiles.
* Oversee deliverability, consent, preference management, and applicable privacy requirements.
* Manage complementary platforms for WhatsApp, conversational commerce, analytics, and tag management.
* Customer Data Platform — Salesforce Data Cloud
* Lead end-to-end Data Cloud implementation, from business case and use-case prioritization through architecture, deployment, and adoption.
* Establish ingestion from commerce, marketing, OMS, POS, loyalty, ERP, marketplace, and web/app data sources.
* Define data models, Data Model Objects, data spaces, calculated insights, and streaming insights.
* Configure identity resolution to unify customer profiles across online and offline channels.
* Enable audience segmentation and activation across marketing, advertising, and commerce platforms.
* Support approved Einstein and Agentforce use cases, including next-best offers, churn insights, and propensity modelling.
* Govern data quality, consent, access, and platform consumption, while tracking license costs and business impact.
* Campaign Microsites & Digital Properties
* Deliver campaign, product-launch and brand microsites using SFCC or suitable headless CMS platforms.
* Establish reusable templates, components, and hosting standards to improve delivery speed and consistency.
* Ensure each launch meets tracking, technical SEO, accessibility, performance, and security requirements.
* Omnichannel Order Management — Vinculum
* Own Vinculum OMS application delivery and support as the backbone for order and inventory orchestration.
* Enable ship-from-store, click-and-collect, endless aisle, store returns, and split-shipment capabilities.
* Manage integrations with marketplaces, warehouses, stores, and logistics partners.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Retail teams to improve inventory accuracy, fulfilment performance, order-to-delivery timelines, and return-to-origin rates.
* Enterprise Integration & Architecture
* Govern integrations across ERP, PIM, OMS, WMS, POS, CRM, loyalty, payments, logistics and analytics platforms.
* Lead API and middleware design using REST/SOAP services, webhooks, event streams and batch interfaces.
* Define data contracts, monitoring, error handling, retries and reconciliation controls.
* Ensure reliable product, pricing, inventory, order, customer, and finance data flows across systems.
* Leadership, Delivery & Application Governance
* Lead the Business Analyst and Application Support team, with responsibility for capability development, resource planning and performance management.
* Manage implementation partners, agencies, and SaaS vendors through clear scopes of work, SLAs and performance reviews.
* Own application budgets, licenses, total cost of ownership and build-versus-buy evaluations.
* Drive Agile delivery, release governance, CI/CD practices and L2/L3 production support.
* Establish effective incident management, root-cause analysis, and preventive action processes.
* Coordinate security assessments, vulnerability remediation, payment security, and applicable data privacy controls.
* Manage global and local technology initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and effective business adoption.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science or Information Technology, MCA, or a relevant postgraduate IT qualification. An MBA is an advantage.
* 12–15 years of IT experience, with substantial responsibility for retail, digital commerce or omnichannel technology programmes.
* Demonstrated delivery experience across SFCC, SFMC, Salesforce Data Cloud and OMS, including at least one end-to-end Salesforce Data Cloud implementation.
* Experience in consumer brands, retail, fashion, lifestyle or D2C businesses is preferred.
* Proven experience leading teams and managing vendors, budgets, and senior business stakeholders.
* Relevant Salesforce Commerce, Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of digital commerce, customer lifecycle marketing and omnichannel retail processes.
* Knowledge of retail operations, POS, inventory, replenishment, fulfilment, and enterprise system integration.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data modelling, identity resolution, and application monitoring.
* Familiarity with Vinculum or comparable OMS platforms; exposure to Ginesys POS or Oracle Retail Xstore is an advantage.
* Strong programme management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to balance application stability, delivery priorities, cost efficiency, and business outcomes.

**Key Success Measures**

* Website availability of at least 99.9% and stable performance during peak sales.
* Improvements in page speed, conversion, and checkout success.
* Reliable inventory synchronization, reduced order failures, and adherence to fulfilment SLAs.
* Reduced integration failures and reconciliation gaps.
* Improved customer engagement, lifecycle journey performance, and retention.
* Effective customer profile unification, audience activation, and measurable business impact from Data Cloud.
* On-time, on-budget roadmap delivery, vendor SLA adherence, and controlled platform costs.

**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

**About Growthally Advisors**
Growthally Advisors is an investment banking and financial advisory firm with over 15 years of experience in delivering comprehensive financial solutions to businesses across India.
  
  
**Our Core Service Offerings Include**

* Debt Syndication
* Equity Advisory
* Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A)

**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented
**Analyst – Debt Syndication**
to join our Debt Syndication / Debt Capital Markets team.
  
  
The role involves financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, cash flow assessment, debt structuring support, financial modelling, and execution of corporate debt fundraising transactions.
  
  
You will work closely with senior investment banking professionals and gain hands-on exposure to financing transactions involving banks, NBFCs, AIFs, private credit funds, and institutional lenders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
🔹
**Credit Analysis & Financial Appraisal**

* Analyse balance sheets, profit and loss statements, cash flow statements, audited financials, provisional financials, CMA data, and financial projections.
* Evaluate borrower creditworthiness, business performance, financial strength, and repayment capacity.
* Identify key financial, business, and industry risks.
* Prepare credit appraisal reports and borrower assessment notes.

🔹
**Financial Analysis & Modelling**

* Analyse key credit metrics, including Debt/Equity, Net Debt/EBITDA, DSCR, ICR, FCCR, Current Ratio, and working capital cycle.
* Evaluate historical financial performance, projected cash flows, profitability, and debt servicing capacity.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling.
* Identify financial trends, deviations, and potential credit red flags.

🔹
**Debt Structuring & Transaction Execution**

* Assist in evaluating suitable debt financing solutions based on funding requirements, cash flows, existing debt, collateral, and repayment capacity.
* Support transactions involving term loans, working capital finance, structured debt, NCDs/bonds, refinancing, acquisition finance, project finance, and private credit.
* Assist in lender mapping and identifying suitable financing institutions.
* Track transaction progress from initial assessment and lender engagement to sanction, documentation, and disbursement.

🔹
**Transaction Materials & Lender Coordination**

* Prepare financial models, company profiles, transaction teasers, Information Memorandums (IMs), credit proposals, and lender presentations.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams for financial data collection and validation.
* Assist in responding to lender queries and preparing supporting financial information.
* Maintain transaction trackers, financial databases, and management information reports (MIS).

🔹
**Industry & Company Research**

* Conduct industry research, sector analysis, and competitive benchmarking.
* Evaluate business models, industry trends, and company positioning.
* Prepare research summaries and financial benchmarks to support credit evaluation and transaction structuring.

**Candidate Profile**
**Experience:**
1–5 years in one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Credit Analysis / Credit Appraisal
* Debt Syndication / Loan Syndication
* Corporate Banking / Investment Banking
* Corporate Finance / Debt Capital Markets
* Structured Finance / NBFCs / Financial Services
* Credit Rating Agencies

**Educational Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM in Finance
* CA / CA Inter
* CFA
* M.Com / B.Com / BBA in Finance
* Other relevant qualifications in Finance or Accounting

**Must-Have Skills**
✅ Strong financial statement analysis and credit appraisal skills
  
  
✅ Good understanding of financial ratios, credit metrics, and cash flow analysis
  
  
✅ Knowledge of CMA data, financial projections, and debt servicing capacity
  
  
✅ Strong MS Excel and numerical analysis skills
  
  
✅ Understanding of corporate finance and debt financing products
  
  
✅ Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking
  
  
✅ Strong report writing, presentation, and communication skills
  
  
✅ Ability to manage multiple assignments and work within tight deadlines
  
  
**Preferred:**
Financial modelling experience, exposure to debt syndication transactions, preparation of credit appraisal notes, and familiarity with lender requirements and banking credit processes.
  
  
**Who Should Apply?**
If you can analyse a corporate borrower's financial strength and creditworthiness, assess funding requirements, and contribute to developing financing solutions that lenders can support, this opportunity is for you.
  
  
Join Growthally Advisors to gain hands-on exposure to live debt fundraising mandates, structured finance transactions, and corporate financing solutions while working alongside experienced investment banking professionals.

title: Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management (IAM Engineer)
description:
**Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management**
The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting, administering, engineering, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access management services. This role works as part of the Digital Identity & Access team to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services across the organization. The IAM Engineer will support identity lifecycle management, authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, application integrations, certificates, and related identity technologies. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with disciplined operational practices, documentation, change management, and collaboration across Technology and Information Security teams. This is a hybrid role and work hours are 2pm – 11pm IST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Identity & Access Management**

* Support the administration and engineering of enterprise identity and access management platforms and services.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication policies, and Conditional Access controls.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory identity services.
* Support identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, modification, deprovisioning, and access changes.
* Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorization, and access-related issues.
* Support application onboarding and integration with enterprise identity platforms using technologies and standards such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related authentication protocols.
* Support identity federation and authentication integrations with SaaS, cloud, and internally developed applications.
* Assist with the administration and support of Auth0 and other enterprise authentication platforms.
* Support role-based access control and group-based access management.

**Identity Security & Governance**

* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain identity security standards and controls.
* Support periodic access reviews, certifications, audit requests, and compliance activities.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of appropriate separation-of-duties controls.
* Identify excessive, inappropriate, or outdated access and work with appropriate stakeholders to remediate identified issues.
* Support privileged identity and access management processes where applicable.
* Assist with investigation and remediation of identity-related security events.
* Ensure identity configurations and processes align with organizational security standards and established governance requirements.

**PKI & Certificate Management**

* Support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate-management processes.
* Monitor certificate expiration and coordinate certificate renewals to prevent service disruption.
* Assist application and technology teams with certificate requests, renewals, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate documentation and visibility into enterprise certificates and associated ownership.

**Engineering & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IAM activities and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain scripts and automation supporting identity administration, reporting, provisioning, and operational processes.
* Support integrations between IAM platforms, enterprise applications, HR systems, and other technology services.
* Participate in identity-platform upgrades, enhancements, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of IAM architecture, standards, technical documentation, and operational procedures.

**Service Management & Operations**

* Manage IAM incidents, requests, problems, and changes in accordance with established service-management processes.
* Develop implementation, testing, validation, rollback, and communication plans for production changes.
* Ensure changes are appropriately documented, reviewed, approved, and communicated prior to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely visibility into assigned work, projects, changes, risks, and commitments.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and support runbooks.
* Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of major incidents involving identity or authentication services.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.

**Collaboration & Customer Experience**

* Partner with Digital Workplace, Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, Enterprise Systems, HR, Service Management, and other technology teams.
* Provide technical guidance to application owners integrating applications with enterprise identity services.
* Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Balance security requirements with the need to provide reliable and intuitive authentication and access experiences for practitioners.
* Demonstrate a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented approach to delivering identity services.

**Essential Traits**

* 3–5+ years of experience supporting or engineering enterprise Identity & Access Management technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
* Experience implementing or supporting Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or similar authentication standards.
* Experience troubleshooting complex authentication and access-related issues.
* Understanding of identity lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, access changes, and role/group management.
* Working knowledge of identity security principles, least privilege, role-based access control, and separation of duties.
* Experience working within formal change, incident, request, and problem-management processes.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across technical teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

**Team Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments, and economics, VCA solves strategic problems for clients. VCA’s core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers, and governments.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Director, Government & Strategic Partnerships, will lead VCA’s public sector growth agenda across India and South Asia. This role will be responsible for establishing and scaling a market-leading Government & Public Sector Advisory practice focused on government institutions and public sector enterprises.
  
  
The successful candidate will build strategic relationships with client stakeholders, originate and lead high-impact consulting engagements, shape VCA’s public sector value proposition, and drive sustainable revenue growth through government, PSU, and ecosystem-led opportunities. The role will also be responsible for developing VCA capabilities, talent, thought leadership, and strategic partnerships that position Visa as a trusted advisor for digital transformation and economic modernization initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute VCA’s Government & PSU Strategy across India and South Asia, from identifying opportunities to delivering projects.
* Originate, pursue, and convert high-impact consulting and transformation engagements across government institutions, public sector enterprises, and ecosystem stakeholders.
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies in partnership with Sales, Product, Marketing Services, Government Engagement, and Account Executives to accelerate growth.
* Lead strategic pursuits, executive client engagements, and commercial negotiations to drive client acquisition and revenue expansion.
* Provide pipeline oversight, forecasting, and governance to ensure accurate opportunity management and business planning.
* Build compelling business cases, value propositions, and ROI-led narratives for clients and stakeholders.
* Develop repeatable consulting frameworks, methodologies, and scalable offerings that can be deployed across multiple government and ecosystem engagements.
* Mentor and develop high-performing talent, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop strategic insights and thought leadership to help governments, public institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders navigate the evolving payments and digital transformation landscape.
* Manage a significant consulting portfolio and be accountable for revenue growth, pipeline conversion, client satisfaction, and overall practice performance.
* Hold self and team members accountable for delivering measurable, high-quality, timely, and impactful business results.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of experience in management consulting, government advisory, public sector strategy, financial services, technology consulting, risk consulting or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated success building and managing senior stakeholder relationships across government institutions, regulators, public sector enterprises, and large organizations.
* Experience leading large, complex, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
* Proven track record of business development, client management, and revenue generation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience with a leading consulting firm, public sector advisory practice, technology consulting organization, or financial services institution.
* Strong understanding of government modernization, Digital Public Infrastructure, financial inclusion, and public-sector transformation.
* Experience defining and executing go-to-market strategies and commercial growth plans.
* Financial acumen with experience managing a P&L or significant consulting portfolio.
* Strong commercial mindset with experience building business cases and demonstrating client ROI.
* Superior analytical and problem-solving capabilities with strong strategic thinking skills.
* Excellent executive presence, communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
* Proven leadership in highly matrixed organizations with strong collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Experience building, mentoring, and leading high-performing consulting teams.
* Demonstrated commitment to delivering measurable business outcomes with accountability for results.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A senior consulting leader with deep expertise in government engagement, public sector advisory, payments, or digital transformation, who can serve as a strategist, business builder, trusted advisor, and people leader. The individual should be capable of shaping VCA’s long-term public sector vision while building a scalable, commercially viable Government & Ecosystem Strategy practice across India and South Asia.

The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.

* Performance Tracking: Maintain audit trackers and service-level metrics to monitor efficiency and adherence to deadlines.

Mandatory
  
  

* Strong understanding of royalty accounting, audit processes, and contractual compliance.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to manage multiple audits and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred**

* Proficiency in SAP 4/HANA, Vistex, EROS, MUR, Ariba, and digital reporting systems.

Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

title: Senior Manager – Debt Syndication
description:
**WE ARE HIRING | Senior Manager – Debt Syndication**
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8 Years
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director – Debt Capital Markets / Investment Banking
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and execution-oriented
**Senior Manager – Debt Syndication**
to lead debt financing mandates, develop institutional lender relationships, and drive transactions from mandate signing to financial closure.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in debt structuring, credit assessment, lender negotiations, and transaction management, with the ability to independently manage complex financing mandates and coordinate effectively with clients, banks, NBFCs, private credit funds, AIFs, and other institutional lenders.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a finance professional who combines commercial acumen, strong lender connectivity, and a proven ability to deliver transaction closures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
🔹
**Transaction Leadership & Deal Execution**

* Lead end-to-end execution of debt syndication and structured finance mandates across corporate, SME, and promoter-led businesses.
* Drive transactions from mandate signing and lender outreach through term-sheet negotiation, sanction, documentation, and disbursement.
* Structure financing solutions for working capital, term loans, refinancing, acquisition financing, project finance, growth capital, and structured debt.
* Manage multiple live transactions, establish execution timelines, and proactively resolve deal bottlenecks.
* Drive transaction closures while maintaining execution quality and client satisfaction.

🔹
**Lender Relationship Management & Negotiations**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with banks, NBFCs, HFCs, private credit funds, AIFs, family offices, and institutional lending platforms.
* Lead lender discussions, credit meetings, management presentations, and commercial negotiations.
* Identify suitable lending partners based on sector appetite, credit parameters, pricing, ticket size, and financing structures.
* Negotiate key commercial terms, including pricing, tenor, repayment schedules, security structures, and covenants.
* Expand the lender network and identify new financing avenues for client mandates.

🔹
**Credit Evaluation & Debt Structuring**

* Independently assess client financials, business models, cash flows, leverage, repayment capacity, and funding requirements.
* Review and guide debt sizing, financial models, sensitivity analysis, DSCR, ICR, and repayment structures.
* Evaluate credit risks, transaction feasibility, and potential financing constraints.
* Recommend appropriate financing structures and execution strategies based on lender feedback and client requirements.

🔹
**Transaction Documentation & Stakeholder Management**

* Oversee preparation and review of information memorandums, lender presentations, financial models, credit notes, and funding proposals.
* Coordinate with clients, lenders, legal counsel, auditors, valuers, and internal teams on due diligence and transaction documentation.
* Monitor sanctions, approvals, conditions precedent, and disbursement milestones.
* Provide regular transaction updates, execution risk assessments, and progress reports to senior management.

🔹
**Business Development & Market Intelligence**

* Support origination teams in evaluating financing opportunities and developing client relationships.
* Track private credit developments, lending trends, sector exposure, pricing benchmarks, and regulatory changes.
* Identify new lenders, financing products, and alternative debt solutions.
* Contribute to improving transaction execution processes and strengthening the firm's debt syndication capabilities.

**Candidate Profile**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in debt syndication, investment banking, corporate banking, structured finance, credit underwriting, or debt advisory.
* Demonstrated experience in managing debt financing transactions and coordinating with multiple lending institutions.
* Strong understanding of corporate credit, debt structuring, financial modelling, and lender negotiations.
* Established working relationships with banks, NBFCs, private credit funds, or other institutional lenders will be an advantage.
* Ability to independently manage transaction workstreams, negotiate commercial terms, and drive financial closure.
* Strong leadership, client management, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven, transaction-oriented environment.

**Educational Qualifications:**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM Finance, CA, CFA, FRM, or equivalent professional qualifications will be preferred.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
✅ Lead complex debt syndication and structured finance mandates
  
  
✅ Build strategic relationships with leading institutional lenders
  
  
✅ Work closely with senior leadership on financing solutions and deal closures
  
  
✅ Earn performance-linked incentives based on transaction execution
  
  
✅ Access career progression opportunities within a growing investment banking and alternative credit platform
  
  
Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with the following details on 07506 236023
  
  

* Current CTC

* Details of transactions executed or closed

title: Specialist- Supply Chain Management, HSS
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply
**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
  
  
**About PATH’s Health Systems Strengthening Vertical**
PATH strives to build a world where innovation ensures that health is within reach for everyone. We start by thinking about people. What do children, women, and men need to be healthy? Similarly, what do health workers, managers, and decision-makers need to do their jobs well? How can the information, products, or services that are needed for health best be obtained—not just for today, but for the future?
  
  
Innovators are developing new information, products, and services that hold great promise for global health. But this promise can’t be realized if solutions can’t be delivered. Health systems—that is, the organizations and people whose primary intent is to promote, restore, or maintain health1—are weak in many countries and represent a challenge to achieving health equity. There is an urgent need for energy, support, and creativity to ensure that health systems can deliver effective health interventions.
  
  
This focus on systems is a core component of PATH’s overall mission to improve the health of people around the world by advancing technologies, strengthening systems, and encouraging healthy behaviors. Our systems work both informs and is informed by our work with technology and behavior change. PATH strengthens health systems to improve the health of people around the world.
  
  
PATH’s health systems vertical is engaged with the following themes:
  
  

* Primary Health Care
* Pandemic Preparedness and Surveillance
* Devices and Diagnostics
* Supply Chain Management
* Healthcare Economics and Financing
* Technology and Innovations
* Private Sector Engagement
* Anti-Microbial Resistance and Global Health Security
* Climate Change
* Quality Improvement

**About The Position**
PATH is seeking a Specialist-Supply Chain Management position for implementation and roll out of the supply chain strengthening project under HSS vertical. This position will work with the national and state teams to provide technical assistance and hand-holding support for strengthening supply chain in the state of Maharashtra.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
Supply Chain Planning and Strengthening
  
  

* Assess the gaps in current supply chain processes and support in the development and implementation of state-specific roadmaps to strengthen the supply chain processes for Maharashtra.
* Collaborate with national and state teams to support the integration and execution of state-specific project activities related to procurement and supply chain management, ensuring alignment with Maharashtra Medical Goods Procurement Authority (MMGPA), NHM guidelines, and standards.
* Coordinate with various competent committees, such as the technical committee and procurement committee of MMGPA, to ensure timely completion of the procurement process.
* Contribute to designing and implementing interventions aimed at enhancing supply chain efficiency within the healthcare system, while adhering to government SCM principles and guidelines

Project Coordination:
  
  

* Support in coordinating with project partners on a day-to-day basis to monitor progress and facilitate the rollout of activities in accordance with approved work plans/proposals, ensuring alignment with the state-specific roadmap.
* Take lead and assist in the development of various technical resources, project documents, and reports related to procurement and supply chain management to support the implementation of the 'To-Be' models for Maharashtra State.

Capacity Building, Digitization in Supply Chain, Innovation and Best Practices
  
  

* Contribute to the development and delivery of training programs for external and internal stakeholders on procurement processes and supply chain management, tailored to the requirements of the state-specific roadmap implementation.
* Support in identifying capacity-building needs and opportunities to enhance supply chain management, and assist MMGPA in developing model drug warehouses.
* Support state in digitization of the supply chain, demand forecasting, data driven decision making, interactive dashboard development in DVDMS in coordination with CDAC.
* Scout for innovative technology solutions to address challenges related to SCM, and in concurrence with key stakeholders, pilot test innovative interventions in selected intervention geographies, closely monitoring outcomes and lessons learned to inform future interventions and scale-up efforts.

Government Liaising:
  
  

* Establish and maintain effective communication channels with relevant government agencies and stakeholders at state and district levels.
* Liaise with government officials to ensure alignment of project activities with government priorities and policies, facilitating collaboration and leveraging government resources and support.

Collaboration and Integration:
  
  

* Work closely with various team members for the integration and implementation of project activities related to warehouse operations in a timely manner, ensuring cross-functional collaboration and synergy.
* Assist the Program Lead in coordinating and executing program partnerships and related program work, fostering collaboration both internally within PATH and with external stakeholders.

Project Management:
  
  

* Support in coordinating project management processes internally within PATH and with external stakeholders, ensuring adherence to project timelines and deliverables outlined in the state-specific roadmaps.
* Provide regular updates and reports on project progress, including achievements, challenges, and lessons learned, contributing to ongoing monitoring and evaluation efforts.
* Undertake other tasks which may be assigned from time to time by the supervisor
* Available to travel to intervention states up to 30-40% of the time.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* Postgraduate /Professional degree in Pharmacy/Logistics and Supply Chain Management/ MBA-SCM MPH/MHA or any other related field.
* Minimum 4-5 years of experience in supply chain management in reputed public or private organization
* Previous experience/ Demonstrated expertise in a similar role would be preferred for this position.
* Expertise in the functions and practices of supply chain in government organizations/ departments and knowledge of best practices in supply chain management.
* Technical knowledge and field experience in planning and implementation of logistics and supply chain programs.

**Skills/ Abilities**

* Excellent knowledge of supply chain processes
* Self-starter and committed to performing their duties with a high degree of autonomy in line with project goals and objectives.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and policy concepts to diverse audiences.
* Self-directed and creative individual with experience managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and project management skills
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Ability to multitask and work in a multi-cultural team.
* Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines
* Ability to travel up to 40-50% of the time.

title: Analyst I, Core & Inno Capabilities
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices.
  
  
We are seeking a curious, analytical, and motivated
**Analyst I – Quantitative Research**
to join our Mumbai team within the Insights & Analytics (I&A) function at General Mills India Center. This team leads in-house consumer research to understand and interpret consumer behavior. We are looking for an individual to work closely on the
**in-house quantitative research**
- someone who loves using data to tell stories and deeply understand stakeholders’ needs and the business requirements to provide strategic insights. The role holder should be able to apply research methodologies effectively, manage global projects end to end, able to multi-task, demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and establish oneself as a trusted advisor to stakeholders.
  
  
Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Project management and execution**

* The candidate will be accountable for end-to-end Quantitative project management which includes –

+ Gaining expertise in using the tools developed in-house and by external vendors
+ Multitasking and managing multiple research projects end to end i.e. from designing a questionnaire, programming surveys to data analysis and reporting
+ Developing knowledge and skills required to apply advanced statistical techniques like Heat maps, Driver’s analysis, Cluster analysis etc. in order to identify patterns and trends from the data.
+ Should be able to design and execute methodologies that involve Concept test, Product test, Maxdiff, Conjoint analysis, Usage & Attitude, Segmentation etc.

* Should be able to create a story out of the insights using compelling narratives, visuals, and data-driven evidence
* Should be able to proactively learn and apply new tools to find unique solutions to business questions
* The candidate will be responsible for establishing best practices, standardized ways of working and building internal benchmarks

* Stakeholder management

* Become a trusted advisor and the go-to person for the internal stakeholders, when they need guidance on answering research questions.
* Is able to effectively communicate key findings to the stakeholders and the leadership team in meetings

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 2 - 3 years of relevant market research experience including experience in quantitative research, client management, questionnaire design, data analysis and reporting
* Master’s degree or MBA with specialization in Marketing or Market research
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and team members
* Should have experience in different research methodologies like Concept test, Product test, Brand tracking, Maxdiff, Conjoint analysis, Usage & Attitudes etc.
* Must be able to multitask and effectively manage multiple stakeholders, vendors and projects together

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**About the role**

As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.

Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.

**What you will own**

Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.

**Revenue and conversion**

* **Storefront conversion rate.**
  Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
* **Cross sell and attach rate.**
  Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
* **Average order value and revenue per session.**
  Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.

**Experience and performance**

* **Site performance.**
  Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
* **Experience quality.**
  Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
* **Consistency across brands.**
  A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.

**Delivery and process**

* **Experimentation velocity.**
  An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
* **Roadmap delivery.**
  Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
* **Delivery against Strategi Project.**
  Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations

**A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**

**Core deliverables**

* Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
* Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
* Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
* Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
* Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in-house stacks.
* Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
* Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
* Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
* Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.

**Stakeholder management**

* Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
* Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
* Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
* Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
* Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
* Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.

**Data and analysis**

* Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
* Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
* Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
* Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
* Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
* Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.

**What you will need to succeed**

* Seven or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
* A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
* A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
* A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
* Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
* Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
* Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
* Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
* A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
* Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar. You will be responsible for driving the right kind of reporting setup required to measure performance in the areas you are responsible for.
* Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
* Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
* Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Driven by delivery, delivering on time and to a high standard.

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days.**
You know our stacks, our funnels and our numbers. You have audited the storefronts across brands, established a clean baseline for conversion, attach and performance, and shipped a first set of quick wins.

**First six months.**
A prioritized storefront roadmap is agreed with brand and engineering leads, a regular testing cadence is running, and reporting is in place that everyone trusts and uses.

**First twelve months.**
Measurable improvement against your conversion, attach and performance targets, a shared experience standard applied across brands, and a healthy backlog of tested, evidenced ideas ready for the following year.

**Why you'll love us.**

* **Weve evolved**
  ; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from- home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* **Work-life balance**
  . Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* **We celebrate one another’s differences**
  . We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* **We care about you**
  . At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* All our employees are eligible for a
  **free domain and WordPress blog**
  as we sponsor the domain registration costs.
* **Where can we take you?**
  We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with #teamnewfold

Programmatic & Indirect Revenue
