title: Analyst I, Agentic Search
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.
  
  
As the Agentic Search Analyst, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross-functional partners. In addition, you will be building cross-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.
  
  
This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.
  
  
Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Data Analysis & Performance Diagnostics: Analyze large, nuanced datasets from LLM optimization platforms to diagnose what is working, what is not, and where search visibility can be improved.
* Market & Competitor Trend Tracking: Maintain a proactive external view of relevant digital topics, retailer landscapes, and competitor movements to surface emerging generative search trends for internal teams.
* Strategic Planning & Prioritization: Translate complex, rapidly evolving AI engine outputs into prioritized, phased optimization plans that focus resources on the highest-value business opportunities.
* Cross-Functional Implementation: Coordinate closely with cross-functional partners to support the accurate, timely execution of approved optimization initiatives.
* Stakeholder Reporting & Capability Building: Track optimization outcomes, maintain organized reporting, and surface risks and follow-up opportunities to stakeholders while documenting learnings to refine the team's analytical approach over time.
* Stay current on industry trends and consumer behavior insights, applying knowledge to refine and inform AI search optimization strategies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field, with an MBA in Marketing / International Business.
* 1-3 years of experience in AI Marketing Agents, AI Search Optimization, AEO, GEO, LLM-based search, SEO, organic search, content optimization or digital marketing
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini/Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity and concepts such as LLMs, RAG and AI citations.
* Strong analytical, communication, project management and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to generate actionable insights to optimize brand strategy execution.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Navigating Tableau dashboards, R/SQL a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush/Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
* Strong understanding of search relevance, ranking, personalization, and evaluation metrics.
* Data-driven approach to experimentation, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable search solutions and product roadmaps.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Product Intern - Stratzy (Raise)
description:
**Role Summary**

Raise is built on this core philosophy, we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user

experience and best-in-class customer service to our users. We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021.

Today,
**Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India**
and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026,
**Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

**Stratzy**
is an algorithmic investing and trading platform that makes rule-based, system-driven trading accessible to everyday investors. The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai

Explore More:

* Connect with us: www.raiseholding.co
* Learn more about our Algo Trading platform - https://stratzy.in/
* Learn more about our Investing & Trading Platform – www.dhan.co

Follow our Instagram page
**#LifeatRaise**
for a glimpse into our people and latest culture

happenings.

**Apply for the Role:**

If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech

ecosystems, we would love to hear from you. Send your resume to:
**careers@dhan.co**

Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an

inclusive workplace.

title: Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology
description:
Abans Financial Services Ltd. is a listed, diversified financial services company offering a comprehensive suite of solutions across broking, commodity trading, asset management, financing, and investment advisory. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates with a strong presence in both Indian and global markets, serving institutional, corporate, and retail clients. As part of the larger Abans Group, the company continues to expand its footprint by delivering integrated financial services and building robust technology platforms to support its growing client base.
  
  
**Profile : Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology**
**Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai**
**Industry Preference: Stockbroking, Capital Markets, Trading, Brokerage, and Financial Services.**
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with expertise in IT infrastructure, trading technology, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within the stockbroking industry. The candidate should have hands-on experience with hybrid infrastructure, exchange connectivity, CTCL trading applications, vendor licensing, and applicable SEBI and exchange regulations.
  
  
The role is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, and resilience of IT infrastructure and trading systems while supporting business operations and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Infrastructure & Operations
* Manage on-premise and cloud infrastructure, including servers, storage, networks, and virtualisation.
* Ensure system availability, performance monitoring, capacity planning, and timely issue resolution.
* Manage backups, Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and periodic DR drills.
* Oversee IT asset management, software licensing, upgrades, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Stockbroking & Trading Technology
* Manage trading infrastructure like leased line connections, servers, licenses, etc for NSE, BSE, MCX, NCDEX, and other applicable exchanges and segments.
* Manage and coordinate with CTCL vendors such as Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or similar trading platforms for software licences, vendor agreements, renewals, terminal registrations, and exchange-related approvals.
* Oversee configuration of CTCL/NNF IDs, terminal IDs, Location IDs, user IDs, and IP mapping, as applicable.
* Coordinate trading application installations, upgrades, testing, mock trading sessions, and exchange-mandated changes.
* Ensure integration and smooth functioning of trading applications, RMS, back-office systems, and market data feeds.
* Monitor trading-system performance and coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve technical issues.
* Exchange Connectivity & Network Management
* Manage leased lines, dedicated connectivity, internet links, VPNs, and network infrastructure for exchange connectivity.
* Handle IP whitelisting, firewall rules, routing, terminal mapping, and connectivity activation with exchanges and vendors.
* Ensure network redundancy, backup connectivity, failover, and business continuity.
* Monitor network performance, latency, and connectivity issues affecting trading operations.
* Cybersecurity & Security Management
* Manage firewalls, VPNs, antivirus, endpoint protection, and network security systems.
* Coordinate SOC operations, security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, access management, and security policies in line with regulatory requirements.
* Ensure timely resolution and documentation of security incidents and vulnerabilities.
* Regulatory Compliance & IT Governance
* Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, and other regulatory requirements relating to IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and trading systems.
* Coordinate exchange inspections, IT and cybersecurity audits, and closure of audit observations.
* Maintain IT policies, SOPs, infrastructure documentation, access records, and compliance reports.
* Oversee DR/BCP compliance, technology risk management, and required regulatory reporting.
* Vendor & Team Management
* Manage CTCL, RMS, back-office, network, cloud, and cybersecurity vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, support escalations, licence renewals, and service delivery.
* Lead the IT team, allocate responsibilities, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
* Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, Risk, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong experience in IT infrastructure, networking, servers, virtualisation, and cloud environments.
* Prior experience in stockbroking, capital markets, or financial services IT.
* Good understanding of CTCL trading applications and vendor licensing, including Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience managing & coordinating third party vendors and Endpoint Security solutions (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, Symantec, McAfee, SentinelOne, etc.).
* Experience working with SOC operations, SIEM platforms, security monitoring, incident response, and threat management.
* Strong understanding of Cybersecurity frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, Vulnerability Management, Patch Management, and Security Best Practices.
* Familiarity with RMS, back-office systems, market data feeds, and trading application integration.
* Knowledge of firewalls, endpoint security, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity controls.
* Understanding of SEBI and exchange IT, cybersecurity, DR, and BCP requirements.
* Experience in exchange audits, IT compliance documentation, vendor management, and incident resolution.
* Minimum 5+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Prior experience in Trading, Broking, Capital Markets, Financial Services, or BFSI organisations is highly preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting multiple exchanges and trading segments in a stockbroking environment.
* Hands-on involvement in CTCL implementations, exchange mock tests, system upgrades, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with trading operations, RMS, clearing, depository, and back-office technology.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Data Center Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Mumbai. In this role, you'll help build, maintain, and scale the critical infrastructure that powers our trading operations across APAC.
  
  
Working alongside experienced engineers and traders, you'll solve complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment where reliability, performance, and speed matter. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, where your work directly contributes to the performance and resilience of our trading systems.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
  
  
In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005), Hong Kong (2007), Shanghai (2012) and Singapore (2021). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You'll be responsible for our data center operations in India, as well as work closely with remote technicians and service partners to support infrastructure across our global footprint. Combining infrastructure expertise with a strong problem-solving mindset, you'll help maintain critical environments, improve operational processes, and deliver infrastructure projects from planning through to execution.
  
  
The majority of your work will be based in Mumbai, although occasional travel to other APAC locations may be required.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  
  

* Installing and maintaining cabling, servers, and network equipment across data center locations through:

+ On-site implementation.
+ Remote coordination of smart-hands and service partner personnel.

* Managing power and space, including monitoring and capacity planning.
* Maintaining a consistent and clean cable management philosophy.
* Managing spare parts and cabling inventory.
* Performing break-fix repairs to equipment in the data center environment, including replacing hard drives / memory / transceivers and other hardware related tasks, as required by our server and network teams.
* Assisting with planning equipment moves or new data center build-outs.
* Coordinating the packing, shipping, and logistics of equipment to and from remote colocation sites.
* Maintaining data center documentation.

Working hours will include a combination of:
  
  
  

* Core business hours for planning and monitoring
* Weekends and out-of-hours work for physical infrastructure changes (with time off provided during the week)

**Who You Are**
As our next Data Centre Engineer, you’ll need to have:
  
  
  

* Attention to detail within a data center.
* Ability to identify basic parts of network equipment – SFPs, line cards, chassis.
* Ability to identify basic parts of servers – memory, network card, hard drives, etc.
* Experience with identifying port locations for specific device manufacturers (Cisco, Arista, Juniper).
* Knowledge of structured cabling systems using cat 5, cat 6, multi-mode and single-mode fiber.
* Familiarity with both power and communications cabling standards.
* Experience configuring and using cable testers, for both fiber and copper, to troubleshoot cabling issues.
* Ability to perform basic installation, configuration and troubleshooting on server operating systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English.
* An understanding of change control processes.
* Strong documentation mentality.
* Strong communication skills (especially with remote engineers whose native language may not be English)..
* Ability to regularly work on weekends.

**What You'll Get**

* A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.

**DIVERSITY STATEMENT**
Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion
  
  
We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process.
  
  
**Questions?**
Get in touch with the recruitment team at careers@optiver.com.au

The role provides frontline support for end user devices, office based technology, onboarding activities, conference rooms, and local smart hands requirements, helping ensure stable and responsive support.
  
  
The role supports a remote and operationally important location, requiring strong independence, responsiveness, and coordination with Digital Operations as well as Infrastructure & Operations teams.
  
  
The position serves as the primary local IT support presence and works closely with global IT teams to resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, maintain device readiness, and support day to day business operations. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical troubleshooting, sound judgement and a customer focused approach.

you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* End User Support:

+ Provide in person support for desktops, laptops, monitors, peripherals, printers and mobile devices.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and access related issues for local users.
+ Support new hire onboarding, workstation setup, user moves, and day to day break/fix activities.
+ Deliver timely user updates and ensure support activities are properly documented and managed through our approved ITSM processes.

* Workplace Technology & Site Support:

+ Support conference room and collaboration technology, including basic meeting room troubleshooting and readiness checks.
+ Assist with workstation setup, hot desk support, office moves, and shared workspace readiness.
+ Provide local smart hands assistance for infrastructure, network, telecom or vendor led onsite activities as required.
+ Coordinate with regional and global support teams to ensure smooth handling of issues requiring escalation.

* Device Lifecycle & Logistics:

+ Assist with asset handling activities including receipt, setup, collection, return, and local coordination of hardware movements.
+ Support termination hardware retrieval, end of lease handling, and eWaste / recycling processes in alignment with company standards.

* Operational Support & Continuous Improvement:

+ Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities affecting end user experience, support responsiveness or local site readiness.
+ Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure Teams, and third party providers to help maintain stable service delivery.

+ Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling.
+ Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

* Physical Demand/Work Environment:

+ The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Required:

+ Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
+ Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
+ Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
+ Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
+ Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
+ Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.

* Preferred:

+ Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
+ Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.

**Moving forward together**

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.
* AWS, Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications.

Working with designated high-demand customers, you will ensure they receive premium-level technical support across every phase of the Data Center technology lifecycle. You will review data and analyze trends to identify problems holistically and strengthen customer networks with proactive, analytics-driven solutions. With significant exposure both internally and externally, and collaborating across cross-functional teams to achieve key performance indicators, you will have a genuine opportunity to make a difference in the customer experience.
  
  

* Act as the technical focal point for complex Data Center network problem resolution, solve and resolving customer issues end-to-end across Cisco’s Data Center portfolio—including Nexus switching, ACI fabrics, UCS compute, and storage networking—spanning Layer 2/3 network fabric, overlays, virtualization, and compute/storage integration.
* Deliver thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) at both the infrastructure and application-interconnect levels, producing detailed technical documentation with root-cause findings, remediation steps, and proactive prevention recommendations, and provide software partner concern referrals for Cisco Data Center platforms (NX-OS, UCS firmware, ACI image bundles) to address critical or recurring problems.
* Continuously monitor and analyze operational trends in the customer’s Data Center environment, collaborating with the High Touch Operations Manager (HTOM) to deliver quarterly technical reviews of findings, metrics, and strategic action plans, and expedite resolution during critical partner concerns by leveraging deep knowledge of the customer’s architecture, operations model, and change-control practices.
* Partner with the Account Team, Cisco TAC, Product Business Unit, and HTOM to coordinate resolution strategies and enhance the quality of services delivered, serving as Lead Engineer across HTTS and TAC teams to drive persistent or recurring issues to full resolution.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships that drive high satisfaction and retention, provide remote or onsite deployment support for Data Center rollouts, migrations, and fabric expansions—including occasional travel for high-impact engagements—and give to Cisco’s intellectual capital through reusable tools, scripts, and best-practice documentation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Typically requires a BS in a technical field (CS/EE preferred) plus 10+ years of related experience, or an MS in a technical field (CS/EE preferred).
* Hands-on experience with core Cisco Data Center technologies, including Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K), ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure), and UCS (Unified Computing System).
* Experience with Data Center fabric architectures and overlay/underlay technologies such as VxLAN, EVPN, FabricPath, OTV, LISP, and Data Center Interconnect (DCI).
* Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, Multicast, STP, HSRP, VRRP, and QoS, including packet-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark.
* Experience with SAN and storage networking (FC/FCoE), virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Data Center troubleshooting tools such as Nexus Dashboard and UCS Manager/IMC.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cisco certifications such as CCNP or CCIE Data Center.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive-level presentation skills to convey complex solutions to non-technical audiences and help drive business growth and outcomes.
* Self-driven, with strong problem-solving and probing skills and a proven ability to work autonomously to resolve complex technical issues in Data Center networks.
* Understanding of Data Center security, segmentation, and zero-trust architecture.
* Exposure to network management systems (NMS), telemetry, and monitoring tools, with experience following agile methodology for fast solution delivery, testing, and value realization.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

description:

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.

Data Investigation
  
  
Data Validation
  
  
Analytical Queries

Advanced Formulas

Application Monitoring
  
  
Service Monitoring

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: MS Engineer L3, Windows & VMware

title: DCO Tech 3, BOM NORTH - DCO
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
  
  
To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
  
  
The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cuttingedge data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:
  
  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift & rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
* 1+ years of computer networking experience
* High school or equivalent diploma

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

title: Survey Party Chief
description:
**Company Description**
Nil is a professional surveying organization focused on delivering accurate spatial data and measurement services for a variety of land development and construction projects. The company emphasizes precision, reliability, and adherence to industry standards to support engineers, architects, and planners. Team members work with modern surveying equipment and technology in dynamic field environments. Nil values safety, collaboration, and continuous learning, offering opportunities to grow technical expertise. The organization encourages problem-solving and accountability in all project activities.
  
**Role Description**
The Survey Party Chief is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for leading field survey crews and ensuring accurate data collection for land and construction projects. Day-to-day tasks include planning survey assignments, setting up and operating total stations and other survey equipment, and overseeing topographic, land, building, and boundary surveys. The Survey Party Chief will verify field measurements, maintain detailed field notes, and coordinate with project managers and office staff to deliver clear, complete survey records. The role also involves monitoring crew safety, training team members in proper survey procedures, and troubleshooting technical or site-related issues. The individual will ensure that all surveys comply with applicable standards, project specifications, and client requirements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in land-related survey work, including Land Surveying and Topographic Surveys.
* Experience conducting Building Surveying and ALTA Surveys for development and compliance purposes.
* Ability to set up, operate, and troubleshoot Total Station and related survey instruments.
* Knowledge of survey principles, field methodologies, and basic geospatial concepts.
* Experience leading field crews, with strong organizational and team coordination skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to produce accurate field notes and survey documentation.
* Familiarity with survey software or data collection systems is an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Willingness to work outdoors on active sites in Mumbai and adapt to varying field conditions.

title: SAP CO - Senior Consultant - L3
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description: SAP CO Lead Consultant (L3) – CO Specialist
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP FICO Lead Consultant (L3) with a strong specialization in SAP Controlling (CO) for a 2-year, full-time implementation project. The ideal candidate will possess deep corporate finance domain knowledge alongside advanced, hands-on enterprise configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA Management Accounting (CO) and Finance modules.
  
  
Position Details
  
  

* Location: Mumbai
* Project Duration: FTE in-house
* Employment Type: Full-Time Employee
* Experience Level: 7 to 9 years

**Educational & Professional Qualifications**

* Minimum Education: Post Graduate degree (MBA Finance).
* Preferred Education: CA / ICWA (CMA) candidates are highly preferred due to the heavy costing requirements.
* Certification: SAP S/4HANA Management Accounting (CO) certification is preferred.

**Key Requirements & Experience**

* Core Experience: 7 to 9 years of dedicated configuration experience in SAP CO.
* S/4HANA Lifecycle: Minimum of 2 full-lifecycle S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations and 2 complex support projects.
* Niche Integration: Proven experience in Treasury and Risk Management (TRM).
* Value Adds: Hands-on exposure to FSCM and Funds Management (FM) is a strong advantage.
* Domain Expertise: Strong background in Management Accounting, Inventory Valuation, and Cost Accounting.
* Leadership: Minimum 2 years in a Team Lead role, with executive presence to interface directly with client CFOs and Top Management.

Technical Skills & Submodules
  
  
SAP Controlling (CO) – Specialized Deep Dive
  
  

* Overhead Cost Controlling: Expert configuration of Cost Center Accounting (CO-OM-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA), and Internal Orders (CO-OM-OPA), including complex allocations, assessments, and distributions.
* Product Costing (CO-PC): Advanced configuration of Product Cost Planning (Costing Variants, BOM, and Routing integration), Cost Object Controlling (Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order), and WIP calculation.
* Material Ledger & Actual Costing (CO-PC-ACT): Comprehensive knowledge of Material Ledger activation, multi-currency valuation, Actual Costing execution, production variance analysis, and balance sheet revaluation.
* Profitability Analysis (CO-PA): Hands-on expertise in S/4HANA Margin Analysis (Account-based CO-PA), Costing-based CO-PA, CO-PA planning, characteristic derivation, and complex settlement rules.
* Period-End Closing: End-to-end execution of Controlling month-end and year-end closing processes, reconciliation with the Universal Journal (ACDOCA), and variance settlement.

SAP Financial Accounting (FI)
  
  

* Expertise in New General Ledger (G/L), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Accounts Payable (AP).
* Deep knowledge of Asset Accounting (FI-AA) and Banking processes (APP, EBS).
* Experience handling financial validations, substitutions, and parallel ledger/multi-currency reporting.

Cross-Module Integration & Technical Delivery
  
  

* Manufacturing Integration: Flawless integration of CO-PC with Production Planning (PP) and Materials Management (MM) for automatic account assignment (OBYC), split valuation, and activity type price calculation.
* Project & Sales Integration: Strong integration setup between CO/CO-PA and Project Systems (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), and Sales & Distribution (SD) for resource-related billing and profitability tracking.
* Data Migration: Proficiency in using SAP S/4HANA Data Migration Cockpit, LTMC, LSMW, and BDC for migrating open items, master data, and cost balances.
* Technical Literacy: Ability to draft technical specifications utilizing User Exits, BAPIs, and BAdIs specific to costing and profitability enhancements.

**Responsibilities**

* Business Blueprinting: Lead workshops to map complex costing models, overhead structures, and profitability reports to SAP Best Practices.
* Solution Design: Design, configure, and prototype end-to-end financial and management accounting scenarios.
* Functional Specs: Author highly descriptive Functional Specification documents for custom RICEFW objects, pricing procedures, and custom CO reports.
* Technical Liaison: Coordinate closely with the ABAP/technical team to test and deliver custom objects.
* Support & Delivery: Monitor daily project delivery tickets, analyze system issues, provide effort estimates, and resolve defects within strict SLAs.
* Travel: Mobility is mandatory; candidate must be ready for project-specific business travel and on-site deployment.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Key Improvements Made For The CO Focus**

* Replaced Generalities with Modules: Changed generic terms like "Overheads" to specific technical terms like CO-OM-CCA, EC-PCA, and CO-OM-OPA so senior candidates know exactly what config is expected.
* S/4HANA Profitability Update: Updated CO-PA to highlight S/4HANA Margin Analysis (Account-based CO-PA), which is the standard architecture for S/4HANA implementations.
* Detailed Product Costing: Explicitly called out the Material Ledger (ML), Actual Costing split, and variance analysis, which are the hardest areas of SAP CO and crucial for a 7–9 year lead.
* Strengthened Integration Points: Clarified exactly what integrates (e.g., OBYC setup, BOM/Routing ties with PP/MM), which instantly filters out superficial resumes.

title: Operations Research Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), Mumbai

**Job Category:**
Project Research Staff

**About the Project**

This government-funded initiative focuses on the development, integration and demonstration of drones and allied technologies. Within this programme, the role will contribute to UAV Traffic Management (UTM) research by developing methods and tools to coordinate drone operations safely and efficiently while accounting for airspace constraints and operational requirements. The project promotes research, technology development and industry-academia collaboration.

**Role Overview**

The Operations Research Scientist will build simulation-based modelling and analysis frameworks for managing traffic. The work will connect rigorous Operations Research methods with practical decision-support capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Formulate and solve optimization models for UAV routing, trajectory planning, mission scheduling, fleet/resource allocation, airspace network design and traffic-capacity planning.
* Develop strategic deconfliction and coordination algorithms for safe, efficient planning of multiple UAV operations.
* Build simulation and analytical frameworks to evaluate traffic demand, congestion, throughput, delays, resource utilization and system performance.
* Apply Operations Research methods to transportation, logistics, fleet coordination and network-management challenges.
* Analyze operational, trajectory and geospatial data to define performance metrics, conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses, and validate model outcomes.
* Translate research models into reproducible, testable software components, collaborating with software and autonomy teams and documenting technical findings.
* Bridge the gap between theoretical R&D and production-ready engineering solutions.

**Qualifications and Key Skills Required**

* PhD in a relevant discipline with relevant experience, OR MTech/ME or BTech/BE (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline with relevant research or industry experience. Relevant disciplines include Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a closely related field.
* Strong fundamentals in optimization, mathematical modelling, algorithms, simulation modelling and quantitative analysis.
* Familiarity with optimization modelling libraries or solvers (e.g., Pyomo, OR-Tools, Gurobi or CPLEX), simulation tools (e.g., SimPy, AnyLogic or equivalent), and Monte Carlo Simulation is desirable.
* Proficiency in Python, modelling and data analysis.
* Ability to validate models, conduct sensitivity or scenario analysis, interpret results, and communicate technical findings clearly in written reports and discussions.

title: Analyst/Associate – Middle Office Operations (Public Credit)
description:
**About This Role**
Job Description
  
  
**Company Description**
HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for clients. The firm manages strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit, including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high-yield bonds; asset-based finance; and real estate. The scale and breadth of the platform provide flexibility to invest in companies large and small through standard or customized solutions. Intellectual rigor and discipline are central to creating value for clients.
  
  
HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (HCM), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (JPMAM). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM. Following the transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity.
  
  
The HPS/BlackRock transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset-owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS formed a new Private Financing Solutions business unit (PFS), led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. The combined platform includes more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally and offers capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. Scott Kapnick, Scot French and Michael Patterson joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick was appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.
  
  
**Team Description**
The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS), BlackRock’s private credit platform, is responsible for ensuring that fund positions and cash balances are accurate and for managing the lifecycle of all trades and investments. Responsibilities include trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate-action elections and recordings, audit requests, new-mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. The team also handles ad hoc requests from deal teams and separately managed account clients and works closely with Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and Deal Teams.
  
  
**Position Description**
HPS is seeking an Analyst to join the Public Credit Middle Office, a subgroup within the broader Middle Office team that focuses on the liquid credit business within PFS.
  
  
The individual should be highly organized, with strong attention to detail and effective written and verbal communication skills. The role requires the ability to meet strict deadlines, work independently and collaboratively, and demonstrate excellent critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. The platform is scaling rapidly, making comfort in a fast-paced environment essential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Research and resolve cash breaks versus custodians.
* Research and resolve position breaks versus custodians, clients, administrators and other systems.
* Perform cash and asset reconciliations between internal systems, including Aladdin, and custodians.
* Play a key role in the daily reconciliation between HPS and BlackRock accounting systems.
* Provide daily oversight of loan and security administration in the firm’s accounting system, including delayed fundings, contracts, coupon payments, factor payments and maturities.
* Investigate transactional or accrual discrepancies.
* Provide full trade-lifecycle operational support for products including fixed- and floating-rate bonds, private placements, ABS, cross-currency swaps, term loans, delayed-draw term loans and revolvers.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of onboarding processes for new investments, including trade lifecycle, cash management, valuation, PnL recognition and reconciliation.
* Work closely with custodians, including responding to questions on how to apply cash.
* Assist with position confirmation and provide support to internal and SMA auditors.
* Interact daily with internal and external groups to troubleshoot booking and position discrepancies, including Front Office, Fund Accounting, Fund Administrators, SMA clients and auditors.
* Collaborate with technology teams on automation and workflow enhancements and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including scenario testing and error resolution before production release.
* Liaise with accounting, product control, valuations, investment data and other internal groups to resolve open queries and support team objectives.
* Participate in cross-functional initiatives and group-level projects.
* Manage transactional data for alternative products by sourcing information from legal documents and third-party notices and entering it into internal systems.
* Assist in trade execution.
* Ensure relevant controls are in place and diligently followed to maintain a risk-controlled environment.
* Provide oversight of daily and ad hoc processes and assist with issues, escalations and complex scenarios.
* Collaborate with external service providers and internal teams to exchange product and asset data and resolve operational issues.
* Maintain and regularly update process documentation and control frameworks.

**Candidate Profile**

* Master's degree in Finance or Accounting or relevant field.
* 2+ years of experience in middle office/operations, data management, accounting or administration, with a focus on alternative investment funds.
* Deep understanding of alternative investment products, including hedge funds, structured products and private equity.
* Knowledge of trading and settlement.
* Understanding of lifecycle events, including coupons, factors, amendments, tenders and maturity.
* Experience with cash and position reconciliation.
* Strong Excel and Outlook management skills.
* Enjoys problem solving and critical thinking.
* Ability to resolve complex issues efficiently and independently by applying knowledge from training and past experience.
* Curiosity and a strong desire to learn and build knowledge continuously.
* Ability to use lookups, pivot tables and extensive formulas and to build them from scratch.
* Ability to manage a high volume of email without missing important items, respond promptly and escalate when necessary.

**Shift Timings -**
2- 11 PM
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. To support you, we’ve provided

on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
