description:
**Job Title: Supplier Quality Engineer**

Location: CCPL Engineering, Navi Mumbai

**Experience:**
5+ years of hands-on quality engineering in medical devices, pharma, aerospace or automotive industry

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to own product quality across our orthopedic surgical instrument manufacturing business. In this role, you will drive first-pass yield up and customer rejects down. You will lead root cause investigations, close the gap between our inspection results and our customers' incoming inspection, and work closely with our manufacturing partners to raise the quality of the parts we receive from them.

Please find more information about the company here: https://ccplengg.com/

**Key Responsibilities:**

·      Candidates should possess skills in Supplier Evaluation and Supplier Quality to assess and qualify manufacturing partners.

·      Supplier quality: Own incoming inspection of partner shipments; qualify and audit machining and finishing partners, run first article inspections, verify material certifications (ASTM F899, A564) and manage supplier corrective actions.

·      Partner process control: Get control plans, PFMEA, in-process checks and SPC in place at partner sites for critical features, so defects are caught at the source.

·      Reduce rejects and improve yield: Track first-pass yield, scrap, rework and customer rejects by part and supplier; lead projects that measurably bring them down.

·      Root cause and CAPA: Lead structured investigations (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa) into nonconformances and customer complaints; own corrective actions through to verified effectiveness.

·      Drawing and GD&T review: Review customer drawings per ASME Y14.5 before production; flag unspecified dimensions, ambiguous datums and malformed callouts with the customer up front.

·      Quality system: Keep our processes and records aligned with ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR (21 CFR 820) expectations as a registered contract manufacturer — NCR/MRB, device history records, document control and audit readiness.

·      Customer communication: Act as the technical quality contact for international customers — investigation reports, SCAR responses and clear written updates.

**Required Qualifications:**

·      B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field.

·      At least 5 years of hands-on quality engineering experience in medical device, pharmaceutical equipment or aerospace manufacturing.

·      Strong command of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and reading complex engineering drawings.

·      Proven record of quality projects that increased throughput or reduced rejects, with numbers to show for it.

·      Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

·      Ability to work on multiple projects across different industries.

**Preferred Skills:**

·      Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or a Lean manufacturing certification.

·      Experience working within a customer's quality system as a supplier or contract manufacturer.

·      Experience with orthopedic instruments or implants, and stainless steel (420, 17-4 PH, 465) or titanium parts.

·      Supplier quality engineering experience, driving improvement at external manufacturers.

**Perks & Benefits:**

·      A high-impact role with direct ownership of quality outcomes for Global medical device customers.

·      The chance to shape CCPL's supplier quality program and how we work with our manufacturing partners.

·      Work in a collaborative, close-knit team with direct access to leadership.

·      Competitive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks, with strong potential for career and salary growth.

Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday – 10:00 – 18:00

Ability to commute/relocate: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Production Engineering/Industrial Engineering or related field

Experience: 5+ years in quality engineering — medical device, pharma, aerospace or automotive manufacturing

Language: English (required)

Work Location: In person, with periodic visits to supplier sites

Interested candidates: Please submit your resume along with a cover letter to sreeramgm@ccplengg.com.

In your cover letter, describe one quality improvement project you led and the results it delivered.

Pune/Chennai/Mumbai
  
  
**Role: F&A Operations (PTP)**

* Oversee high-volume, multi-entity, multi-currency invoice processing environments.
* Ensure accurate accounting of liabilities in line with GAAP / IFRS.
* Leadership & People Management
* Lead, mentor, and develop AP managers, team leads, and analysts.
* Drive a strong culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Manage workforce planning, hiring, training, performance assessments, and succession planning.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex operational or people-related issues.
* Controls, Compliance & Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, audit standards, and tax regulations (e.g., GST, TDS, VAT).
* Partner with internal and external auditors to support successful audit outcomes.
* Implement and maintain robust documentation, SOPs, and control frameworks.
* Identify process risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Management
* Act as the primary interface for business leaders, procurement, treasury, tax, and IT teams.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships and address escalations related to payments, disputes, and compliance.
* Collaborate with Procurement to strengthen 3-way matching, invoice accuracy, and vendor onboarding controls.
* Automation & Digital Transformation
* Lead AP automation initiatives including OCR, RPA, E-invoicing, workflow tools, and ERP enhancements.
* Drive system improvements within SAP, Oracle, Workday, or similar ERPs.
* Analyze data to identify process bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
* Champion continuous improvement using Lean, Six Sigma, and process re-engineering techniques.
* Financial & Strategic Support
* Support cash flow forecasting in collaboration with Treasury.
* Partner with Finance leadership on monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities.
* Prepare and present AP performance metrics and executive dashboards.
* Contribute to broader Finance transformation and cost-saving initiatives.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Invoice processing cycle timeFirst-pass yield / accuracy rate
* On-time payment percentage
* Vendor satisfaction score
* Audit findings and control effectiveness
* Cost per invoice

* CA / CPA / CMA / ACCA Experience10–15+ years of progressive experience in Accounts Payable or Procure-to-Pay
* Minimum 5+ years in a people leadership role
* Experience in shared services / global finance operations preferred
* Strong exposure to ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, Workday, etc.)

* Strong financial and accounting acumen
* Deep understanding of AP controls, compliance, and tax concepts
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills
* Proven ability to drive transformation and automation
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Effective communication and executive presentation skills

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset
* High integrity and attention to detail
* Ability to manage complexity and ambiguity
* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability

description:

The Manager Virtual CFO is responsible for leading finance and accounting engagements, providing strategic financial advisory, managing client relationships, and overseeing the delivery of outsourced CFO services. * Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Develop MIS reports, dashboards, and management reports.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, and liquidity planning.
* Conduct profitability, variance, and financial performance analysis.

* Develop financial models for business expansion, fundraising, and investment decisions.
* Advise management on financial risks and business performance.
* Drive process improvements and finance transformation initiatives.

title: Lead Golang Engineer
description:
Lead Golang Platform Engineer

**Domain:**
Fintech / Trading & Capital Markets

**Experience:**
6–8+ Years

**Work Mode:**
To be confirmed

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Lead Golang Platform Engineer**
to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone.

Key Responsibilities

* Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.
* Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency.
* Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using
  **Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis**
  .
* Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling.
* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.
* Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization.
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana.
* Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases.
* Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

title: Brand Partnerships & Analysis Lead
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a driven, commercially sharp person to lead brand partnerships for our Partnerships & Creator Monetisation team. You will bring in the right brands, grow them into long-term partners, and design the programs and data logic that make every partnership perform.

You will work closely with brands, internal teams and senior leadership, and own both the relationships and the numbers behind every initiative you lead. It’s a high-ownership role with direct impact on revenue and margin.

**Key responsibilities**

**Brand partnerships & business development**

* Build and own the brand pipeline: identify high-potential brands, marketplaces and D2C players that fit our creator base.
* Pitch LehLah’s creator-led commerce proposition and close partnerships, from first meeting to pilot to long-term deal.
* Lead commercial negotiations on rates, terms and contracts, balancing growth with healthy margins.
* Bring new brands live every month, with smooth onboarding and a clear growth plan from day one.

**Brand growth & account management**

* Be the trusted partner and single point of contact for your brands.
* Run regular business reviews and quarterly planning with key brands: results, ROI and next steps.
* Grow every account by unlocking new categories, sale-event opportunities, campaign budgets and better commercials.
* Spot at-risk brands early and drive recovery plans.
* Bring brands insight, not just updates: present performance, opportunities and strategic recommendations.

**Leadership & cross-functional ownership**

* Own revenue and margin goals for your brands, and report progress to senior leadership.
* Turn every signed deal into a live program by rallying creator, tech, finance, sourcing and product teams.
* Represent LehLah with senior brand stakeholders.
* Build the playbooks, processes and trackers that help the brand function scale, and guide team members as it grows.

**Program design & logic**

* Design incentive structures, test vs control groups and payout logic for brand programs.
* Build creator shortlisting criteria and estimate content capacity across platforms.
* Build attribution and cost logic using cross-marketplace data, with an execution plan for each program.
* Own full-funnel tracking: Content → Views → Clicks → Orders.

**Data, analysis & reporting**

* Own the numbers behind every brand (GMV, orders, creator count, revenue and margin), including month-end reconciliation.
* Make every external report accurate, consistent and in the format brands need.
* Find the root cause of performance drops, spikes and conversion changes, and spot funnel opportunities.
* Build dashboards and KPI reports, and share data-backed projections with leadership.

**Programs you will ownQualifications**

**Education & experience**

* Bachelor’s from a Tier 1 institute (required).
* Master’s in Marketing, Strategy, Management or an MBA (preferred).
* 2–4 years in startups, e-commerce, D2C or affiliate.
* Demonstrated ability to manage projects cross-functionally.

**What we’re looking for**

* Proven experience in brand partnerships, business development or account management, with deals you’ve closed and grown.
* A natural relationship-builder who is confident with senior brand stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical thinking: comfortable building logic from scratch.
* High attention to detail, especially in external-facing data.
* An ownership mindset: you lead initiatives across teams and see them through.
* Familiarity with marketplaces (Meesho, Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart) or creator monetisation is a plus.

**Tools & skills:**
Advanced Excel · PowerPoint · SQL / Google Sheets · Google Analytics · Data dashboards · Funnel analysis · Root-cause analysis · GMV & attribution modelling · Revenue forecasting · Stakeholder reporting

**Why you’ll love it here**

* **Real ownership:**
  your work moves revenue and margin, and you’ll see the impact every week.
* **Strategy and execution:**
  you shape the plan and make it happen.
* **Big-name partners:**
  work with some of India’s leading marketplaces and brands.
* **Fast learning:**
  sit close to leadership and grow with the creator economy.

**Interested?**
Apply with your CV and a short note on a partnership or analysis you’re proud of.

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure
description:
**Manager, IT Infrastructure**

Mumbai

Working at Teach For India

Teach For India is on a journey to reach an India free of poverty and filled with love by ending educational inequity in our country. Fifteen years into our journey we are a movement of ~5000+ Alumni working at all levels of the education system, who are reaching 1 in 10 children across the country. These Alumni have graduated from our two-year Fellowship Program where they taught in under-resourced classrooms to put ~33,500 low-income children on a different life path. Today, we have ~1000 Fellows and are the largest pipeline of driven, skilled talent into the educational ecosystem in India. Over 16,000 Teach For India students have appeared for the 10th grade board examinations till date, with an impressive 95% pass rate across cities as of November 2024.

In 2022, we embarked on
**Phase 4**
, our fourth strategic phase. We have a bold and ambitious ten-year journey ahead of us that aims to
**grow 50,000 leaders**
, who will
**work collectively**
, and
**with love**
, to
**transform the lives of 1 in 10 low-income children in our regions**
, through an
**education that unleashes the potential of self, others and India**
. In this decade, five key priorities will lead us to this vision.

1. **Strengthen**
   our core Fellowship to build strong teacher leaders who provide an excellent and equitable education to our children and continue to do so beyond the Fellowship
2. **Scale**
   our impact by strategically introducing additional Fellowships as alternative pathways for leadership development
3. **Match**
   the Alumni of our programs at an intersection of their interests and the needs of the system and our children
4. **Advocate**
   for key issues that impact educational equity, and engage 3.5% of the population in the movement for educational equity
5. **Act**
   collectively with our Alumni to learn about and address key issues in our regions.

Our work will only be completed when we have built a movement of leaders that is large enough to ensure that every child in India attains an excellent education.

We pride ourselves as being a passionate, idealistic, mission-driven team of individuals. We’re committed to learning and excellence in our roles, and to being deeply rooted in our core values.

What Teach For India Can Offer You

* The opportunity to be part of one of the most established and visionary movements in the education sector in India which is at a pivotal point in terms of expanding its scale and outreach across the nation and working with changemakers across the country.
* A challenging yet flexible workplace in which every individual employee’s Staff journey is tracked for excellence and leadership development.
* A work environment in which employees’ holistic well-being is a core priority, enabling people to be their best selves.
* Access to connections and resources from the global Teach For All network that includes partner organizations spanning 50+ countries across 6 continents.
* Remuneration that is competitive within the top quartile of the Indian NGO pay scales, and a benefits package that includes extensive medical insurance and maternity coverage for both parents.

Position Summary

**Reporting to:**
Senior
Manager, IT Infrastructure

The Manager, IT Infrastructure will be responsible for ensuring each staff member and Fellow has continuous and secure access to IT Infrastructure hardware and enterprise applications for their day-to-day work activities.

Responsibilities

**Primary responsibilities:**

* **System Management:**
  Manage allocation, maintenance, and up-gradation of hardware and enterprise applications, internet connections, their maintenance, and up-gradation of network equipment in all offices.
* **Purchase and Vendor Management:**
  Manage the vendors and purchase IT infrastructure hardware and enterprise software as per the purchase process.
* **Asset Management:**
  Maintain records of all IT assets to plan for maintenance, upgrades, retirements, and future IT investments.
* **Data Backup and Recovery:**
  Responsible for data backup and recovery of deleted or lost data of users.
* **Systems’ Audit:**
  Manage systems audit and assess their outcomes.
* **Implement technology policies:**
  Implement the technology policies approved by the management and train the users about the technology policies.
* **Software Compliance:**
  Ensure timely renewals of all enterprise software application platforms, that the number of software licenses is adequate for each team, and 100% of devices used in Teach For India have genuine software licenses.

Additional Responsibilities

**As Manager Infrastructure at Teach For India**

* Contribute to
  **the team goals and priorities**
  beyond individual goals and priorities
* Serve as an
  **ambassador of the Teach For India brand**
  and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication after commiting time in our classrooms to understand our work more deeply
* Support with key organizational areas such as
  **Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Volunteering, Movement Building**

Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations

* 2-3 years working experience as IT Manager / Technology Manager in a small to medium enterprise.
* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunication is preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of System Administration with problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Familiarity with various operating systems (Windows, Mac, Android) and platforms.
* Ability to be resourceful, take responsibility and find practical solutions to problems.
* Ability to work in a deadline-based environment.
* Google/Microsoft certification in IT/System Administration is a plus, but not mandatory.
* Experience working with mobile device management tools is a plus, but not mandatory.

***Note:***
*We want to hear your unique voice and perspectives through the process, hence all applicants are expected to personally author statements of purpose/essays in the application form. Sole use of AI or Chat-GPT based tools may lead to disqualification from the process.*

description:
**Location:**
Mumbai

**Type:**
Full-time, 2-year articleship

15 November 2026

**Eligibility:**
CA Inter qualified (both groups cleared) and pursuing CA Final. This role is open only to students who have yet to start or are in the middle of articleship. Candidates who have already qualified as Chartered Accountants are not eligible.

**About the programme**

Most articleships teach you how to account for money. This one teaches you how money moves. The TCG Analyst Accelerator Program is a 2-year articleship for CA Inter qualified students who want front-office exposure to investment banking, capital markets, and strategic finance. It is built around live transaction execution, not backend compliance or routine accounting work.

**About us**

Felix Advisory, founded in 2013, operates through 7 offices across 50+ industry verticals. TCG is India’s first research-led, climate-focused investment advisory platform, with a network of 2,000+ investors and 200+ domain experts. Together, the articleship puts you at the intersection of capital markets, strategy, and climate and emerging sectors.

**What you will work on**

* Equity and debt fundraising mandates
* Mergers and acquisitions
* Due diligence
* Business valuation and financial modelling
* Research and sector analysis
* Investor evaluation, including how PE and VC firms decide

**How you will grow**

* **0–6 months:**
  Foundation and transaction immersion
* **6–12 months:**
  Controlled transaction ownership
* **12–18 months:**
  Multi-transaction leadership
* **18–24 months:**
  Senior analyst and mentoring role
* Structured training runs through four stages: research foundations, financial modelling and valuation, deal structuring (term sheets, SHA, SSA/SPA), and the investor’s perspective.
* You get weekly 1:1 reviews with a Manager or Partner, plus weekly sessions with an assigned mentor.

**Who we are looking for**

* CA Inter qualified (both groups cleared) and ready to begin a fresh 2-year articleship
* Strong analytical aptitude and comfort with financial statements and Excel
* Curiosity about businesses, sectors, and capital flows
* An owner’s mindset: if a task is assigned, you own it end to end
* Willing to work on-site in Vikhroli West, Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
* Self-driven. Mentorship is provided, but initiative has to come from you.

**What you get**

* Monthly stipend: ₹12,000 in Year 1 and ₹16,000 in Year 2
* Performance Alpha: variable pay of up to 100% of base stipend, linked to monthly quality and efficiency
* Project/Deal Bonus: 5–25X of base stipend on project completion and deal closure

* Application → Screening → Technical Round → Manager Round → Partner Round → Onboarding

title: Associate Campaign Manager
description:
**Associate Campaign Manager**

**Company: AstroGuruji**

**Location: Mumbai, India**

**Job Type: Full-time, On-site**

Company Description

**AstroGuruji**
is a digital platform that connects users with verified astrologers through chat and voice consultations, making astrological guidance more accessible and convenient. The platform allows users to explore experts, understand their areas of specialization, and choose consultations that fit their needs.

Trust, ease of use, and a high-quality consultation experience are central to AstroGuruji’s mission. By combining traditional astrological knowledge with modern technology, the team is focused on building a reliable, user-friendly experience at every step. AstroGuruji is growing and continuing to expand its product, platform, marketing initiatives, and team.

Role Description

As an
**Associate Campaign Manager**
at AstroGuruji, you will support the planning, execution, monitoring, and optimization of marketing and promotional campaigns across digital and offline channels. This role requires hands-on knowledge of
**Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid advertising platforms**
, along with an understanding of performance marketing, audience targeting, campaign analytics, and conversion optimization.

You will assist in setting up and managing advertising campaigns, monitoring daily performance, coordinating creative assets, tracking budgets, analyzing key metrics, and identifying opportunities to improve campaign results. You will work closely with marketing, sales, product, and creative teams to support user acquisition, app installs, engagement, consultation bookings, and business growth.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, detail-oriented, and eager to develop expertise in paid media and digital campaign management in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities1. Paid Advertising and Performance Marketing

* Assist in planning, setting up, executing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), YouTube Ads, Google Display Network, and other relevant platforms.
* Manage and monitor Google Search, Display, Performance Max, remarketing, app promotion, and lead generation campaigns.
* Support paid social campaigns, including audience targeting, retargeting, creative testing, and campaign optimization.
* Assist with advertising on other platforms, such as LinkedIn Ads, programmatic advertising networks, affiliate channels, and other relevant paid media platforms.
* Monitor campaign budgets, impressions, clicks, app installs, registrations, conversions, and advertising spend.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, reduce acquisition costs, and increase return on advertising spend.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to develop ad creatives, copy, and promotional assets.

2. Campaign Planning and Execution

* Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives and growth targets.
* Maintain campaign calendars, timelines, budgets, and execution trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies to ensure campaigns are launched on time.
* Assist with promotional campaigns, seasonal offers, festive campaigns, product launches, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Ensure campaign messaging, creatives, landing pages, and promotional offers are consistent with brand guidelines.
* Track campaign deliverables and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely execution.

3. Campaign Analytics and Reporting

* Monitor daily campaign performance and prepare regular reports on key marketing metrics.
* Track key performance indicators, including CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CPI, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS.
* Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Ads reporting, Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and dashboards to analyze campaign performance.
* Assist with Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, and other tracking tools to ensure accurate campaign measurement.
* Identify performance trends, audience insights, and areas for improvement.
* Recommend data-driven changes to targeting, bidding, budgets, creatives, and campaign structure.
* Maintain accurate campaign records and communicate performance updates to relevant stakeholders.

4. Growth Marketing and User Acquisition

* Support campaigns designed to increase app installs, registrations, first-time consultations, and repeat user engagement.
* Assist in developing remarketing and retargeting campaigns to re-engage existing users and improve conversions.
* Help analyze the customer acquisition funnel and identify opportunities to reduce drop-offs.
* Coordinate with product and sales teams to align campaign activities with user acquisition and revenue objectives.
* Support initiatives across digital advertising, referral marketing, influencer campaigns, and customer engagement channels.

5. Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate campaign activities with marketing, design, content, product, sales, and operations teams.
* Manage multiple campaign tasks, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Communicate campaign requirements, progress updates, and performance insights clearly.
* Support external agency and vendor coordination, including creative delivery and campaign execution.
* Stay updated on paid advertising trends, platform updates, and digital marketing best practices.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Practical knowledge or experience in digital marketing, campaign management, performance marketing, or paid media advertising.
* **Proficiency in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager**
  , including campaign setup, audience targeting, budget management, bidding strategies, ad optimization, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of Google Search Ads, Display Ads, YouTube Ads, Performance Max, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, app promotion campaigns, and remarketing.
* Familiarity with other paid advertising platforms, including LinkedIn Ads, programmatic advertising, affiliate marketing, and other relevant digital advertising channels.
* Basic understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CPI, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, and campaign analytics tools.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign reports and identify optimization opportunities.
* Good communication, coordination, and project management skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, presentation tools, and marketing dashboards.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new marketing technologies, advertising platforms, and campaign optimization techniques.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* A proactive, growth-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
* Interest in astrology or willingness to learn about the astrology industry is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

* Hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns for mobile applications, consumer brands, e-commerce businesses, or digital platforms.
* Familiarity with app install campaigns, mobile attribution tools, Firebase, AppsFlyer, or Adjust.
* Basic knowledge of landing page optimization, A/B testing, retargeting, and conversion rate optimization.
* Google Ads, Google Analytics, or Meta Blueprint certifications are an advantage.
* Experience coordinating with creative agencies, marketing vendors, or external advertising partners is beneficial.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance in this role will be measured through:

* Timely and accurate campaign setup and execution.
* Growth in app installs, registrations, and qualified users.
* Campaign performance improvements across CPC, CTR, CPA, CPI, and ROAS.
* Efficient budget utilization and adherence to campaign budgets.
* Accuracy of campaign tracking, reporting, and analytics.
* Improvements in conversion rates and user acquisition performance.
* Effective coordination with internal teams and external partners.

Why Join AstroGuruji?

* Opportunity to work with a growing technology-driven consumer platform.
* Hands-on exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, and multi-channel performance marketing.
* Opportunities to learn campaign analytics, audience targeting, and growth marketing strategies.
* Collaborative environment with exposure to marketing, product, and business teams.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to user acquisition and business growth.

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
  
  
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
  
  
As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
  
  
You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. title: Manager - Cloud Operations Lead
description:
****Job Summary****
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
**Create your own sunshine**
”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
****Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?****
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
****Job Summary:****
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Lead to run the day-to-day operations of our AWS-primary cloud estate (with a fast-growing Azure footprint) and to own and drive DevSecOps across the organisation. Reporting to the Cloud Architect within the Cloud CoE, the role spans three areas: cloud operations (about half the role), cloud-security remediation (about a quarter), and DevSecOps ownership, adoption and governance (about a quarter). In practice that means running the reliability and cost-efficiency of the cloud estate, closing security findings and hardening the environment, and owning the DevSecOps toolchain while driving its adoption and governance across delivery teams. It is a deeply technical, execution-focused role for an engineer equally comfortable in infrastructure-as-code, pipeline security, incident response, and directing a managed-services partner pool.
  
  
On the operations side, you will operate and continuously improve the landing zones, networking, and platform services designed by the Cloud Architect — primarily on AWS, and increasingly on Azure as that estate grows. You will run monitoring and observability, drive incident, problem, and change management to resolution, and enforce operational guardrails, patching, and backup/DR routines across environments. You will act as the operational owner of the NTT DATA cloud and DevSecOps managed-services pool, holding the partner to SLAs and quality standards.
  
  
On the security and DevSecOps side, you will remediate cloud-security findings and harden the estate, and own the DevSecOps toolchain and practice end-to-end — building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets-scanning, and image/container security into the delivery flow, and shifting security left. You will define secure-pipeline standards, onboard and enable delivery teams, and actively drive DevSecOps adoption and maturity across the organisation, in line with CISO requirements. Across both halves of the role you will maintain infrastructure-as-code, automate operational toil, support cloud cost/FinOps optimisation, and work within the architecture standards and guardrails set by the Cloud Architect and the Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB), escalating design changes rather than making them unilaterally.
  
  
**Areas Of Responsibility**
**Area of Responsibility**
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Operations & Reliability (~50%)**
Operate and maintain the AWS-primary cloud estate (and growing Azure footprint) for reliability and availability against agreed SLOs.
  
  
Own monitoring, alerting, and observability across infrastructure and platform services.
  
  
Drive incident, problem, and change management to timely resolution, including on-call/major-incident response.
  
  
Operate landing zones, networking, and platform services within the guardrails set by the Cloud Architect.
  
  
Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM) to provision and change environments consistently.
  
  
**Automation & Platform Engineering**
Automate operational toil across provisioning, monitoring, and scaling.
  
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform deployments in collaboration with DevOps/DevSecOps.
  
  
Perform operational debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning; document runbooks and share operational knowledge.
  
  
Operate backup, restore, and disaster-recovery routines; verify recoverability and data availability.
  
  
Implement and maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
  
  
Maintain platform health across integrated components and dependencies.
  
  
Track operational metrics and keep stakeholders informed of service health and incidents.
  
  
**Cloud Security Remediation & Hardening (~25%)**
Implement and operate cloud security and DevSecOps controls in line with CISO requirements.
  
  
Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.
  
  
Establish and report DevSecOps KPIs (pipeline coverage, scan pass rates, mean-time-to-remediate, adoption %).
  
  
Manage secrets, keys, and certificates and enforce supply-chain security (SBOM, dependency and artifact integrity).
  
  
Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Vendor Oversight**
Own the NTT DATA cloud managed-services pool: assign work, hold to SLAs, and review quality.
  
  
Track operational best practices and drive continuous improvement of run processes.
  
  
Propose and implement automation and tooling improvements to reduce toil and cost.
  
  
Pilot operational tooling (monitoring, FinOps, automation) with the Cloud Architect’s endorsement.
  
  
Feed operational insights back into architecture and standards via the Cloud Architect / EARB.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication and Reporting**
Interface with application, infrastructure, and business teams to understand operational needs.
  
  
Coordinate with external partners, vendors, and technology providers on operational delivery.
  
  
Coordinate cross-functional teams during incidents, changes, and releases.
  
  
Ensure operations meet agreed service levels and business expectations.
  
  
Clearly communicate service health, incidents, and root causes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Provide regular operational reporting (availability, incidents, cost) to the Cloud Architect and management.
  
  
**Operational Delivery & Run Management**
Own operational delivery of the cloud run function, including SLAs and service reviews.
  
  
Ensure operational commitments are met within agreed timelines and budget.
  
  
Manage the managed-services pool and schedules for operational execution.
  
  
**Travel Estimate**
**Job Scope**
**Internal Interactions (within the organization)**
Function Heads, business vertical leads/end users , procurement , SUN Infrastructure Teams (Network, Server, Database, Security), vendor payment, commercial, SAP support & other as necessary
  
  
**External Interactions (outside the organization)**
OEM, SI’s others partners/vendors/service providers in the space as applicable
  
  
**Geographical Scope**
Global
  
  
**Financial Accountability (cost/revenue with exclusive authority)**

* Cost Management:
* Execute cloud cost/FinOps optimisation: right-sizing, reserved-capacity actions, and waste elimination.
* Monitor daily cloud expenditure and enforce tagging, budgets, and lifecycle policies on storage and compute.
* Provide regular cost analysis and anomaly alerts to identify savings, escalating structural decisions to the Cloud Architect.
* Budgeting and Forecasting:
* Assist in preparing and tracking the cloud services run budget.
* Forecast run-rate cloud costs and flag variances early.
* Ensure operational cloud spend stays aligned to approved budgets.
* Vendor and Contract Management:
* Manage day-to-day relationship and tickets with cloud service providers.
* Support commercial reviews with usage data; recommend cost actions (final negotiation owned by the Cloud Architect / management).

Track consumption against contractual commitments and flag over/under-utilisation.
  
  
****Job Requirements****
**Educational Qualification**
**Specific Certification**
Mandatory Certifications
**(at least 01 in each group)**

* Cloud Certification (one or more of the following):

+ AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (Azure Administrator AZ-104 a plus, given the growing Azure estate)
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
+ Security Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified Security – Specialty (or CCSP)
+ DevSecOps / pipeline security credential — e.g. GitLab Security Specialist, GitHub Advanced Security, or Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)
+ DevOps Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
+ HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
+ Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) — value-add for Azure

Optional Certifications (any one of more of below will be a value add))
  
  

+ ITIL 4 Foundation (service operations)
+ FinOps Certified Practitioner

****Experience****
6–10 years in cloud operations / cloud engineering, running production cloud environments (AWS primary; Azure growing). Blend of experience across the three areas of this role: cloud operations (~50% — monitoring, incident/change, IaC, vendor oversight), cloud-security remediation (~25% — CSPM/vulnerability closure, hardening, CISO-aligned), and DevSecOps (~25% — CI/CD security, toolchain ownership, adoption and governance).
  
  

* Skill (Functional & Behavioural):

Functional Skills
  
  

+ Cloud Operations: Hands-on expertise operating AWS (primary) and Azure (growing) — landing zones, networking, compute, storage, and platform services in production.

title: Lead - SCADA (E&M)
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - SCADA is responsible for the operational integrity, maintenance, and security of the SCADA systems within assigned plant segments. This role ensures the smooth functioning of control systems essential for monitoring and managing automated processes, contributing to operational efficiency, safety, and productivity. By providing technical expertise in SCADA programming, network management, and system troubleshooting, the Associate enhances the reliability and security of plant operations. Additionally, they play a key role in supporting business development through technical advisement, compliance management, and assisting in the evaluation of new SCADA technologies, ultimately contributing to both the operational and strategic goals of the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Maintenance and Operation of SCADA Systems:**
Conduct regular maintenance checks on assigned SCADA systems within specific plant segments, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently by performing system diagnostics, software updates, and addressing any minor technical issues to prevent interruptions in operations.
  
  
Identify and troubleshoot any technical malfunctions in the SCADA systems, collaborating with other team members if necessary to resolve issues quickly and prevent unplanned downtime, which could impact plant productivity and safety.
  
  
**Network Security And Protocol Management**
Regularly monitor and configure network security protocols within the SCADA system to ensure safe and uninterrupted data transfer across different plant sections by managing firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption protocols that protect sensitive information.
  
  
Set up, configure, and maintain essential SCADA-related infrastructure, such as servers, switches, and routers, to provide a secure and stable network environment that supports the SCADA system and prevents unauthorized access or data breaches.
  
  
**Technical Support For Business Development**
Act as a technical advisor to the sales and business development teams, providing insights on SCADA system functionalities and potential upgrades that align with client needs by giving input on the feasibility, cost, and benefits of different SCADA solutions to aid in sales strategies and client presentations.
  
  
Engage in discussions about emerging technologies in SCADA and related control systems, communicating potential benefits to the business development team to support marketing initiatives and promote advanced solutions that could attract new clients.
  
  
**Technical Review And Vendor Communication**
Review technical specifications, industry standards, and product brochures when considering SCADA software purchases from vendors and carefully evaluate these documents to confirm the software meets plant requirements, is compatible with existing systems, and aligns with regulatory standards for SCADA.
  
  
Maintain open communication with vendors, discussing product capabilities, licensing terms, and support services to ensure any SCADA system acquisitions are well-understood, fully documented, and meet the plant's current and future technical needs.
  
  
**SCADA System Programming And Development**
Assist in developing user-friendly SCADA screens, custom databases, and reporting tools that enable efficient monitoring and analysis of plant data by designing clear, responsive interfaces that give operators real-time access to critical information and streamline workflows.
  
  
Configure and manage SCADA system networks to support data integration across various plant segments.
  
  
**Safety And Compliance Management**
Ensure that all SCADA system operations adhere to established safety protocols, regulatory standards, and industry best practices by routine checks and updates to safety features and compliance documentation, which help protect both personnel and equipment.
  
  
Maintain accurate documentation for all licenses, support contracts, and compliance-related records associated with SCADA software and hardware to avoid compliance issues, supports system audits, and ensures clear tracking of all SCADA-related liabilities and assets.
  
  
**Data Analysis And Reporting**
Collect and analyze SCADA data to generate insights into system performance, energy consumption, and operational efficiency.
  
  
Develop and deliver detailed reports to management, including recommendations for system improvements.
  
  
Maintain accurate logs of system events, alarms, and incidents for audit and compliance purposes.
  
  
**Energy Efficiency And Sustainability**
Use SCADA data to identify opportunities for energy conservation and sustainable practices.
  
  
Implement advanced control strategies to reduce energy waste and optimize resource utilization.
  
  
Collaborate with the Energy Management team to achieve airport-wide energy reduction goals.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Lead -MEPF
  
  
Plant Operations Team
  
  
Maintenance Team
  
  
IT/Network Security Team
  
  
Sales and Business Development Team
  
  
Engineering Department
  
  
Compliance and Safety Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
SCADA Software Vendors
  
  
Network and Hardware Suppliers
  
  
Regulatory Authorities
  
  
Third-Party Service Providers
  
  
Clients/Customers
  
  
Industry Consultants
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field
  
  
Certifications in SCADA systems, Industrial Automation, or Network Security (preferred)
  
  
**Work Experience**
5-7 years of experience in SCADA systems maintenance, operations, or control systems engineering in an industrial or plant setting
  
  
Experience with network configuration, server management, and troubleshooting in SCADA environments
  
  
Familiarity with industry standards, compliance protocols, and technical documentation

Job Opening: Fleet Personnel Officer

📍
**Location:**

💼

**Industry:**
Maritime / Shipping / Ship Management

📂

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Fleet Personnel Officer**
to manage and coordinate crewing activities for assigned vessels. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in crew change management, seafarer documentation, travel and visa coordination, and maritime compliance.

The role involves ensuring that vessels are manned with qualified and competent crew members while maintaining compliance with applicable maritime regulations, company procedures, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities1. Crewing Operations

* Organise and coordinate crew changes efficiently and within the required timelines.
* Plan crew changes and arrange suitable relief for crew members.
* Coordinate with port agents and monitor vessel schedules.
* Arrange flight bookings, visa formalities, and local transportation for crew members.
* Handle deviations from standard crew change procedures and document the necessary actions.
* Verify STCW certificates, training records, medical certificates, and travel documents before crew members join vessels.
* Ensure all required documentation and clearances are completed before embarkation.
* Coordinate induction programmes, briefings, and debriefings for new and promoted crew members.
* Assist vessel Masters with updating relevant crew matrices after crew changes, where applicable.
* Participate in emergency crewing duty and respond to urgent operational requirements.

2. Crew Administration & Documentation

* Maintain accurate crew records and update crew change details in the crewing database.
* Prepare and update crew lists for vessel Masters.
* Verify crew salary scales and ensure database records are consistent with employment contracts and applicable agreements.
* Monitor crew contract extensions and coordinate with internal teams and manning agents.
* Conduct regular checks of crew documentation and certificate validity.
* Review crew-related expenses and travel costs, ensuring the correct budget codes are applied.
* Verify and approve crew-related operational invoices, as authorised.
* Maintain organised records of employment contracts, crew change reports, risk assessments, evaluations, and debriefing documents.
* Ensure the confidentiality and security of seafarer information.

3. Crew Planning & Coordination

* Coordinate crew planning for assigned ranks and vessels.
* Monitor crew availability, rotation schedules, and deployment requirements.
* Work closely with fleet personnel coordinators and other relevant teams to ensure timely crew changes.
* Identify potential crewing gaps and coordinate solutions to avoid operational disruptions.

4. Compliance & Continuous Improvement

* Ensure compliance with applicable STCW requirements, medical fitness standards, and relevant maritime regulations.
* Participate in internal and external audits related to crewing operations.
* Support the review and improvement of crewing procedures, policies, and processes.
* Assist in training and onboarding manning agents when required.
* Follow up on crew evaluation reports and support performance review processes.
* Provide support during emergency response situations involving crew-related matters.

5. Communication & Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with vessel Masters, fleet teams, crew administration officers, and manning agents.
* Maintain regular communication with seafarers regarding joining instructions, documentation, travel, and deployment.
* Liaise with travel agents, port agents, authorities, and consulates for crew-related matters.
* Handle crew-related concerns professionally and sensitively.
* Provide timely updates to relevant stakeholders regarding crew changes and operational issues.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Relevant educational qualifications in Maritime Studies, Shipping, Logistics, or a related field are preferred.
* Prior experience in crewing, fleet personnel, or maritime operations is required.
* Experience with ship management companies or maritime organisations will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of crew change procedures and seafarer documentation.
* Understanding of STCW, medical certification, and maritime compliance requirements.
* Experience in crew planning, flight bookings, visa coordination, and travel logistics.
* Familiarity with crewing databases and documentation management systems is desirable.

Required Skills

* Excellent coordination and organisational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple crew changes and operational requirements simultaneously.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Attention to detail when handling documentation and compliance matters.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced maritime environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office and relevant crewing management systems.
* Professionalism and sensitivity when handling confidential seafarer information.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, responsible, and capable of managing time-sensitive crewing operations with minimal supervision. Candidates with practical experience in crew changes, fleet personnel administration, maritime documentation, and international travel coordination are encouraged to apply.

title: Franchise Manager
description:
About the job

* Senior Manager – Franchise Development · Pan-India · Reports to Head of Franchise & Retail
* The mandate. Our client, a large, listed Indian building materials company with a multi-decade brand, national retail footprint and manufacturing in Gujarat and Maharashtra, is scaling a franchise-led retail format. The pilot cluster in Gujarat has proven the model; the next phase is disciplined, fast expansion built on a strong, converting pipeline of franchise partners. This role exists to own that pipeline end to end — from first conversation to signed agreement — and to do it personally, not through a team. The person who takes this on will be the company's face to every prospective franchisee: pitching the opportunity, handling objections on economics and territory, and closing.What you will ownBuild and manage a live pipeline of prospective franchisees across target Gujarat & Maharashtra markets, sourced through referrals, market visits, dealer networks and inbound leads.
* Personally pitch the franchise opportunity to prospects — store economics, territory rights, brand support, ROI — and adapt the pitch to first-generation entrepreneurs, existing multi-brand retailers and family businesses alike.
* Run commercial negotiations on franchise terms within approved templates and escalate only genuine exceptions.
* Conduct site and market due diligence with prospects (catchment, footfall, competing formats) to qualify locations before commercial terms are discussed.
* Coordinate handoff to legal and operations post-signing so onboarding starts without delay.
* Represent the brand at trade fairs, dealer meets and regional business forums to generate inbound franchisee interest.
* Report pipeline health, conversion ratios and lost-deal reasons to the Head of Franchise & Retail on a fixed cadence.
* What you bring -
  *Must have*
  6–10 years in franchise sales, channel sales or B2B business development with a demonstrable personal track record of closing franchise, dealership or distributorship agreements (not managing a team that closes them).
* Fluent, persuasive spoken and written communication in English, Hindi and Gujarati.
* Direct experience presenting commercial/ROI-based pitches to individual entrepreneurs or small business owners, not only to corporate procurement teams.
* Comfortable with heavy field travel across Gujarat and periodic pan-India travel.

* *Strongly preferred*
  Background in building materials, tiles, sanitaryware, furniture, or another considered-purchase retail category with a franchise or dealer format.
* What we look for beyond the CVSomeone who wants to carry a number personally and close deals themselves, not delegate pitching to a junior while managing from a distance.
* Comfort reporting into a lean structure and working directly with a founder-style principal on deal terms — this is not a role with layers of internal sign-off.
* Ground-level instinct for reading a prospective franchisee's real financial appetite and risk tolerance within one or two meetings.
* Resilience through a long, relationship-driven sales cycle rather than a transactional, single-call close.
* Reporting and structureReports to the Head of Franchise & Retail. No direct reports at this stage — this is an individual-contributor, quota-carrying role. Key interfaces: legal (agreement execution), operations (store onboarding), and regional retail leadership.CompensationCommensurate with experience.

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their Firewall infrastructure remain operational through proactively identifying, investigating, and routing the incidents to correct resolver group.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions and focuses on first-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests.
  
  
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

SOC Analyst
  
  
Configure and maintain the SIEM system, ensuring that it's properly set up to collect and analyze security event data. Develop, customize, and manage security rules within the SIEM to detect and respond to security threats. Monitor SIEM alerts, investigate them, and take appropriate actions based on the severity and nature of the alerts. Oversee the collection, normalization, and storage of log data from various sources.
  
  
Develop and document incident response procedures, and lead or assist in incident response efforts when security incidents occur. Analyze and investigate security events from various sources. Manage security incidents through all incident response phases to closure. Utilize SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, EDR, NBAD,Splunk
  
  
PCAP, Vulnerability Scanning, and Malware analysis technologies for event detection and analysis.

Identify log sources and examine system logs to reconstruct event histories using forensic techniques.
  
  
Align SIEM rules and alerts with the LIC’s security policies and compliance requirements.
  
  
Conduct computer forensic investigations, including examining running processes, identifying network connections, and disk imaging.
  
  
Maintain and support the operational integrity of SOC toolsets.
  
  
Collaborate with SIEM solution vendors for updates, patches, and support to ensure the system's reliability and effectiveness.
  
  
Maintain thorough documentation of the SIEM system's configuration, procedures, and incident response plans.
  
  
Proactively identify and report system security loopholes, infringements, and vulnerabilities to the Security Operations Centre Manager in a timely manner.
  
  
Work closely with other IT and security teams during incident response, coordinating efforts and sharing information to mitigate security incidents effectively.
  
  
Ensure that the SIEM system helps the LIC meet regulatory compliance requirements and is ready for security audits.
  
  
Continuously optimize the SIEM system for efficient performance, ensuring it can handle the volume of data and remain responsive.
  
  
Develop automation scripts and workflows to streamline common security response tasks and enhance efficiency.

title: Research Engineer, Portfolio Management Group (PMG Tech), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Portfolio Management Group Technology (PMG Tech) is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group. The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with web-harvesting techniques and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence and machine learning tooling, large language model experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, and question-and-answer applications. Experience with dashboards, notebooks, lightweight research tools, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, or directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

.
