title: Principal Engineer – Mechanical (Pump & Pipeline)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP India is currently seeking a
**Principal Engineer – Mechanical (Pump & Pipeline)**
for Australia Mining Infrastructure Projects (Materials Handling Infrastructure). They shall be responsible for engineering design of Process with WSP Engineering and Client Standards. Previous experience in an EPCM environment in the O & G, Power plant, Chemical process plant, Mining processing industry is an asset.
  
  
A Team player and willing to work collaboratively with a motivated and highly successful team in Australia.
**The position will be for Mumbai location.**
**Responsibilities**
About the role:
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Engineer to support mining infrastructure projects across Australia, with a strong focus on pumping systems, pipeline networks, and water management systems.
  
  
This is a hybrid role combining process engineering, hydraulic analysis, and pipeline/pumping system design, rather than a conventional EPC-style discipline role.
  
  
The position will lead technical delivery, mentor engineers, and interface with multidisciplinary teams across Australia and India.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration and effective coordination with clients, multidisciplinary engineering teams, vendors, suppliers, pipeline route survey consultants, geotechnical investigation teams, construction contractors, and other key stakeholders to ensure engineering excellence, compliance with project requirements, timely delivery of deliverables, and successful project execution.
  
  
Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead design and analysis of:
* Pumping systems (HP pumps, transfer systems)
* Pipeline and network systems (water, slurry, dewatering)
* Define system philosophy:
* Pumping strategy and operating scenarios
* Overpressure and surge protection philosophy
* Brownfield integration and tie-ins
* Provide technical assurance and review of key deliverables like Pipeline route selection and feasibility studies, material selection, wall thickness design, pipeline stress analysis in accordance with applicable international codes and standards, design of crossings for highways, roads, railways, rivers, and other utilities, pipeline integrity management, identification and mitigation of geohazards, and preparation of material specifications and other engineering deliverables.
* Undertake and lead pipeline design work for projects and studies including typical activities and deliverables: -
* Concept design and layout development
* Process descriptions and design basis
* Material balances
* Preparation of process flow diagrams & piping and instrumentation diagrams
* Hazardous area classification/assessment
* Preparation of equipment lists, equipment datasheets, specifications
* Fluids lists and materials selection
* Process hazard studies (including HAZOP) and design safety reviews
* SIL assessment
* Process basis of safety
* Detailed process design calculations
* Pressure relief design Utilities schedules, utilities flow diagrams and line sizing
* Preparation of validation documentation
* Commissioning plans and support
* Prepare the following for pipelines and their components:
* Material specifications and datasheets
* Fabrication specifications
* Installation specifications
* Pipeline design and installation, stress analyses
* Material takeoffs
* Bids & Proposal support
* Pipeline reports and installation manual
* To ensure technical excellence in Pipeline engineering and design.
* Develop and review:
* Basis of Design (BoD)
* Design criteria and technical specifications
* P&IDs and process schematics
* Hydraulic calculations and reports
* Perform and validate:
* Hydraulic modelling (PumpSim, or equivalent)
* Flow scenarios and system behaviour
* Pipe sizing and pressure rating
* Review and guide:
* Pipe class and valve class selection
* Pump selection and system curves
* Co-ordination of a design to ensure good interface with all other disciplines.
* Participation in design reviews and technical audits.
* Input into multi-discipline design programmes.
* Contributing to processes to maintain change & cost control.
* Develop the strength of the expertise within the Pipeline engineering department.
* Support/generate cost and manhours estimate for proposals, studies and projects.
* Act as Lead Pipeline Engineer on selected projects controlling design, specifications, costs, hours, quality and programme.
* Lead and deliver Pipeline engineering scopes for mining sustaining capital and brownfield projects.
* Develop and review pipeline design documentation, including mass and energy balances, PFDs, P&IDs, process descriptions, and design reports.
* Support concept studies, feasibility assessments, and detailed design phases with Pipeline modelling and optimisation input.
* Liaise with operations teams to understand plant performance issues and develop improvement strategies.
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior Pipeline engineers and designers.
* Ensure all designs comply with WSP’s quality standards, client requirements, and relevant Australian and international codes and standards.
* Contribute to project planning, cost estimation, and risk assessments for process-related scopes.
* Make technical presentations internally, to clients and to outside organisations.
* To ensure that process safety issues are fully considered within projects eg. HAZOP, LOPA, hazardous area classification, SIL reviews.
* Contribute to:
* Maintenance strategies
* System operability and reliability improvements
* Provide practical, field-aligned engineering solutions

Client / External focus
  
  

* Maintain strong colleague relationships and contribute to the teams’ performance of client satisfaction.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing in internal and external forums.
* Remain up to date with market and competitor knowledge.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Lead Pipeline engineering activities associated with mining infrastructure projects including:
* Raw water systems
* Mine water management systems
* Mine dewatering systems
* Tailings transport systems
* Reclaim water systems
* Slurry transport systems
* Process water distribution networks

Mandatory Skills
  
  
We anticipate you will have an interest in the following areas:
  
  

* You will also be computer literate with a reasonable proficiency in MS office suite and Navisworks.
* Having a thirst for knowledge, cultural awareness, an open mind, and good English
* communication skills are essential, along with the ability to work as part of a team.
* Coordinating his/her work with other members of the Team.
* Work competently with minimal supervision or on an individual basis.
* The candidate must have a valid passport.
* Key competencies expected are:
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Technical Capability & Delivery
* Adaptability & Learning

**Desired Skills**
Strong experience in:
  
  

* Pumping systems and pipeline networks
* Hydraulic design and system analysis

Good understanding of:
  
  

* Overland pipelines
* Transient / surge analysis

Exposure to:
  
  

* Slurry pipelines and rheology (desirable)

Experience in:
  
  

* Technical documentation and specifications
* Multidisciplinary coordination

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 13-16 years of experience in process engineering.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree & preferred master’s degree in mechanical/civil engineering. PG diploma or certificate in Piping engineering would be an asset.
* Strong organizational, technical, and communication skills.
* Strong attention to the detail.
* Familiar with working in a LEAN environment.
* Experience with projects in Australia, New Zealand would be an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, in English.
* C. Eng, P. Eng qualification would be an added advantage.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Investment Associate – Venture Capital
description:
**Investment Associate – Venture Capital**

**Location: Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

**About Rockstud Capital**

**Rockstud Capital is an India-focused investment platform managing SEBI-registered Category I and Category II Alternative Investment Funds. Our current investment focus centres on manufacturing-led businesses and applied deep technology, including advanced manufacturing, industrial systems, defence, aerospace, space technologies, industrial sustainability and manufacturing-led consumer businesses.**

**We assess opportunities through commercial and operating fundamentals: engineering capability, competitive differentiation, unit economics, capital efficiency, governance and the ability to scale. We work closely with founders on investment strategy, business priorities and long-term growth.**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for an Investment Associate who can independently identify promising businesses, build relationships with founders and industry participants, and develop well-reasoned investment recommendations.**

**This is a sourcing-led investment role within a lean, founder-led team. You will take ownership of opportunities from identification and initial engagement through preliminary evaluation and preparation for deeper diligence, working closely with colleagues responsible for transaction execution and portfolio management.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Originate investment opportunities:**
  Build a consistent pipeline aligned with Rockstud’s investment focus through direct founder outreach, sector research and relationships with investors, incubators, accelerators and industry networks.
* **Own founder engagement:**
  Lead initial discussions, ask commercially relevant questions, maintain timely follow-ups and build constructive relationships.
* **Develop sector insight:**
  Map industries, value chains and emerging businesses to identify attractive investment themes and sourcing opportunities.
* **Evaluate businesses:**
  Assess business models, market opportunities, competitive positioning, technology differentiation, customer adoption, unit economics and scalability.
* **Analyse financial performance:**
  Review financial statements, build appropriate projections and valuation analyses, and assess working-capital requirements, capital intensity and funding needs.
* **Prepare investment recommendations:**
  Write clear screening notes and investment memos that explain the opportunity, key risks, unresolved questions and recommended next steps.
* **Support diligence and transactions:**
  Coordinate with the investment team, founders and relevant specialists, ensuring a clear handover of findings, documents and outstanding issues.
* **Maintain investment records:**
  Keep pipeline information, meeting notes, source documents and next actions current and organised.
* Contribute to selected portfolio and strategic projects where your sector knowledge or relationships can add value.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Relevant experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, transaction advisory, consulting or an industrial/technology business.
* Evidence of independently identifying opportunities, developing relationships and taking work through to a clear outcome.
* A strong interest in manufacturing and applied technology, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and distinguish technical claims from commercial potential.
* Sound financial analysis, modelling and valuation skills.
* Clear writing and communication, including the ability to form and defend an investment view.
* Initiative, sound judgement and disciplined follow-through in a lean team.
* Comfort working from our Mumbai office and travelling for founder meetings, industry engagement and site visits when required.
* A degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or a related discipline. CA, CFA progress or an MBA would be an advantage.
* Candidates should be able to explain their individual contribution to previous sourcing, evaluation or transaction work, including the decisions made and outcomes achieved.

title: Staff Engineer – Mechanical Design
description:
**Position Title:**
Staff Engineer – Mechanical Design
  
  
**Department**
**:**
HB Engineering
  
  
The Bloom Energy Mumbai team seeks a highly motivated Engineer to support its Fuel Cell Hotbox Engineering team. The Staff engineer will be an integral part to drive the conceptual design, analysis, and execution of highly engineered SOFC powered systems. The role bridges early-stage R&D with manufacturing, demanding expertise in CAD, cross-functional engagement, and compliance with strict industrial standards
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities**
**:**
**System Design & Engineering:**

* Execute the design, analysis, and evaluation of assigned components for advanced Solid oxide fuel cell components and systems
* Develop ideas and concepts to improve design and reliability of mechanical components of HotBox, columns and other SOFC sub-systems as assigned by stakeholders
* Very strong fundamentals on thermodynamics, mechanics, heat transfer, and metrology with ability to reason through ambiguous problem statement and break it down into tangible and actionable steps.
* High degree of comfort in performing hands-on work and ability to prototype and test out concepts quickly
* Ability to engage and collaborate with stakeholders, making independent decisions within defined requirements to resolve complex technical design challenges
* Review designs and consult with senior technical leaders for evaluation of work
* Participate in a team framework on next generation technology development to enable future design advancements, while independently executing tasks leveraging your technical skills.
* Maintain documentation of designs, test results, and engineering change orders
* Prepare CAD models, drawing, specifications, and detailed design basis documentation for solid oxide fuel cell system and component design

**Analysis & Validation:**

* Work closely with modeling team to evaluate the design and iterate the design based on feedback from the CFD and FEA team.
* Lead prototype testing programs in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams to characterize and improve reliability and durability

**Manufacturing & Sourcing:**

* Work with manufacturing, supply chain and quality team to ensure DFM (design for manufacturing)
* Works closely with sourcing and manufacturing to support cost reduction activities

**Key Skills Required:**

* Knowledge of mechanical engineering principles. heat transfer, thermal stresses and drafting practices.
* Demonstrated problem solving ability and ability to perform complex engineering analyses and complete documentation
* Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD modeling, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T)
* Knowledge of high temp material and ceramics is desirable
* Good understanding of the structure and properties of engineering materials
* Demonstrate good failure analysis and root cause analysis skills.
* Must be willing to do Hands-on testing on projects.
* Demonstrate a hard-working attitude and self-motivation.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Team player.
* Motivated self-starter, capable of organizing tasks with little to no oversight
* Good interpersonal skills and proven ability to establish effective cross-functional working relationships; Ability to effectively participate in multi-disciplinary teams.

**Education:**

* BTech degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Master’s in Mechanical/Material Science/Aerospace is essential

**Experience**
: Between 6-8 years of related experience in the field as mentioned above.
  
  
**Reports To**
**:**
Engineering Hotbox, India
  
  
**Location**
**:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About Bloom Energy:**
Bloom Energy is changing the way the world generates and consumes energy.
  
  
Our unique on-site power generation systems utilize an innovative new fuel cell energy technology with roots in NASA's Mars program.
  
  
Derived from a common sand-like powder, and leveraging breakthrough advances in materials science, our technology is able to produce clean, reliable, affordable energy from a wide range of renewable energy sources or traditional fuels.
  
  
Our energy servers are among the most efficient energy generators on the planet, providing significantly reduced electricity costs and dramatically reduced greenhouse gas emissions.
  
  
By generating power on-site, where it is consumed, Bloom Energy offers increased electrical reliability and improved energy security, providing a clear path to energy independence.
  
  
Founded in 2001, Bloom Energy is headquartered in San-Jose, California.

title: Assistant Manager, Accounts Payable
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
We are looking for an Assistant Manager , Accounts Payable to join our Finance team and play a key role in managing day-to-day invoice processing and Accounts Payable activities.
  
  
In this role,you will own end-to-end Accounts Payable operations across our US, India, UK and Swiss entities, and the reporting that gives management visibility into payables, vendor exposure and cash commitments. You are required to set the standard for AP accuracy, control, and timeliness. You work closely with procurement, business users, taxation, and the month-end close team
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the full procure-to-pay AP cycle across markets: invoice validation, PO matching, coding, approvals, payment runs and reconciliations.
* Review and approve payment proposals against due dates, priorities, and cash availability.
* Review vendor ageing, advances and open balances, and ensure timely vendor statement reconciliations.
* Act as the escalation point for vendors and internal queries, resolving issues quickly with procurement and business users.
* Govern vendor master data, including onboarding checks and bank detail changes
* Ensure correct withholding tax and indirect tax treatment on vendor invoices (TDS and GST in India, 1099 reporting in the US, VAT in the UK and Switzerland).
* Reconcile GSTR-2B with the purchase and vendor ledgers each month.
* Coordinate with the tax team on AP-related filings and queries.
* Identify control gaps and drive corrective action.
* Prepare AP schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents for statutory, internal and tax audits, and close audit observations related to AP.
* Maintain controls against duplicate, incorrect, and unauthorized payments.
* Deliver AP sub-ledger reconciliations, accruals, prepayments and GRNI reviews within close timelines.
* Resolve open items and ensure AP-related journals are accurate and supported.
* Produce a regular AP reporting pack covering ageing, DPO, payment commitments, vendor concentration, statutory liabilities, and cash outflow forecasts.
* Provide inputs to treasury and the CFO for cash flow planning and working capital decisions.
* Track and report AP KPIs such as invoice cycle time, first-pass match rate, overdue payables, and late-payment exposure.
* Identify and implement improvements in AP workflow, invoice capture, approvals, and reconciliations.
* Drive effective use of Oracle Fusion and work with IT on automation initiatives.
* Document and maintain SOPs for AP and reconciliation processes.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* CA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent, with 6 to 8 years of AP experience, preferably across multiple geographies.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close and audit support
* Strong working knowledge of withholding tax and indirect tax (India required; US, UK and Swiss exposure preferred).
* Working knowledge of accounting principles (Ind AS, US GAAP, or IFRS).
* Proficiency in an ERP, with Oracle or Oracle Fusion preferred, and advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliations). Power BI or similar is a plus.
* Strong analytical, reconciliation, and reporting skills.
* Attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to work tight deadlines across time zones.
* Clear communication with vendors, auditors, and senior management.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a recruiter screening, followed by 4 interview rounds, including the HRBP interview.
  
  
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

You will work on a wide range of projects, lead junior engineers, and draw on support from the wider EP&W team as needed. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with EP&W engineers and multidisciplinary teams across Arup, from early concept advice to advanced modelling for some of the firm’s most high-profile and complex projects.
  
  
We are looking for someone who delivers high-quality work on time and on budget, with a proven track record in numerical analysis of internal and external flows to inform design decisions (e.g., wind and thermal comfort, emissions dispersion, ventilation, HVAC, and building physics).
  
  
As a senior member of the EP&W Practice, you will bring strong communication and negotiation skills and experience leading project teams. You will mentor and support others, helping the team grow and develop. We actively support learning and development, including access to relevant training.
  
  
You will have strong commercial, client-facing skills and represent Arup externally with minimal supervision. An established client network is an advantage. You should have experience in CFD modelling (OpenFOAM, ANSYS CFX or Fluent) and working with geographically distributed teams. Experience in datacentre CFD, microclimate design, dynamic thermal modelling and/or wind engineering is a plus.
  
  
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
  
  
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
  
  
**Is this role right for you?**
**We Are Looking For Candidates With**

* Degree in Aeronautical/Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent) and Chartered (or close to) with a relevant institution (e.g., IMechE).
* 7+ years in consultancy (incl. 3+ years senior) with sector experience in one or more of: datacentres, property, urban microclimates, labs.
* Modelling skills: CFD (OpenFOAM and/or ANSYS CFX/Fluent), plus dynamic thermal modelling (EnergyPlus/IES or similar); Python and Rhino/Revit exposure preferred.
* Strong project delivery and commercial skills: manage budgets, programme constraints, scope/fee/terms, and change control.
* Leadership and communication: lead and mentor engineers, write clear reports, and present technical solutions (incl. CFD) to clients and stakeholders; excellent English and a collaborative style.
* Business development: contribute to winning work and build strong internal and external networks.

**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance
  
  
**Different people, shared values**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

title: Senior Manager- Corporate Partnerships & Careers
description:
Who we are

Plaksha is a 21st-century university focused on solving global challenges through transformative technology education. A unique collective philanthropy effort, our initiative is driven by a dedicated team committed to reimagining technology education in India.

Role : Senior Manager – CPC Outreach

Location: Mumbai

The Senior Manager – CPC Outreach is responsible for driving corporate engagement and building a robust pipeline of industry partners for internship and placement opportunities at Plaksha. Based in Mumbai, this role serves as the primary interface between Plaksha’s Office of Corporate Partnerships & Careers (CPC) and the corporate ecosystem, with a focus on establishing long-term, mutually value-adding relationships with leading organizations. The incumbent works closely with the Head – CPC, internal stakeholders including faculty and students, to align industry engagement with Plaksha’s mission of producing future-ready, industry-relevant talent.

Job Description

Corporate Outreach & Pipeline Development:

Identify, approach, and onboard new corporate partners for internships, placements, and broader engagement with Plaksha’s student community.

Build and manage a structured funnel of leads by mapping target companies, researching hiring needs, and executing a systematic outreach strategy in coordination with the Head – CPC.

Pitch Plaksha’s talent proposition to senior industry leaders including CHROs, CTOs, COOs, and Business Heads, and independently front-end these high-stakes conversations.

Relationship Management & Partner Engagement:

Develop and deepen relationships with strategic corporate partners with the primary objective of securing firm, repeatable hiring commitments for Plaksha students.

Act as the key point of contact for partner companies, ensuring timely responses, proactive updates on student profiles, and seamless coordination during hiring cycles.

Enhance partner experience by creating year-round touchpoints – company visits, leadership talks, live projects, and co-branded events – beyond just the placement season.

Maintain a structured CRM of partner interactions, commitments, and engagement history.

Conceptualize and organize events, industry conclaves, and networking forums that bring together senior leaders and the Plaksha community.

Leverage events as a platform to deepen existing partnerships and generate new leads for the CPC pipeline.

Represent Plaksha at external forums, industry associations, and HR conferences to enhance brand visibility in the corporate ecosystem.

Internship & Placement Execution:

Work with the CPC team to plan and execute the annual placement and internship calendar, ensuring adequate corporate participation across sectors and roles.

Coordinate with partner companies to gather Job Descriptions, confirm participation timelines, and manage the end-to-end recruitment process on campus.

Ensure a high quality of roles offered – aligned to Plaksha’s student profiles.

Oversee the entire placement process, from employer outreach to final offer negotiations, ensuring seamless execution.

Organize company visits, pre-placement talks, industrial tours, guest lectures, and expert sessions to enhance corporate engagement.

Work closely with students to provide guidance on career opportunities, resume building, and interview preparation.

Track offer status, conversion rates, and stipend / CTC data, and maintain accurate placement records for reporting and accreditation purposes.

Brand Positioning & Market Intelligence:

Develop and maintain a strong understanding of industry hiring trends, competitor university placements, and evolving skill demands to sharpen Plaksha’s employer positioning.

Work closely with the founding community, faculty, and students to align industry engagement with academic objectives and student career aspirations.

Collaborate with faculty to develop co-curricular projects, capstone assignments, and live case studies with corporate partners.

Leverage professional networks, LinkedIn, and industry databases to generate actionable intelligence on potential partners and role opportunities.

Provide inputs on Plaksha’s employer branding collateral, student showcase events, and digital outreach to strengthen corporate mindshare.

Education & Experience

Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields; MBA with specialization in Sales, Marketing, or Business Development is preferred

Minimum 12+ years of relevant experience in corporate relations, campus placements, B2B sales, talent advisory, or executive search.

Prior experience in a university placement office or an organization working at the intersection of academia and industry is an advantage.

Key Skills

Excellent communication skills – oral and written – with the ability to engage senior leaders with confidence and credibility.

Strong understanding of industry trends, employer expectations, and career pathways for students in technology and innovation

Strategic thinking ability and analytical skills; ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Commitment to excellence, accuracy, and attention to detail in all external communications and data management.

What can Plaksha offer you?

An opportunity to collaborate and work with the best global academic and business leaders.

A challenging yet flexible workplace with a focus on excellence and leadership development for all team members.

A work culture that promotes continuous learning and development, enabling people to be their best selves.

An opportunity to be part of one of the largest collective philanthropy initiatives to reimagine higher education and build future skills for the next generation.

title: Organic Growth Lead (US Market)
description:
Work Timings - 5 PM to 2 AM IST (US Eastern Time Zone)

Location - Mumbai Office (Andheri East) - In-Person Role

Pepper helps brands win
**organic search, AI search, and every organic channel that drives growth**
. We're building an AI-native customer success team, and we're looking for an
**Organic Growth Lead**
to own organic growth for a small set of our customers across search, AI engines, and channel-level distribution.

Search is changing fast. Buyers now discover brands through Google, through AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and through communities and creators on YouTube, LinkedIn, and Reddit. We're looking for someone who understands this new landscape deeply and can confidently build growth across all of it.

If that sounds like the work you want to be known for, this one's for you.

About the role

As an Organic Growth Lead, you'll be the growth partner for a focused set of accounts (around 5–6). You'll set the growth direction, work alongside an SEO Lead, and lead a small pod that brings the plan to life. You won't do it alone — you'll have a strong team, proven playbooks, our AI workflows, and a center of excellence behind you.

This is a role where strategy and delivery come together: you decide what will move the needle for each customer across SEO, GEO, and distribution, then make sure it actually ships.

What you'll do

* Own the growth plan for your accounts — what we focus on, the pace, and the channels that matter most for each customer
* Partner with an SEO Lead and guide a pod (content, SEO/GEO, distribution, and project management) where everyone does one job really well
* Run and refine our AI-powered content and SEO workflows (we'll train you on these)
* Keep customers close with clear communication, regular reviews, and honest reporting
* Connect the work back to outcomes that matter: organic growth that turns into pipeline

Win in AI Search and GEO

This is central to the role, not a side skill. You'll own how our customers show up in AI-driven search:

* Build a clear point of view on how AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews — retrieve, rank, and cite brands, and what it takes to be the answer they surface
* Shape content, entities, and authority signals so our customers get cited and recommended by AI engines, not just ranked on a blue-link page
* Run GEO audits and turn them into concrete fixes: structure, schema, entity coverage, citability, and brand attribution
* Stay ahead of how AI search is evolving and translate that into an advantage for every account

Own channel-level distribution

Great content only wins when it reaches the right place. You'll build distribution strategy that goes well beyond the website, with a real understanding of how each channel actually works:

* **SEO / GEO**
  — search and AI-answer visibility as the foundation
* **YouTube**
  — search and suggested-led discovery, and how video compounds organic reach
* **LinkedIn**
  — founder- and brand-led organic reach and thought leadership
* **Reddit and communities**
  — authentic presence plus the growing role of community content in both Google and AI search
* **Digital PR**
  — authority, links, and building the brand as a recognised entity

You'll decide which channels matter for each customer, why, and how they reinforce each other — then drive the pod to execute.

What you'll bring

* Strong experience in SEO, content, or organic growth, with a real understanding of how organic compounds over time
* A confident grasp of
  **GEO and AI search**
  — or a deep curiosity and the drive to become an expert fast
* An understanding of
  **channel-level distribution**
  : how YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Digital PR each work, and how to use them together
* An ownership mindset: you like setting direction, not just ticking off tasks
* Comfort using AI tools to work faster and better — we'll help you level up
* Strong communication and the ability to build trust with customers
* The ability to juggle a few accounts and keep them all moving

Nice to have

* Hands-on experience improving AI-search visibility and earning AI citations
* A background in agencies, consulting, or in-house growth teams
* Proven results on a specific distribution channel (YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, or Digital PR)
* A habit of turning wins into repeatable systems and SOPs

Why you'll love it here

* You'll be at the heart of Pepper's shift to an AI-native growth team, working on the most interesting problem in search right now
* Real support: structured onboarding, workshops (including SEO/GEO audits), playbooks, and a sharp engineering team building tools for you
* A focused book of accounts so you can go deep, not spread thin
* Plenty of room to grow as we scale this team

title: Associate Campaign Manager
description:

This role sits at the intersection of media execution, publisher strategy, and client advisory — requiring someone equally adept at optimizing campaign delivery in real time and presenting clear, strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.

It also serves as the primary point of escalation for fraud prevention, traffic quality, commercial proposals, and billing operations.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Campaign Management**

* Own end-to-end campaign setup, launch, optimization, troubleshooting, and delivery across multiple APAC markets and channels.

**Publisher Management**

**Account Management Support**

* Support Client Partners with performance insights, campaign troubleshooting, and strategic recommendations.
* Respond daily to client inquiries, provide campaign status updates, and investigate performance concerns.
* Participate in weekly performance calls with clients; prepare and deliver recommendations and custom strategy outputs as requested.

**Fraud Prevention & Traffic Quality**

* Monitor and identify fraudulent activity, suspicious publishers, and traffic quality risks across the APAC portfolio.
* Review fraud dashboards daily; investigate blocked traffic, rejected installs, and suspicious activity patterns.
* Lead weekly publisher quality reviews and fraud trend analyses; generate and communicate optimization recommendations.

**Finance & Billing Support**

* Support billing reconciliation and validation processes for APAC publisher activity.
* Submit publisher invoices to the finance team on a weekly basis; proactively communicate on pending payments.
* Provide monthly billing validation to all publishers, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.

**Commercial & Strategic Support**

* Support Client Partners and Management with campaign planning, proposals, inventory forecasting, and commercial requests.
* Respond to rate card requests, provide inventory availability assessments, estimate campaign volume and KPI feasibility.
* Support proposal development; deliver historical benchmark data and market insights to inform client strategy.

**Experience & Background**
**What You Need For This Role**

* 5+ years in mobile app performance advertising, ad operations, or programmatic media ideally within a DSP, ad network, or publisher-side environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing publisher relationships and traffic quality in the APAC market.
* Hands-on experience with mobile measurement platforms (e.g. AppsFlyer, Adjust, Kochava) and DSPs.
* Prior exposure to fraud detection tools and traffic quality frameworks.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset - comfortable working with large datasets and translating data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication skills; able to present complex performance narratives clearly to clients and senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and operational rigour, particularly in billing and reconciliation workflows.
* Commercial acumen - able to support proposal development and provide market benchmarking.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-market environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working across multiple APAC markets especially SEA
* Familiarity with CRM tools and publisher onboarding workflows.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reporting; SQL or BI tool experience a plus.
* Fluency in English required; additional APAC language skills advantageous.

**What Will Make Us Really Love You**

* You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience.
* You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table.
* You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.
* You have an eye for detail.
* You thrive on teamwork but also bring a driven, goal-oriented spirit.
* You’re genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad-tech, and staying ahead of industry trends.
* You have the ability to engage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way.

**What You’ll Love About Us**

* We care about your individuality by giving you freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position
* Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising
* Be part of a company with a truly global footprint, working with leading brands, platforms, and publishers across 90+ markets.
* We foster a dynamic environment where creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas are encouraged and celebrated.
* Join a diverse, multicultural team that values and embraces different perspectives, experiences, and talents.
* At Aleph, your work directly contributes to connecting brands and consumers in meaningful ways, shaping the future of digital advertising.

**Why Join Us?**
This is your chance to make a real impact by shaping the future of our talent strategy. You'll be part of a forward-thinking organization where your insights and leadership will help guide us toward global success. If you’re ready to be at the forefront of transforming talent management, we want to hear from you!
  
  
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
  
  
“Share our similarities, celebrate our differences.” – M. Scott Peck
  
  
#ALEPH

We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

is the single-threaded owner of sneaker category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on sneaker culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.
  
  
**You Will Act As:**

* The internal authority on the primary and secondary sneaker ecosystem
* The external face of StockX to sneaker sellers, creators, and community leaders
* The architect of the sneaker go-to-market / growth playbook for this new initiative

This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to sneakers within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader sneaker portfolio and team.
  
  
****What You’ll Do:****
**Own the Sneakers Category End-to-End**

* Define and execute the growth strategy for sneakers within the platform
* Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue
* Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms

**Be the Market & Culture Expert**

* Maintain deep, current knowledge of sneaker culture, including:

+ Key sellers, creators, collectors, and resellers
+ Sub-segments (hype vs. GRs, vintage, performance, regional markets, etc.)
+ Drops, releases, brand dynamics, and cultural moments
+ Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics

* Serve as the internal voice of the sneaker community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions

**Supply & Creator Acquisition**

* Build and own a pipeline of high-impact sneaker sellers, shops, influencers, and creators
* Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform
* Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce

**Commerce Strategy & Category Moments**

* Identify and orchestrate sneaker-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion
* Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations
* Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with Account & Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to sneaker sellers and buyers
* Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization

**Build the Playbook**

* Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories
* Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX
* Support hiring and onboarding as the sneaker category team grows

****About You:****

* Deeply embedded in sneaker culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem
* 5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in sneakers, streetwear, or adjacent ecosystems
* Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt
* Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, and community members
* Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives
* Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up

****Nice To Have:****

* Existing network of sneaker resellers, store owners, creators, or influencers
* Experience buying and selling sneakers or operating within resale marketplaces
* Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities
* Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams

Sneakers will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:
  
  

* The cultural bar for the platform
* The go-to-market & growth blueprint for future categories
* The credibility of StockX with the sneaker community

title: Short Form Content Video Editor (Premier pro and After Effects)
description:
**About Mesmerize India**

Mesmerize India is a fast-growing D2C jewellery and lifestyle accessories brand, known for premium men’s jewellery, natural stone bracelets, spiritual accessories, rings, cuffs, necklaces, and innovative product features like MagSnap.

Our brand combines style, meaning, craftsmanship, and modern design to create products that are not just worn, but personally connected with. From premium product launches to high-performing ad campaigns, we focus on creating content that feels aspirational, emotional, and conversion-driven.

As we continue to scale, we are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and skilled Video Editor who can help bring the Mesmerize brand story to life through engaging, premium, and high-quality video content.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a passionate Video Editor who understands storytelling, social media trends, product presentation, and brand aesthetics. The ideal candidate should be able to convert raw footage into visually strong, scroll-stopping videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, ads, product launches, website creatives, and brand campaigns.

You will play an important role in shaping how customers experience Mesmerize visually, whether through product reels, lifestyle edits, UGC videos, launch teasers, ads, behind-the-scenes content, or premium brand storytelling.

**Key Responsibilities**

Video Editing & Production

● Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and high-quality videos for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, website, ads, and other digital platforms.

● Create premium product-focused edits for jewellery, natural stone bracelets, rings, cuffs, necklaces, and spiritual accessories.

● Add smooth transitions, effects, text animations, motion elements, and visual enhancements where required.

● Maintain consistency with Mesmerize’s brand tone, visual style, pacing, and premium aesthetic.

● Work on different video formats including reels, UGC ads, cinematic product videos, launch teasers, testimonials, lifestyle edits, and campaign videos.

Content Creation & Optimization

● Create short-form and long-form video content for social media, paid ads, website banners, and product launches.

● Understand platform-specific formats and optimize videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta ads, website sections, and performance campaigns.

● Work closely with the marketing, content, design, and product teams to develop fresh and engaging video ideas.

● Edit videos that are not just visually appealing, but also hook-driven, story-led, and conversion-focused.

● Adapt raw product shoots, influencer content, and internal footage into usable marketing assets.

Motion Graphics & Animation

● Add basic motion graphics, kinetic typography, animated text, callouts, icons, and product highlights to improve video impact.

● Create engaging product feature videos explaining USPs such as MagSnap, stainless steel, anti-tarnish finish, natural stones, spiritual engravings, and other product benefits.

● Use simple animation and visual effects to make product launches, offers, and campaign creatives more engaging.

Sound & Music Editing

● Sync voiceovers, music, sound effects, and product sounds properly with the video.

● Choose suitable background music that matches the mood of the content, whether premium, emotional, energetic, spiritual, or cinematic.

● Balance audio levels for voiceovers, dialogues, sound effects, and background music.

● Add sound design wherever needed to make product videos feel more premium and engaging.

Creative Storytelling

● Transform raw footage into engaging narratives that connect with the audience emotionally and visually.

● Understand the difference between organic content, UGC content, product-led content, and ad creatives.

● Stay updated with trending reel formats, editing styles, hooks, transitions, and ad formats.

● Bring fresh ideas to the table for product launches, campaign videos, and social media content.

● Help the brand create content that feels premium, relatable, and performance-driven.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

● 1-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably in D2C, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle, e-commerce, or social media content.

● Strong knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar editing tools.

● Basic knowledge of motion graphics, typography animation, and product callout animation.

● Good understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta ads, and social media video formats.

● Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, transitions, music, and visual flow.

● Understanding of color grading, sound editing, video compression, and export settings.

● Ability to work with tight deadlines while maintaining video quality.

● Attention to detail, especially while working with jewellery, product close-ups, skin tones, lighting, and premium visual aesthetics.

● Ability to take feedback positively and revise edits based on brand and campaign requirements.

**Bonus Skills**

● Experience in jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, grooming, or product-based video editing.

● Experience editing UGC-style ads, influencer videos, unboxing videos, product feature videos, and launch campaigns.

● Basic photography or videography skills.

● Familiarity with AI-based editing tools and workflow-enhancing platforms.

● Knowledge of 3D product animation or product visualization will be a plus.

● Understanding of performance ads and what kind of edits work for conversion-focused campaigns.

**Why Join Mesmerize India?**

● Be part of a fast-growing D2C jewellery and lifestyle accessories brand.

● Work on premium product launches, ad campaigns, and social media content seen by a large audience.

● Get creative freedom to experiment with new editing styles, storytelling formats, and campaign ideas.

● Work with a young, creative, and fast-moving team.

● Grow with a brand that values ideas, quality, creativity, and execution.

● Be a part of a brand that believes in creating products with meaning, style, and substance.

title: Brand Experience & Community Outreach Interns
description:
We’re hiring: Brand Experience & Community Relations Interns ✨
  
  
Join TFS Luxe Pharmacies for our biggest marketing campaign ever.
  
  
Our brand, 24/7, is a pharmacist-led neighbourhood pharmacy bringing round-the-clock access to medicines and care closer to home.
  
  
This internship will give you hands-on exposure to connecting directly with residents in premium Lodha residential communities across South Bombay and learning how a growing hyperlocal business builds awareness, relationships and trust.
  
  
We’re looking for people who will take ownership of representing our brand and bring confidence, warmth and professionalism to every interaction.
  
  
If you want to learn how to approach people, communicate more confidently and build meaningful customer relationships, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
And if you’re interested in building your own startup, this is an opportunity to gain practical experience with a growing business and understand the work that goes into reaching customers.
  
  
You’ll gain exposure to:
  
• Understanding customer behaviour and building client relationships.
  
• Approaching potential customers and creating awareness about a brand and its services.
  
• Understanding how a hyperlocal business grows from the ground up.
  
• Learning practical marketing, sales and on-ground brand activation skills.
  
• Luxury brand representation and outreach through polished communication and personalised engagement with residents in premium communities.
  
  
We’ll begin with training on 24/7 Pharmacy, our services, how the business has grown, and how startup operations support that growth.
  
  
You’ll then put that learning into practice through door-to-door resident outreach, introducing our services, distributing campaign hampers and materials, and gathering customer feedback.
  
  
The aim is to help you develop transferable communication, marketing and client-handling skills you can use throughout your career, in your own ventures and in everyday life.
  
  
Top-performing interns will have the opportunity to progress into full-time roles with TFS Luxe Pharmacies.
  
  
📍 Location: Selected Lodha residential communities and more, South Bombay.
  
  
💰 Stipend: ₹5,000 for the one-month internship plus incentives for top performing interns
  
📅 Duration: One month | Seven days a week
  
🕒 Reporting: 2 PM | Outreach: 3–7 PM
  
📜 Internship certificate upon completion
  
📢 Top candidates may be permanently retained
  
  
Students and recent graduates with strong communication skills, confidence, professionalism and an interest in marketing, customer engagement and community relations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
  
#MumbaiInternships #MarketingInternship #BrandExperience #StartupExperience #CommunityRelations

title: Head of Demand Generation
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Head of Marketing to lead Pixelo's demand generation function. This role will be responsible for driving pipeline growth through outbound and inbound channels, leading a high-performing team, and ensuring alignment between Marketing and Sales to achieve revenue goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute the overall demand generation strategy to drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
* Own and optimise multi-channel outbound campaigns across Email, Cold Calling, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other channels.
* Lead inbound demand generation initiatives through SEO, Paid Ads, Content Marketing, and Marketing Automation.
* Manage, mentor, and develop the Demand Generation team.
* Drive SQL, MQL, meetings booked, and pipeline generation targets.
* Partner with Sales and Content teams to improve messaging, lead quality, and conversion rates.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyse data, and implement optimisation strategies.
* Conduct market and competitor research to identify growth opportunities.
* Manage client interactions and present campaign performance and strategic recommendations.
* Contribute hands-on to prospecting, client calls, and key growth initiatives when required.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have completed the Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Management and relevant fields.
* 6 - 10 years of relevant work experience in B2B SaaS Demand Generation, Growth Marketing, or Sales Development.Proven track record of driving pipeline growth and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong expertise in outbound lead generation, SEO, Paid Ads, and Marketing Automation.
* Hands-on experience with Email, Cold Calling, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp outreach.
* Experience with tools such as Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, Lusha, Clay, Phantombuster, SendGrid, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Prior experience leading and scaling high-performing teams.
* Excellent communication, client management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-motivated, strategic thinker with a strong ownership mindset.

Contact Information: careers@pixelodigital.com

We're looking for a
**Head of Demand Generation**
to own one number:
**pipeline.**

Not brand awareness. Not impressions. Not "marketing qualified leads" that sales ignores.
**Meetings. Pipeline. Revenue.**

Your job is to build a demand generation machine that delivers
**$30–40M in ARR pipeline**
—the kind of pipeline that actually converts, not the kind that looks good in a board deck.

This is a leadership role for someone who's built demand engines before, knows what it takes to scale B2B pipeline for Mid-Market and Enterprise, and is obsessive about the math behind every campaign, every channel, every dollar spent.

If you've ever founded or scaled a company yourself, even better. You'll know what it means to own a number with no one else to blame.

The Core Goal

**Own the meetings target for Mid-Market + Enterprise.**

Build and scale multi-channel demand gen programs that drive qualified pipeline. Not leads. Not MQLs.
**Meetings that turn into revenue.**

You'll be measured on:

* Meetings booked (this is the number that matters)
* Pipeline contribution (SQLs → Opportunities → Revenue)
* SDR performance (connect rates, response rates, conversion)
* Campaign ROI and CAC efficiency

If you can't tie your work directly to pipeline and revenue, this isn't the role for you.

What You'll Do at Pepper

1. Own Demand Generation Strategy & Execution (End-to-End)

* Build and own the overall demand generation strategy across inbound, outbound, and lifecycle campaigns
* Design the full-funnel engine: awareness → interest → MQL → SQL → Meeting → Opportunity
* Architect campaigns that target Mid-Market and Enterprise buyers—not SMB spray-and-pray
* Balance long-term brand building with short-term pipeline pressure (but never lose sight of the number)

2. Build & Lead a High-Performance SDR Engine

* Lead, coach, and scale the SDR team to maximize outbound efficiency
* Own outbound messaging, sequencing, and cadence optimization
* Implement rigorous A/B testing on email, LinkedIn, cold call scripts
* Build an SDR culture obsessed with connect rates, response rates, and meeting conversion
* Create comp structures and incentives that drive the right behaviors

3. Scale Inbound Demand Channels

* Scale inbound pipeline through SEO, SEM, LinkedIn Ads, and paid media
* Build a webinar and virtual event engine that drives qualified registrations and conversions
* Partner with Content to create assets that actually convert—not just "thought leadership" that goes nowhere
* Optimize landing pages, forms, and conversion paths with relentless testing

4. Partner Cross-Functionally to Drive Pipeline

* Work closely with the
  **Content team**
  to ensure campaign assets (eBooks, case studies, whitepapers) are built for conversion, not vanity
* Collaborate with
  **ABM**
  to run targeted account-based programs for Enterprise logos
* Align tightly with
  **Sales leadership**
  on ICP definition, lead quality feedback, and pipeline goals
* Partner with
  **Product Marketing**
  to translate product value into demand-driving messaging

5. Build the Analytics & Attribution Infrastructure

* Set, track, and report on pipeline contribution goals (MQL → SQL → Meeting → Opp → Revenue)
* Build dashboards and reporting systems that give real-time visibility into funnel performance
* Obsess over conversion rates at every stage—and know exactly where the leaks are
* Run weekly pipeline reviews with Sales to ensure alignment on lead quality and follow-up

6. Constantly Optimize for ROI

* Approach every dollar spent as your own money
* Kill underperforming channels and campaigns fast—no emotional attachment
* Double down on what's working with speed and conviction
* Build a culture of experimentation: test, measure, iterate, scale

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

* **10+ years in B2B SaaS or Services demand generation**
  , with significant experience in Mid-Market and/or Enterprise segments
* **Proven track record of owning pipeline targets**
  —not "contributing to" pipeline, but
  *owning*
  the number
* Experience building and scaling both
  **inbound and outbound engines**
  from the ground up
* **Hands-on experience managing SDR teams**
  —you know what good outbound looks like and how to coach it
* Deep expertise in multi-channel demand gen: SEO, SEM, LinkedIn, paid media, email, ABM, webinars, events
* **Analytically rigorous**
  —you live in dashboards, you know your CAC and LTV by channel, you can calculate pipeline coverage in your sleep
* Experience with marketing automation and CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, or similar)
* Comfort operating in high-growth, high-pressure environments where the number is the number

What Will Set You Apart

* **Ex-founder or early-stage operator experience**
  —you've built something yourself and know what it means to own outcomes with no safety net
* Experience scaling demand gen for a company from
  **$10M to $50M+ ARR**
* Track record of building pipeline for
  **content, marketing tech, or SaaS platforms**
* Strong POV on where B2B demand gen is heading—and what most companies get wrong
* Ability to context-switch between strategy and execution without losing momentum

We value:

* **Ownership over hierarchy**
  —you own the number, you make the calls
* **Outcomes over activity**
  —we don't care how many campaigns you ran; we care how much pipeline you built
* **Speed over perfection**
  —launch, learn, iterate
* **Data over opinions**
  —bring the numbers, not the narratives

Benefits at Pepper

* Paid menstrual leave
* Comprehensive medical insurance
* COVID-19 insurance coverage

To Apply

Skip the generic cover letter. Tell us:

1. **What's the largest pipeline target you've personally owned?**
   What was the number, and did you hit it?
2. **One demand gen channel or campaign you scaled**
   that drove disproportionate pipeline—what made it work?
3. **What's broken about B2B demand gen today?**
   What would you do differently?

*If you've built demand engines before, know what it takes to hit a pipeline number, and want to do it again at a company that's scaling fast into Enterprise—this is your seat at the table.*

title: Head of GTM - US
description:
HEAD OF US GTM

Company: Pepper

Location / Time Zone: US Market (US time zone), Mumbai

Employment Type: Full-time

About Pepper

Pepper is building a new category of content and SEO growth platform, where strategy, content, technology, automation, and AI come together to drive measurable business outcomes.

We are now extending this foundation to build a modern enterprise growth engine, and we are looking to hire our first Head of US GTM to own and scale our go-to-market motion in the US market.

About the Role

As Head of US GTM, you will own the entire go-to-market strategy and execution for the US: pipeline, demand generation, sales alignment, positioning, and revenue growth across new business and expansion. You will define how Pepper wins in the US market and build the engine to get there.

This is both a strategic and a hands-on role. You will set the GTM strategy and operating rhythm, then roll up your sleeves to build programs, run experiments, and drive results. You will work shoulder to shoulder with sales, product, product marketing, and customer success to deliver a consistent customer journey and accountable, measurable growth. This role primarily works in the US time zone.

What You Will Do

• Own US GTM strategy and revenue. Define and execute the go-to-market plan for the US, and own pipeline and revenue targets across new business and expansion in partnership with sales and customer success leaders.

• Build the demand generation engine. Create sustained, iterative programs across demand channels: paid marketing, email, SEO, conversion rate optimization, and, over time, ABM, social, and content marketing.

• Sharpen positioning and messaging. Partner with product marketing to ensure clear, compelling positioning and a consistent experience across the full customer journey.

• Drive funnel performance. Rigorously audit the full funnel, surface data-driven insights, and make fast adjustments to accelerate growth. Work closely with the SDR function to improve lead-to-discovery conversion.

• Collaborate and prioritize. Work cross-functionally and use data to focus the team on the right initiatives in the right order.

• Present strategy and results to leadership. Articulate key initiatives and present performance reviews including financials, test results, forecasts, and metrics. Hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes.

• Stay hands-on. Contribute directly to campaign development, content, and tactical execution as needed.

What You Will Bring

• 10+ years of GTM, demand generation, and/or digital marketing experience, with B2B and enterprise software experience a strong plus

• 4+ years in a leadership role, ideally building and scaling GTM motions for a new or growing market (experience managing contractors and distributed teams is a plus)

• A proven, data-driven operator who has built multi-channel demand programs across geos and segments and delivered against aggressive growth targets

• Experience owning pipeline and revenue, and managing or working closely with the SDR function to improve conversion

• Experience launching or scaling GTM in the US market, working with US stakeholders

• Strong command of marketing automation tools, and Google Analytics

• A collaborative team player who partners effectively with marketing, sales, product, and customer success to hit business goals

• A detail-oriented operator who can cohere teams, drive efficiency, and thrive in a fast-paced organization

• A track record of setting, exceeding, tracking, and communicating meaningful goals

• A self-starter who operates with limited guidance, knows when to ask for help, and brings flexibility, adaptability, and accountability

title: Field Metallurgist
description:
**Job ID:**

**Location:**

**Work Model:**
Onsite
  
  
The Field Metallurgist is responsible for delivering on-site metallurgical testwork and technical services at customer concentrators and pellet plants. The role involves executing flotation, pelletizing and filtration trials, troubleshooting dosing and process-related issues, and providing technical interpretation and recommendations. The position also works closely with plant-level employees, Technical Service and R&D teams to facilitate the acceptance and implementation of Clariant solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver on-site metallurgical testwork and technical services at customer concentrators and pellet plants.
* Run bench and pilot flotation programmes in customer laboratories and plants, including:

+ Reagent screening
+ Dosage-response curves
+ pH and pulp density variation
+ Collector/depressant/frother combinations
+ Mass and metal balances against plant baseline

* Execute pelletizing testwork, including:

+ Balling disc/drum trials
+ Green pellet drop number and compressive strength
+ Moisture optimisation
+ Binder and additive evaluation
+ Fired pellet quality checks

* Conduct filtration trials.
* Sample and log trial conditions and issue standardised trial reports with interpretation.
* Commission and troubleshoot dosing hardware, including pump calibration, suction and discharge faults, chemical transfer lines, IBC and ISO tank connections, heated storage, trace heating and viscosity-related feed problems.
* Diagnose in-circuit product behaviour, including overfrothing and froth carry-over, entrainment, froth stability collapse and water chemistry interference.
* Select and relocate dosage points where required.
* Work directly with shift operators and escalate unresolved issues to Technical Service and R&D.
* Develop relationships with plant-level employees to facilitate acceptance of Clariant proposed solutions.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Degree in Mineral Processing, Metallurgy, Mining Engineering or Chemical Engineering.

* Experience in flotation is preferred.
* Experience in Iron Ore is preferred.

* Ability to influence customers when troubleshooting industrial trials.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, including communication across multicultural customers.
* Understanding of the mineral processing industry, project development, and the transition from laboratory work to successful commercial execution.

title: Investment Analyst, Portfolio Management
description:
**ABOUT VANTROCK**

Vantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, built to work in the white space of every strategy it enters. A real asset is three jobs: finding the land, building and running the asset, managing the capital that owns it. Vantrock does all three with one team. Headquartered in Mumbai, it originates, develops, operates and manages institutional-grade real assets from land to operations. Warehousing, industrial and logistics parks are the first strategy. The platform is run by operators, and it is built to run lean. Suburban office campuses, strata offices, data centres, senior living and infrastructure assets follow, each as its own strategy, sequenced on delivery and each in a white space others have left open, with a clear path to REITs and InvITs. Real assets only, across every class the platform grows into, in sequence.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

The portfolio management company needs clean research, accurate data and books that close every day. This seat provides all three, working directly with the Principal Officer.

It is an analyst seat with a wide view. You research listed markets and credit, build the real asset data that sits behind the platform's thinking, and keep the portfolios, records and reports right. You prepare the case. The Principal Officer makes the decision.

You should not apply if you want a pure research seat with no reconciliation in it. The operations work is half the seat, and it matters as much as the research.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* Conduct research and analysis on listed companies to identify potential investment opportunities.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, earnings growth, balance sheets and cash flows.
* Assist in preparing financial models, company valuations, investment notes and research reports.
* Track stock-market developments, company announcements, quarterly results and relevant sector trends.
* Monitor portfolio holdings, share-price movements, investment performance and sector exposures.
* Support portfolio reviews, investment recommendations and periodic reporting.
* Research real estate industry fundamentals, including property demand, rental growth, REIT performance, developer sales and leverage.
* Maintain investment research records and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with the investment team to support portfolio monitoring and other investment-related activities.
* Follow applicable internal policies, investment mandates and regulatory procedures.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

*Essential*

* A graduate degree in any discipline from a recognised Indian or foreign university.
* 2+ years in the securities market, at a portfolio manager, alternative investment manager, asset manager, stock broker, investment adviser or research analyst. Real estate development, leasing or consulting does not count towards this.
* Excel models you have built yourself.
* You use AI tools every day in your work and can show what you have done with them.
* Mumbai, on site.

*Advantageous*

* An MBA, a CA, or the CFA at any level.
* NISM certifications, such as XXI-B or XIX-D.
* Real estate or infrastructure investing, REITs or InvITs.
* Bloomberg, Capitaline, ACE Equity or similar tools.
* Portfolio accounting or back-office systems.

*What this role is not*

* It is not a decision-making seat. You do not approve investments or vote at the Investment Committee.
* It is not an investment banking seat. Deal preparation and investor coordination for the platform sit with the capital formation team.
* It is not a finance or accounts seat. Accounts and treasury sit with the finance team.

**STANDING REQUIREMENTS**

AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every seat at Vantrock. You use AI tools daily as force multipliers, and you judge their output rather than forwarding it. This is tested for every appointment through a supervised assessment. There are no exceptions by seniority.

Partner command is the second standing requirement. Vantrock runs on outsourced partners, so every person here must be able to scope, brief, hold to an SLA, score and commercially discipline a partner, and must know what should never be delegated.

**COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY**

The people who build the platform own a piece of it, vesting over time. A market salary covers the month. The rest of what you earn here is built: pay on what you bring in, for land, leases and capital, so a good year in your seat is yours and not only the company's, and a stake in a platform designed to be worth more for every rupee it manages than one assembled the old way. Most careers in this industry pay you for your time. This one is built to make you wealthier for what you build. Run your seat like it is yours, because part of it is.

**CULTURAL FIT**

We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.

We don't fill seats. We build the platform.
