We are looking for an Manager, execution-focused SEO Manager to take complete end-to-end ownership of the search engine optimization and digital content ecosystem for Dononman.

In this dual-impact role, you will lead our organic growth strategy by combining technical webmastering, high-ranking blog creation, on-page optimization, and site performance optimization. You will bridge the gap between technical web development and strategic content, ensuring Dononman ranks at the top of search engine results pages (SERPs) while maintaining a fast, seamless user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.⁠ ⁠Blog Strategy & Content Creation (Complete Blog Management)

Keyword Strategy: Conduct in-depth keyword research, intent analysis, and competitive gap assessments to identify high-converting content opportunities for Dononman.

End-to-End Blog Publishing: Write, edit, structure, and publish high-quality, engaging, and SEO-optimized blog posts using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify).

On-Page Optimization: Optimize all blog elements, including titles, meta descriptions, header structures (H1–H4), internal links, URL slugs, image alt text, and schema markup.

Content Lifecycles: Audit and update existing articles regularly to refresh decaying content, fix broken links, and keep rankings competitive.

2.⁠ ⁠Technical SEO & Webmastering

Site Health & Architecture: Conduct regular technical audits to maintain clean site architecture, crawlability, and indexability.

Core Web Vitals & Speed: Diagnose and optimize page speed, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals performance across desktop and mobile devices.

Technical Fixes: Manage robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, 301 redirects, HTTP status codes (404, 500), and structured data (JSON-LD).

Platform Management: Manage domain configurations, basic CMS maintenance, plugin updates, security monitoring, and coordination with web developers for complex structural modifications.

3.⁠ ⁠Link Building & Off-Page SEO

Execute high-quality link-building tactics, guest blogging outreach, digital PR, and competitor backlink acquisition strategies.

Monitor backlink profiles, manage toxic links, and execute disavow actions when necessary.

4.⁠ ⁠Analytics & Reporting

Track, analyze, and report on key organic metrics (organic sessions, keyword rankings, impressions, bounce rates, conversion rates) using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and third-party tools.

Translate raw search data into actionable growth initiatives for the Dononman brand.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 2–4 years of experience as an SEO Analyst, Technical SEO Specialist, or Webmaster with a proven track record of growing organic search traffic.

Technical Proficiency:

Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript principles affecting crawlability, and CMS management (WordPress/Webflow/Custom frameworks).

Hands-on expertise with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Screaming Frog, and Google Tag Manager.

Proficiency in SEO suites such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Keyword Planner.

Content Skills: Exceptional written English skills with the ability to write clear, compelling, and search-optimized blog copy.

Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset capable of diagnosing complex indexing, crawling, or speed issues.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Increase in domain-wide organic traffic and keyword positions for high-intent keywords.

Blog traffic growth, reader engagement, and organic lead/conversion generation.

Improvement in Core Web Vitals scores and zero critical technical/crawling errors.

Acquisition of high-authority, relevant backlinks.

title: Advertising Ops Analyst, Amazon Ads
description:
**Description**
Traffic and set up advertising campaigns across Prime Video (PV) and 3P Video for the India marketplace. Own the pre-launch campaign lifecycle from IO/deal intake and line item setup to creative upload, QA, and go-live across Amazon's ad serving platforms (ADSP/Rodeo).
  
  
Ensure every campaign goes live accurately, on time, and in full compliance with deal terms, platform specs, and ad policies. Serve as the first line of quality control, catching setup errors before they impact delivery or advertiser experience.
  
  
Work closely with sales, CSM, and ad tech teams to ensure campaigns deliver on time, on budget, and in line with advertiser expectations. Proactively identify delivery risks, resolve operational issues, and contribute to process improvements that drive efficiency and revenue across India's video advertising business.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Campaign Setup & Trafficking
  
  

* Receive IO/deal briefs from CSM and translate them into accurate campaign setups on ADSP and Rodeo
* Create and configure line items — targeting parameters, flight dates, budgets, frequency caps, dayparting, and deal IDs — as per the approved deal terms
* Set up programmatic guaranteed (PG) and direct-sold deals with precision across PV, AMXP, and 3P Video inventory
* Ensure correct mapping of advertiser, brand, and campaign hierarchy within the platform

Creative Upload & QA
  
  

* Upload 1P hosted video creatives and third-party tracking pixels/tags on Rodeo
* Validate creatives against platform specifications (format, resolution, duration, file size) and ad policy guidelines
* Flag non-compliant or missing creatives to CSM/sales before go-live deadlines
* Conduct end-to-end pre-launch QA — verify targeting, creative assignment, tracking, pacing settings, and deal linkage before activating campaigns

Go-Live & Handoff
  
  

* Activate campaigns on schedule and confirm successful ad serving within the first few hours of launch
* Perform launch-day health checks — verify impressions are delivering, creatives are rendering correctly, and tracking is firing
* Hand off live campaigns to CSM for ongoing pacing management, optimisation, and advertiser communication

Troubleshooting (Pre-Launch & Launch)
  
  

* Diagnose and resolve setup-related issues — including trafficking errors, creative rejection, targeting misconfigurations, and deal ID mismatches
* Escalate platform-level bugs or ad tech issues to the appropriate engineering teams with clear documentation

Process & Quality
  
  

* Follow established SOPs and trafficking checklists to maintain zero-error campaign setups
* Flag gaps in existing workflows and contribute to SOP updates and process improvements
* Maintain accurate trafficking logs and campaign setup documentation

A day in the life
  
  

* New campaign briefs awaiting setup
* Creative assets received from advertisers/agencies
* Urgent same-day go-live requests
* Escalations or flags from the previous evening
* Read the IO/deal brief — understand the advertiser, deal type (PG/direct), flight dates, budget, targeting requirements, and creative details
* Create the campaign shell — set up the campaign, line items, and deal IDs on the platform
* Configure targeting — geography, device, content genre, dayparting, frequency caps as per deal terms
* Map brand hierarchy — ensure correct advertiser → brand → campaign mapping for accurate reporting and brand repetition rules
* Link deal IDs — connect PG deal IDs to the correct line items so programmatic demand flows correctly
* Upload video creatives (1P hosted) and companion banners on Rodeo
* Attach third-party tracking pixels — impression trackers, click trackers, verification tags (MOAT, IAS, etc.)
* Validate creative specs — check format (MP4/MOV), resolution (1920×1080), duration (15s/30s), file size, and audio levels against platform requirements
* Flag rejections — if a creative doesn't meet specs or violates ad policy (e.g., restricted category, missing disclaimers), flag it back to CSM immediately with clear reasons
* Test rendering — preview the ad to ensure it renders correctly across devices (Fire TV, mobile, web)
* Send go-live confirmations to CSMs for campaigns activated during the day
* Flag pending items — creatives still awaited, IOs with missing information, campaigns blocked due to spec issues
* Prepare next-day queue — review what's coming up tomorrow and pre-read briefs if available

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of sales experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
  
  
As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
  
  
We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
  
  
Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
We are looking for a data-driven, strategic, and hands-on
**Demand Generation Manager**
to lead our customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and account-based marketing (ABM) strategies. In this role, you will own multi-channel campaigns designed to create, capture, and convert qualified pipeline for our sales teams.
  
  
You will bridge the gap between marketing execution and sales velocity, partnering directly with Revenue Operations, Account Executives, and SDR leads to accelerate funnel conversion and maximize lifetime target account value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Campaign Strategy & Execution: Design, build, and optimize multi-channel inbound and outbound marketing campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, content syndication, webinars, and automated email sequences.
* Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Partner closely with sales leads to execute tailored ABM strategies targeting our Target Account List (TAL) to increase enterprise deal velocity and win rates.
* Sales & SDR Alignment: Build tight hand-off processes and SLAs with the sales team to ensure rapid lead follow-up, high conversion rates, and continuous feedback loops on lead quality.
* Funnel Analytics & Attribution: Track, analyze, and present performance metrics across every stage of the funnel (MQLs, SQLs, CAC, ROAS, sales pipeline generated, and closed-won revenue).
* MarTech & Automation: Manage and optimize our core marketing stack (CRM, Marketing Automation, ABM tools) for precise audience segmentation, automated nurture tracks, and lead scoring.
* Experimentation & Optimization: Continuously test ad creative, landing pages, copy, and audience targeting to lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) while scaling pipeline volume.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience: 8-10 years of hands-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Channel Mastery: Proven track record managing significant monthly paid acquisition budgets ($30k+/month) with verifiable pipeline contribution.
* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).
* Sales-Minded Alignment: Strong empathy for sales workflows with a clear understanding of enterprise sales cycles, deal stages, and ACV dynamics.
* Data-Driven: Ability to extract actionable insights from raw performance data and communicate key metrics clearly to executive leadership.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

title: Senior CX Insights Manager, APAC
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About The Role**
Crunchyroll is seeking a
**Senior Manager, CX Insights (APAC)**
to lead our Customer Experience (CX) Insights function across APAC. Reporting to the
**Director of CX Insights & Analytics**
, this leader will transform customer feedback, operational data, and market insights into actionable recommendations that improve the fan experience and influence business strategy.
  
  
This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of Customer Experience, Analytics, Product, Content, Marketing, Subscription, and Customer Support. You will be responsible for developing a comprehensive understanding of the APAC customer journey, identifying opportunities to improve satisfaction and loyalty, and championing the voice of the customer throughout the organization.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical expertise, customer obsession, business acumen, and a deep understanding of the APAC market. They are equally comfortable diving into data, presenting executive-level insights, and leading high-performing teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead Customer Insights Strategy**

* Own the CX Insights strategy for the APAC region, ensuring alignment with Crunchyroll's global customer experience objectives.
* Build a holistic view of the customer journey by integrating feedback, behavioral, operational, and market data.
* Develop frameworks to measure customer sentiment, loyalty, satisfaction, effort, and retention drivers across the region.
* Identify emerging customer trends, pain points, and opportunities that influence strategic priorities.

**Drive Actionable Business Impact**

* Translate complex data into compelling narratives and recommendations that influence decision-making across Product, Marketing, Content, Subscription, Commerce, and Customer Support teams.
* Establish scalable mechanisms for surfacing customer insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Partner with regional and global teams to prioritize initiatives that improve customer satisfaction and business outcomes.
* Quantify the impact of customer experience improvements and track progress against key performance indicators.

**Lead Voice of the Customer Programs**

* Own and evolve Voice of the Customer (VoC) programs across APAC.
* Design and optimize customer listening strategies, including surveys, feedback programs, support interactions, social insights, and community feedback.
* Ensure customer feedback is systematically captured, analyzed, and integrated into business planning.

**Build World-Class Analytics & Reporting**

* Develop executive-level dashboards, reporting frameworks, and performance reviews.
* Leverage advanced analytical techniques to identify drivers of customer behavior and sentiment.
* Partner closely with Analytics, Data Science, and Research teams to enhance measurement capabilities and predictive insights.
* Champion data quality, governance, and best practices for customer insights.

**Lead and Develop Talent**

* Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of insights professionals.
* Foster a culture of curiosity, accountability, innovation, and customer obsession.
* Establish clear goals, development plans, and career growth opportunities for team members.

**What You'll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Consumer Research, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Strategy, or related fields.
* Including 3+ years of people leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
* Proven experience leading customer insights programs within a subscription, digital product, streaming, entertainment, technology, or consumer-focused business.
* AI and technology-forward mindset with experience evaluating and adopting innovative tools and methodologies to improve the speed, scale, and quality of customer insight generation.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience working across large datasets and customer feedback ecosystems.
* Expertise in Voice of the Customer methodologies, customer satisfaction measurement, and customer journey analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional alignment.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presentation skills.
* Professional fluency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working across multiple APAC markets.
* Familiarity with streaming, media, entertainment, gaming, or fan-driven consumer businesses.
* Experience with customer feedback platforms, survey tools, CRM systems, and modern BI solutions.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation, or customer segmentation methodologies.

**Success in Your First Year**
In your first year, you will:
  
  

* Establish yourself as the leading voice of the APAC customer within Crunchyroll.
* Build trusted partnerships with regional and global stakeholders.
* Elevate the maturity of our Voice of the Customer and CX measurement programs.
* Deliver insights that directly influence customer experience improvements and business performance.
* Develop a scalable framework for understanding and communicating the evolving needs of anime fans across Asia-Pacific.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
  
  
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
  
  

* Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
* Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Free premium access to Crunchyroll

* up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents

title: Digital Insights Consultant
description:
**About i-Genie**

At i-Genie.ai, we believe the best insights don't just inform. They inspire.

We're an AI-powered consumer insights company. We help leading global brands and retailers, including Kenvue, Unilever and Coca-Cola, spot future trends and make better decisions, faster.

We do this by bringing together billions of data points from search, social media, reviews and market data. Clients get the answers through easy-to-use dashboards and Presto, our GenAI copilot, which spots trends, tracks brand health and benchmarks performance in real time.

**The role at a glance**

Role: Digital Insights Consultant (Social, Search & Reviews)

Location: Mumbai, hybrid

Type: Full-time

Experience: 5 to 6 years in social listening, search and reviews insights

Focus: Global FMCG client

Start: November 2026

**Why this role matters.**
Brands are drowning in digital signals but short on clear answers. You'll turn what people post, search for and write in reviews into insights that shape marketing, brand strategy, innovation and content.

You'll also help our client's teams get better at this themselves. You'll coach them on using social, search and reviews data well, so good insight becomes part of how they work every day.

**What you'll do**

**Find the story in the data**

* Dig into social listening, search and ratings & reviews data to answer real business questions
* Use tools like Trajaan, Google Keyword Planner, review analytics platforms and i-Genie's own platform
* Connect the dots across sources: what people say on social, what they search for, and what they praise or complain about in reviews

**Turn insight into action**

* Work on strategic briefs on innovation, content, trends and brand health
* Build clear, compelling narratives that help marketers decide what to do next
* Present findings to brand, marketing and insights teams in plain, confident language

**Build capability**

* Coach client teams on using social, search and reviews data well
* Share best practices and stronger ways of analyzing digital signals
* Help teams ask sharper questions and get more out of the tools they already have

**Shape what we build**

* Share what you learn from clients with i-Genie's product and data teams
* Help us improve our dashboards and Presto based on real client needs

**What you bring**

* 5 to 6 years of hands-on work turning social, search and reviews data into consumer insight
* Strong, practical experience with social listening tools; Trajaan experience is a must, and Meltwater or ConvoTrack is a big plus
* Confidence with search data (for example Google Keyword Planner or Google Trends) to size interest and spot rising demand
* Experience analysing ratings and reviews to find product strengths, pain points and unmet needs
* A track record of stitching data into stories that changed a marketing, brand or innovation decision
* Experience working with, or consulting for, marketing and brand teams
* Clear communication: you can explain complex data simply to senior stakeholders
* A natural coach who enjoys helping others get better

**The kind of person who thrives here**

* Curious about people, culture and what drives consumer behavior
* Proactive and can-do, with a habit of delivering results
* Comfortable switching between hands-on analysis and big-picture thinking
* Excited by AI and new ways of finding insight

**Nice to have**

* Experience in Beauty, Personal Care or Wellbeing categories
* Background in an insights agency, a social listening vendor or a client-side consumer insights team
* Comfort with dashboard tools such as Power BI
* Experience running training sessions or workshops

**Who you'll work with**

You will work closely with the client’s team and be integrated into their day-to-day operations. Although you will be embedded within the client’s organisation, you will remain an employee of i-Genie.ai and continue to be part of our wider team.

**Why you'll love working here**

* **Innovative work:**
  be part of a company changing how brands use AI for insights
* **Global exposure:**
  work with some of the world's best-known brands
* **Supportive culture:**
  we're a team that has your back
* **Room to grow:**
  ongoing learning and a clear path to bigger client roles
* **Flexible working:**
  hybrid set-up that fits how you work best

**How to apply**

Send your CV to people@i-Genie.ai and a short note on an insight you're proud of the data you used, the story you told, and what changed because of it.

title: API Support Engineer
description:
Experience: 0–2 years in API support, application support, integration support, or a similar technical role.

Job Location: Mumbai or Pune

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary: We are looking for an API Support Engineer responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting APIs and system integrations with clients, suppliers, and third-party service providers.

The candidate will work closely with the Development, QA, Product, Database, and Infrastructure teams to identify API issues, analyze technical problems, coordinate resolutions, and ensure stable operation of production systems.

Experience in Travel / OTA / Hotel Booking / APIs will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Monitoring & Support

Monitor API performance, availability, response time, error rates, and transaction failures. Monitor production APIs and identify abnormal behavior or service interruptions. Investigate API failures, timeouts, slow responses, incorrect responses, and connectivity issues. Ensure critical API issues are identified and escalated promptly. Perform regular health checks of APIs and integrations.

2. API Troubleshooting

Analyze API requests and responses to identify the root cause of issues.

Troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, headers, parameters, and response codes. Check request/response logs and application logs. Identify whether an issue is related to the client, supplier, application, database, network, or infrastructure. Coordinate with development teams for code-level issues. Coordinate with suppliers/third parties for external API issues.

5. Logs & Database Analysis

Analyze application and API logs to identify errors and transaction failures. Perform basic SQL queries to investigate transaction and booking-related issues. Verify data consistency between API responses, application databases, and supplier systems.

Work with senior developers/DBAs for complex database-related issues.

6. Client & Supplier Coordination

Communicate with clients and suppliers regarding API connectivity and transaction issues. Collect complete technical information before escalating an issue. Share request/response details, timestamps, booking references, error messages, and relevant logs with the concerned team. Follow up with external suppliers until the issue is resolved. Provide clear technical updates to internal teams and clients.

7. Incident Management

Prioritize incidents based on business impact and severity. Immediately escalate major issues affecting bookings, revenue, API availability, or multiple clients. Maintain incident timelines and resolution details. Perform basic root-cause analysis and prepare incident reports for major issues. Identify recurring problems and recommend permanent solutions.

Required Technical Skills.

Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration. Strong knowledge of JSON and XML. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and HTTP status codes. Experience with Postman / Swagger. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to analyze application and API logs.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work under pressure during production incidents. Good coordination with Development, QA, Product, Infrastructure, clients, and suppliers. Travel Domain Knowledge – Preferred

Qualification

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Experience.

0–2 years of experience in API Support, Application Support, Production Support, Integration Support, or a similar technical role.

Candidates with experience in Travel Technology / OTA / Hotel Booking Systems / API Integration will be given preference.

title: Senior Consultant - Middleware/OCP
description:
**About The Job**
The Red Hat India Services team is looking for a Consultant to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will help us ensure that our engagements are not just a technology implementation, but an organizational transformation. As a consultant, you will work with our lead architect in our engagements, cocreating innovative software solutions using emerging open source technology and modern software design methods in an agile environment. You’ll be coached by the team to facilitate the design and technical delivery of our solutions. As you do so, you’ll create enthusiasm for building great software using principles of open source and agile culture. You'll support everything from the scoping to delivering the engagements. Successful applicants must reside in a city where Red Hat has mentioned the location.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Applies software engineering principles to the operations domain.
* Ensures service reliability meets users’ needs, including internally critical and externally visible services
* Uses software & systems engineering to design, build, and run large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems
* Develop API’s using Red Hat technology products and service
* Design, develop, and manage Kafka-based data pipelines
* Provide issue analysis on Kafka applications
* Monitor Kafka performance and troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted data flow, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiency.
* Participates in an on-call rotation within a geographically distributed team to provide 24x7x365 production support, with responsibility to respond to urgent customer issues
* Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
* Help us cover domains including microservices, API management, and web-scale architectures, DevOps engineering and application delivery, container-based continuous delivery (CD), i.e., using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform,
* Team up with Red Hat and the open source community to engineer innovation-based software solutions, designed to further accelerate our customers’ success at their transformation journey
* Work as a trusted adviser to our customers and use your critical thinking skills to tackle tough problems in an innovative way
* Train and coach team members both on technical and non-technical skills
* Remain an active coder as this is required during our engagements and maintain deep direct technical knowledge of container management systems (CMSs), application infrastructure, architectures, and development solutions
* Support presales and post-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience and advanced knowledge of middleware technologies, including enterprise web or middleware development project experience with application integration
* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered
* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment
* JEE and Middleware technology
* Good technical skills and experience designing and implementing JEE solutions.
* Thorough experience with at least one of the major middleware solutions, preferably Red Hat JBoss Middleware; experience in Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, WebMethods, Tibco, etc. will also be considered.
* Hands on experience in application development with Agile approach
* Hands on experience on building pipelines and CI/CD.
* Knowledge on Devops and Microservices
* Enterprise Java development skills are an advantage.
* Knowledge of Hibernate and Tomcat is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience on AMQ, API management like 3scale.
* Ability and desire to learn new technologies on your own and apply new concepts to problems

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with or knowledge of Red Hat’s technologies like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Red Hat Fuse, Red Hat 3Scale, Red Hat AMQ, or Red Hat AMQ Streams (Kafka)
* Working with some community technologies like Argo CD, Tekton Pipelines, Helm, or Jenkins
* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

**The Role:**
The function reports to the Senior Manager of Incident & Problem Management and the purpose of this role is to ensure end to end accountability of managing the Incidents across various business units.
  
  
The role will be responsible for overall coordination and facilitation of technical and other resources through service restoration and recovery efforts for escalated incidents.
  
  
**Role Responsibility**
**Incident Management [40%]**
Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of P1/P2 incidents with minimal business impact.
  
  
Coordinate technical teams, stakeholders, and vendors to restore services within SLA targets.
  
  
Initiate and facilitate bridge calls, war rooms, and communication channels during major incidents.
  
  
Monitor incident queues, escalations, and aging tickets to ensure timely resolution.
  
  
Provide accurate and timely updates to customers, management, and affected stakeholders.
  
  
Ensure compliance with Incident Management processes and quality standards.
  
  
Drive technical teams to provide regular updates and resolution actions.
  
  
Maintain detailed incident records, timelines, and resolution documentation.
  
  
Escalate risks and service-impacting issues as required.
  
  
Support a 24x7 operational environment and major incident response activities.
  
  
**Problem Management [30%]**
Identify recurring incidents and trends to proactively detect underlying problems.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and coordinate problem investigations with technical teams.
  
  
Create, track, and manage Problem Records through to closure.
  
  
Facilitate problem review meetings and ensure corrective actions are assigned and completed.
  
  
Monitor known errors and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).
  
  
**Duty Manager Escalation & Expedite [20%]**

Acknowledge, assess, and coordinate Duty Manager escalations through to resolution.
  
  
Expedite ticket progression by engaging appropriate technical, vendor, and management resources.
  
  
Maintain and update escalation tracking tools and management dashboards.
  
  
**Post Incident Reports [10%]**
Prepare and publish Post Incident Reports within agreed timelines following major incidents.
  
  
Document incident timelines, business impact, root causes, and resolution activities.
  
  
Coordinate with technical teams to gather accurate incident information and evidence.
  
  
Facilitate post-incident review meetings and lessons-learned discussions.
  
  
Track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
  
  
**Key Competencies**
**Stakeholder involvement**
Consistent identification and involvement of stakeholders who need to be consulted in the decision-making process
  
  
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Proactively engage relevant stakeholders to gather requirements, feedback, and business insights.
  
  
Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed through clear and timely communication.
  
  
**Adaptability and Multitasking**
Adapt to changing work environments, priorities, and organizational needs with a positive attitude. Swiftly process information and manage multiple tasks accurately.
  
  
Adapt to changing work environments, priorities, and organizational needs with a positive attitude.

Effectively prioritize workload based on business impact, urgency, and service commitments.

title: Consultant - OT Data Operations Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles.
* Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions.
* Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases.
* Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms.
* Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites.
* Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns.
* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition.
* Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation.
* Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting.
* Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture.
* System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization.
* Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams.
* Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
* GCP certification
* Background in Mathematics or Statistics

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Technology Support III- Application support / Production support- Geneos, Unix
description:

* Treat operations as software problems, solve system failures, minimize client impacts and ensure all systems function seamlessly to meet business needs.
* Analyze and troubleshoot production application flows to ensure end-to-end application or infrastructure service delivery supporting the business operations of the firm.
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to speed up incident triage and trend analysis from operational signals, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within incident/problem/change routines to identify recurring interruption patterns and support validated remediation actions aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

* Create proactive event management through observability and developing automation to minimize toil.
* Work closely with the Software Engineering and Product teams/other stakeholders to understand issues, drive resolutions, and stability enhancements of the applications, leading to improvement in operational stability, performance, and availability.
* Create, continuously improve, and maintain real-time monitoring dashboards to ensure system operability and performance.
* Identify trends and assist in the management of incidents, problems, and changes in support of full-stack technology systems, applications, or infrastructure.
* Participate in public cloud infrastructure management and cost optimization and ensure resiliency of the platform through managed Disaster Recovery (DR), Site Reliability (SR), and High Availability (HA) events.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise troubleshooting, resolving, and maintaining information technology services
* Experience in supporting public cloud-based applications.
* Experience in building tools using AI.
* Knowledge in automating daily support operations using scripting and tooling.
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support production support workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted incident recommendations before action, escalating when uncertain and following operational and security expectations.
* Experience in one or more observability and monitoring tools and techniques like Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, ITRS Geneos.
* Knowledge of one or more general-purpose programming languages or automation scripting (Python, UNIX shell scripting, etc.).
* Experience with one or more major cloud services (AWS, Azure or GCP) and Infrastructure as Code tooling.
* Understanding of networking concepts and troubleshooting.
* Possess a continuous improvement mindset with ability to work collaboratively in teams and develop meaningful relationships to achieve common goals.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Experience in AI tools like Copilot or Claude code.
* Familiarity with ITIL support methodologies and concepts.
* Experience/knowledge of working in a DevOps/SRE model would be an advantage.
* Knowledge of Investment banking domain including Fixed Income products.

:

:

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring & resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

* Collaboration & Leadership — Demonstrated ability to work with global IT teams, OEMs, vendors, partners, and service providers, and act as SPOC for transition, transformation, and greenfield/brownfield projects. Ability to lead technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

title: Incident Manager
description:
Job description:
  
  
Incident Manager

**Location:**
India, Mumbai

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business-to-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.

 About the Role

Agfa is looking for an experienced and service-oriented
**Incident Manager**
to join its Global IT (Information & Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the incident management process and ensuring the rapid restoration of IT services when disruptions occur. You will play a critical role in minimizing business impact, coordinating cross-functional resolution activities, and driving continuous improvement across the IT service landscape.

As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will collaborate closely with internal teams, managed service providers, and business stakeholders worldwide to ensure effective incident response, SLA compliance, and clear communication during both standard and major incidents.

 About You (Skills Required)

You excel in high-pressure situations and have the ability to coordinate multiple teams while maintaining clear and effective communication. You combine a process-driven mindset with strong stakeholder management capabilities and a commitment to service excellence.

You possess:

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong coordination and facilitation capabilities.
* A structured, process-oriented approach to service management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain calm and decisive during major incidents and service disruptions.
* A continuous improvement mindset focused on service quality and business satisfaction.

 What You'll Do (Duties & Responsibilities)

* Lead and govern the global Incident Management process.
* Manage major incidents and coordinate all activities required to restore services as quickly as possible.
* Organize and facilitate Major Incident bridge calls involving technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate incident resolution activities across internal teams and external service providers.
* Monitor and drive resolution of aging incidents, ensuring SLA compliance and timely closure.
* Provide clear, timely, and regular status updates to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Manage escalations and ensure appropriate engagement of technical and management resources.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and identify opportunities for service improvement.
* Prepare and maintain incident management reports, metrIT, and performance dashboards.
* Serve as backup for the Problem Manager when required.

**What You'll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven track record in Incident Management roles.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Incident Management processes and best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher certification preferred.
* Technical background with a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, applications, and service environments.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and coordinating multiple service providers.
* Experience managing major incidents in complex, global IT environments.
* Strong reporting, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* High degree of flexibility and willingness to support major incidents that may occur outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and on-call escalation situations, to ensure business continuity in a global 24/7 environment.

**Why Join Us**

* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that supports critical business operations worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams and strategic technology partners.
* Play a key role in maintaining service stability and improving the end-user experience across Agfa's global IT environment.

If you are passionate about service management, thrive in dynamic environments, and enjoy coordinating teams to resolve incidents, we invite you to join Agfa and make a global impact.

Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers

worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes
* Customer Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

**Role Summary:**

The SIEM Engineer II position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.

**Primary Responsibility:**

* Lead end-to-end SIEM implementation or integrations in a customer environment.
* Understand customer business requirements and the threat landscape applicable to their industry’s vertical sector to develop tailored use cases for security and Incident monitoring.
* Coordinate with customers to deploy collectors and agents in the on-premises network for data collection and forwarding.

* Coordinate with service delivery managers, management, engineering, maintenance, and operational support teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Develop content, use cases, data models, dashboards, and connectors to support custom user requirements.
* Troubleshooting end-to-end network and infrastructure issues during data onboarding.

* Engage with customers and internal product development teams to gather user requirements, suggest new product features, and help improve existing ones.
* Training and enabling customers and partners for successful adoption.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 4+ years of experience in information security and SIEM field.
* Strong understanding of SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Qradar, ArcSight, Logrhythm and Exabeam.
* Experience deploying SIEM across multiple customers.
* Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
* Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
* Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM

**Preferred:**

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, CyberSecurity
* 3-4+ years of experience in UEBA deployment
* Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
* Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
* Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
* Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions
* Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About You**
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
* 7+ years of managing large complex facilities organizations experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in project/program management
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: EHS&S Digital Solution Specialist
description:

Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
Dow has an exciting and challenging opportunity for
**Digital Solution Specialist**
, based in
**Navi Mumbai (India)**
to join the
**Environment, Health, Safety and Sustainability (EHS&S)**
Information Technology team. In this role, you will own and manage a small EHS&S portfolio of digital solutions and systems, guiding them through their full lifecycle—analysis, design, implementation, adoption, optimization, and end-of-life retirement. Your work will deliver advanced EHS&S functional and business capabilities that accelerate Dow’s digital transformation.
  
  
You will collaborate with a multi-disciplinary IT team—including analysts, designers, developers, and support specialists—to deliver innovative, user-centric solutions. A key part of your role is to gather and analyze data to define functional and technical requirements, with a strong focus on experience, simplification, automation, efficiency, and reliability. You will also oversee development and adoption of solutions leveraging best-in-class mobile, web, desktop, and cloud technologies, while identifying opportunities for digital innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Requirements Analysis: Understand key business drivers to explore, analyze, and map business and functional requirements.
* Experience Mapping: Translate user journeys and stories into solutions that enhance employee and customer experience (EX/CX).
* Solution Lifecycle Management: Drive end-to-end lifecycle—design, architecture, integration (buy vs. build), development, testing, and compliance with corporate standards and security policies.
* Adoption & Support: Support implementation, user adoption, and define supplier/team support models.
* Performance Management: Establish controls, KPIs, and measures for solution performance and reliability.
* Integration & Optimization: Coordinate with Solution Managers and Business Process Managers for end-to-end process integration.
* Roadmap Development: Define improvement and innovation roadmaps; assess resources, technology, and investment needs.
* Team Support: Assist senior Solution Managers with workload analysis and capacity planning.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems using technical expertise and sound judgment. Strong communication skills to explain complex concepts and provide informal guidance to new team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, EHS&S, or a related field.
* Min 5+ years of work experience in the role.
* Knowledge and experience with EHS and Sustainability processes and technologies.
* Experience supporting sustainability, decarbonization, carbon accounting, environmental compliance, product carbon footprint (PCF), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) initiatives through digital solutions and data-driven capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation technologies.
* Strong understanding of system integration and application architecture, including API integrations, data flow analysis, end-to-end process integration, and Azure Integration Services.
* Experience working with Databricks, SQL, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) and Copilot solutions.
* Knowledge of software development concepts and modern application delivery practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Understanding of cloud-based technologies, enterprise data management, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Your Skills**

* Business Requirements: The ability to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements that guide the design and delivery of effective digital solutions.
* Solutions Delivery: Managing the full lifecycle of digital solutions—including design, integration, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and retirement—to ensure they meet performance, security, and usability expectations.
* Design Thinking: Applying user‑centered methods such as journey mapping and experience analysis to create solutions that improve employee and customer experience while driving simplification, automation, and efficiency.
* Integration Services: Coordinating and defining end‑to‑end system and process integrations to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across applications, platforms, and business processes.
* Strategic Planning: Developing solution roadmaps, identifying digital innovation opportunities, and aligning technology investments and resource needs with organizational strategy and long‑term business goals environment.

**Additional Notes**

* The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential.
* Relocation assistance is not provided with this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
