title: D&T Analyst II – Corporate Services
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
You'll own the systems that keep our people and sites safe — badge access, video surveillance, and visitor management — across General Mills locations worldwide.
  
  
You'll work hands-on with vendors, integrators, and site teams to plan upgrades, troubleshoot issues, and bring new systems online.
  
  
You'll be a trusted go-to partner, giving you visibility and influence well beyond a typical technical support role.
  
  
Ownership, strong relationships, and work that directly protects people, this role gives you that every day.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Administer and maintain Badge Access Control systems (e.g., AMAG), including panel and reader configuration, credentialing, and access group management across global facilities.
* Configure, commission, and troubleshoot CCTV/Video Surveillance systems (e.g., Milestone) to ensure continuous coverage and platform stability.
* Manage and enhance Visitor Access Management platforms (e.g., SPLAN) to keep visitor workflows secure, efficient, and aligned with site requirements.
* Support and refine site-specific Physical Security configurations to keep systems compliant with enterprise security standards.
* Own and maintain technical documentation, device inventories, IP/network mappings, and as-built diagrams for every site.
* Act as the technical liaison with security integrators and vendors that includes statement-of-work validation, service reviews, deliverable acceptance, and escalation of recurring deficiencies during installations, upgrades, and service delivery,
* Coordinate with site and facilities teams to plan project timelines, access windows, and on-site logistics for security deployments.
* Monitor and maintain integrations between Physical Security platforms and enterprise systems.
* Triage, escalate, and resolve incidents related to access control, video surveillance, and visitor management, ensuring timely acknowledgment and resolution per defined SLAs.
* Ensure platform performance, cybersecurity, and adherence to physical security best practices and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with Global Security and Corporate Services stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities and implement incremental enhancements.
* Research, evaluate, and pilot proof-of-concepts for new security hardware and software capabilities to expand platform value.
* Partner with Solution Managers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to refine backlog priorities and translate requirements into technical specifications.
* Support system upgrades, firmware/software patching, and device replacements, ensuring minimal disruption to site operations.
* Maintain lifecycle and asset-management records, including warranties, spares, end-of-life status, replacement and system upgrade planning.
* Create SOPs, runbooks, and training materials and provide knowledge transfer to site security and facilities teams.
* Provide dedicated coverage during rotational night shift hours (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM India time) to support real-time monitoring, escalations, and time-sensitive vendor/site coordination.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of overall IT experience and 5+ years of overall Physical Security experience, with hands-on experience configuring and supporting Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Visitor Management systems.
* Experience administering Access Control platforms (e.g., AMAG or similar), including panel/reader configuration, credentialing, and access group management.
* Hands-on experience with Video Management Systems (e.g., Milestone or similar), including camera commissioning, network configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Visitor Management platforms (e.g., SPLAN or similar) and visitor workflow configuration.
* Experience with system integrations and data interfaces, such as APIs, identity/directory services, HR systems, badging systems, visitor management, and monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals (IP addressing, VLANs, network diagrams) and ability to create and maintain technical documentation and as-built diagrams.
* Experience coordinating with security integrators, hardware/software vendors, and site/facilities teams on installation and service delivery.
* Strong incident management skills, with the ability to triage, escalate, and resolve issues within defined SLAs.
* Knowledge of Physical Security Infrastructure, including controllers, readers, locks, door hardware, video servers, PoE, cabling, UPS, and low-voltage design.
* Knowledge of security system compliance, cybersecurity, and industry best practices for access control and surveillance systems.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently across multiple global sites.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and manage external vendor relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security issues to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Willingness and flexibility to work rotational night shift hours (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM India time) to support global site coverage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Relevant certifications in physical security systems (e.g., AMAG, Milestone, or equivalent) preferred.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Design and execute migration proof-of-concepts (PoCs), pilot migrations, validation activities, and cloud transformation assessments.
* Develop migration dashboards, reporting frameworks, business cases, and executive presentations to support client engagements.
* Provide technical advisory support on cloud adoption, application modernization, landing zone architecture, cloud governance, and migration best practices.
* Support cloud cost optimization, operational readiness, resiliency planning, and post-migration stabilization activities.

* Experience designing and executing migrations to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

title: Architect
description:

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

* Complex Problem Diagnosis — Perform advanced analysis and diagnosis of complex networking and security issues across multi-vendor environments.
* Solution Deployment — Deploy and support multi-vendor network and security solutions, ensuring stability, scalability, and compliance with design standards.
* Monitoring & Management Tools — Deploy and support network and security monitoring/management tools, ensuring visibility and proactive issue detection.
* Documentation Ownership — Prepare and update HLDs, LLDs, operational processes, and technical documentation for ongoing and new deployments.
* Sev-1/MIM Incident Support — Provide expert support during incidents to ensure resolution within SLA and minimize business impact.
* Root Cause Analysis — Perform RCA based on OEM inputs and internal investigation, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Continuous Improvement — Identify improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements for network and security infrastructure.
* Tool Evaluation — Evaluate new tools and technologies (automation platforms, observability suites, AI-driven NMS), produce recommendations and support effort estimation for new project opportunities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with global IT teams, OEMs, vendors, partners, and service providers to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
* Training & Knowledge Transfer — Provide technical training and mentorship to L1/L2 operations teams to uplift capability and reduce escalations.
* Technology Up-skilling — Continuously learn and stay updated with the latest networking and security technologies, OEM releases, and industry best practices.
* Project Leadership — Act as the key SPOC for transition, transformation, organic growth, and greenfield/brownfield network projects.

**About You**

* Core Networking — 12–15+ years of hands-on experience in Routing & Switching, Wireless, Datacenter Networking, and Security across enterprise environments.
* Multi-Vendor Implementation — Proven implementation and operational experience with multi-vendor OEMs (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, etc.).
* Wireless & RF Technologies — Strong background in RF technologies, wireless security, AVC, and enterprise mobility solutions.
* Network Security — Expertise in Cisco ISE, ACLs, VPN (L2VPN, L3VPN, IPSEC, GRE), and advanced security architectures.
* Datacenter Networking — Deep experience with protocols and technologies such as BGP-Lite, VLAN, VxLAN, FCoE, TRILL, OTV, IS-IS, and datacenter fabrics.
* Virtualization — Hands-on experience with VMware, Hyper-V, and virtual networking solutions.
* Datacenter Projects — Experience in datacenter consolidation, transformation, and migration projects.
* Cloud Infrastructure — Knowledge and experience with cloud computing infrastructure, orchestration, and hybrid networking.
* Software Defined Networking — Strong understanding of SDN and NFV technologies, including deployment and operational support.
* Automation & Scripting — Practical experience with automation frameworks (Python, Ansible, REST APIs, Terraform) for configuration, compliance, and workflow optimization.
* Observability & Monitoring — Exposure to observability platforms (DNAC, SolarWinds, Splunk, Prometheus, AIOps tools) for proactive monitoring and predictive insights.
* AI/ML in Networking — Experience leveraging AI/ML-driven tools for anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and performance optimization.
* Proficiency in network monitoring tools ( SolarWinds, DNAC, Prime, Splunk, etc.)
* Collaboration & Leadership — Demonstrated ability to work with global IT teams, OEMs, vendors, partners, and service providers, and act as SPOC for transition, transformation, and greenfield/brownfield projects. Ability to lead technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

description:
**Job Title:**
Associate– Software Asset Management
  
  
**Department**
: CIB IT Production - ISPL
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The Software Asset Management (SAM) function is a strategic, cross‑functional capability that ensures the organization’s software portfolio is managed efficiently, compliantly, and cost‑effectively. By combining rigorous governance, data‑driven insights, and close collaboration with IT, procurement, finance, and business units, SAM maximizes the value of software investments, reduces unnecessary spend, and mitigates licensing and regulatory risk.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The SAM Associate will report to the Software Asset Management Lead and will be primarily responsible for the monitoring and governance of the software licenses. The role will maintain accurate license inventories, conduct usage reconciliations, support internal audits, and drive cost‑optimization initiatives across the organization. The Analyst must be able to translate business requirements into actionable SAM processes and technical solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategy & Governance**

* Define and maintain the SAM policy, processes, and standards in line with corporate governance and relevant licensing agreements.
* Develop a roadmap for software asset optimization and cost‑reduction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with vendor contracts, audit requirements, and internal controls.

**License Management**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of all software licenses, entitlements, and usage rights.
* Reconcile procurement records, vendor contracts, and actual usage data.
* Manage software license renewals, extensions, and terminations.
* Generate regular dashboards on license compliance, utilization, and cost savings.

**Cost Optimization**

* Identify opportunities for license consolidation, volume discounts, and alternative (e.g., open‑source) solutions.
* Track and report on software spend, savings, and ROI.
* Recommend budgeting adjustments based on usage trends.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with IT Operations, Security, Procurement, Finance, and Business Units to align software usage with business needs.
* Serve as the point of contact for software request and licensing queries.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical**

* Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot)
* Experience with SAM tools – Snow Software, ServiceNow SAM, BMC, or similar
* Familiarity with Enterprise CMDB (ServiceNow, BMC)
* Understanding of software licensing models (per‑core, per‑user, concurrent, subscription, SaaS)

**Behavioral**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving ability
* Excellent written and verbal communication – able to craft clear audit evidence and executive‑level summaries
* Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, virtual team
* Detail‑oriented with a focus on data quality and governance
* Team player – comfortable collaborating across IT, Finance, Legal and Business Units

**Specific Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, IT Procurement, or a closely related discipline within a large, regulated enterprise (banking, financial services, or technology).
* Prior experience in similar domain.

**Skills Referential**

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. * Collaborates with and directs project teams to maintain world-class standards in all expansion projects and site builds.

**Installation and Maintenance:**

* Directs high-level planning and coordination of rack deployments, installations, and network infrastructure upgrades/changes.

**Planning & Execution:**

Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

title: Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory

Your impact
  
  
The Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory will lead the development and delivery of strategic advisory services for airports, governments, investors, airport operators, and infrastructure developers. The role will support clients in making informed decisions on airport development, expansion, investment, commercialization, privatization, airport city development, and long-term aviation growth strategies.

* Lead aviation market studies, traffic forecasts, catchment assessments, and benchmarking exercises.

**Client Engagement & Business Development**

**Key Clients**

* Airport Operators and Developers

* Infrastructure Funds and Investors
* Airport City and Real Estate Developers

Here's what you'll need

* Proven ability to engage with senior stakeholders, clients, and multidisciplinary teams.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Aviation Strategy & Airport Development
* Airport Economics & Business Planning
* Commercial & Investment Advisory
* Airport City & Land Development
* Market Analysis & Forecasting
* Business Development & Client Management
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Engineering, Transport Planning, Urban Planning, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.

Master's degree in Aviation Management, Transport Planning, Economics, Urban Development, Infrastructure Finance, or MBA.

description:
IPE Global’s Social and Economic Empowerment practice works towards building girl capital, empowering women and nurturing resilient communities by creating inclusive and sustainable solutions, including but not limited to policy development, capacity building, adaptive management, community mobilisation, behaviour change communication, deepening social safety nets, beneficiary feedback analysis, poverty assessment, and evidence-based monitoring.

We seek a strategic leader who will strengthen institutional employment mechanisms for school students, amplify OJT/internship opportunities for girls in aspirational market-linked trades, and support the implementation of the state vocational education action plan.

The
**State Consultant**
will work closely with the State Education Department to strengthen planning, implementation, monitoring, and data systems for school vocational education under Samagra Shiksha, with a focus on improving school coverage, delivery quality, and data-driven decision-making. The role ensures alignment with the state vocational skilling ecosystem and the project. It involves extensive stakeholder engagement, capacity building, and program management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with the state education department to implement guidelines, frameworks, and operational manuals on VE
* Support roll-out of public awareness initiatives in the state to improve social perception of VE and life skills.
* Support the state department in organising localised career fairs in collaboration with industries and the State Skill Mission.
* Strengthen the monitoring and evaluation systems and state MIS to track student outcomes, adapting strategies as needed.
* Build and sustain strong partnerships with relevant state government departments and bodies to align school vocational initiatives with skill missions.
* Develop a stakeholder engagement plan and organise regular coordination meetings and field visits
* Organise events like meetings, roundtables, conferences in collaboration with the concerned dept representatives
* Prepare high-quality periodic progress reports, presentations, and briefs for government reviews and steering committees.

As job descriptions cannot be exhaustive, the State Consultant may be required to undertake other duties broadly in line with the above tasks, as determined by senior leadership.

***Qualification & Experience:***

**Educational Background**

Master’s degree or higher in Education, Social Sciences, Public Policy, or a related field.

**Work Experience and Expertise:**

* At least 10 years of experience leading state-level programmes related to education and/or skilling and promoting student retention.
* Proven experience working with government education departments, skill development ministries, civil society, and community stakeholders. Experience working with Samagra Shiksha or state education systems is desirable.
* Strong understanding of NEP 2020, NSQF, and national and state frameworks guiding vocational education in schools.
* Experience in designing gender-responsive, large-scale in-school programmes that enhance vocational skills, employability, and life skills for adolescents.
* Strong understanding of the socio-cultural, economic, and policy factors influencing school dropout rates and school-based vocational education, including poverty, gender discrimination, social norms, and systemic barriers within the education system.
* Deep commitment to advancing youth empowerment, gender equality, and inclusive education, with a particular focus on enabling girls’ access to in-school vocational pathways and lifelong skills.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* **Strategic leadership:**
  Demonstrated capacity to lead complex, multi-stakeholder programmes at scale.
* **Stakeholder engagement and management:**
  Ability to engage and persuade diverse stakeholders.
* **Analytical thinking:**
  Strong data interpretation skills, academic content decoding, and evidence-based decision-making.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* **Team building:**
  Ability to lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Engineer – Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity.

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation.

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation.

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications.

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times.

• Run demos, application trials and customer training.

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running.

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation.

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team.

Must Have

• Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation.

• 1–4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering.

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills.

• Willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP.

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming.

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics.

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAE – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Head – Retail (Express Business)
description:
**Head – Retail (Express Business)**

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Experience:**
18–25 years

**About the Company**

Our organization is India’s largest integrated logistics services provider and a global leader in less-than-container-load consolidation, headquartered in Mumbai. With more than three decades of logistics experience, we operate across 180 countries, provide door-to-door delivery in more than 50 markets, and maintain extensive express distribution coverage across India. Growth has been shaped by organic expansion, strategic mergers and acquisitions, and entry into multiple logistics verticals. Our integrated portfolio spans international supply chain, express distribution, CFS-ICD, contract logistics, air freight, and logistics parks. By creating synergies across group businesses, we deliver customized supply-chain solutions. We aim to stay ahead through dynamic leadership, innovation, courageous decision-making, change management, and agile execution in India and globally.

**About the Role**

The Head – Retail will own the pan-India channel and retail ecosystem for the Express Business, converting network scale into profitable, sustainable growth. This leader will shape national strategy, expand franchise and partner coverage in underpenetrated markets, and own the Channel and Retail P&L across zones. The role will lead a network of more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees through zonal leadership, while improving partner capability, retention, productivity, and returns. Success requires transforming retail experience through consistent outlets, technology-enabled visibility, customer-service improvements, activations, loyalty initiatives, and stronger governance. The leader will mentor zonal business heads and future leaders, establish audit and financial controls, and align Operations, Product, Finance, Marketing, HR, and L&D. Reporting to the National Head – Sales and Marketing, the role manages four to five direct reports and requires extensive travel across India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the national channel and retail strategy, aligning network expansion, partner economics, customer experience, and P&L outcomes with Express Business growth priorities.
* Expand into underpenetrated markets through scalable franchise and partner models, using market data, investment discipline, and clear return thresholds to build sustainable coverage.
* Own Channel and Retail P&L performance across zones, shifting the operating model from volume-led expansion toward value-based partner engagement, productivity, contribution, and profitability.
* Govern a network of more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees through zonal leadership, strengthening capability, retention, grievance resolution, and long-term partner relationships.
* Establish data-backed channel-health metrics, CRM and retail analytics reviews, and performance cadences that improve partner productivity, outlet economics, visibility, and return on investment.
* Transform the retail experience through footprint expansion, brand consistency, technology-enabled service visibility, retail activation, loyalty programs, and coordinated customer engagement with Marketing.
* Build leadership depth by mentoring zonal business heads and next-line leaders, while partnering with HR and L&D on training for channel sales teams and franchise owners.
* Strengthen governance through franchise audits, financial controls, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, and industry stakeholders.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Deep expertise in logistics, express distribution, retail operations, franchise networks, and channel-partner ecosystems, with the judgment to balance scale, service quality, and profitable growth.
* Proven P&L ownership, financial acumen, negotiation, stakeholder management, and national-level commercial leadership across complex, distributed operating environments.
* Working familiarity with CRM, ERP, retail analytics, logistics software, inventory-management systems, and data-analysis tools used to improve visibility, decisions, execution, and governance.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience leading large-scale channel or franchise networks in logistics, express delivery, e-commerce, FMCG, or other distributed consumer-facing businesses will be advantageous.
* A postgraduate degree such as an MBA, exposure to national retail transformation, or experience with technology-enabled outlet models will strengthen candidacy.
* Demonstrated success in building partner capability, improving franchise profitability, and expanding coverage across underpenetrated geographies will be valued.

**What You'll Bring**

* You will bring 18–25 years of experience in channel leadership, franchise-network development, retail operations, logistics, express delivery, e-commerce, FMCG, or a closely related distributed business. At least five years should reflect national leadership responsibility, with ownership of large networks, multi-zone performance, and commercially material P&L outcomes.
* You will combine strategic thinking with execution discipline, translating market opportunities into scalable partner programs, stronger outlet economics, improved customer experience, and sustainable profitability. Your leadership will be grounded in analytical decision-making, problem-solving, negotiation, communication, and relationship management across partners, employees, and senior stakeholders.
* You will demonstrate customer focus, adaptability, resilience, integrity, and governance in a fast-moving environment. A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, or a related discipline is expected; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* You must be comfortable using data, CRM, ERP, retail analytics, logistics, inventory, and performance-management systems to create visibility and accountability. Extensive travel across India is essential for direct network engagement.

**Why Join Us**

* Shape the national retail and channel agenda for a large, integrated logistics platform, with direct ownership of partner ecosystem growth, customer experience transformation, and profitable Express Business outcomes.
* Influence a distributed ecosystem spanning more than 6,000 partners and approximately 4,000 employees, while building the next generation of zonal and channel leadership.
* Work across international supply chain, express distribution, contract logistics, air freight, and logistics-park businesses to create synergies and deliver integrated customer solutions.
* Lead a high-impact transformation agenda centered on technology, governance, partner economics, operational efficiency, and sustainable national expansion.

**What We Offer**

* A senior national leadership mandate with ownership of Channel and Retail P&L, strategic expansion, partner governance, customer experience, and profitability across India.
* The opportunity to work with a broad logistics portfolio, cross-functional leadership teams, and a large partner and retail ecosystem undergoing technology-enabled transformation.
* A performance-oriented environment that values innovation, courageous decisions, agile execution, collaboration, integrity, and disciplined governance.

title: Drainage & Sewerage Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Nippon Koei India Private Limited (NK India) is part of the global ID&E Group (formerly Nippon Koei Group), a consulting engineering organization with over 75 years of experience. Founded in 1946 as Japan’s first independent consulting engineering company, Nippon Koei has built a strong international reputation for quality and reliability. The group has delivered planning, design, construction supervision, and project management services for major infrastructure projects across nearly all development sectors in more than 100 countries. NK India and the wider group work extensively with leading international funding agencies such as JBIC, JICA, the World Bank, and the Asian Development Bank, offering professionals exposure to large-scale, high-impact projects.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Drainage & Sewerage Design Engineer (Water Infrastructure) based in Mumbai / Navi Mumbai. We are looking for an engineer with approximately 10 years of experience in water-sector and infrastructure consultancy projects.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Stormwater drainage design:**
  Plan and design drainage systems for urban infrastructure, roads, highways, industrial areas, townships, and land development projects. This covers catchment delineation, runoff estimation, and sizing of underground pipes, RCC drains, open channels, roadside drains, culverts, inlets, catch pits, manholes, and outfalls.
* **Hydrology and hydraulic modelling:**
  Carry out rainfall-runoff analysis using IDF curves, runoff coefficients, time of concentration, and design return periods. Model drainage networks to assess capacity and surcharge. Carry out flood and waterlogging assessments, evaluate the impact of new development on existing drainage and downstream conditions, and recommend improvements such as capacity augmentation, diversion channels, detention/retention, and sustainable urban drainage solutions.
* **Sewerage network design:**
  Design gravity sewers, trunk sewers, lateral networks, manholes, and inspection chambers. Estimate wastewater flows from population projections, generation rates, and infiltration allowances. Size pipes and check slopes, invert levels, velocities, and hydraulic gradients using relevant modelling software. Support the design of pumping stations and rising mains where required.
* **Deliverables:**
  Prepare and review DPRs, feasibility studies, design basis reports, technical specifications, BOQs, design calculations, and detailed drawings (layouts, longitudinal sections, cross-sections, hydraulic profiles).
* **Coordination and support:**
  Coordinate with civil, structural, road, water supply, and environmental teams, and align drainage and sewer designs with road levels, grading plans, and utility corridors. Review survey and utility data, incorporate client comments, join client meetings, review designs for constructability, safety, and compliance, and support site visits and construction-phase technical issues.

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering (mandatory); M.Tech / M.E. in Environmental Engineering, Hydrology, Water Resources Engineering, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in water-sector, urban infrastructure, and engineering consultancy projects.
* Strong hands-on experience in stormwater drainage design, sewerage network design, and hydraulic calculations.
* Demonstrated experience in hydrological analysis, catchment assessment, rainfall-runoff calculations, and drainage network planning. Experience in urban drainage, road drainage, surface runoff management, and flood mitigation is desirable.
* Experience preparing DPRs, detailed engineering designs, technical reports, and multidisciplinary project deliverables.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, plus Civil 3D and GIS tools for terrain analysis and catchment delineation.
* Experience with SewerGEMS/WaterGEMS and stormwater modelling tools such as StormCAD, InfoDrainage, SWMM, HEC-HMS, or HEC-RAS, depending on project needs.
* Knowledge of CPHEEO manuals, applicable Indian Standards, local drainage requirements, and project-specific design guidelines.
* Ability to interpret survey data, topographic maps, and DEMs, and to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to safety and sustainability.
* Familiarity with projects funded by international agencies (JICA, World Bank, ADB, etc.) is an advantage. Experience in urban development, roads and highways, municipal infrastructure, and water and sanitation projects is also an advantage.

title: Senior Manager, Circle U
description:
**Summary**
As Senior Manager, Circle U, you will play a central role in shaping and building Circle U—The Circle’s teacher-preparation and capacity-building vertical serving educators in low-income communities across India.
  
  
By 2033, Circle U aims to become a reputable School of Education, preparing 3,000+ educators with the capabilities to reinvent learning. This role is a rare opportunity to help shape that institution at its founding stage.
  
  
Circle U is entering Year 2 of operations. This is a build-from-the-ground-up phase: systems are still being shaped, quality benchmarks are being defined, and the long-term identity of the program is being forged. As part of the Circle U founding team, this role is for someone who is energised by the pace, complexity, and ambiguity of a start-up environment within a mission-driven organization - someone who is excited to strengthen, deliver, and scale a teacher education model that has the potential to reinvent teacher education in India.
  
  
You will lead the design and delivery of training tracks, curriculum, and key program projects, while also providing instructional support across multiple school sites - working directly with teachers and coaches through classroom observations, coaching, training, and on-ground facilitation. You will also work
  
  
closely with the Program Lead and Director to contribute to Circle U’s strategy and program design.
  
  
**Role**
In the coming year, your work will play a critical role in shaping the learning experiences of 400 educators across India through:
  
  

* A one-year certification program serving 200 teachers and coaches, combining

in-person residencies, school-based apprenticeships, virtual learning, site visits,
  
  
and coaching
  
  

* A suite of short-stint hybrid courses serving 200 educators beyond The Circle

Network
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Training, Coaching, and On-Ground Support:
  
  

* Serve as lead faculty for the program, designing and facilitating sessions across in-person residencies, virtual electives, and learning touchpoints through the year.
* Design and lead grade-specific learning experiences across program tracks (KG, Elementary, Middle School), ensuring content is contextualised and relevant for participants.
* Lead instructional support for multiple Circle U partner sites, including classroom observations, lesson modeling, workshop facilitation, and coaching teachers and coaches with clear, actionable feedback.
* Provide 1:1 coaching and mentorship to teachers and coaches, supporting growth in instructional practice and professional mindset.
* Model instructional excellence and reflective practice, serving as an example across the Circle U community.

**Curriculum, Instructional Design & Quality**

* Support the design and implementation of core instructional tools, including rubrics, assessment resources, and high-quality instructional materials (HQIMs).
* Contribute to the curriculum design for the one-year and short-stint programs, translating the learning arc into high-impact learning experiences for teachers and coaches.
* Partner with expert faculty and institutions to co-create tools, session designs, and learning experiences that are rigorous, relevant, and practice-based.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of assessment data systems, to inform instruction, coaching, and program improvement across Circle U.

**Program Operations, Partnerships, And Culture**

* Lead projects and workstreams within Circle U offerings, managing timelines, logistics, and coordination for specific program components.
* Support cross-functional collaboration across The Circle (Labs, Incubation, Ops, Tech, Finance) to enable smooth execution.
* Build relationships and partnerships with entrepreneurs, school leaders, faculty, and ecosystem partners to strengthen program delivery and long-term sustainability.
* Contribute to shaping Circle U’s and The Circle’s leadership culture, values, and ways of working as the vertical grows.

**Circle U Strategy And Design**

* Contribute to Circle U’s annual strategic direction and planning, translating long term vision into annual priorities, operating models, and quality benchmarks
* Support the refinement of program structures and learning arcs, sharing field insights to strengthen coherence, rigor, and progression.
* Support monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) processes, including data collection, reflection, and learning cycles to strengthen program quality.
* Use feedback and data from participants, sites, and faculty to inform continuous improvement across Circle U’s offerings.

Qualification & Experiences
  
  
We are looking for someone to be a core member of the Circle U team, contributing meaningfully to shaping the vertical through strong instructional practice, project ownership, and a deep commitment to impact.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree with significant relevant experience (4+ years highly preferred), including at least 2 years of classroom teaching in a low-income community
* Proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, coaching, and instructional excellence -Strong outcome orientation, with a demonstrated track record of driving measurable improvements in student learning and educator practice
* Experience working in low-income communities, with a strong equity lens
* Excellent program and project management skills, with experience planning, organizing, and delivering complex, multi-phase initiatives -Strong openness to learning and feedback, with a willingness to reflect, adapt, and grow in a fast-evolving program environment
* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills
* Highly adaptable, comfortable with ambiguity, and eager to learn in a growing organization -Willingness to travel extensively (40% of your time)

title: Process Engineer
description:
**Job Opportunity: Process Engineer**

**Location :**
Navi Mumbai

**Company :**
SFC Environmental Technologies Limited

SFC is an environmental technology company providing advanced solutions in wastewater treatment, wastewater recycle & reuse, and solid waste treatment. Since 2005, we have been enabling municipalities and industries to build and operate plants that are simple, flexible, and cost effective throughout their lifecycle.

We are the market leader in India in sequencing batch reactor (SBR) technology through our flagship C-Tech process, holding 80%+ share and delivering reliable treatment at scale. With technologies spanning C-Tech, Fiber Disc Filters, Submerged Ultrafiltration, MBR, MABR, and CCRO, we are helping drive the transition to reuse and circular water management.

Our footprint covers India, Austria, Germany, and Czechia, supported by in-house R&D, manufacturing, and automation capabilities. Together with our subsidiary Hindustan Waste Treatment, we are also advancing integrated solid waste management solutions that generate renewable energy and reduce landfill impact.

At SFC, we believe in People → Planet → Profit. Our culture is built on freedom, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning — empowering our teams to innovate and grow across roles, functions, and geographies.

**Role Definition :**

**The Design Engineer – Process**
will be responsible for end-to-end process engineering for wastewater recycling systems, including
**SBR-based sewage/effluent treatment systems**
and an indepth knowledge of
**STP/ETP/CETP technologies**
(ASP, MBBR, SBR, MBR). The role involves reviewing tender requirements, preparing Basic Engineering Packages, performing process and hydraulic calculations, developing key engineering documents such as PFDs, P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, and mass balances, and coordinating drawings and documentation with drafting teams. The position also includes vendor interaction, site visits for data validation, ensuring compliance with relevant standards, and providing process support during construction, commissioning, and start-up to ensure successful project execution.

**Experience**

* 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in Wastewater / Chemical / MSW / Oil and gas / Infrastructure projects

**Minimum Qualifications**

* B.E. / B. Tech in Civil Engineering
* M.E. / M. Tech in Environmental Engineering is mandatory

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process design, equipment sizing, selection, and preparation of datasheets for wastewater recycling systems STP/ETP/CETP technologies (ASP, MBBR, SBR, MBR).
* Develop PFDs, P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, mass/energy balances, BOQs, and plant layouts.
* Perform detailed process calculations and select appropriate treatment equipment.
* Review vendor drawings, prepare RFQs, and support techno-commercial evaluations.
* Generate process documentation, process notes, O&M manuals, and maintain design records.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at
careers@sfcenv.com
with the subject line 'Process Engineer'.

title: Assistant Manager - Enterprise IT
description:
**Position Overview**
We require an experienced L2 Windows Domain & Backup Engineer to manage and maintain enterprise Windows environments along with backup and recovery infrastructure. The role includes Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and core Windows services, along with enterprise backup administration, monitoring, and recovery operations. The engineer will also perform assessments, reporting, compliance activities, and enable automation using scripting/AI tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Windows Infrastructure Management
  
  

* Administer Active Directory (Users, Groups, GPOs, OU structure)
* Maintain DNS, DHCP, and RADIUS (NPS) services
* Manage Windows Server environments (2016/2019/2022) including installation, configuration, and upgrades
* Ensure high availability and performance optimization of Windows infrastructure

Backup Administration
  
  

* Manage and monitor enterprise backup solutions (e.g., NetBackup, BackupExec, Veeam, Commvault, or similar)
* Perform backup scheduling, configuration, and policy management for servers, databases, and applications
* Ensure successful completion of daily backups and troubleshoot failed backup jobs
* Perform data restoration (file-level, VM-level, and application-level) as per business requirements
* Conduct regular backup validation and restoration drills to ensure recoverability
* Manage backup storage, retention policies, and archival processes
* Optimize backup performance and storage utilization
* Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams during backup and restore activities
* Ensure DR readiness by supporting disaster recovery drills and failover testing
* Maintain backup reports, logs, and documentation

Security & Vulnerability Management
  
  

* Perform Windows patch management (monthly/critical updates)
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities using tools like Qualys/Nessus
* Ensure SLA-based closure of vulnerabilities
* Implement server hardening best practices
* Ensure backup data security, encryption, and access controls
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and internal policies
* Prepare documentation for audits (including backup and recovery evidence)
* Track audit findings and remediation
* Maintain security and backup baselines

Incident & Change Management
  
  

* Handle L2/L3 incidents related to Windows infrastructure and backup systems
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for failures (including backup failures)
* Support change management processes for infra and backup changes

**Required Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**
Strong experience in Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, RADIUS/NPS; Windows Server (2016/2019/2022/2025); patch management tools (WSUS/SCCM/Intune/Bigfix)
  
  
**Backup Tools:**
Experience in enterprise backup tools (NetBackup, Veeam, Commvault, etc.)
  
  
**Security:**
Knowledge of ISO 27001 and security frameworks; experience with vulnerability tools (Qualys, Nessus)
  
  
**Scripting:**
PowerShell scripting for automation
  
  
**Certifications (Preferred):**
Microsoft certifications (MCSA, Azure Admin); certifications in backup technologies (Veeam/Commvault/NetBackup)
  
  
**Environment:**
Experience in enterprise multi-domain environments; exposure to hybrid environments (on-prem + Azure/GCP); exposure to AI/automation tools
  
  
**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Communication:**
Strong documentation and reporting skills; effective communication and coordination with IT and business teams
  
  
**Attention to Detail:**
High attention to detail in backup validation, security compliance, and audit readiness
  
  
**Resilience:**
Ability to work in high-pressure production environments with SLA-bound deliverables

Root cause analysis; incident management; proactive vulnerability remediation

SFC Environmental Technologies Limited

SFC is an environmental technology company providing advanced solutions in wastewater treatment, wastewater recycle & reuse, and solid waste treatment. Since 2005, we have been enabling municipalities and industries to build and operate plants that are simple, flexible, and cost effective throughout their lifecycle.

We are the market leader in India in sequencing batch reactor (SBR) technology through our flagship C-Tech process, holding 80%+ share and delivering reliable treatment at scale. With technologies spanning C-Tech, Fiber Disc Filters, Submerged Ultrafiltration, MBR, MABR, and CCRO, we are helping drive the transition to reuse and circular water management.

Our footprint covers India, Austria, Germany, and Czechia, supported by in-house R&D, manufacturing, and automation capabilities. Together with our subsidiary Hindustan Waste Treatment, we are also advancing integrated solid waste management solutions that generate renewable energy and reduce landfill impact.

At SFC, we believe in People → Planet → Profit. Our culture is built on freedom, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning — empowering our teams to innovate and grow across roles, functions, and geographies.

title: Manager – Talent Management & Development
description:
**Company Description**
IceWarp is a global collaboration and communication platform that offers an integrated alternative to MS 365 and Google Workspace. The company enables streamlined business processes through real-time collaboration tools, easy file sharing, and a unified virtual office experience from a single window, without third-party applications. IceWarp serves over 50 million paid users and 50,000 customers across more than 50 countries, emphasizing security, efficiency, and ease of use. Founded in 2001, IceWarp is fully developed in-house, with ongoing innovation and product updates to meet evolving workplace needs.

**Role Description**
The Manager – Talent Management & Development is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for designing and implementing talent management strategies, including performance management frameworks, succession planning initiatives, and career development programs.

The role will own the employee learning journey from induction and onboarding through structured
**30, 60 and 90-day enablement plans**
, followed by ongoing development. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience implementing an LMS, conducting assessments, managing training partners and working with business leaders to deliver measurable improvements in employee performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**New Joiner Onboarding & Enablement**

•⁠ ⁠Design and execute structured induction, onboarding and on-the-job training programmes across functions.

•⁠ ⁠Develop role-specific
**30, 60 and 90-day plans**
with clear learning objectives, milestones, assessments and readiness criteria.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate with reporting managers, subject matter experts and HR to ensure timely execution.

•⁠ ⁠Track new joiner progress, identify learning gaps and implement corrective interventions.

•⁠ ⁠Provide documented readiness recommendations to support probation and confirmation decisions.

**Training Needs Analysis & Learning Programmes:**

•⁠ ⁠Identify individual, team and organisational training needs through stakeholder discussions, performance data and competency assessments.

•⁠ ⁠Develop and execute a training calendar aligned with business priorities.

•⁠ ⁠Organise regular functional, behavioural and managerial workshops.

•⁠ ⁠Deliver or coordinate programmes covering communication, interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence (EQ), analytical thinking, problem-solving and cognitive abilities (IQ).

•⁠ ⁠Build structured learning paths for different roles and levels.

**Assessments & Learning Effectiveness:**

•⁠ ⁠Develop pre- and post-training assessments, practical evaluations and competency-based reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate appropriate behavioural, emotional intelligence and cognitive assessments, using qualified providers where required.

•⁠ ⁠Track knowledge retention, application on the job and progress against agreed capability standards.

•⁠ ⁠Evaluate training effectiveness through assessment outcomes, manager feedback and changes in employee performance.

•⁠ ⁠Maintain assessment records and ensure timely communication of results and development actions.

**LMS Implementation & Administration:**

•⁠ ⁠Lead or actively manage LMS implementation, including requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, configuration, testing and rollout.

•⁠ ⁠Create learning paths, upload content, configure assessments and manage training assignments.

•⁠ ⁠Drive LMS adoption among employees and managers.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor course completion, assessment results and learning engagement through LMS reports.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate with IT and vendors to resolve issues and improve platform usability.

**Stakeholder & Training Vendor Management:**

•⁠ ⁠Partner with business heads, reporting managers and HR to agree on learning priorities and expected outcomes.

•⁠ ⁠Establish clear ownership for training delivery, employee participation and progress reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Evaluate and manage external trainers, training institutes, assessment partners and content providers.

•⁠ ⁠Manage training proposals, commercials, schedules, delivery quality and vendor performance.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor training budgets and evaluate the value delivered by learning programmes.

**Employee Performance & Development:**

•⁠ ⁠Track employee development against agreed learning goals, competency requirements and performance milestones.

•⁠ ⁠Support managers in translating performance gaps into practical development plans.

•⁠ ⁠Facilitate regular development reviews and monitor completion of agreed actions.

•⁠ ⁠Identify high-potential employees and support career development and succession planning.

•⁠ ⁠Work with HR and business leaders to strengthen feedback, coaching and continuous learning practices.

**Performance Improvement Plans:**

•⁠ ⁠Partner with HR and reporting managers to develop and monitor structured
**Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).**

•⁠ ⁠Define measurable improvement goals, review timelines, learning support and accountability.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate relevant training, coaching and assessments during the PIP period.

•⁠ ⁠Document progress, review discussions and outcomes to support consistent, evidence-based decisions.

**Reporting & Governance:**

•⁠ ⁠Maintain dashboards covering onboarding milestones, training participation, LMS completion, assessment results and employee development progress.

•⁠ ⁠Track time to proficiency, overdue learning actions and PIP progress.

•⁠ ⁠Present regular updates to leadership, highlighting capability gaps, outcomes and recommended actions.

•⁠ ⁠Maintain accurate training records, assessment documentation and development plans.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

•⁠ ⁠
**Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Talent Management, Learning & Development or Employee Enablement within the IT industry.**

•⁠ ⁠Proven experience working as a Manager in the same domain, with ownership of learning programmes and employee development initiatives.

•⁠ ⁠Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured onboarding and 30–60–90-day enablement plans.

•⁠ ⁠Hands-on involvement in at least one LMS implementation, along with experience managing LMS administration, reporting and adoption.

•⁠ ⁠Experience conducting training needs analysis, competency assessments and learning effectiveness reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Experience facilitating workshops and managing external training vendors.

•⁠ ⁠Exposure to behavioural, EQ and cognitive assessments and their appropriate use in employee development.

•⁠ ⁠Experience supporting performance management, development planning and PIPs.

•⁠ ⁠Graduate or postgraduate qualification in HR, Psychology, Business Management or a related discipline.

**Key Competencies:**

•⁠ ⁠Stakeholder management and business partnering

•⁠ ⁠Training facilitation and coaching

•⁠ ⁠Programme planning and execution

•⁠ ⁠Interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence

•⁠ ⁠Vendor and budget management

•⁠ ⁠Data analysis and performance reporting

•⁠ ⁠Ownership, follow-through and attention to detail

**Success Measures:**

•⁠ ⁠Timely completion of onboarding and 30–60–90-day milestones.

•⁠ ⁠Improved new joiner readiness and reduced time to proficiency.

•⁠ ⁠Strong LMS adoption and timely completion of assigned learning.

•⁠ ⁠Measurable improvement in assessment results and on-the-job capability.

•⁠ ⁠Consistent execution of training calendars and development plans.

•⁠ ⁠Timely PIP reviews and documented progress against improvement goals.

\*Interested candidates with relevant IT industry experience are invited to apply with their updated CV.\*

title: Senior IT Service Desk Analyst
description:
We are a global consultancy group, combining multi-disciplined expertise to deliver marine, engineering and technical services that drive safety and sustainability in maritime, oil & gas and renewable energy sectors.
  
  
With a legacy dating back to 1856 – to the world’s first marine surveying organisation, The Salvage Association – Aqualis continues to evolve to provide the deepest pool of technical expertise across marine and engineering disciplines in more locations worldwide, to best support our clients and markets in keeping the world moving today, whilst managing the challenges of tomorrow.
  
  
The Senior IT Service Desk Analyst will provide technical support and assistance to staff across various regions and time zones. With strong technical skills and a customer-oriented mindset, you will act as an escalation point for the most complex incidents and service requests. Your role is crucial in ensuring the smooth operation of IT services and delivering a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Deliver an exceptional customer experience by managing service desk interactions professionally and efficiently.
* Provide technical support in accordance with service desk policies, procedures, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Triage, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, system, network, and user account issues for both local and remote users.
* Gather information through effective questioning to identify root causes and implement appropriate solutions.
* Guide users through issue resolution via phone, email, chat, and remote support tools.
* Keep users informed with timely updates and escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate teams when required.
* Manage and prioritise multiple incidents and service requests to ensure agreed response and resolution targets are achieved.
* Accurately document incidents, requests, resolutions, and customer interactions within service management systems.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support Windows operating systems, end-user devices, and business applications.
* Research, identify, and implement workarounds and permanent solutions to technical issues.
* Collaborate with internal teams and third-party vendors to resolve hardware, software, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Maintain and contribute to the service desk knowledge base, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
* Promote adherence to service desk processes, policies, and best practices to ensure consistent service delivery.
* Act as an escalation point for complex incidents, providing technical guidance and support to colleagues.
* Monitor service trends, identify recurring problems, and recommend proactive improvements to reduce future incidents.
* Work closely with IT Service Desk leadership to support continuous improvement initiatives and the effective operation of the service desk.
* Identify training needs and support the delivery of technical and customer service development programmes.
* Coach and mentor team members to enhance their technical expertise, service quality, and customer support skills.
* Foster a collaborative team environment and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across the business.
* Promote awareness and adoption of IT products and services available to the organisation.

**What are we looking for?**

* Minimum 3 years' experience in an IT Service Desk environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL best practices or IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks.
* Advanced knowledge of Windows operating systems and Windows Server administration.
* Administration and support of Microsoft 365, including Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Intune, and Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure and technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, DHCP, DNS and VPNs.
* Experience with backup, recovery and restoration processes.
* Knowledge of audio-visual and conferencing technologies.
* Fluent in English.

**Further Information**
*This position will be based at our office in Govandi East, Mumbai.*
*You must have the right to live and work in India.*
*You must be able to work on a shift rotation, including 06:00-14:00,14:00-22:00 and 22:00-06:00. You must also be able to work public holidays on occasion.*
*You can learn more about our team and what we do here:*
*https://aqualis-group.com/*
*To ensure your application is considered, please submit it using the link provided on this page.*
*NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES.*
**Our Commitment To D&I**
At Aqualis Group, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive, regardless of background, identity, or role. As a global company, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion strengthens our teams. We support flexible working, accessible environments, and employee wellbeing. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your unique perspective could be just what we need.

title: Article Assistant
description:

Our firm offers a dynamic, high-growth professional environment specializing in
**Chartered Accountancy services, Business & Asset Valuations, and Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code (IBC) practice**
. We are committed to fostering young talent, providing structured mentorship, and offering unmatched exposure to multidisciplinary financial domains.

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and ambitious
**Article Assistant**
to join our core team. This role is designed for a recently qualified CA who is eager to build a robust foundation in specialized corporate advisory, regulatory compliance, and valuation.

* Strong financial acumen with a keen interest in Valutions, IBC, and Corporate Finance.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Prevention Worker
description:
The Prevention Worker(s) will be responsible for responding effectively in providing preventative service to Nigig Gamik clients in a collaborative and ongoing manner, or from time-to-time in crisis situations; ensuring support to children, youth and families during difficult times. The role will require flexibility and prompt response.
  
  
**Position Title:**
Prevention Worker
  
  
**Posting Period:**
Until the position is filled
  
  
**Salary:**
$65,000 - $75,000 Annually
  
  
***Nigig Nibi Ki-win Gamik Society is growing our team!***
Join our dynamic and dedicated team as we continue to develop capacity within the Algonquins of Pikwakanagan First Nation and greater unceded Algonquin territory. With our Child Well-being law, Nigig Nibi Ki-win, now fully in force, the community embraces a step in reconciliation by reclaiming jurisdiction over the safety and well-being of our children, youth and families.
  
  
We're looking for the right people to grow with the organization. Are you interested?
  
  
Learn more about Nigig: https://www.nigignibi.com/about/nigig-nibi-ki-win
  
  
**Summary**
The Prevention Worker(s) will be responsible for responding effectively in providing preventative service to Nigig Gamik clients in a collaborative and ongoing manner, or from time-to-time in crisis situations; ensuring support to children, youth and families during difficult times. The role will require flexibility and prompt response.
  
  
The Prevention Worker will often work in conjunction with other services departments within Nigig Nibi Ki-win Gamik to ensure a wholistic approach to well-being is offered/provided.
  
  
In addition, this role includes participating in the facilitation of culturally appropriate programing for children, youth and families with a wholistic approach that promotes and supports a healthy family lifestyle.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery**

* Works closely with children, youth, their families and community in facilitating connection to resources and assistance with participation in activities promoting well-being.
* Provides opportunities for the enhancement and development of a positive cultural identity for all clients.
* Complete all administrative duties and responsibilities including comprehensive and accurate notes on active files.
* Completes incident reports as may be required.
* Acknowledges and implements best practices based on trauma informed care and department/Nigig policy.

**Collaborative Practice**

* Works closely with Nigig Gamik's other departments/staff to ensure quality service delivery and relevant programming is captured.
* Participates on relevant boards, committees and community development projects as may be assigned by management.
* Participates actively in task or work groups as assigned.
* Participate in staff meetings and care plan meetings.

**Crisis Support**

* Collaborates with emergency services to stabilize crisis issues of individuals as may be required in certain situations.
* Provides intensive short-term crisis support services in order to facilitate a successful transition to longer-term supports and services including but not limited to providing respite.
* Provides short-term follow-up and support to individuals following a crisis assessment.
* Provides resources and supports to family members of individuals in crisis.
* Assesses client needs and general well-being, prior to the development of appropriate recovery plans, in collaboration with Client Care Coordinator.
* Facilitates and monitor crisis recovery plans.
* Provide linkages to longer-term resources for those individuals in crisis.

**Programming**

* Informs and assists in the development and facilitation of individual and group programs according to community needs i.e. children, families and parents.
* Promotes and advertises relevant programs and activities to clients who may be interested in participating.
* Follows program guidelines, rules, regulations and completes all necessary forms/paperwork as might be required by the department.

**Community Development**

* Identifies, assesses, and prioritizes family and child prevention needs.
* Participates in developing strategic plans and annualized work plans.
* Participates and coordinates new prevention strategies and initiatives.
* Provides education and support to key stakeholders for the purpose of enhancing crisis services within Pikwakanagan and Renfrew County
* Liaises and networks with community and other child and youth services for the integration of new and existing services.
* Participates on relevant committees and meetings.
* Promotes community awareness of prevention services.

**Administrative**

* Assists in the development and implementation of tools to ensure evidence-based reporting.
* Completes all administrative reporting requirements according to department/Nigig policy and best practices.
* Maintains client files and data files, including updating client information.
* Participates in on-going training and education, and in the application of new skills into practice.
* Participates in administrative and office functions within the department
* Demonstrates computer literacy and good note taking skills.

**Quality Management**

* Utilizes evidence-based reporting to create and evaluate work plans.
* Participates in cultural awareness and cultural sensitivity training.
* Participates in staff development initiatives and training relevant to their role or as mandated by the organization.
* Ensures all certifications are current.
* Ensures they are compliant with policies and procedures developed and implemented by Nigig Gamik and in adherence to all relevant legislation and regulatory bodies.
* Provides a safe workplace environment by ensuring adherences to Workplace Health and Safety Regulations and Policies, Infection Control Guidelines, WHIMIS and Safe Work Procedures; including but not limited to Fire, Disaster and Evacuation Plans.
* Supports an environment which avoids, prevents and corrects all activities or actions which may result in an adverse outcome in the delivery of preventative services to clients.

**Risk Management**

* Participates in a comprehensive risk management planning with the department.
* Ensures the protection and privacy of all client and department/Nigig information and records in strict confidentiality.

**Other**

* Performs other related duties as may be required by the Client Care Coordinator/Manager.

**Working Conditions**
Work involves extensive public contact with clients, emergency services workers, child welfare agencies and other Nigig departments; work is subject to deadlines and interruptions. Work involves handling and dealing with issues of a very sensitive and confidential nature. Work involves a flexible schedule including evenings and weekends, travel and transporting clients.
  
  
**Employment Requirements**

* Basic Requirements:
* Some post secondary education in Mental Health or Social Work with a minimum of one year of successful experience working with children, youth and families, preferably in a First Nation setting.
* Expertise in mental health/illness and mental health difficulties and treatment modalities, with a willingness to participate in additional training provided
* Willing to be coached
* Able to work a flexible schedule including evenings and weekends.
* A minimum of a valid class “G” driver’s license and access to a dependable vehicle.
* Provide a clear Criminal Record Check with Vulnerable Sector Screening
* Certification in CPR and First Aid or willingness to obtain
* Experience with computer operations and software programs, preferably Microsoft 365 Suite.
* Rated Requirements

**Knowledge**

* Has an understanding of intergenerational violence and trauma in Indigenous communities.
* Has a firm grasp on Algonquin Anishinàbeg culture, social structure and traditional approaches to helping and healing.
* Is aware of Pikwakanagan’s community-based services and external resources.
* Has a comprehensive knowledge of social service resources within the Renfrew County Region and the ability to make referrals, guide and advocate on behalf of clients.

**Abilities**

* Can coordinate, plan and facilitate sessions, clinics, presentations, workshops and activities.
* Is able to respond to brief crisis intervention.
* Can complete narrative and statistical reports.
* Is able to research, analyze, conceptualize, organize and effectively communicate verbally and in writing.
* Is proficient in the use of computers and software.
* Is able to work flexible hours, sometimes on short notice.
* Is able to manage conflict and crisis situations.

**Personal Suitability**

* Has excellent interpersonal skills.
* Can work effectively in an inter-disciplinary team environment.
* Possesses tact, discretion and a professional level of confidentiality.
* Possesses a high degree of initiative, self-motivation, and is reliable and thorough.
* Is conscious of and sensitive to Indigenous culture and values.
* Possesses excellent assessment and evaluation skills
* Possesses excellent organizational & critical thinking skills

profile.

description:
Location:
  
  
Navi Mumbai, MH, IN, 400708

**About Holcim**
As the world’s global leader in innovative and sustainable building materials, Holcim is reinventing the way the world builds. Supported by a 45,000-strong global team spread across 44 countries and four industry segments (Cement, Aggregates, Ready-Mix Concrete and Solutions & Products), we are committed to shaping a greener, smarter and healthier world. It’s our ambition to lead the industry in reducing carbon emissions and accelerating the transition towards low-carbon constructions globally.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Sourcing & Procurement Manager**
to lead end to end sourcing and procurement on all aspects of our India Business services Centre and Digital Hub (main categories include but not limited to
**IT, Facility, Infrastructure & Other Indirect category)**
. In this role, you will lead sourcing, commercial negotiations, drive end-to-end category strategy, and partner closely with internal business stakeholders, Compliance, and Legal teams and vendors. You will be responsible for initiating, executing, and closing high-value procurement ensuring contracts while safeguarding the organization against legal, reputational, and compliance risks.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong commercial negotiation skills with expertise in regulatory compliance (sanctions screening, anti-bribery & corruption directives), contract management, foundational working understanding of SAP PR/PO/Invoices workflows and practicing AI for automation
  
  
Key Requirements
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering (MBA or PGDM preferred).
* Experience: 8+ years of core experience in Strategic Sourcing, Commercial Negotiations, and Contract Management for India, APAC & EU
* In depth knowledge of Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) policies, and knowledge of sanctions screening & vendor due diligence tools.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP PR/PO process flows and P2P lifecycles.
* Familiarity with Indian tax structures (GST, TDS) and local commercial statutory compliance.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Negotiations
  
  

* Lead strategic sourcing initiatives across IT and Indirect categories, with a strong focus on IT procurement, Contract Staffing, Facility, HR & Consulting Services.
* Execute commercial negotiations to optimize Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), secure competitive pricing structures, and obtain favorable commercial & payment terms.
* Lead competitive bidding including RFPs, RFQs, and market benchmarking to select lowest cost , high performing suppliers.

Contract Management
  
  

* Partner directly with the Legal team to initiate, draft, negotiate, and finalize contracts, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), SLAs, and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
* Proactively identify and mitigate contractual, commercial, and operational risks by enforcing essential clauses (indemnity, liability, data privacy, termination rights, and penalties).
* Manage contract renewals, amendments, and vendor obligations to ensure full compliance.

Compliance & Sanctions Screening
  
  

* Sanctions & Third-Party Screening: Conduct comprehensive due diligence and mandatory sanction screening on all new and existing vendors prior to onboarding.

* Maintain complete audit trail readiness for internal and external regulatory audits.

SAP Workflow Management
  
  

* Understanding the entire P2P cycle with strong hands-on experience of Purchase Requisitions (PR) and Purchase Order (PO) creation and approval workflows in SAP. Must know Invoice/SES workflows
* Coordinate with internal procurement operations and finance teams to ensure POs align accurately with executed contracts and commercial terms.

Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Oversee vendor performance evaluations through periodic scorecards, key performance metrics, and Annual Business Reviews
* Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional business heads to align sourcing strategies with business budgets and project timelines.
* Serve as the single point of contact to resolve vendor performance issues, commercial disputes, and contract ambiguities.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Professional certification in procurement (e.g. CPSM, CIPS, or CSCP).
* Exposure to modern e-Sourcing platforms (e.g. SAP Ariba, Coupa, or Fair Markit).
* AI-Based Sourcing & Automation: Exposure to or familiarity with AI-driven procurement tools, Hands on expertise with ChatGPT, Gemini and automation platforms
