title: Medical Administrator-Patient Check-In & Check-Out Coordinator
description:
VerityMD India Private Limited is hiring a Remote Patient Check-In & Check-Out Coordinator to support the daily operations of our busy neurology clinics in California.

The coordinator will work remotely in night shifts from India, using Epic and approved communication systems to manage patient registration, insurance verification follow-up, appointment scheduling, check-out, and patient communication.

This is a nonclinical position requiring excellent English communication, attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work during California business hours.

Key Responsibilities1. Remote Patient Check-In

* Monitor daily patient schedules in Epic.
* Review patient registration, demographics, insurance, PCP, and referring provider information.
* Confirm that insurance eligibility and required authorizations have been completed by the billing team.
* Identify missing forms, questionnaires, and registration information.
* Contact patients by telephone or approved messaging systems to obtain missing information before appointments.
* Coordinate with on-site front-desk staff to confirm patient arrival and readiness for rooming.
* Update appropriate patient registration fields in Epic within authorized access.
* Flag missing insurance information, incorrect appointment types, and scheduling discrepancies.

2. Remote Patient Check-Out

* Review provider-documented follow-up instructions and appointment orders.
* Schedule follow-up visits according to provider recommendations.
* Coordinate appointments for EMG/NCS, routine EEG, ambulatory EEG, autonomic testing, cognitive testing, Botox, and other procedures.
* Ensure required insurance authorization is obtained or pending appropriately before scheduling procedures.
* Send appointment confirmations and preparation instructions through approved channels.
* Coordinate outside referrals and diagnostic testing with the referral team.
* Contact patients who leave the clinic without scheduling their recommended follow-up.
* Maintain a daily list of patients with incomplete check-out tasks.

3. Appointment Scheduling and Patient Communication

* Manage incoming and outgoing scheduling-related calls.
* Schedule and reschedule appointments according to provider availability and clinic protocols.
* Confirm appointment dates, times, locations, and visit types.
* Assist patients with appointment-related questions and portal communication.
* Document telephone encounters and scheduling actions in Epic.
* Escalate urgent clinical concerns to the appropriate on-site clinical team.
* Coordinate with the patient confirmation and referral teams to prevent duplicated work.

4. Insurance and Billing Coordination

* Review eligibility and authorization status supplied by the billing team.
* Identify patients with missing insurance verification, authorization, or referral documentation.
* Coordinate insurance and billing issues with Sumit, Internal RCM Lead.
* Flag copayment, deductible, and outstanding balance information for on-site collection.
* Assist with payment-related communication without independently determining insurance coverage.
* Escalate payer discrepancies before appointments to minimize avoidable cancellations and denials.

5. Daily Patient Flow Management

* Monitor the live Epic appointment schedule throughout the day.
* Track scheduled, arrived, roomed, completed, canceled, and no-show appointments.
* Coordinate with the Folsom and Carmichael site supervisors to resolve scheduling issues.
* Identify patients waiting for check-out or follow-up scheduling.
* Help reduce front-desk administrative workload and appointment delays.
* Escalate unresolved patient issues to the office manager.

6. End-of-Day Reporting

Submit a daily report containing:

* Total patients scheduled and checked in.
* Number of completed check-outs.
* Follow-up appointments scheduled.
* Patients requiring additional scheduling outreach.
* Missing insurance or authorization issues.
* Unresolved patient complaints or scheduling problems.
* Pending tasks requiring next-day follow-up.

title: Site Implementation Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Contineu is an AI-native construction management platform dedicated to revolutionizing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes in the construction industry. The platform leverages advanced AI models to automate defect detection and classification, enabling faster, more accurate, and transparent quality management. Contineu’s innovative approach involves using helmet-mounted 360° cameras to capture site walks, significantly reducing manual defect logging and facilitating data-driven decision-making across all construction stages.

Job Summary

The
**Field Implementation Engineer – 360° Site Scanning**
is responsible for conducting on-site 360° visual scans of active construction sites using Contineu’s specialized capture devices. This role ensures high-quality data collection for defect identification through AI analysis, supporting the company’s mission to enhance construction quality management. The engineer will coordinate with project teams, ensure systematic scanning procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of the platform’s detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

* Conduct on-site 360° visual scans of active construction areas using Contineu’s helmet-mounted cameras.
* Ensure complete and accurate coverage of designated areas according to the predefined scanning plan.
* Coordinate with site QA/QC teams, project managers, and subcontractors to schedule scans without disrupting ongoing site activities.
* Perform basic quality checks on captured footage to verify data usability and high quality.
* Upload, organize, and maintain scan data within Contineu’s platform.
* Maintain detailed logs of all scanning activities, including date, site, area covered, and duration.
* Report on-site challenges, access issues, or scan anomalies to the central QA/QC or product teams.
* Support pilot projects and client demonstrations as needed.
* Gather stage-wise activity information during site visits to ensure scans align with ongoing construction progress.
* Understand and record developer-specific quality benchmarks to ensure AI outputs meet client expectations.
* Study and document construction workflows and QA/QC processes for each client, providing structured feedback to improve detection accuracy.
* Identify and flag new defect types not currently included in the AI detection taxonomy by analyzing AI outputs and site observations.
* Collaborate with QA/QC and data teams to validate AI-marked defects against real-site conditions and enhance model accuracy.

Qualifications

* 0–4 years of experience in construction QA/QC, site supervision, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of construction stages, defect types, and standard QA/QC processes.
* Ability to manually identify and record defects across civil, structural, and finishing works.
* Comfortable working at active construction sites and traveling across project locations.
* Basic familiarity with digital tools, mobile applications, and data entry systems.
* Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related field.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with digital site inspection tools and AI-based defect detection systems.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple site visits efficiently.
* Knowledge of construction workflows and quality benchmarks specific to different project types.
* Analytical skills to interpret site observations and AI outputs for continuous improvement.

Experience

* 0 to 4 years of relevant experience in construction QA/QC, site supervision, or related fields.
* Prior experience with site inspections, defect logging, or quality audits is preferred.

Environment

* The role involves working
  **on-site at various construction project locations across India**
  .
* The work environment is active, often involving physical movement and working in outdoor conditions.
* The position requires travel between multiple project sites, with work conducted in a dynamic construction setting.
* The role is primarily
  **in-office at project sites**
  , with some coordination and reporting done remotely.

Salary

* Competitive with industry standards.
* Travel and accommodation expenses for site visits will be covered by the company.

Growth Opportunities

* Potential career advancement into QA/QC technology operations and quality analytics roles within the company.
* Opportunity to work at the intersection of construction and cutting-edge AI technology.
* Exposure to India’s leading developers, PMCs, and contractors, fostering professional growth and industry recognition.

Benefits

* Coverage of travel and accommodation expenses for site visits.
* Opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup transforming construction quality management.
* Engagement with innovative AI-driven solutions in the construction industry.
* Professional development and exposure to leading industry projects.

title: SOC Analyst
description:

As a security operations center (SOC) engineer, you will help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Waystone infrastructure. You will work with software engineers, DevOps engineers, IT Engineering, internal audit and compliance teams, and other security engineers across multiple teams to protect Waystone.

* Develop and refine security monitoring policies, rules, and alerting configurations for enhanced detection capabilities.
* Conduct investigations into security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation steps.
* Maintain and optimise DLP solutions for the organisation to prevent unauthorised data exposure.
* Generate regular reports on security incidents, key metrics, and recommendations for security improvements.
* Proactively identify security risks and work with various teams to mitigate potential threats.

**Experience**

* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, Zscaler and O365 security tools and technologies.
* Strong familiarity with cloud native tools, cloud security posture management, and application security (Security Hub, Defender for Cloud).
* Experience with SIEM platforms (CrowdStrike NG-SIEM or similar) including alert tuning, query development, and integration with cloud environments.
* Proficient in data loss prevention (DLP) strategies and tools, with the ability to customise and maintain DLP policies.
* Strong understanding of incident response processes and best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct thorough investigations and report on complex security incidents.
* Familiarity with cloud security principles, tools, and techniques, including identity and access management (IAM) and network security.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

* Azure Certification

title: Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence
description:
**Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.

With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.

We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.

We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.

If you thrive in high-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.

As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.

* **The Mandate**

You will own quality across the entire studio network end to end — compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself — what gets checked, how often, through what method — and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on.

* **What you'll be doing**

Checking every studio against its own standard — how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run — through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported.

Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all — you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change.

Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it — real visits and unannounced ones — so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to.

Owning the physical readiness of every studio — hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on — and catching what's broken before a customer does.

Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted — and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it.

Building the entire audit system from nothing — the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask — designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day.

Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale — holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something.

* **What we're looking for**

You've done this before — run quality or audit work across multiple locations.

You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all.

Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past — the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later.

You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen.

You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone — a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior — you report what you found, not what's comfortable.

Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both — the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once.

Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline — what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before.

* **What success looks like**

every studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.

The audit system runs as a system — not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping.

* **Practical details**

Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline

Preferred Industry - Retail Only

A quality or process-audit certification — Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent - This is optional, However this is an added advantage

title: Senior Training Specialist, Leadership Programs
description:
**About Women’s World Banking**

For more than 40 years, Women’s World Banking has designed and delivered financial solutions, technical assistance, and leadership programs that dismantle systemic barriers for low-income women in emerging markets.

Our leadership training initiatives focus on building a sustainable pipeline of gender-diverse talent and equipping senior policymakers and financial institution executives with the tools to champion women’s financial inclusion. Through innovative, action-oriented programs often run in partnership with leading academic institutions, our leadership training programs empower leader pairs (senior executives and emerging women leaders) to drive organizational and policy-level change.

An overview of Women's World Banking's Leadership Programs can be found here: Leadership Development Program for Regulators and Tech Policy Learning Lab. These pages provide context on the participant experience and global scope of our leadership training programs.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented Senior Training Specialist to support the end-to-end curriculum design, delivery, and evaluation of Women’s World Banking’s global leadership programs.

In this high-impact, highly visible role, you will help shape and facilitate interactive, blended learning experiences for senior- and working-level leaders across central banks, financial regulatory authorities, and financial service providers worldwide. You will work closely with the Director, Leadership Training Programs and WWB Institute staff as well as external faculty, executive coaches, and global participants to ensure our programs translate directly into actionable workplace and policy outcomes.

The perfect candidate has a background in adult learning. They are dynamic and engaging without dominating the classroom. They have previously worked with very senior audiences, and they demonstrate cultural sensitivity in their communication style. They thrive in fast-paced environments, but they can also make time for big-picture thinking and strategic planning when needed. They are self-directed but highly communicative, and they can quickly build trust working remotely. They don’t mind doing light coordination work when needed, and feel confident using AI to support such work.

**Curriculum Support & Instructional Design**

* Adapt and curate interactive training modules, toolkits, and pre/post-session materials covering topics such as inclusive policy design, executive sponsorship, communication, negotiation, and strategic influence.
* Ensure learning assets reflect adult learning principles, action-learning methodologies, and global best practices in gender-diverse leadership.
* Collaborate with academic partners and internal subject matter experts to integrate regional case studies and emerging financial inclusion data into course materials.

**Program Facilitation & Delivery**

* Co-facilitate interactive live virtual sessions, peer-learning activities, and workshop discussions for cohorts of international leaders.
* Lead on the logistics and delivery of both online and in-person learning.
* Guide participants through the action-learning process, ensuring excellent learner experience from first engagement to course wrap up.

**Participant Engagement & Relationship Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for program cohorts, delivering clear pre-course orientations, communications, and ongoing learner support.
* Coordinate executive coaching sessions and advisory sessions.
* Foster an inclusive, psychologically safe online and in-person environment that encourages open peer exchange across diverse cultural contexts.
* Manage the online learning management platform.

**Monitoring, Evaluation, & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor participant progress, session attendance, and assignment completion across virtual learning platforms.
* Collect, analyze, and synthesize participant feedback and impact metrics to measure learning transfer and career progression.
* Recommend continuous improvements to course structure, platform usability, and facilitation approaches based on cohort feedback.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in training, instructional design, adult learning, or executive education, preferably within international development, financial inclusion, or corporate organizational culture and talent development.
* **Facilitation Skills:**
  Ability to co-deliver engaging, highly interactive virtual and in-person workshops for international, cross-cultural audiences.
* **Subject Matter Familiarity:**
  Understanding of core leadership topics and a strong commitment to women's financial inclusion and economic empowerment.
* **Tech Savvy:**
  Hands-on experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), virtual meeting platforms (Zoom, Teams), and collaborative tools (Survey Monkey). Highly fluent in the MS Office Suite is essential - in particular designing how to present new learning materials. Experience creating automation of workflows using AI tools would be beneficial.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional written and spoken English skills; ability to communicate clearly and empathetically with senior executive stakeholders.
* **Global Mindset:**
  Experience working with stakeholders in emerging markets (Sub-Saharan Africa, Southeast Asia, Latin America, Middle East).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Qualification in adult learning, such as a PGCE (PCET); learning and development, such as CIPD; or coaching.
* Ideally with prior experience working alongside central banks, ministries of finance, microfinance institutions, or commercial banks.

**Measure of Success**

**Within the first 75 days:**

* Build strong working relationships across the Institute, particularly with the Leadership Training Programs team, and with key internal subject matter experts and external delivery partners.
* Develop a strong understanding of Women’s World Banking’s leadership programs, participant audiences, curricula, delivery model, learning platforms, and current program commitments.
* Review existing learning materials and participant journeys and identify priority opportunities to strengthen instructional design, adult-learning practice, learner engagement, and consistency across programs.
* Demonstrate readiness to co-facilitate interactive virtual and in-person learning for senior, cross-cultural audiences, including effective preparation, participant engagement, and follow-up.
* Take ownership of core program-delivery processes, including participant communications and support, learning-platform management, coordination of coaching and advisory sessions, and tracking of attendance and assignments.
* Establish a practical approach to using participant feedback and program data to assess learning transfer and continuously improve curriculum, facilitation, and the learner experience.
* Fully integrate Women’s World Banking’s systems, policies, cultural values, and code of conduct into day-to-day work.

title: IT & Security Operations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

Today we run on Microsoft 365 and Slack with no central identity platform, no device management baseline, no formal service desk, and no security framework. There is no Active Directory. This is not a role that inherits a mature estate and governs it.

This is a build role first and a governance role second. In your first year you'll design and stand up the identity, endpoint, network and security foundations for the whole group, and then run them well. You'll have one engineer working to you from day one, real budget, and a direct line to the CTO. You'll also be hands-on: at our size, the person who designs conditional access is the same person who occasionally re-images a laptop.

**What You'll Own**

* Identity & access: Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory as the group's authoritative identity source. SSO, MFA, conditional access, RBAC, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver, and periodic access reviews.
* Microsoft 365: Tenant administration and governance, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing optimisation, multi-entity and multi-domain design, and security baselines.
* Slack: End-to-end administration (Teams chat is deliberately disabled). SSO and SCIM from Entra ID, retention and eDiscovery, DLP, app approval, and guest governance.
* Endpoint management: A mixed Windows and macOS fleet of roughly 100 devices. Intune, Apple Business Manager with zero-touch enrolment, FileVault escrow, and a macOS patching approach of your recommendation.
* Security operations: SPF, DKIM and DMARC across all domains, endpoint protection, vulnerability posture, phishing simulation and awareness training, shadow-IT discovery, secrets hygiene, and an incident response runbook you've actually rehearsed.
* Compliance & audit: IT controls evidence for SOC 2, IT's obligations under India's DPDP Act including breach notification readiness, the asset register, e-waste rules, and access control and CCTV administration.
* Infrastructure & network: Firewall, VPN, Wi-Fi and ISPs, the new Mumbai office comms room and cabling handover, and the physical environment for on-premises GPU infrastructure (power, cooling, access, encryption at rest).
* Backup, DR & continuity: Backup standards, defined recovery objectives, restores tested on a schedule, and documented continuity procedures.
* Service management: Select and run our first ticketing system, publish SLAs, direct the Network & Helpdesk Engineer's work, and own major incident escalation.
* Vendors & budget: Microsoft partners, ISPs, hardware and SaaS vendors. Contracts, renewals, endpoint procurement, vendor security reviews, and input into the annual IT budget.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

We'll judge this role on outcomes, not activity. By the end of your first twelve months we expect:

* Identity is authoritative: Entra ID and Active Directory deployed, everyone provisioned from a single source, and SSO live for our top applications including Slack
* MFA and conditional access at 100%: No exceptions without a documented, time-bound approval
* Every device managed: 100% of Windows and macOS endpoints enrolled, encrypted, patch-compliant and in a single inventory
* Joiner-mover-leaver is a process, not a favour: Documented, measured against an SLA, with offboarding that reliably revokes access on the day it should
* A service desk exists: Ticketing live, SLAs published, and a baseline satisfaction measure
* Recovery is proven, not assumed: At least one full documented restore test for each critical system
* Audit-ready: SOC 2 IT evidence produced on a defined schedule, and DPDP obligations mapped to owners
* The estate is documented: Asset register, network documentation, and runbooks your engineer can work from without you

**Scope Boundary**

* You own corporate IT: identity, endpoints, the corporate network, SaaS, and the physical technology environment, including power, cooling, access control and encryption for our on-premises GPU hardware.
* Engineering owns production cloud infrastructure, the build and deployment pipeline, and the product environment. You're consulted on those and own identity and access into them, but you're not the approver for production change.
* Where the boundary is genuinely unclear, raise it rather than either annexing or ignoring it.

**What You Bring**

* You've personally built a Microsoft identity platform from nothing, with Entra ID and Active Directory designed, deployed and cut over, not just administered one someone else built
* Deep, hands-on Microsoft 365 tenant administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing, security baselines and conditional access
* Real endpoint management across Windows and macOS, including Intune and Apple Business Manager, and opinions about managing Macs properly
* You've carried SOC 2, ISO 27001 or an equivalent framework as the person who produced the IT evidence, not a bystander to the audit
* Comfortable being hands-on and hands-off in the same day: architecture in the morning, a stuck user in the afternoon, without resenting either
* You can lead one engineer well: allocate work, review it honestly, and grow them
* Patience with non-technical users in a trading business and a biotech who don't think in tickets

**Bonus Points**

* Slack administration at organisation scale: SCIM, retention, DLP, eDiscovery, app governance
* Multi-entity or multi-company tenant design, including data segregation and per-entity licensing and cost allocation
* Familiarity with India's DPDP Act as it applies to IT operations
* Commissioning a new office: comms room, structured cabling, access control and CCTV integration
* Exposure to on-premises GPU or high-density compute environments
* Working fluency in Hindi or Marathi alongside English

**What You Get**

* A true build opportunity: design the group's identity, endpoint, network and security foundations from scratch
* One engineer working to you from day one, and real budget
* A direct line to the CTO
* Group-wide scope across trading, biotech and legal tech, including the infrastructure behind India's agentic legal AI

, we're transforming how companies around the world manage tax compliance---helping half of the Fortune 500 and thousands more stay ahead in a complex, ever-changing global regulatory landscape. As a
**Senior Network Operations Center Analyst**
, you'll serve as a critical link between customer support and engineering teams, driving technical problem resolution and ensuring the reliability and performance of our global network infrastructure.
  
  
This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You'll lead resolution on complex network issues, mentor junior analysts, and be a go-to resource during critical incidents---all while helping build the operational foundation that keeps Sovos running at scale.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Monitor network systems and services using NOC tools and dashboards
* Respond to alerts and troubleshoot network issues promptly
* Document incidents and resolutions in the ticketing system
* Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or supervisors as needed
* Perform routine checks and preventive maintenance tasks
* Mentor analysts and lead resolution for complex issues
* Assist in implementing network changes and upgrades
* Maintain accurate logs and reports for compliance and analysis
* Manage technical escalations by triaging issues, determining root causes, and coordinating resolution efforts
* Serve as technical point of contact during critical incidents, providing updates to stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and support teams to resolve complex issues
* Document technical issues, workarounds, and resolutions in knowledge management systems
* Identify patterns in escalated issues to recommend product improvements
* Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 coverage for critical issues

**What We Need From You**

* 3+ years of experience in network monitoring or support
* Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to navigate complex technical systems
* Experience with monitoring tools and ticketing systems
* Strong analytical and communication skills
* Experience with incident management processes and tools
* Strong time management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, 24/7 environment
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) for communication with customers and internal stakeholders

**What Does Sovos Offer You?**
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure
* Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a growing global team and shape its future

**Our Recruitment Process**

Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
  
  
Stage 2: Automated Video Interview
  
  
Stage 3: Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or key stakeholders
  
  
Stage 4: Final Interview
  
  
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
**Company Background**
Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter .

title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on application security, secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and vulnerability management, particularly within cloud-native or hybrid environments.
* Experience with cloud and software development.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field.
* Experience with AI-powered security tools for automated vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and code fix remediation.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, delivering product and solution briefings, partnering with security leaders and technical teams, and optimizing for production results.
* Understanding of the impact of AI on both offensive and defensive security strategies, including how AI can be leveraged to exploit binaries and firmware as source code.
* Familiarity with platforms for deploying and managing security agents or AI models for security applications, particularly in code analysis and remediation workflows.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cyber security business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
* Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
* Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
  
  
GIS Identity & Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
  
  
**Job Description**
In support of the Cloud Security program and the delivery of an operational framework, the role requires hands-on knowledge and experience with the policies, tools, configurations, and rules needed to deploy solutions that manage the security of cloud platforms and reduce risk to bank workloads in the cloud.
  
  
The role supports the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for IAM controls in cloud environments and help drive implementation of the designed control environment. This includes developing cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, driving related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines, and assessing operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement the required controls.
  
  
The successful analyst is result-oriented and business-focused, and succeeds at interfacing across multiple organizational units at various levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ensure IAM technology and controls for cloud are implemented, monitored, and adhered to established IAM standards.
* Achieve intended cloud IAM outcomes through the development and enhancement of applicable standards, processes, data elements, oversight, and governance for the bank’s cloud infrastructure, systems, and applications.
* Develop cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, and drive related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines.
* Assess operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement required controls; determine whether existing or proposed controls satisfy policy, regulatory, and control requirements.
* Appropriately assess risk when business and technology decisions are made, demonstrating a risk management mindset to safeguard the bank’s reputation, clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations and adhering to Policy and Standards.
* Apply industry IAM best practices, templates, and documentation, while proposing improvements based on practical knowledge.
* Influence technology and platform owners to build and implement necessary IAM controls into cloud environments to create a smooth and effective cloud IAM adoption experience.
* Engage with Product Managers and Senior Architects to understand the strategic technology roadmap and the resulting need for modernized security principles.
* Consult with the business to identify gaps and governance issues, leveraging domain expertise to find effective solutions.
* Provide IAM subject matter expertise within the business and technical domain to support scope and requirement decisions.
* Perform impact analysis of modifications or enhancements, working closely with development teams to refine requirements into implementable specifications.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations through comprehensive UAT/QA testing of functionality and quality, and confirm the delivery timeline and adoption plan are fit for purpose.
* Create required documentation, playbooks, job aides, workflows, and training material as part of deployment and adoption activities.
* Support the design and update of new and existing controls, including the streamlining and automation of reporting.
* Develop and maintain documentation that accurately describes the current cloud IAM control environment for review by oversight organizations (Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators).

**Requirements**

* Education

BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)
  
  

* Certifications If Any

NA
  
  

* Experience Range

8+ years of technology/information security experience
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in cyber security or a technology-related field.
* Deep, applied knowledge of the IAM domain (business and technical) and of cloud IAM threat models and related security controls.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud IAM technology and related business processes.
* Experience evaluating threats and risks posed by new cloud technologies and deployment models, and determining best-fit mitigations for advanced cyber threats (attack tactics, techniques, and procedures).
* Ability to understand the intent of policy, regulations, and control requirements and determine whether existing or proposed operational controls satisfy them.
* Familiarity with common information security and data protection frameworks and standards (e.g., CIS, NIST, MITRE, ITIL, COBIT, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail; able to communicate with business leaders, users, and tech-savvy stakeholders, and to tailor messages across audiences with varying technical understanding.
* Strong ability to interact, communicate, and influence vertically and laterally, and to collaborate and influence across peer groups and various levels of management.
* Excellent organizational skills; able to effectively prioritize multiple competing tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Experience participating in large or complex projects; strong project management skills.
* Proactive self-starter able to drive direction and work independently on initiatives with minimal oversight.
* Ability to coordinate and facilitate delivery routines (kick-offs, status reviews, stakeholder meetings, change controls, tollgates).
* Ability to create management-level reporting using aggregated data.
* Experience working in Agile methodology with a deep understanding of all phases of the SDLC.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual-thinking skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint), with the ability to analyze data, distill key data points, and present information effectively.
* A broad knowledge of information security principles and security capabilities

**Desired Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Azure Security Center, AWS Security Hub, or Google Cloud Security.
* Detailed, bank-specific knowledge across Identity & Access Management, application security, risk assessments, cloud technologies, and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) with emphasis on security processes and controls.
* Familiarity with financial industry laws, rules, regulations, and guidance documents.
* Experience within, or interacting with examiners and partners across, control oversight organizations such as Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators, and independent assessment organizations.
* Experience implementing information security strategy, including compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical business owners.
* Highly organized, motivated self-starter who excels at adapting to changing business needs, anticipating problems, and executing solutions while balancing multiple competing priorities.

**Work Timings:**
12:30 to 21:30 (IST) or 14:30 to 23:30 (IST)
  
  
**Job Location:**
Mumbai

title: Associate, Content Strategy & Monetization (Paid Media)
description:
Paradox Media Systems is a US-based performance marketing firm enabling digital monetization at scale across arbitrage models, affiliate marketing, B2B software, and telehealth platforms. Our parent company holds interest in venture capital, commercial real estate, and health tech.

**THE ROLE**

As Content Strategy & Monetization Associate, you will own the full content monetization journey, from researching content ideas and preparing them with AI tools to planning ad placements and running profitable paid traffic to those content pieces.

The content monetization process:

1. **Find a topic:**
   Evaluate audience engagement signals to identify content opportunities with
   strong traffic and revenue potential
   .
2. **Write the article:**
   Utilize AI to draft the content, then refine it for accuracy and relevance.
3. **Set up the ad units:**
   Strategically place display ad units on the content page through Google Ad Manager, balancing revenue potential with the user experience.
4. **Buy traffic:**
   Run paid media (Google, Meta Ads) that bring readers to the content, aiming to keep the cost-per-visitor below the ad-revenue-per visitor.
5. **Measure and scale:**
   Analyze ad revenue against its traffic costs daily. Scale profitable campaigns, pause underperformers, and use what you learn to improve future topic selection, content, and ad placement.

Every piece of content is a micro P&L. Your job is to run that loop faster and more profitably than the competition.

**THE RESPONSIBILITIES**

This is a hands-on, entry-level role for someone who enjoys combining creativity with analytical thinking. You'll research trends, experiment with content formats, work with Google Ad Manager (GAM) ad placements, and run performance marketing campaigns across platforms such as Google and Meta.

* Content Research & Ideation: Research trending topics, audience interests, and emerging opportunities to identify content ideas with strong traffic and revenue potential.
* Content Strategy: Develop article concepts, formats, and structures designed to engage audiences and maximize profitability.
* Ad Monetization Strategy: Plan and optimize Google Ad Manager (GAM) ad unit placements and formats, including in-content ads, interstitials, anchor ads, and other suitable placements.
* Performance Marketing: Build, launch, and optimize paid acquisition campaigns across Google, Meta, and other relevant advertising platforms to drive traffic to content.
* Performance Analysis: Monitor campaign spend, traffic quality, engagement, ad revenue, and profitability to understand what's working and identify optimization opportunities.
* Testing & Optimization: Experiment with content topics, article formats, headlines, ad placements, and campaign strategies to improve overall performance.
* End-to-End Ownership: Manage the workflow from initial content idea to performance optimization, with the singular goal of scaling profitable campaign flows.

You will develop a strong understanding of how content strategy, paid advertising, and ad monetization combine to create profitable digital businesses. This role offers the opportunity to take increasing ownership of individual initiatives and financial performance.

**YOUR EXPERIENCE**

**Must Have:**

* 0–1 year of experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management or a related field. Internships, freelance work, and personal projects will be considered.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with large data sets and performance metrics.
* Excellent research skills and an ability to identify interesting topics, trends, and audience opportunities.
* Strong written communication skills and an eye for compelling content, headlines, and formats.
* A curious, experiment-driven mindset with a willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and workflows.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with Google Ads, Meta Ads, or other paid advertising platforms.
* Experience with content creation, digital publishing, blogs, or online media.
* Exposure to Google Ad Manager (GAM) or related digital monetization platforms.
* Experience using AI tools for research, content ideation, writing, or workflow automation.

**WHY JOIN US?**

* Modern Workspace: Work in a relaxed, well-equipped office with access to an on-site cafeteria, games room, gym, and swimming pool.
* Performance Bonus: Eligible employees participate in performance bonus programs after 3 months with the company. Top performers can earn ₹1L+ in additional bonuses per month.
* End-to-End Exposure: Gain hands-on experience across content strategy, paid acquisition, and ad monetization rather than being limited to a single marketing function.
* Learn by Doing: Work on live campaigns with the opportunity to test ideas and see the direct financial impact of your decisions.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**We’re Hiring | Senior Performance Marketer | TSH Media**

📍 Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra | 💼 3–4+ Years of Experience

**We’re looking for someone who knows that performance marketing is about more than just running ads.**

Good campaigns start with the right questions, strong creative ideas, a clear understanding of the audience, and the ability to make sense of what the numbers are telling us.

At
**TSH Media**

, we’re looking for an experienced Performance Marketer who enjoys figuring out what works, testing new approaches, solving problems, and helping brands achieve measurable business results.

If you enjoy working with data, understand the thinking behind a successful campaign, and like taking ownership of your work, we’d love to connect with you.

**What will you be working on?**

**1. Planning and executing campaigns**

Plan, set up, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads and Google Ads. You’ll work on everything from understanding campaign briefs and defining objectives to audience selection, budget allocation, and campaign structure.

**2. Improving campaign performance**

Go beyond clicks and impressions to focus on meaningful business outcomes such as lead generation, customer acquisition, conversions, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend.

You’ll regularly analyse performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions to improve campaign efficiency.

**3. Analysing data and finding insights**

Monitor important metrics such as CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rates, and ROAS. Understand why performance changes, identify what needs attention, and turn data into practical recommendations.

**4. Testing creatives, audiences, and strategies**

Experiment with different creatives, messaging, audience segments, campaign structures, and bidding strategies. Work closely with the creative team to share performance insights and help develop better-performing advertisements.

**5. Reporting and tracking**

Prepare performance reports, communicate results clearly, and ensure campaigns are tracked properly. Familiarity with conversion tracking, pixels, Google Tag Manager, analytics tools, and landing-page performance will be an advantage.

**Who would be a good fit?**

We’re looking for someone who:

* Has
  **3–4+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing**

  .
* Has strong practical knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Has managed campaigns with real budgets and defined performance goals.
* Understands campaign optimisation, audience targeting, creative testing, and conversion tracking.
* Is analytical, curious, and comfortable making data-backed decisions.
* Can manage multiple campaigns while paying attention to the details.
* Takes ownership of results, communicates clearly, and is always looking for ways to improve.

You don’t need to know everything. But you should be willing to learn, question assumptions, share ideas, and take responsibility for your work.

**What can you expect at TSH Media?**

You’ll get the opportunity to work across different brands, audiences, campaign objectives, and business challenges. We value people who think independently, bring ideas to the table, and understand the business impact behind the campaigns they manage.

For us, performance marketing is not just about managing dashboards. It’s about connecting creative, data, and strategy to get better results.

**Role details**

**Position:**

Performance Marketer

**Company:**

TSH Media

**Location:**

Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Experience:**

3–4+ years

**Work arrangement:**

Office Based

**How to apply**

We’d like to know a little about you and the work you’ve done.

**Step 1:**

Send your updated resume to hr@tsh.media or apply through LinkedIn.

**Step 2:**

Include the following details in your application:

* Your current location in Mumbai.
* Your total experience in performance marketing.
* Your notice period and earliest joining date.
* Your current and expected CTC.

**Step 3:**

Share a brief overview of
**2–3 campaigns you’ve managed**

. Mention the campaign objective, platforms used, budget range, key results, and the role you personally played. You can share a portfolio, case study, or a short summary. Please exclude confidential client information.

**Email subject:**

Application – Performance Marketer – [Your Name]

* **Write long form: blogs, articles, whitepapers, e-books, reports and thought-leadership pieces.**
* **Keep everything in a campaign sounding like one idea, across formats, markets and months.**
* **Work with art directors, designers and animators from the first sketch, so ideas are built visually from the start.**
* **Dig through research, reports and expert interviews to find the insight a campaign can stand on. The technical detail is there to support the story.**
* **Use modern creative and productivity tools to explore more routes and move quickly. The ideas and the final words are yours.**

**Who you are**

* You're an ideas person first. Your portfolio has campaigns you helped come up with, as well as copy you wrote.
* **You get social. You've made social campaigns that people actually engaged with, and you can tell which trends are worth joining.**
* **You have your own voice and a good ear, and you can adapt to any brand, from playful to boardroom.**
* **You're as comfortable with a six-word headline as with a 3,000-word whitepaper.**
* **You'll pitch the idea that makes the room a little nervous, and you can tell a good idea from a loud one.**

**The suit**

* You communicate clearly with senior marketing teams and can present and defend your work.
* **You meet deadlines. Enterprise clients rely on it, and so do we.**
* **You have [3–6] years in an agency or brand team, including some B2B work. You don't need to be a tech expert, but you pick up a new industry or product quickly.**
* **You follow brand guidelines, check your facts and only ship work you can stand behind.**
* **You use modern creative tools to work faster, and you know when to put them down and think for yourself.**
* **You like working with designers, take feedback well and give it honestly.**
* **Your written and spoken English is excellent.**

**Nice to have**

* Campaign work that won awards, made a shortlist or got results you can point to.
* **Concepting and scripting for brand films, animated explainers or events.**
* **Experience with IT services, consulting, SaaS, sustainability or financial services clients.**
* **Some understanding of how B2B buyers make decisions.**
* **Something you make outside work: a newsletter, a podcast, short films, poetry, a meme page.**

**How to apply**

Send us your CV and 5–8 pieces of work. We mostly want to see campaign ideas and social campaigns, B2B or not, and one or two B2B pieces help. Add a line for each piece on the brief and what you did. Unproduced ideas and spec work count.
 

**If you're shortlisted, we'll send a short, paid writing exercise based on a typical B2B brief.**

 

**[Apply via email / link] · [Closing date]**

 

**Avoid going so vague ("tech-savvy", "digitally literate") that it reads like knowing how to use Google Docs.**

 

**Things to decide before posting:**

 

* ☐ Location and work model (office, hybrid, remote) and time zones the team works across
* **☐ Seniority and salary band; adding a range noticeably improves applications**
* **☐ Who they report to and team size**
* **☐ Whether you also want concept/ideation ownership (Senior/Lead level) or mainly execution**
* **☐ Confidentiality: enterprise clients often mean NDAs, and portfolio pieces may be under NDA, so allow redacted samples**
* **☐ Partner sign-off: the site's FAQ mentions AI-driven workflows, so confirm the restriction is only for this JD**

**Screening exercise (the most important part).**
Give a 60–90 minute task:
 

1. Hand over a short B2B brief with a dull-sounding topic (e.g. a client launching a supply chain resilience report).
2. **Ask for 2–3 campaign ideas, each in one line, plus a social-first rollout for the strongest one: what runs, where, and why people would share it.**
3. **Ask for one hero piece written out: a LinkedIn post, a carousel or a 30-second video script.**
4. **Ask them to explain how they worked, including which tools they used and where.**

What good looks like: at least one idea you didn't see coming, a social plan built around the idea rather than a list of posts, a human insight, and a candid answer on process. Polished but predictable copy is your red flag.
 

**Interview questions:**

 

* Walk us through the campaign idea you're proudest of. Where did it come from?
* **Which social campaign (anyone's, any category) do you wish you'd made, and why?**
* **Tell us about an idea that got killed. What did you learn?**
* **Tell us about a time a tool gave you a first draft. What did you change, and why?**
* **How would you make a cloud services company funny, or moving?**

How we operate

**Job Description**

NIQ GFK is a global measurement and data analytics company that provides the most complete and trusted view available of consumers and markets worldwide. We provide consumer packaged goods manufacturers/fast-moving consumer goods, Tech & Durables manufacturers and retailers with accurate, actionable information and insights and a complete picture of the complex and changing marketplace that companies need to innovate and grow. Our approach marries proprietary  data with other data sources to help clients around the world understand what’s happening now, what’s happening next, and how to best act on this knowledge.  We like to be in the middle of the action. That’s why you can find us at work in over 90 countries, covering more than 90% of the world’s population. For more information, visit www.niq.com.

NIQ GFK is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action-Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, protected veteran status or any other protected class.

Customer Success TEAMS

NIQ GFK CMI’s Customer Success Team is focused on delivering world-class insights and reports to the clients and striving for very high level of Customer Satisfaction and advocacy.

Customer Success is NIQ GFK’s key department which is instrumental for the company’s success.

Role purpose:

So where do you fit here?

A successful candidate for this role will be someone who can establish strong relationships with both our clients and our colleagues. You will quickly become a trusted partner, working with many of our clients’ teams, including marketing, sales, category, and many more.

You will be expected to understand our clients’ needs and then create and present solutions that help achieve their strategic and tactical goals.

If telling stories through data excites you but you’re uncertain whether you have the data knowledge: get in touch. We have an excellent training program, ensuring you understand all our products and how we create analyses.

In your role, you would:

* Be responsible for delivering analytics & insights services and executing NIQ GFK CMI products and solutions such as Brand Health, Usage & Attitudes and other ad hoc studies.

* Entrusted to deliver flawless research and analytics to our clients.

* Have a strong working knowledge of the client business priorities and the role we can play in supporting these goals

* Be a confident and capable crafter of compelling insights, deliver clear and actionable recommendations to our clients helping them grow their business.

Throughout your tenure, you will develop the following competencies:

* Relationship Building: Develop effective long-term professional interactions with customers based on trust working toward the best interest of those involved providing positive results.

* Active listening: Enhance mutual understanding in communicating with customers by expressing genuine interest in, and providing full attention to, the content and meaning of customers’ messages

* Information seeking: Curiosity and desire to know more about things, people, or issues. This involves going beyond routine questions and includes digging or pressing for exact information; resolving discrepancies by asking in-depth questions.

* Influence and persuasion: Persuading, convincing, influencing, or impressing others in order to get them to support a specific agenda, make a specific type of impression, or take a specific course of action.

* Composure and resilience: Effectively deal with pressure, maintain focus and intensity, and remain optimistic and persistent, even under adversity. Have the ability and propensity to recover quickly from setbacks, rejections, and conflicts and to maintain self-control in the face of hostility or provocation.

* Organizational Savvy: Gather and accurately assess information related to the organization’s formal and informal communication channels and power relationships

* Business Acumen: Makes sound business decisions based on a strong understanding of the company’s business model, strategic goals, and relevant policies, as well as best practices and current technologies in their own discipline or functional area.

About you

You are a high-performing individual thriving in ensuring high client centricity & customer satisfaction. You know how to take care of client requirements & develop long-lasting client relationships.  Awareness of the market landscape, our CMI products, and our processes is at the forefront of your mind. You know that collaboration amongst teams and active listening of clients is critical to meet goals and grow.

We are looking for people with:

* Graduate or Post Graduate with atleast 1- 2 years of experience in data analysis and delivery

* Ideally a first experience in a related industry but not essential

* Customer Centric mindset

* Awareness of data analytics industry, business model, products, services and solutions like Brand Health, Segmentation, Usage & Attitude, Customer Experience & Shopper solutions etc.

* Awareness of market trends and its interdependencies impacting customers

* Excellent time management and prioritization skills with a proven track record of delivering projects on time

* Confident numerically & ability to analyse data confidently

* Problem solving and solutions orientated

* Performs work accurately and effectively with attention to detail

* Engaging presenter

* Good at building relationships, internally and with clients

* Strong verbal and written communication skills

* Experience of working in an analytical environment

* Capable of leveraging tools such as Microsoft excel and PowerPoint

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs-ai-safety-policies/

  

**About NIQ**

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Want to keep up with our latest updates?

Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook

  

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/diversity-inclusion

title: CPW Analyst II, Consumer Insights
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The future of food will be created by those who best anticipate evolving consumer behavior. Consumer & Market Insights (CMI) collects, curates, and combines data, human behavior understanding, and empathy to achieve competitive advantage for General Mills.
  
  
Our mission in
**CMI ‘globally’**
is to be the spark that ignites growth acceleration, connecting insights and analytics to drive action.
  
  
We drive business growth through a deep understanding of our consumers and our markets. Our goal is to illuminate growth opportunities and guide teams to activate behind them through consumer-led strategies and ideas.
  
  
**CMI in General Mills India Center**
is a part of
**General Mills Strategy and Growth Organization**
, working as extensions of
**Consumer Insights and Commercial Measurement and Revenue Analytics**
central organizations, to deliver insights and analytics across all our GMI business segments i.e. North America Retail, Pet, International and North America Food Service, along with the CPW business (GMI’s JV with Nestle).
  
  
We are a young and dynamic team of ~100 and growing, with research, data, and analytical skills, with the unique opportunity to shape and scale capabilities across our global organization.
  
  
We are seeking a curious, analytical, and motivated
**Analyst II – Primary Research**
to join our CI team within the Consumer Insights function at General Mills India Center. The Consumer Insights team leads in-house consumer research is largely primary (
**quantitative)**
to understand and interpret consumer behavior. We are looking for an individual to work closely on the in-house quantitative function. Someone who loves using data to tell stories and deeply understand stakeholder’ needs and the business requirements to provide strategic insights. The role holder should be able to apply research methodologies effectively, manage global projects end to end, able to multi-task, demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and establish oneself as a trusted advisor to stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Project management and execution**
The candidate will be accountable for end-to-end project management which includes –
  
  

* Gaining expertise in using the tools developed in-house and by external vendors
* Multitasking and managing multiple research projects end to end i.e. from designing a questionnaire, programming survey, discussion guides to analysis the data and reporting
* Developing knowledge and skills required to apply advanced statistical techniques in order to identify patterns and trends from the data.

Should be able to create a story out of the insights using compelling narratives, visuals, and data-driven evidence
  
  
Should be able to proactively learn and apply new tools to find unique solutions to the business questions.
  
  
**Vendor management**
The candidate must partner with external research agencies and ensure projects are completed within agreed timelines and as per agreed quality standards.
  
  
**Stakeholder management**

* Should proactively connect with internal stakeholders to understand their requirements, and suggest appropriate research methods to fulfill those requirements with minimum manager supervision
* Become a trusted advisor and the go-to person for the internal stakeholders, when they need guidance on answering research questions
* Is able to effectively communicate key findings to the stakeholders and the leadership team in meetings

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 - 6 years of relevant market research experience including experience in client management, questionnaire design, discussion guides, data analysis and reporting
* Master’s degree or MBA with specialization in Marketing or Market research
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and team members
* Should have experience in different research methodologies like
* Must be able to multitask and effectively manage multiple stakeholders, vendors and projects together
* Should possess strong time management, teamwork, critical thinking, analytical, and influencing skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Led/ Worked on multi country primary research (Quantitative) studies.
* Worked at leading market research agency like Kantar or Ipsos
* Has experience working with cross-functional teams
* Experience on working with CPG industry and global markets will be an added advantage

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.
