title: BC Sector - Lifescience - Primary Market Research - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: BC Sector Life sciences – Primary market research**
**Experience Required: 4+ years**
**Client Focus:**
US-based pharmaceutical and biotech clients
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic commercial analytics professional to join our life sciences team, supporting
**US-based pharmaceutical and biotech clients**
. The ideal candidate will bring over 4 years of experience in life sciences consulting, with a strong foundation in commercial strategy, market research, and data analytics. A key requirement for this role is
**extensive experience in leading both quantitative primary market research (PMR) projects (ATUs, Conjoint analysis)**
, including stakeholder engagement with HCPs, KOLs, and payers. The candidate should be adept at translating research findings into actionable commercial insights and strategic recommendations. Proficiency in Python and SQL is a strong advantage, enabling advanced analytics and automation.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage multiple commercial analytics projects across diverse therapy areas (oncology, immunology, rare diseases, cardiovascular, etc.).
* Drive secondary research to build foundational knowledge for primary market research and strategic analysis.
* Review and refine materials for primary market research including screeners, discussion guides, quantitative surveys, and stimuli.
* Supervise qualitative and quantitative interviews with HCPs, KOLs, and payers to extract actionable insights.
* Prepare and lead client calls, workshops, and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations.
* Develop and present high-impact client deliverables including strategic decks, dashboards, and executive summaries.
* Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights using tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, and optionally Python/SQL (preferable)
* Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering skill development and quality delivery.
* Promote a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.

**Key Competencies:**

* Proven leadership and project management experience in life sciences consulting, with a strong track record of delivering strategic insights.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI); working knowledge of Python and SQL is a plus.
* Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to present complex data and insights to senior stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Strategic and client-centric mindset with therapeutic area-specific expertise.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences (e.g., pharmacology, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences); MBA preferred.
* 4+ years of experience in life sciences commercial strategy consulting, with exposure to US clients and regulatory environments.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and executing primary market research (quantitative and qualitative) and engaging with stakeholders such as HCPs, KOLs, and payers.
* Technical proficiency in Python, SQL, or other analytics platforms to support data-driven decision-making.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to lead projects and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
* Personal drive, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

* Extensive experience in commercial strategy projects including market uptake studies, opportunity assessments, market entry strategies, ATU studies, product messaging strategies, TPP research and conjoint analysis
* Ability to proactively manage tasks and contribute to strategic problem-solving.
* Experience working across diverse therapy areas such as oncology, immunology, rare diseases, and cardiovascular.
* Collaborative mindset with a strong work ethic and ability to thrive in demanding situations.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal BIM Technician - Bridges
description:
**Job Description**
WSP India is currently seeking a Principal BIM Technician to join our Bridges Department, located at our Mumbai/Noida office. This position will be responsible for the delivery of producing detailed bridge and structural drawings for various Canadian projects, including bridges, LRT components, retaining walls, and other related structures. The successful candidate will be expected to handle complex projects, and prioritize effectively and Passionate about bridges and eager to put CAD/BIM skills to good use
  
  
As Principal BIM Technician - Bridges at GCC, you will play a crucial role in our design and development process. Will work closely with our team of engineers and also work along with BIM team to create detailed technical drawings and plans for a variety of bridge projects. Ability to use CAD/BIM software and understanding of bridge design principles will be essential to success in this role.
  
  
In addition to creating and revising detailed drawings, you will also be responsible for collaborating with the engineering team to ensure that designs are accurate and comply with industry standards. Opportunities shall be provided to work on a wide range of projects, from small-scale bridge repairs to large-scale bridge constructions, allowing for to expand and refine the skills in the bridge discipline.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead project set up by agreeing drawing strategy, type and size of drawings and drawing numbering with project engineer, and suggesting methods of drawing production to ensure efficient methods of working.
* Manage production of work, review and ensure it is carried out to specified WSP I CAD standards, suggest revisions to standards as appropriate.
* Use templates for CAD/BIM work and use CAD/BIM library items to assist design work lead the production of Templates and Library Items.
* Agree priorities and deadlines for drawing production through liaison with the Project Engineer and Canada Client team
* Co-ordination of engineering services on projects to sure that the correct inputs are received timely and the outputs are issued after full review.
* Ensure that work produced by the team is to specified WSP CAD/BIM standards, suggest revisions to standards as appropriate
* Use templates for CAD/BIM work and use CAD/BIM library items to assist design work
* Ensure that all work produced by the team follows QA, document control, archiving & CDM guidelines
* Co-ordination of engineering services on projects to sure that the correct inputs are received timely and the outputs are issued after full review.
* Review engineer’s sketches and other design team member drawings and details with a view to querying any unbuildable / conflicting details or missing information.
* Raise and follow up requests for information; maintain a log of open queries
* Maintain regular dialogue with Project Engineer and Canada client Team
* Ensure that the development of skills in REVIT, Micro station, Civil 3D and ASD is documented
* Be responsible for the sharing of knowledge with immediate colleagues and the rest of the GCC
* Ensure that all new skills learnt are documented and available for new starters to the team.
* Proactively support the WSP India CAD / BIM forums.
* Plan and prepare standard details for repetitive or small / routine work.
* Plan and produce templates and CAD library items to assist design work.
* Exchange information and share libraries and details with Canada and other GCC teams inclusive.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma Cad with at least 14 years of relevant experience
* Experience of having worked in a similar role.
* Competence in AutoCAD/Revit/SofiSTIK BIM/Micro station/RCD/CIVIL 3D.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: SAP CCM (Condition Contract Management)
description:
**Job Title:**
SAP CCM (Condition Contract Management)
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology / Enterprise Applications
  
  
**Experience Level:**
8–10 Years
  
  
**Role Type:**
Full-time
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced
**Senior SAP Functional Consultant**
with 8–10 years of expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD) / enhancements.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise in
**SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebates, settlements, and accruals—complemented by strong domain knowledge in
**Sales & Distribution (SD)**
and
**Pricing**
. In this role, you will lead enhancement deliveries, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support to ensure seamless business operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enhancements, Projects & Business Analysis
* Enhancement Delivery: Lead and deliver enhancements in CCM processes, including designing new contract types, complex settlement logic, and business-specific rebate models.
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement settings, and seamless integration points with financial modules.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with ABAP/technical teams during custom development, code walk-throughs, unit testing, and deployment.
* Testing & Deployment: Drive System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring defect-free releases into production environments.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.
* Application Support & Maintenance (L2/L3)
* Production Support: Provide high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM processes, ensuring strict SLA adherence and minimal operational disruption.
* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.
* Cross-Module Integration & Governance
* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.
* Change Governance: Strictly adhere to transport management, release governance, and change management procedures (CAB approvals) for all system changes.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate functional design documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for peer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).
* SAP SD & Pricing: Strong expertise in SD core processes (O2C), pricing procedures, condition technique, access sequences, and condition types.
* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

Experience & Education
  
  

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* S/4HANA Exposure: Hands-on experience operating in S/4HANA environments is mandatory.
* Certifications (Preferred): SAP Certified Application Associate – S/4HANA Sales or SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management.

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting abilities.
* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both business key users and technical developers.
* Leadership: Ability to independently manage tasks, mentor junior support team members, and drive delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder Management: Experienced in facilitating workshops, prioritizing backlog items, and managing business user expectations during critical issue resolution.

Skills: contract management,ccm,integration,sap,testing

title: Principal Consultant-Sustainable Resources & Circular Economy
description:
**Job Description**
A typical working week for this role will consist of delivering solutions for our clients, whilst furthering your knowledge and professional development, in the field of responsible consumption covering sustainable value chains, circular economy and sustainable resources and waste management. You will be involved in leading and providing support to clients across a wide range of resource and waste management themes, and clients, with a range of projects that could include: This role will deliver commercially informed advisory services across sustainable value chains, circular economy, sustainable resources and waste management. You will combine sector understanding with strong commercial and financial analysis to support investors, lenders, operators and public-sector clients in evaluating assets, businesses and strategic opportunities. Assignments will include technical and commercial due diligence, business-plan and financial-model review, options appraisal and the preparation of clear, evidence-based reports and recommendations. Projects could include:
  
  

* Technical and commercial due diligence for assets, businesses and investment opportunities in circular economy, resources and waste management
* Review of business plans, investment cases and management forecasts, including challenge of underlying assumptions
* Development, review and validation of financial and cost models, including revenue, demand, CAPEX, OPEX and lifecycle-cost assumptions
* Scenario, sensitivity, benchmarking and cost-benefit analysis to test downside resilience and value drivers
* Market, competitor and value-chain analysis, including demand, pricing, regulation and commercial positioning
* Preparation of concise, client-ready due diligence reports, business-case reviews, presentations and recommendations that clearly articulate risks, opportunities and key sensitivities

**Responsibilities**
We’d love to hear from you if you have
  
  

* Experience in commercial, transaction, infrastructure or investment advisory, ideally within sustainable resources, waste management, circular economy, environmental services or related infrastructure sectors
* Demonstrable experience supporting technical and commercial due diligence and reviewing business plans, financial projections and management assumptions
* Strong financial and cost-modelling capability, including revenue, demand, CAPEX, OPEX, cash-flow, scenario and sensitivity analysis
* Ability to review and challenge management forecasts, identify gaps and inconsistencies, and form an independent evidence-based view
* Excellent analytical, research, report-writing and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and financial information into clear commercial insights
* Exceptional time management skills, including the ability to manage and deliver several projects at once
* A methodical approach to problem solving and a high level of attention to detail
* Commercial awareness and confidence working with multidisciplinary technical, sustainability and financial teams
* An undergraduate and/or postgraduate degree in finance, economics, accounting, business, engineering, environmental science, sustainability or another relevant quantitative discipline
* Relevant professional qualification or progress towards one, such as IEMA or CIWM, would be advantageous

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Experience in technical and commercial due diligence, business-plan review or transaction/investment advisory
* Strong financial and cost-modelling skills, including model review and validation
* Ability to assess revenue, demand, CAPEX, OPEX and lifecycle-cost assumptions and forecasts
* Advanced spreadsheet and quantitative-analysis capability, with strong attention to transparency and auditability
* Strong client-ready report writing, communication and presentation skills

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in circular economy, waste management, recycling, resource recovery, environmental services or sustainable infrastructure; familiarity with UK and international environmental regulation; and a relevant professional qualification or membership

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, environmental science, sustainability or another relevant quantitative discipline.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

* Maximize collaboration.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery—from concept through detailed and construction design.
  
  
Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems.
* Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables

+ Equipment sizing & selection
+ Mechanical design calculations
+ Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
+ P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
+ Mechanical data sheets and specifications

* Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design.
* Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements.
* Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews.
* Manage and own key design management documents

+ Project Responsibility Matrix
+ Basis of Design
+ Overall Design Programme
+ Schedule of Deliverables
+ Design Risk Register
+ Design Change Register

* Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery.
* Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling.
* Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability.
* Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.

* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for

+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.
* Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.
* Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans.
* Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset.
* Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field is advantageous

* Experience leading process or audit reviews, control assessments, RCA, corrective-action tracking, reporting, and senior stakeholder management preferred.
* CA, CPA, CIA, CISA, FRM, Lean Six Sigma, or relevant domain certification preferred.
* Strong knowledge of TQM, process standardization, defect prevention, quality measurement, and continuous improvement.

Core Skills and Knowledge

**Audit and risk:**
Risk-based auditing, control design/operating-effectiveness testing, sampling, evidence assessment, finding writing, rating calibration, RCA/CAPA, and closure validation.

**Leadership and communication:**
Analytical judgment, attention to detail, professional skepticism, ethical conduct, concise writing, confident readouts, stakeholder management, coaching, and execution under tight deadlines.

**Tools and improvement:**
Advanced Excel; exposure to Power BI/Tableau, SQL/Alteryx, GRC tools, VBA/RPA, continuous monitoring, and governed AI use is advantageous.

description:
**Assistant Manager – Customer Growth& CRM Lifecycle**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a data-driven and customer-centric
**Assistant Manager – Customer Growth & CRM Lifecycle**
with

, to drive repeat customer growth, retention, and CRM-led revenue across Tata CLiQ Fashion and Luxury.

The role will work closely with Business, Category, Product, Technology, Analytics, and Loyalty teams to improve repeat purchases, customer lifetime value, and channel effectiveness.

**What You’ll Do**

**Customer Growth & Retention:**

* Drive repeat customer growth, retention, purchase frequency and CRM-led revenue.
* Develop cohort-based strategies across new, active, repeat, dormant and high-value customers.
* Build lifecycle journeys covering onboarding, second purchase, repeat purchase, cross-sell, loyalty and win-back.
* Translate business revenue targets into customer, cohort and CRM plans.

**CRM Lifecycle & Campaign Management:**

* Plan and execute personalized campaigns across Push Notifications, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Email, In-App Messages, App Inbox and Native Displays.
* Own the CRM campaign calendar aligned to business priorities and customer lifecycle stages.
* Ensure campaigns are targeted, personalized, tested and delivered with high quality and accuracy.
* Continuously optimize communication frequency, channel mix and customer experience.

**CRM Channel Health & Platform Ownership:**

* Own channel health metrics including reachability, deliverability, CTR, conversion, engagement, unsubscribe rates and customer fatigue.
* Monitor channel-wise revenue contribution, ROI and ROAS and identify optimization opportunities.
* Manage CRM platform capabilities, data quality, campaign automation and journey orchestration.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to implement new triggers, personalization capabilities and platform enhancements.

**Analytics & Experimentation:**

* Analyze customer behaviour, campaign performance and lifecycle movement to identify growth opportunities.
* Measure key KPIs including repeat customers, retention rate, reactivation, purchase frequency, orders per customer, CRM GMV, CTR, conversion and ROAS.
* Conduct A/B tests and experiments to continuously improve customer engagement and business performance.
* Develop and leverage machine learning models and predictive analytics for churn prediction, customer reactivation, purchase propensity, customer lifetime value (CLV) and next-best-action recommendations.
* Build dashboards and present actionable insights to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with Business, Category, Product, Technology, Customer Service, Analytics and Creative teams to deliver customer growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop relevant customer offers, improve customer experience and resolve campaign or platform issues.
* Benchmark industry best practices and recommend new CRM capabilities, automation and customer engagement initiatives.

**Skills We Are Looking For**

**Technical Skills:**

1. **SQL & Data Analysis:**
   Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, and customer-level data analysis.
2. **Python:**
   Working knowledge of Python, particularly Pandas and NumPy, for data manipulation, analysis, and workflow automation.
3. **Statistical Analysis & Experimentation:**
   Understanding of descriptive statistics, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and campaign uplift and incrementality analysis.
4. **Data Visualization & Reporting:**
   Proficiency in Excel, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau for dashboard development and performance reporting.
5. **Automation & Analytics:**
   Ability to automate recurring reports, data extracts, campaign performance tracking, and analytical workflows using SQL and Python.
6. **Data Science & Machine Learning:**
   Understanding of predictive modelling techniques for customer segmentation, churn prediction, customer lifetime value (CLV), purchase propensity, and customer reactivation.

**Desired Skills:**

1. Passion for customer growth, retention, and lifecycle marketing in E-commerce/M-commerce.
2. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
3. Understanding of customer cohorts, RFM segmentation, loyalty programs, repeat purchase behaviour, and customer lifetime value.
4. Familiarity with regression analysis, data science, and machine learning models for customer targeting and campaign optimization.
5. Knowledge of CRM campaign measurement, customer journey analysis, and cross-channel performance optimization.
6. Awareness of AI-driven personalization, recommendation systems, and next-best-action frameworks.
7. Ability to translate customer insights into actionable CRM strategies and measurable business outcomes.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Repeat Customer Growth
* Retention & Reactivation Rate
* CRM-led GMV & Revenue
* Purchase Frequency & Orders per Customer
* Channel Health (Reachability, Deliverability, CTR, Conversion)
* Channel ROAS & Campaign ROI
* Automation & Lifecycle Journey Contribution
* Customer Engagement & Personalization Effectiveness

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive – Implementation Planning who will:
  
  

* Develop strong relationships with Client Servicing and Activation teams to facilitate flawless execution of plans.
* Communicate effectively across all levels of the team and across all practices.
* Support Media Planning Managers to ensure the smooth delivery of campaigns and their performance against agreed outcomes.
* Conduct research and compile data to guide and support planning and optimization recommendations.
* Compile and validate creative specs. Collaborate with creative agency partners to ensure deadlines are met.
* Collaborate with Activation teams to complete the detail of the plan in Olive.
* Create trafficking sheet templates and collaborate with Ad Operations through campaign launch.
* Prepare data for reporting and analysis.
* Support the team in making optimisation recommendations.
* Assist in the management of testing plans for assigned campaigns.
* Contribute to internal case studies for the sharing of learning and best practice.
* Meet with vendors and attend presentations to build knowledge of the media landscape

****Skills And Experience****

* Media Planning are experts on the paid media landscape and how consumers interact with it. We architect and steward holistic media plans throughout their lifecycle, owning the creation of overall plans, cross-channel budget allocation, in-flight cross-channel optimization & reporting and post-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns, narrating the story of the campaign from planning recommendation through to PCA.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, business, or a related field.
* 2-4 years of B2B program marketing experience, preferably in the technology field; enterprise infrastructure software marketing experience is a huge plus
* In-depth knowledge of media planning principles, techniques, and best practices across various channels (digital & social)
* Familiarity with media buying, negotiation, and contract management.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions.
* Proficiency in using media planning and tracking tools (Marketo, Convertr or Data Studio is a plus)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Computer literate with good skills in all basic Office programs (including Excel)
* Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* A passion for everything media and advertising, coupled with a continued desire to expand your knowledge

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: GDS Cyber-CAOE-Senior-AI IT OT Network And Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security Senior professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a Senior professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
  
  
This role is part of the Cyber Frontier & AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge & experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience across AI driven Network & Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc.)
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**Why join us**
Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network & infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network & infrastructure security practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.
  
  
**Typical work environment**

* Global, cross-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

We are seeking an experienced and dependable
**L2 Linux & Database Support Engineer**
to manage, maintain, and optimize our enterprise Linux operating systems and database environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Linux administration, hands-on database operations (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL), patching, backup management, and preventive maintenance. You will serve as an escalation point for infrastructure and application incidents, ensuring maximum uptime, security compliance, and strict SLA adherence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Linux OS Administration & Troubleshooting**

* Provide L2-level administration, configuration, and troubleshooting for enterprise Linux operating systems (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, SuSE).
* Perform continuous system monitoring, performance tuning, kernel parameter updates, disk management (LVM), and log analysis.
* Implement server hardening, user management, SSH security, and security best practices across Linux servers.
* Database Operational Administration & Maintenance
* Execute day-to-day database administration, monitoring, maintenance, and health checks (Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL / MS SQL).
* Conduct regular database health reporting, index maintenance, tablespace management, and query performance checks.
* Oversee database patching, version updates, and vulnerability remediation in coordination with application teams.
* Backup, Storage & Infrastructure Support
* Coordinate, execute, and troubleshoot database backups (RMAN, pg\_dump, mysqldump, or enterprise backup tools) and perform periodic restoration test runs.
* Provide cross-functional support across server hardware, NAS/SAN storage, basic network configurations, and security devices.
* Conduct preventive maintenance, proactive health checks, and capacity planning for Linux and database platforms.
* Incident Management & OEM / Vendor Escalation
* Resolve complex L2 incidents, service requests, and problem tickets within defined SLA targets.
* Lead end-to-end technical escalations and vendor coordination with OEMs (e.g., Red Hat, Oracle, hardware vendors) and application developers to resolve critical technical issues or software bugs.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major system or database outages and document permanent fixes.
* Application Support & Compliance
* Assist application support teams with database connectivity, environment readiness, deployment support, and troubleshooting.
* Implement OS patching, security updates, and vulnerability remediation to maintain security compliance.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational logs.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and database support in enterprise environments.
* Linux Expertise: Advanced knowledge of RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu, shell scripting (Bash/Python), systemd, LVM, user/permission management, and networking configurations.
* Database Management: Working knowledge of database administration (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server) including backup/restore, user management, and performance monitoring.
* Security & Patching: Demonstrated experience in automated/manual OS & database patching, vulnerability scanning tool remediation, and system hardening.
* Backup & Recovery: Practical knowledge of enterprise backup tools (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, RMAN) and DR procedures.
* Vendor & SLA Management: Experience coordinating with hardware/software vendors, managing high-severity escalations, and operating within an ITIL incident management framework.

**Preferred Certifications (Plus)**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) / Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Database Certifications (e.g., Oracle Certified Associate/Professional, PostgreSQL Certified Engineer).
* ITIL Foundation certification.

Skills: database,management,oracle,security,enterprise,linux,postgresql

description:
**Company Description**
RK Interiors Private Limited (RKIPL), established in 1982, is a premium turnkey contracting company specializing in large-scale Civil, Interiors, and MEP fit-out projects. Guided by the mission “Inspired To Do Things Better,” the company is committed to continuous improvement and adherence to international standards. RKIPL places strong emphasis on technology implementation, standard operating procedures, and rigorous Quality and HSE audits across all projects. A qualified in-house team of architects, engineers, quality professionals, and HSE officers ensures timely, high-quality delivery for projects of any size. The company serves diverse sectors including corporate offices, data centers, banks, coworking spaces, hotels, hospitals, showrooms, and premium residences.

**Job Posting:**
Project Engineer / Execution Lead – Data Center & Turnkey Fit-Outs

**Company:**
RK Interiors Private Limited (RKIPL)

**Location:**
Mahape, Navi Mumbai

**Experience Level:**
Mid to Senior Level

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Qualifications & Competencies:**

**Education:**
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Interior Design / Civil Engineering.

**Experience Preference:**
8-10 years of experience in turnkey commercial interiors, large-scale corporate fit-outs, or mission-critical Data Center projects.

**Technical Proficiencies:**
Working knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Excel, MS Project (MSP), BOQ preparation, and quantity estimation.

**Core Skills:**
Strong technical execution instincts, clear verbal/written client communication, conflict resolution, and contractor management.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Execution Engineer / Assistant Project Manager with specialized expertise in turnkey civil, interior fit-outs, and mission-critical environments (specifically Data Centers). The role involves leading on-site execution, managing contractor packages, enforcing precision finishing standards, tracking project timelines, and coordinating closely with clients, PMCs, and consultant architects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Site Execution & Technical Delivery**

Lead the end-to-end execution of turnkey civil and architectural interior packages, with a strong focus on data center specifications (raised access flooring, specialized partitions, heavy-duty false ceilings, and acoustic/thermal linings).

Review architectural drawings, GFCs (Good for Construction), specifications, and the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) to preempt technical clashes and site execution challenges.

Supervise site installations per material extracts and approved Submittals of Finishes (SOF), ensuring clean interfaces between civil/interior finishes and MEP/low-voltage services.

**2. Planning, Scheduling & Progress Monitoring**

Assist in drafting and actively tracking the detailed Level-2 (L2) baseline project schedule against agreed milestone dates.

Monitor critical-path activities daily to identify potential bottlenecks early and implement corrective action plans.

Prepare, verify, and submit daily, weekly, and monthly MIS operational reports.

**3. Material Extraction, Commercials & Billing Support**

Generate detailed material extracts, procurement package schedules, and site requisitions strictly aligned with the BOQ.

Perform monthly quantity reconciliations, tracking raw and installed materials to produce timely excess/savings statements.

Log all scope deviations, extra items, and quantity variations; prepare technical and cost impact sheets to secure timely client/PMC approvals.

Provide validated daily site progress data (DPRs) to the commercial/billing team to expedite interim sales bill submissions.

**4. Quality Control, Safety & Compliance**

Enforce RKIPL’s Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC) benchmarks across all work trades.

Implement real-time snagging protocols during execution rather than deferring to handover, ensuring prompt closure.

Comply strictly with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) policies, site housekeeping guidelines, organized material stacking, and statutory site compliances.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Handover**

Maintain active liaison with Clients, Project Management Consultants (PMC), and Architects for approvals, inspections, and resolution of site issues.

Maintain complete site document repositories: Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Delivery Challans, Material Test Certificates (MTC), Inspection Test Plans (ITP), and manufacturer warranties.

Coordinate final snag list sign-offs, secure Virtual Completion Certificates (VCC), compile the Handover Manual (HOM), and draft the final project closure documentation.

Oversee site demobilization, including reconciling raw material/infrastructure inventory and returning surplus goods and rental equipment to the central warehouse.

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L3) at NTT DATA, your primary role will be to provide exceptional service to our clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents. You will ensure that client infrastructure is configured, tested, and operational, leveraging your deep technical expertise to solve complex problems and enhance our service quality.
  
  
Part of your Responsibilities will entail pre-emptive service incident resolution, product reviews, and operational improvements. You will manage high-complexity tickets, perform advanced tasks, and provide diverse solutions while ensuring zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions. Your role will also involve mentoring junior team members and working across various technology domains such as Cloud, Security, Networking, and Applications.
  
  
You will conduct necessary checks, apply monitoring tools, and respond to alerts, identifying issues before they become problems. Logging incidents with the required level of detail, you will analyse, assign, and escalate support calls. Additionally, you will proactively identify opportunities for optimization and automation, ensuring continuous feedback to clients and affected parties.
  
  
Important responsibility is to create knowledge articles for frequent tasks/issues and train junior team members in executing those tasks. Provide inputs to automation teams to reduce manual efforts.
  
  
You will engage with third-party vendors when necessary and keep systems and portals updated as prescribed. As a senior engineer, you will coach L2 teams on advanced troubleshooting techniques and support the implementation and delivery of projects, disaster recovery functions, and more, ensuring all actions adhere to client requirements and timelines.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Extensive Managed Services experience handling complex cross-technology infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes.
* Proven experience working with vendors and/or third parties.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Effective planning skills, even in changing circumstances.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Active listening skills and adaptability to changing client needs.
* Client-focused approach to create positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

title: Ivy League Admissions Advisor
description:
**Ivy League Admissions Advisor**

**CollegePass | Mumbai | Full-time | Hybrid**

CollegePass is hiring an experienced Ivy League Admissions Advisor to personally guide students applying to Ivy League and other highly selective US universities.

You will work directly with students and parents on academic planning, profile development, university selection, application strategy and essays. We are looking for someone who combines informed admissions judgement with strong writing skills, thoughtful student mentoring and dependable execution.

This is a hands-on admissions-delivery role with direct responsibility for students and their applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Assessment and Admissions Strategy**

* Assess each student’s academic record, curriculum, interests, activities, achievements and aspirations.
* Develop an individual advising plan with clear priorities, milestones and deadlines.
* Help students explore intended majors and understand how their academic and extracurricular choices support their interests.
* Set realistic expectations while encouraging ambition and informed decision-making.

**Profile Development**

* Guide students towards meaningful activities, projects, research, competitions and leadership opportunities suited to their interests and circumstances.
* Help students deepen existing commitments and demonstrate initiative, contribution and intellectual curiosity.
* Monitor progress and adjust plans according to school workload, development and application timelines.
* Maintain accurate, authentic records of students’ activities and achievements.

**University Selection and Application Planning**

* Build balanced university lists based on academic fit, intended major, preferences, affordability and admissions selectivity.
* Advise on Early Decision, Early Action, Restrictive Early Action and Regular Decision options, including applicable restrictions.
* Research and verify current requirements, testing policies, deadlines and programme-specific components.
* Coordinate school documents, recommendations, portfolios and other application materials where required.

**Essays and Written Applications**

* Guide brainstorming and provide substantive feedback on personal statements and supplemental essays.
* Help students communicate their experiences, motivations and perspectives clearly while preserving their authorship and voice.
* Review activities, honours and additional-information sections for clarity, accuracy and consistency.
* Check coherence across the application so that different components contribute useful information.

**Student and Parent Relationships**

* Conduct structured advising meetings with clear actions and follow-up.
* Communicate progress, concerns and upcoming decisions to parents professionally.
* Help students manage uncertainty, competing priorities and application pressure.
* Handle disagreements thoughtfully while supporting student ownership and maintaining appropriate boundaries.

**Application Execution and Quality Assurance**

* Maintain accurate meeting notes, task trackers and application calendars.
* Identify missed milestones early and implement practical recovery plans.
* Review applications for completeness, factual consistency and compliance with university requirements.
* Ensure students review and approve their materials before submission.
* Track outcomes and use case reviews to improve advising practice.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Direct experience advising US undergraduate applicants through complete application cycles.
* A demonstrable record of personally supporting applications to Ivy League or other highly selective US universities.
* Strong understanding of holistic admissions, academic preparation, profile development and application strategy.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with strong essay-review skills.
* Familiarity with Common App and the requirements of students studying IBDP, A Levels, CBSE, ISC or comparable curricula.
* Ability to build credibility with parents and productive relationships with teenagers.
* Strong research habits, attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Willingness to personally manage advising, essay feedback, documentation and deadlines.

Candidates should be able to explain their individual contribution to reported admissions outcomes. No particular degree subject is required.

**This role has no sales targets or lead-conversion responsibilities.**

**Work Days and Hybrid Schedule**

* **Working days:**
  Tuesday–Saturday, 11:00 AM–8:00 PM IST.
* **Tuesday–Friday:**
  Working from home.
* **Saturday:**
  Working from the Mumbai office.
* **Weekly off:**
  Sunday and Monday.

Candidates must be based in Mumbai by joining and available to attend the office every Saturday.

**Selection Process**

Shortlisted applicants may complete a live student-profile assessment, university-selection discussion and essay-review exercise. Candidates may also be asked to substantiate their experience and outcomes while protecting student confidentiality.

**About CollegePass**

CollegePass supports students through personalised university admissions advising, profile development and academic preparation. We work closely with students and families to help them make informed choices and present thoughtful, authentic applications.

**Website:**
https://www.collegepass.org/

title: Senior Engineer
description:
We are hiring Senior / Lead Engineers to design, build, and scale robust, production-grade data and platform systems for a product portfolio within Blenheim. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own complex problem areas end-to-end, influence system architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable solutions in a fast-growing, product-led environment.
  
  
If you enjoy working with ambiguity, building platforms from the ground up, and shipping real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.
* Data-driven, outcome-focused decisions. Validates ideas with data, plans for schema evaluation, and aligns features with real user impact.

Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.

title: Lead – Partnerships & Affinity Business
description:
Lead – Partnerships & Affinity Business

AVYA / Protector IQ

Location: Mulund, Mumbai | Office-based

Employment: Full-time

Compensation: Negotiable fixed salary plus sales-linked incentives

ABOUT US

AVYA and Protector IQ bring together insurance expertise, product innovation and technology to develop protection solutions for individuals, businesses and communities.

AVYA helps people understand their risks and find suitable insurance. Protector IQ works with insurers, technology firms and institutions on insurance innovation, product intelligence and solutions for health, climate and livelihoods.

Backed by IIMA Ventures, we are looking for a commercially driven professional to grow our partnerships, affinity business and direct insurance broking business.

THE ROLE

We are building partnerships around real protection gaps in health, business continuity, climate and livelihoods. Our approach is gender-intentional: recognising how risks and access to protection differ across genders, and using those insights to develop relevant solutions for people, businesses and communities.

We want someone who asks what people need to remain financially resilient, questions whether existing products meet that need, and brings insurers and partners together around a commercially viable response. You may have tried to introduce a different approach within an insurer, broker or financial services firm and struggled to find the space to pursue it. We value that initiative and what you learned, including when an idea did not reach launch.

This is a hands-on, revenue-owning role for someone who enjoys opening doors, acquiring new clients and partners, and closing business. You will build opportunities from scratch and take them from initial outreach to placement, activation and realised revenue.

We need a new-business hunter who can also grow the relationships they win. Success will be measured by business generated and partnerships activated, alongside client retention and growth.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Discover underserved protection needs through conversations with clients, communities and partners.

• Shape propositions with our underwriting and product team, challenge standard approaches where they fall short, and secure insurer and distribution partners.

• Take pilots from concept to launch, adoption and revenue, assessing whether they deliver meaningful protection as well as commercial results.

• Build a pipeline of affinity partners, including employers, financial institutions, healthtechs, professional associations, membership organisations and community networks.

• Source and close direct insurance broking business, acquiring individual, SME and corporate clients.

• Generate opportunities through targeted outreach, industry networks, referrals and events.

• Understand clients’ and partners’ needs and identify suitable insurance and protection solutions.

• Develop commercially viable partnership propositions with the founder and insurance team, with a knack for innovating and structuring insurance solutions.

• Liaise with insurers and the internal team on product fit, coverage structuring, quotations, negotiations and insurance placement.

• Lead pitches, proposals, commercial negotiations and closure.

• Take partnerships beyond signing: drive activation, customer acquisition, sales conversion and revenue.

• Own the commercial relationship from prospecting through conversion, servicing coordination and renewals.

• Identify and develop opportunities for Protector IQ’s consulting, product innovation and institutional services.

• Own agreed sales targets, maintain a disciplined pipeline and forecast, and follow through on revenue collection.

• Build repeatable approaches to acquiring partners and clients, laying the foundation for a larger sales team.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Curiosity about resilience, business continuity and livelihoods, and a commitment to building insurance that responds to real needs.

• Product imagination and the ability to translate an idea into a practical partnership and business proposition.

• We welcome backgrounds in insurance or financial services partnerships, affinity business, insurance broking, institutional sales, bancassurance, embedded insurance or business development.

• We welcome candidates from the wider financial sector with a strong record of acquiring partners and closing business.

• Evidence of new business you personally sourced and won, rather than experience limited to managing assigned accounts or inbound leads.

• The ability to engage decision-makers, navigate partnership sales cycles and turn relationships into paying business.

• An understanding of insurance products and an interest in developing innovative propositions. Direct broking and insurer engagement experience will be valuable.

• Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills and disciplined follow-through.

• Comfort with revenue targets, performance-linked earnings and hands-on execution in a growing company.

• Willingness to work from our Mulund office and travel for client and partner meetings.

An existing network in insurance or financial services is valuable. Your ability to convert access and relationships into business matters most.

GROWTH INTO SENIOR LEADERSHIP

You will work directly with the founder and help shape our commercial direction. This role is intended to grow into a senior leadership position as the company scales, with increasing responsibility for business strategy, revenue and team building.

Progression will depend on sustained business results, the ability to build a repeatable sales function and readiness to recruit and lead a team.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is negotiable and will comprise a fixed salary plus sales-linked incentives.

The fixed salary is the guaranteed component. Incentives are earned on realised revenue from closed business, under an agreed incentive plan. No sales means no sales incentive; meetings, introductions, proposals or signed partnerships without revenue will not qualify for incentives.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Tell us about something you tried to do differently in insurance or financial services: the need you saw, what you proposed, the partners you brought together and what happened. We welcome examples that did not reach launch and what you learned from them. Please also share a client or partnership you personally sourced and won, your role from initial outreach to revenue, and the results you delivered. Approximate figures are welcome where confidentiality requires.

We are at day one: a clear thesis, committed backing and no team yet. You would join as founding CEO and build the company from here.

membership pricing, experience formats, city roll-out and unit economics.

manage the budget, with monthly reporting to the founder.

first experiences, first members and repeat attendance, against clear targets.

the Community & Events Lead, hosts, marketing, and product and tech partners.

product vision, choice of build partners, launch and adoption.

brand, partnerships, marketing and member referrals.

member verification, conduct, safeguarding and data privacy.

with venues, brands, employers and community organisations.

get the business ready for outside funding when the time comes.

with press and partners.

**Experience:**
a minimum of 8–10 years, including P&L or general-management responsibility in a consumer business.

a startup, a new city launch or a new business line.

**Team building:**
experience hiring and leading teams from scratch.

consumer marketing, community-led growth and unit economics.

taking a digital product from idea to launch with product and tech teams.

you care about the member experience as much as the numbers.

based in Mumbai and willing to travel as we expand.

·      Experience with community platforms or two-sided marketplaces.

lead it from day one, with committed backing.

·

success is measured in friendships made, not clicks.

including equity for the right candidate.

Compliance & Reporting

Good-to-Haves

You follow up on unpaid and denied insurance claims for US healthcare providers. You call payers, check claim status, find out why a claim was denied or underpaid, and take the action that gets it paid.

- A collaborative, supportive workplace with Great Culture

US shift, Monday to Friday, from the office.

WORK LOCATION

Loma IT Park, Aurum Q Park, Q1, Floors 7/12, Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai.

Apply here, or write to jobs@triarqhealth.com, or WhatsApp +91 77560 94800.

title: junior Architect, draughtsman
description:
