title: Content Manager
description:
**Content Manager**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:**
2-5 years

**About the Company**

BigBrainCo. is a dynamic digital agency that helps brands strengthen their online presence through innovative strategies, high-quality content creation, and data-driven insights. The company works with diverse clients across industries, developing and executing impactful social media campaigns that connect brands with their audiences. Our work brings together research, creative thinking, production discipline, platform expertise, and performance measurement. Teams collaborate closely across content, scripting, production, editing, operations, client servicing, publishing, and analytics to move ideas from insight to execution. BigBrainCo. offers an environment where professionals can take meaningful ownership of client outcomes, build practical expertise across the complete content lifecycle, and contribute to campaigns designed for measurable audience and business impact. The company values organised execution, clear communication, creative quality, responsive collaboration, and continuous learning as it scales content operations for multiple client accounts.

**About the Role**

The Content Manager owns the day-to-day content execution pipeline for assigned client accounts. Through research, content calendars, production coordination, publishing operations, community management, and analytics, this role turns client objectives into timely, platform-ready deliverables. You will coordinate scripts, props, graphics briefs, shoots, editors, videographers, client reviews, and publishing sequences while protecting service-level timelines. The role also owns Instagram and YouTube execution, including captions, covers, SEO metadata, thumbnails, cards, end screens, and feature testing. Success means every deliverable progresses predictably, meets visual and channel standards, reaches clients for review at least 48 hours before key milestones, and produces clear insight through weekly reporting on audience and content performance. Reporting to the Production Lead, you will serve as the operational owner connecting creative quality, reliable delivery, client alignment, and measurable channel outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own research for assigned client niches and convert emerging hooks, formats, trends, and competitive insights into actionable content ideas that strengthen calendar relevance and audience performance.
* Build and maintain monthly and weekly calendars across static posts, carousels, Reels, YouTube long-form videos, and Shorts, keeping publishing sequences accurate as priorities change.
* Coordinate script delivery, props, graphics briefs, and shoot readiness so clients receive scripts at least 48 hours before shoots and production teams have the inputs required for execution.
* Oversee on-set framing and visual requirements across Instagram 9:16 and YouTube 16:9 formats, protecting brand consistency and ensuring footage is usable for intended channels.
* Brief editors on priorities, edit styles, and turnaround expectations; determine batch or rolling workflows based on campaign urgency and ensure drafts reach clients 48 hours before go-live.
* Own publishing operations by writing captions, selecting cover frames, testing Instagram features, and executing YouTube titles, descriptions, timestamps, tags, cards, end screens, and thumbnail coordination.
* Monitor comments and audience sentiment, engage constructively, remove or report toxic content, resolve execution queries with client servicing, and produce weekly performance reports covering views, watch time, retention, CTR, growth, and engagement.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Hands-on experience managing content calendars, coordinating shoots, and working with editors, videographers, script writers, operations teams, and client-facing stakeholders across multiple concurrent deliverables.
* Strong working knowledge of Instagram and YouTube publishing, platform algorithms, content trends, competitive benchmarking, visual framing standards, brand consistency, and platform-specific content best practices.
* Practical YouTube SEO and analytics capability, including metadata, tags, thumbnails, cards, end screens, captions, and interpretation of views, watch time, retention, CTR, follower growth, engagement, and sentiment.

**Additional Plus**

* Prior experience working directly with clients or within a client-facing content, social media, or digital marketing team is an advantage for managing expectations and approvals.
* Experience supporting accounts across multiple industries, formats, and publishing schedules can help you adapt research and execution decisions to different audience and campaign requirements.
* Familiarity with testing emerging Instagram features, coordinating thumbnail requirements, and improving workflows through performance insights will strengthen your ability to drive channel outcomes.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring hands-on ownership of content execution, from market research and calendar planning through shoot coordination, editing traffic, approvals, publishing, community moderation, and reporting. You understand how each stage affects the next and use a clear operating rhythm to protect quality and deadlines.
* You are highly organised and comfortable managing multiple client accounts, deliverables, stakeholders, and changing priorities without losing visibility into commitments. You keep calendars current, surface risks early, and maintain SLA discipline around scripts, drafts, reviews, and go-live milestones.
* You combine creative judgement with operational precision. You can assess hooks, formats, captions, cover frames, framing standards, brand consistency, and platform requirements while coordinating effectively with script writers, videographers, editors, operations, and client servicing teams.
* You communicate confidently in writing and conversation, whether preparing captions, briefing editors, updating clients, or presenting performance results. You are comfortable reading views, watch time, retention, CTR, follower growth, engagement, and sentiment, then translating those signals into practical next steps.
* You stay curious about industry developments, audience behaviour, platform changes, and competitive content. You take initiative, work independently, and remain accountable for moving client work forward in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the complete content execution pipeline for real client accounts from day one, with direct influence over research, production readiness, publishing quality, community experience, and measurable channel performance.
* Work closely with a Production Lead and cross-functional creative, editorial, operations, and client servicing teams in a fast-paced agency environment where disciplined execution creates visible client impact.
* Build practical expertise across content strategy, production coordination, Instagram and YouTube operations, SEO, analytics, and audience management while working across diverse industries and content formats.
* Follow a clear growth path toward Production Lead and other senior content leadership opportunities while contributing to a collaborative, creative, and high-energy culture.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful ownership of end-to-end content execution for diverse client accounts, giving you broad exposure across strategy, research, production, publishing, SEO, community management, and performance analytics.
* Close collaboration with experienced production and cross-functional teams, with the opportunity to learn through real campaign delivery, feedback cycles, and performance-led decision-making.
* A creative, collaborative, and high-energy work environment where organised execution, initiative, and strong communication are valued.
* A clear development path toward Production Lead and other senior content leadership roles as you build capability and demonstrate consistent ownership.

title: Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategist - LinkedIn + Cold Emailing
description:
We're looking for someone who knows how to
**turn LinkedIn outreach and cold email into predictable B2B pipelines.**

If you've built outbound systems, managed high-volume outreach campaigns, experimented with automation tools, and consistently generated qualified meetings for B2B businesses, we'd love to meet you.

At Myntmore, you'll work with multiple founders and B2B companies across industries, building and scaling outbound systems that drive real business outcomes.

**This is a hands-on outbound role, not a paid marketing, social media, or brand marketing position.**

Must-Haves

* **Location:**
  Mumbai (mandatory)
* **Experience:**
  3+ years in B2B Lead Generation, Outbound Sales, Demand Generation, or GTM
* **LinkedIn Outreach:**
  Proven experience running LinkedIn prospecting and outreach campaigns at scale
* **Cold Emailing:**
  Hands-on experience building, launching, and optimising cold email campaigns
* **Automation & Tools:**
  Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, Sales Navigator, or similar platforms
* **Data & Research:**
  Strong understanding of ICP definition, prospect sourcing, lead enrichment, and list building
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiner or available within 15 days

**Compensation:**
₹6–15 LPA, depending on experience, plus performance-based incentives.

**Working hours:**
Full-time, 10 AM–7 PM.

What You'll Do

**1. LinkedIn Outreach at Scale**

* Build and manage outbound campaigns targeting relevant B2B decision-makers.
* Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator and automation tools to source prospects and execute structured outreach.
* Develop personalised messaging, connection requests, follow-ups, and outreach sequences.
* Improve connection acceptance rates, response rates, and qualified meetings booked.

**2. Cold Email Campaigns**

* Build and execute cold email campaigns from scratch, from prospect sourcing to meetings booked.
* Set up and manage email sequences, follow-ups, segmentation, and personalisation.
* Work with tools such as Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, and other outbound platforms.
* Understand email deliverability, domain and inbox setup, bounce management, and campaign optimisation.

**3. ICP Research & Prospecting**

* Define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and identify the right industries, companies, and decision-makers.
* Build high-quality, targeted prospect lists using research and data enrichment tools.
* Identify buying signals, business pain points, and opportunities to improve targeting.
* Test different ICPs, segments, and messaging angles to identify what drives results.

**4. AI, Automation & Growth Systems**

* Use tools like Clay and other AI-powered platforms to enrich prospect data, personalise outreach, and automate repetitive workflows.
* Build scalable outbound processes rather than relying on manual, repetitive execution.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency through integrations, automation, and AI.
* Continuously experiment with new tools and workflows to improve output.

**5. Pipeline Ownership & Optimisation**

* Own weekly and monthly outreach and qualified-meeting targets.
* Track campaign metrics, including acceptance rates, reply rates, positive responses, and meetings booked.
* Analyse performance, identify bottlenecks, and iterate on campaigns.
* Build repeatable outbound playbooks that consistently generate qualified B2B opportunities.
* Collaborate directly with founders and clients to align outreach with their sales goals.

**6 Client Strategy & GTM Execution**

* Work directly with founders and clients across multiple B2B industries to understand their business models, offerings, target audiences, and revenue goals.
* Develop customised outbound and GTM strategies for each client based on their ICP, industry, market positioning, and growth objectives.
* Identify the right mix of LinkedIn outreach, cold email, prospecting, and automation to generate qualified opportunities.
* Experiment with different industries, ICPs, messaging angles, and outreach strategies to identify what works best for each client.
* Act as an extension of each client's growth team, providing strategic inputs while owning campaign execution and performance.
* Communicate campaign insights, results, and recommendations to clients, continuously refining strategies based on performance.
* Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously, adapting your approach to different industries, sales cycles, and business objectives

Who We're Looking For

You're a great fit if you:

* Have
  **actually executed LinkedIn outreach and cold email campaigns at scale,**
  not just managed or supervised them.
* Know how to build prospect lists, write outreach sequences, configure tools, and optimise campaigns end to end.
* Understand the difference between generating leads and generating qualified sales conversations.
* Are comfortable working with automation tools and building efficient outbound workflows.
* Can analyse campaign data and make decisions based on results.
* Take ownership of pipeline outcomes instead of focusing only on activity metrics.
* Enjoy testing new ICPs, messaging angles, tools, and strategies to improve results.

**Please note:**
This role is specifically for hands-on B2B outbound lead generation. Experience limited to paid advertising, SEO, social media management, content marketing, or general brand marketing will not be sufficient.

About Myntmore

Myntmore is a B2B growth company specialising in LinkedIn personal branding, AI-powered outbound lead generation, and scalable growth systems.

We've worked with 300+ clients, delivered 900+ websites, and helped generate over $80M in revenue.

We partner with founders and B2B businesses to build predictable pipelines through targeted prospecting, LinkedIn outreach, cold email, and AI-led automation.

Why Join Myntmore?

* Work directly with founders on real B2B pipeline challenges.
* Build outbound systems for multiple businesses across industries.
* Get hands-on exposure to advanced prospecting, enrichment, AI, and automation tools.
* Take ownership of measurable business outcomes.
* Work in a performance-driven environment with incentives linked to impact.
* Grow your expertise in modern B2B outbound, GTM, and revenue generation.

**Think you can turn outbound into a predictable pipeline? Apply now.**

title: Manager / Sr. Manager – Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk's work in Maharashtra depends on how well we are trusted by the government system, industry, donors, NGOs and communities on the ground. This role owns that trust. The Manager – Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships is the person who ensures RightWalk's PMU is seen by government counterparts, establishments, industry and civil society as a credible, dependable, high-integrity partner — not just a project vendor.

This is a high-ownership role, not a coordination or liaison function. The person is fully accountable for the stakeholder ecosystem that determines whether RightWalk's programs in Maharashtra land with government buy-in, industry participation, and community trust — expected to originate strategy, make independent judgment calls on engagement, and drive outcomes rather than simply execute instructions. Reporting to the PMU Head – Maharashtra, this role owns the connective layer between the PMU's program delivery and the external ecosystem it depends on.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Stakeholder Relationship Ownership**

* Own and build strong working relationships with government departments, establishments & industry, donors, NGOs, and community groups across Maharashtra.
* Own all external stakeholder communication on behalf of the PMU — timely, professional, and consistent, without needing to be directed.
* Represent RightWalk at government meetings, industry forums, and community events, building and personally standing behind the organisation's credibility.
* Independently identify, pursue and close opportunities for collaboration and strategic partnerships that strengthen program impact.

**2. Engagement Strategy, Planning & Execution**

* Own the design, implementation and monitoring of the Maharashtra stakeholder engagement strategy, aligned with the PMU's program priorities.
* Own and maintain a live stakeholder map and engagement tracker — who matters, why, and what the relationship status is — as a single source of truth for the PMU.
* Take end-to-end ownership of workshops, roundtables and forums — agenda setting, logistics, and follow-through — ensuring each engagement delivers a clear outcome.
* Ensure engagement is inclusive and sustained, not transactional — built for long-term trust rather than one-off wins.

**3. Advisory & Internal Collaboration**

* Advise the PMU Head – Maharashtra, Project Managers, and the Steering Committee on engagement strategy, and take the lead on flagging stakeholder risks early.
* Own the briefing of internal teams ahead of stakeholder meetings, translating stakeholder context into actionable guidance.
* Anticipate stakeholder concerns and potential friction points, and take the initiative to resolve them before they become the PMU's problem.

**4. Reporting & Documentation**

* Own the inputs for weekly and monthly reports to the Project Board, government counterparts, establishments/industry, and donors.
* Maintain a clear, auditable record of all stakeholder interactions, and be personally accountable for its accuracy.
* Define and own engagement effectiveness metrics, and use them to sharpen the approach over time.
* Own the preparation of reports, decks and briefing material for stakeholders and leadership.

**5. Partnership Development & Resource Mobilisation**

* Own the identification and cultivation of new partnerships with donors, industry, NGOs and government programs in Maharashtra, driving them from first conversation to agreement.
* Take the lead on resource mobilisation efforts that strengthen the PMU's delivery capacity, working the relationship rather than waiting to be asked.
* Co-create programs and initiatives with partners in line with RightWalk's organisational goals.
* Continuously and independently scout for opportunities that expand RightWalk's visibility and credibility in the state.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — YEAR 1**

* A live, accurate stakeholder map exists for Maharashtra, covering government, industry, donor and NGO relationships, with clear ownership and engagement status.
* RightWalk is a known, trusted name among key government counterparts and industry stakeholders relevant to the PMU's mandate.
* At least one new partnership or resource-mobilisation opportunity is identified and progressed with a donor, industry or government body.
* Stakeholder engagement plans are running on a predictable cadence — not ad hoc — with documented outcomes from each major forum or workshop.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Program design or delivery — this role enables delivery through relationships, it does not run the program itself.
* Strategic communications, media relations or public narrative — that sits with the Strategic Communications function.
* Overall donor strategy or fundraising targets — this role owns partnership cultivation and resource-mobilisation opportunities in Maharashtra, not the organisation's fundraising strategy.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience: 4–7 years in stakeholder engagement, partnerships, or institutional relations within the development sector.
* Results-driven and proactive, comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal, networking and people-management skills, with the ability to engage credibly across government, industry and community groups.
* Confident working independently, able to anticipate challenges, and deliver quality work under tight timelines.
* Professional or working proficiency in Marathi is required for effective engagement with state-level stakeholders and communities.
* Motivated by social justice, equity and systemic change, and energised by fast-paced, impact-driven environments.

**Core Values We Expect You to Embody**

* Integrity & Ethics: Do what's right, always.
* Ownership & Excellence: Take full charge, no excuses.
* Resilience & Audacity: Be fearless, even when it's hard.
* Empathy & End-User First: Listen, understand, and design what matters most.
* Helicopter Mindset: Zoom out to think big, zoom in to deliver relentlessly.

title: PMU Manager - Strategic Communications
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk Foundation (RWF) addresses poverty and inequality by activating transformative social policies end to end, through Policy Advocacy, System Design, Capacity Building and Efficient Delivery — engaging System Leadership, Lawmakers and Communities. This work has unlocked policies such as RTE 12.1(c) in Uttar Pradesh, directly impacting over 800,000 children across 75 districts and 20,000 schools, and has activated Apprenticeship policy in several states, enabling over 70,000 youth to find skilling and employment opportunities.

The Manager, Strategic Communications works with the PMU Head – Maharashtra and Senior Management overseeing Strategic Communications on the planning and implementation of RWF's stakeholder communications and outreach in the state. This role owns all communication channels for the Maharashtra PMU and positions RightWalk as an influencer and implementer of public policies promoting equity, inclusion and justice — working closely with teams across the PMU's key focus areas.

**AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY**

The list below illustrates the scope of responsibilities and is not exhaustive — other tasks may be required or assigned as needed. These responsibilities are supported by existing team members who report into this position.

**1. Communications Strategy**

* Develop and deliver the strategic communications plan to support the Foundation's objectives, extend awareness of its work, and increase its reach into key sectors and audience groups.
* Devise communications plans around all active programs/projects of the PMU.
* Work with the management team and staff to identify potential internal and external communications opportunities and threats, and proactively manage them.
* Serve as a communications adviser to the PMU management team.
* Conceptualise and implement the communications plan, including design and dissemination of RWF's knowledge collaterals and key accomplishments.
* Prepare the editorial calendar and manage content and outreach for RWF's digital properties — website updates, blog, newsletters, videos, and social media channels.
* Manage RWF's brand assets and brand toolkit, updating them on a regular basis.

**2. Communications Operations**

* Write blogs, create videos and articles for internal newsletters, and draft opinion editorials for external media outlets.
* Network and develop strategic relationships with media and key ecosystem influencers.
* Evaluate and apply relevant, innovative communication tools and dissemination methods to maximise content engagement and message efficacy.
* Oversee the prioritisation and delivery of all PMU communications, including press and PR activity, print and digital communications, and stakeholder relationship management activities.
* Work with programme directors/managers to agree communications frameworks for delivery partners on tendered projects — establishing responsibility areas, reporting and evaluation measures, and monitoring activity.

**3. Management**

* Ensure accountability for delivery against pre-defined outcomes.
* Ensure accountability for program delivery and a focus on improving quality of outcomes.
* Support professional development and talent planning across the team.
* Undertake the administrative tasks necessary to ensure effective delivery of specified tasks to agreed timelines.
* Ensure effective and economic manpower planning for operational management.
* Drive a culture of coaching and mentorship to build team capacity.
* Coordinate with outside agencies for website design/development/maintenance and marketing materials.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Qualification: Post-graduate degree in Communication or Management, with knowledge of the social sector.
* Experience: 5–7 years of work experience with demonstrated success in communications, influencer outreach, and public relations.
* Team leadership: Experience growing and managing team members.
* Sector interest: Demonstrated interest in the social enterprise sector.
* Language: High fluency in English; medium fluency in Hindi.
* Tools: Ability to create content using Canva, Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Publisher; basic knowledge of video editing software.
* Work style: Able to work independently and proactively, with little supervision and without dedicated support staff.
* Communication: Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Planning: Strong organisational skills, with the ability to set priorities, plan timelines and meet deadlines.
* Desired qualities: Entrepreneurial spirit and a “get-it-done” attitude; comfortable in a small-organisation setting where teamwork and resourcefulness are valued; strong leadership skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects at a time.
* Personal attributes: Strong alignment with RWF's mission of driving Equity, Inclusion and Social Justice in building stronger education ecosystems in India; results-focused with a strong sense of ownership; willing to take personal accountability for delivery of goals; able to think creatively with discerning judgement; open to listening, learning and contributing beyond the confines of this role.

title: Software Testing Engineer, Portfolio Management Group, Analyst
description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom-up expertise from our sector specialists
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Testing Analyst to help deliver reliable web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-powered features. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to define quality criteria, identify risks early, and assess whether features are ready for release.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and define acceptance criteria, test plans, and regression scenarios.
* Assess AI-generated responses for relevance, factual support, consistency, and correct use of supporting sources.
* Validate data across application screens, APIs, databases, and generated outputs.
* Cover edge cases and failure scenarios, including invalid inputs, timeouts, interrupted requests, and access restrictions.
* Own defects from discovery through resolution: investigate issues, communicate their impact, and verify fixes.
* Build and maintain automated checks, reusable test data, and quality documentation.
* Communicate quality risks and provide clear recommendations on release readiness.

**Must know**

* Test-case design, manual testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Programming in Python, Java, or a similar language, with the ability to write validation scripts.
* API testing, including HTTP, JSON, and response validation.
* SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Test automation using a framework such as pytest, Selenium, or Playwright.
* SDLC, STLC, Git, and collaborative delivery practices.
* Structured problem-solving and clear communication.

**Good to know**

* Quality evaluation for AI applications, including prompt variations, unsupported claims, source grounding, and response quality.
* Large language model and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts.
* CI/CD pipelines, application logs, and browser developer tools.
* Accessibility, performance, and security testing.

Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, or substantial projects. We value someone who takes initiative and can drive quality from requirements through release.
  
  
**Education & Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of relevant work experience

**Problem-Solving**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, that means delivering efficient, resilient, and future-ready water supply and wastewater conveyance systems that support urban growth and environmental sustainability.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering large-scale water and wastewater network solutions, driving technical excellence and innovation across projects.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer – Conveyance, you will act as a subject matter expert and technical lead for the planning, modelling, and design of water distribution and wastewater collection systems. You will guide teams on complex assignments while remaining actively involved in critical technical deliverables. You will collaborate within a multicultural, high‑performing engineering environment and contribute to achieving project targets related to quality, schedules, technical rigor, and client satisfaction.

+ Capital investment plans and phasing strategies

+ Pipeline sizing and network layouts

+ Pumping systems and rising mains

* Provide expertise in pumping systems, including system curves, pump selection, operational strategies, and integration with networks.
* Ensure effective integration with treatment plants, reservoirs, and pump stations.
* Perform and lead technical QA/QC reviews of models, calculations, reports, and drawings.

title: Manager / Consultant - Learning & Development (Kaizen & Six Sigma)
description:

We are seeking a hands-on professional with experience in
**Kaizen, Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement or Manufacturing L&D**
to drive competency-based learning and performance improvement.

The role involves working closely with manufacturing and business functions to identify skill gaps, develop techno-functional training modules, deliver training and assess workplace competency improvement.

Key Responsibilities

* **Training Need Identification:**
  Participate in Daily Kaizen meetings, VSK reviews and shopfloor observations to diagnose functional skill and competency gaps.
* **Competency Mapping:**
  Collaborate with functional heads to identify role-specific knowledge and skill requirements.
* **Training Module Development:**
  Co-develop techno-functional training modules with subject matter experts, incorporating SOPs, process standards and practical assessments.
* **Training Delivery:**
  Conduct classroom, shopfloor and on-the-job training using real operational scenarios.
* **Learning Assessment:**
  Evaluate training effectiveness through pre/post assessments, skill demonstrations and workplace application.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Apply Kaizen, Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to connect training interventions with productivity, quality and process improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

* 3–6 years of experience in Kaizen consulting, Six Sigma consulting, manufacturing process improvement or competency-based L&D.
* Working knowledge of
  **5 Why, Root Cause Analysis, Pareto, PDCA, DMAIC and Process Mapping**
  .
* Hands-on experience in Training Need Analysis, competency mapping, training content development and facilitation.
* Strong analytical, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to engage with manufacturing teams, supervisors and functional leaders.

Graduate / Postgraduate in Engineering, Operations, HR, Psychology, Organizational Development or related discipline.

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt, Kaizen implementation or Instructional Design certification.

**Success in this role means translating operational challenges into measurable employee capability and performance improvements.**

title: Senior Executive Assistant
description:
* Location: Mumbai
* Experience: 7+ Years
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Compensation: 70-80K Per Month
* Industry: Real Estate
* Reporting To: Founder

**About The Role**
We are a Mumbai-based real estate company looking for an experienced
**Executive Assistant to work directly with the Founder**
.
  
  
You will be the Founder’s first point of contact and representative, responsible for protecting his time and ensuring that the right people, priorities, and issues reach him.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role requiring strong judgement, organisation, discretion, and confidence. You will manage the Founder’s calendar, travel, communication, coordination, and follow-ups while ensuring his day-to-day commitments run smoothly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Calendar & Priority Management**

* Manage the Founder’s calendar, meetings, appointments, and daily priorities
* Organise schedules to ensure effective use of the Founder’s time
* Coordinate meetings with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively
* Ensure important priorities and follow-ups are tracked through completion

**Travel Management**

* Plan and coordinate domestic and international travel end to end
* Manage flights, accommodation, transportation, itineraries, and other travel arrangements
* Handle last-minute changes and unexpected situations with practical judgement
* Maintain organised travel schedules and relevant documentation

**Gatekeeping & Founder Support**

* Act as the Founder’s gatekeeper and first point of contact
* Filter incoming requests and determine what requires the Founder’s direct attention
* Route matters to the appropriate internal point of contact when required
* Confidently and professionally decline or redirect requests when necessary
* Protect the Founder’s time while ensuring important matters are addressed

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate across internal teams, staff, and external stakeholders on the Founder’s behalf
* Communicate requirements and follow up on action items
* Build effective working relationships with people across different levels
* Ensure information reaches the right stakeholders accurately and on time

**Documentation & Follow-Ups**

* Maintain well-organised records and documentation
* Track meetings, commitments, action items, and follow-ups
* Ensure pending matters are followed through to completion
* Maintain clear and easily accessible information when required

**Confidentiality & Discretion**

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion
* Maintain professionalism when dealing with internal and external stakeholders
* Exercise sound judgement when managing sensitive matters on the Founder’s behalf

**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* 7+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant
* Based out of Mumbai
* Prior experience working in a startup (Preferred)
* Prior experience supporting a Founder or senior leadership is strongly preferred
* Experience within a founder’s office, startup, or real estate company is preferred
* Strong-minded and composed under pressure
* Confidence to establish and maintain boundaries firmly but politely
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills
* Comfortable working with employees and stakeholders at every level
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail
* Strong documentation and follow-through
* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of important details
* High level of discretion and confidentiality
* Digitally inclined and comfortable using:

+ Calendars
+ Email
+ Productivity tools
+ Collaboration tools

* Some travel experience and broader exposure to planning complex itineraries

**The Ideal Candidate**
We’re looking for someone who can do much more than manage a calendar.
  
  
You should understand how to
**protect a Founder’s time, prioritise competing requests, coordinate with different personalities, and make practical decisions independently**
.
  
  
You should be confident enough to say no when necessary, composed enough to handle pressure and last-minute changes, and organised enough to ensure commitments and follow-ups never fall through the cracks.
  
  
Above all, you should be someone the Founder can trust to represent him professionally and handle sensitive information with complete discretion.

title: SME - German (Bridge Beyond) - Consultant
description:
EBSC Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
  
  

* BridgeBeyond Programme

**Content and Training Delivery Specialist**
VOICE German™ Programme
  
  

* Full-Time Permanent
* Mumbai

German Language C2
  
  

* Curriculum Development
* Training Delivery
* BBTC Certification

**Department -**
Learning & Development — Bridge Beyond Germany Nursing Programme
  
  
**Reporting To**
Head of L&D, Project Lead
  
  
**Location**
Mumbai (on-site — candidate must be Mumbai-based)
  
  
**Employment**
Full-Time Permanent
  
  
**Language Req.**
German — C2 level (mastery) –
**Mandatory**
Must have lived and worked in Germany for a minimum of 3 years. Hard requirement
  
  
**(Not Mandatory).**
**Experience**
Minimum 8 years in German language instruction, curriculum development, or a combination of both
  
  
**About The Programme**
Bridge Beyond, operated by EBSC Technologies Pvt. Ltd., is India's only end-to-end India–Germany nursing placement pathway. We source qualified nurses from Maharashtra and beyond, prepare candidates from A1 through B2 entirely in India before departure, secure a confirmed job offer before training begins, and provide structured support for twelve months post-landing in Germany.
  
  
VOICE German™ is our proprietary German language and clinical communication product — a four-level, CEFR-aligned programme with nursing-specific content, scenario-based pedagogy, and a trainer certification framework (BBTC). It is a core intellectual property asset of EduBridge and a primary competitive differentiator of the Bridge Beyond programme.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
This is a senior specialist content and delivery role at the heart of VOICE German™. You will own the curriculum documents that power the programme, deliver training to nursing candidates in Mumbai, and build the trainer pipeline that will allow VOICE German™ to scale across multiple cities. This is not a general language teaching role — it requires C2-level German mastery, direct lived experience of the German workplace, deep pedagogical rigour, and the discipline to produce EduBridge-standard curriculum documents that carry the programme's IP. Your Germany experience is not a preference — it is the foundation of the credibility you will bring to every session, every document, and every trainer you certify.
  
  
*What makes this role significant: The content you create is protected intellectual property used by trainers across 5 cities. The trainers you certify become the programme's delivery engine. The learners you take to B2 are the candidates Germany's hospitals hire. Your direct experience of working and living in Germany is what will make both the curriculum and the classroom credible — not just technically accurate.*
**Key Responsibilities**

* Curriculum Content Development

– Design and write VOICE German™ curriculum documents across all four levels (A1–B2): session plans, learner workbooks, facilitator guides, and assessment rubrics — all aligned to CEFR and Goethe/TELC examination standards.
  
  
– Develop nursing-specific language content: Pflege vocabulary, patient interaction scripts, clinical documentation language, and scenario-based role-play scripts embedded into every level.
  
  
– Produce the VOICE German™ Trainer Playbook and all BBTC (Bridge Beyond Trainer Certification) materials — the documents that enable certified trainers to deliver the programme at scale with consistency.
  
  
– Maintain version control and document compliance standards as per EduBridge's VOICE German Document Production Standards; all materials vest as EduBridge IP.
  
  
– Collaborate with the Head of L&D on programme architecture decisions and review cycles.
  
  

* Training Delivery — Mumbai Batches

– Deliver VOICE German™ training to batches of nursing candidates in Mumbai — covering the full A1 through B2 pathway entirely in India before candidate departure.
  
  
– Use a communicative and immersive methodology: speaking labs, scenario role-plays, Goethe/TELC mock exams, and weekly proficiency checks as per the programme's assessment framework.
  
  
– Monitor individual learner progress rigorously; intervene early when a learner is at risk of not meeting the B1 certification deadline.
  
  
– Prepare candidates comprehensively for the Goethe-Institut or TELC B1 certification exam — the official gateway to the Germany visa. B1 pass rates are a primary performance metric for this role.
  
  
– Maintain attendance records, assessment data, and batch progress reports for submission to the
  
  
Programme Manager.
  
  

* Trainer Certification — BBTC Programme

– Certify VOICE German™ trainers through the BBTC (Bridge Beyond Trainer Certification) framework — the quality gate that ensures every trainer who delivers the programme meets EduBridge's pedagogical and language standards.
  
  
– Conduct BBTC induction, observation, feedback, and certification sessions for new trainer recruits.
  
  
– Support ongoing quality assurance of certified trainers through spot checks, retraining where needed, and annual recertification.
  
  

* B2 Delivery — Full Pathway Completion in India

– Own the B2 level curriculum and deliver it to candidates in India before departure — ensuring all learners exit the programme at CEFR B2 standard, examination-ready.
  
  
– Prepare candidates for Goethe-Institut or TELC B2 certification; B2 pass rates are a milestone metric tied to deployment readiness.
  
  
– Design assessment checkpoints between B1 and B2 to track progression and identify candidates who need additional support before the B2 exam.
  
  

* Cross-City Quality Assurance

– Act as the quality anchor across all 5 pilot city batches — not just Mumbai. Conduct periodic remote observation sessions of city FTE trainers, review their assessment data, and flag early where delivery quality is drifting from the VOICE German™ standard.
  
  
– Design and administer the German language enrolment screening test used across all cities to assess candidates before batch allocation — this must be ready before the first batch goes live.
  
  
– Travel to city locations as required to conduct BBTC certification sessions, in-person quality audits, and trainer calibration workshops — up to 5 cities across Trichy, Hyderabad, Chennai, Guwahati, and Mumbai.
  
  
**Essential**
**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
– German language proficiency at C2 level — full mastery. This is a hard requirement. The role cannot be performed at C1 or below.
  
  
– Minimum 3 years of having lived and worked in Germany. This is not a preference — it is the experience that makes the curriculum authentic, the classroom credible, and the nursing-workplace scenarios real. Candidates who have only studied German in India will not be considered.
  
  
– Minimum 8 years of combined experience in German language instruction, curriculum development, or professional use of German in a structured environment.
  
  
– Proven ability to produce structured curriculum documents: session plans, learner workbooks, assessment rubrics, trainer guides — at professional, publishable standard, not informal teaching notes.
  
  
– Deep familiarity with the CEFR framework and at least one external examination standard — Goethe-Institut, TELC, or ÖSD — from the perspective of a practitioner, not just a test-taker.
  
  
– Working knowledge of healthcare or nursing German is strongly advantageous — Pflege vocabulary, clinical communication, patient interaction language. If not at hire, rapid self-directed acquisition is non-negotiable.
  
  
– Full professional English proficiency for internal documentation, coordination, and programme management.
  
  
**Preferred**
– Experience in a train-the-trainer, trainer certification, or academic programme management role.
  
  
– Prior experience designing curriculum for healthcare professionals, nurses, or migration/pathway programmes.
  
  
– Active professional network in Germany — hospitals, nursing institutions, Goethe-Institut, DAAD, or German employer community. This is not required at hire but is a significant advantage.
  
  
– Exposure to EdTech platforms, LMS environments, or AI-assisted language learning tools.
  
  
– Experience working across multiple geographies or managing distributed training delivery.
  
  
**WHY JOIN BRIDGE BEYOND**
– You will be the most senior German language specialist in a fast-growing programme — your Germany experience, your curriculum standards, and your pedagogical rigour will define what VOICE German™ becomes.
  
  
– The content you produce is registered IP. Your work will build a proprietary product that is designed to scale, license, and carry the EduBridge brand into a new market.
  
  
– You will work directly with the Head of L&D and programme leadership — not inside a large, anonymous team. Your decisions have direct programme consequence.
  
  
– Bridge Beyond is MEA/NSDC-recognised, employer-partnered, and the only pathway in India that guarantees a job offer before training begins. You will represent a credible, differentiated programme — not a generic language school.
  
  
– This role has a natural growth path into Programme Lead, Product Lead, or Head of Language — as the programme scales from 5 cities to 20, the person who built the foundation owns the architecture.

title: Consultant-GIS
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an enthusiastic, creative, and delivery-oriented candidate who has practical experience with GIS and a profound interest in GIS technologies and updates.
**Consultant GIS**
will assist with data management and mapping activities related to Contaminated lands, Environmental Planning, Ecology and Environmental Impact Assessment, Archaeology, Heritage, Indigenous Relations and other environmental investigations projects. Responsibilities include production of cartographic report figure, tabular data summaries, editing, maintaining, and managing spatial datasets in both the web and desktop environments. The Assistant GIS Consultant works under the supervision of intermediate and senior GIS staff. All deliverables produced shall comply with WSP Canada standards and procedures, as well as provincial regulations, standards and guidelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The role would involve:
  
  

* Plot, edit, and analyze spatial components of various projects using ArcGIS Pro and other components of the ArcGIS Suite, including ArcGIS Online
* Preparing maps, drawings, figures, sketches, charts and presentation posters for use in proposals and reports;
* Participate in 2D and 3D GIS data analysis, file management, database management, spatial data capture, georeferencing, structuring and integration into GIS data themes;
* Convert GIS data between multiple file formats;
* Report to and review project work with senior GIS personnel;
* Work collaboratively with staff from other WSP offices, as required to meet project and client needs;
* Communicate and operate in a professional and courteous manner with team members, Project Managers, and clients;
* Perform other administrative and technical duties as required;
* Understand sources and availability of authoritative spatial data for use on projects, both through WSP’s maintained data warehouse and through government and authority data sources.
* Understand and maintain file directory structure per WSP Canada operational standards
* Perform quality reviews to ensure geospatial and content accuracy.
* Proactively identify improvements to enhance the company’s GIS service to clients.
* Attend to team and project needs as required, and respond within agreed timeframes.
* Provide regular work status updates, including risks or concerns, to line manager.
* Develop own expertise and stay abreast of developments in GIS technologies.
* Ensure that Health & Safety is embedded into all work practices in accordance with company policies.

Key Competencies / Skills:
  
  
Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Ability to perform routine spatial analysis, digitizing, collection, and consolidation of project data;
* Understanding of datums and projections and the processes to convert between spatial references
* Perform routine calculations;
* Efficient data entry skills
* Basic knowledge of the web GIS Environment (ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise), ability to manage data therein and create and / or maintain field data collection solutions in Field Maps and / or Survey123.
* Demonstrated proficiency of GIS tools such as ArcGIS suite, ArcGIS Pro, AGOL, and Microsoft Office Suite
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work in a very dynamic and demanding work environment.
* Should possess good interpersonal skills, good team player with an innate ability to motivate colleagues to give of their best.
* To be flexible and adaptable in the range of work undertaken and deliver it with enthusiasm.
* To be self-motivated.
* Ability to work independently with minimal oversight.

* CAD experience desirable.
* International experience is preferred.

* Looking for experienced professional with more than 5 years of experience

* Proven track record in GIS.

**Skills:**

**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
  
  
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as ententions of health advisers. title: Analyst/Associate – Private High-Grade Credit, Middle Office Operations
description:
**About This Role**
**Company Description**
HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.
  
  
HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”).Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).
  
  
The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS) – Blackrock’s private credit platform – is responsible for ensuring the Fund’s positions and cash balances are accurate. They manage the lifecycle of all trades/investments. They are responsible for trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate action elections/recordings, audit requests, new mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. MO handles ad-hoc requests that come from the deal team and/or separately managed account clients. The team interacts closely with the Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and the Deal Teams daily.
  
  
**Description**
**Position Description**
PFS is seeking an Associate to join the High Grade Middle Office (HGMO) team. HGMO is a sub-group within Middle Office that focuses on the High Grade (private investment grade) platform.
  
  
The individual should be highly organized with strong attention to detail. They should have the ability to meet strict deadlines, work independently and as part of a team, as well as possess excellent critical thinking/problem-solving skills. The platform is scaling very rapidly, so the desire for a fast-paced environment is crucial.
  
  
This individual will be the PFS Middle Office team’s first hire in Mumbai and will have an opportunity to play a key role in building out the PFS Middle Office presence there.
  
  
Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
  
  

* Researching and resolving cash breaks vs. custodians
* Researching and resolving position breaks vs. custodians/clients/administrators/other systems
* Play a key role in the daily reconciliation between HPS & BlackRock’s accounting systems
* Daily oversight of loan and security administration in the firm’s accounting system to support internal post close loan administration: tracking delayed fundings, contracts, coupon payments, factor payments, and maturities
* Investigate any transactional or accrual discrepancies that may arise
* Provide full trade life cycle operational support for products including but not limited to Bonds (Fixed & Floating Rate), Private Placements, ABS, Cross-Currency Swaps, Term Loans, Delayed Draw Term Loans, and Revolvers
* Work closely with custodians daily – fielding questions on how to apply cash, and building/providing amortization schedules for factored securities
* Assemble purchaser schedules with the information needed to close/fund new private placements
* Assist with confirming positions and providing support where needed for both internal and SMA auditors
* Daily interaction with internal and external groups to troubleshoot any booking and/or position discrepancies (Front Office/Fund Accounting/Fund Administrators/SMA Clients/Auditors)
* Assist with monthly tie outs of all positions & cash with SMA Client for AUM, Dry Powder, and Management Fee purposes
* Perform daily transaction reconciliation with Stat Accounting administrator, and monthly position/cost/market value reconciliation during the monthly lockdown process
* Ensure proper recording/accounting and cashflow reconciliation of cross-currency swaps
* Perform Detailed Investment Return reconciliation versus full fund administrator
* Collaborate with technology teams on automation and workflow enhancements; Execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including scenario testing and error resolution before production release
* Liaise with multiple internal groups such as accounting, product control, valuations, investment data, etc. to resolve open queries and perform additional responsibilities as required to support team objectives

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or business related field
* 2-6 years of experience in middle office/operations; accounting experience is a plus
* Strong understanding of fixed income securities (private & public), cross-currency and/or interest rate swaps
* Trading and settlement
* Creation of securities/swaps in security master
* Life-cycle events: coupons, factors, amendments, tenders, maturity
* Cash and position reconciliation
* Strong Excel and Outlook Management Skills
* Use of lookups, pivot tables, and extensive formulas – with the ability to build from scratch at any time
* Ability to sort through high number of emails per day without missing anything important, responding in a timely manner, and escalating when necessary
* Enjoys problem solving and critical thinking
* Ability to resolve complex issues efficiently and independently by leveraging knowledge obtained via training as well as past experiences
* Curiosity; need to not just be willing but wanting to learn and build upon existing knowledge every single day
* Experience using trade/accounting/security master systems; FIS VPM, Aladdin, IVP Products, and/or Clearwater preferred
* Experience with Statutory Accounting is a plus

**Hybrid Work Schedule and Shift Timings**

* 4/1 split
* This role requires working a late shift to support stakeholders across EMEA and US time zones (e.g. 2 PM to 11 PM or 3 PM to 12 AM)

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Director – Financial Institutions Group (FIG)
description:
**Company Overview**

Capwise Financial Services is a full-service investment banking and financial advisory firm that helps businesses raise capital, execute strategic transactions, and navigate complex financial decisions across domestic and cross-border markets. With experience spanning 200+ debt transactions and 35+ equity and M&A deals, the firm combines a strong origination network with an active deal pipeline and a partner-led model, where sector heads own their client franchise, revenue budgets, and teams, supported by Capwise’s broader platform, central origination network, and execution capabilities.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Director to lead our Financial Institutions Group (FIG) — a debt-focused practice that helps non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), housing finance companies (HFCs), microfinance institutions (MFIs), small finance banks, fintech lenders, and other financial institutions raise funds from banks, other NBFCs, and institutional debt investors. Coverage spans term loans, non-convertible debentures (NCDs), securitization and direct assignment, co-lending arrangements, structured and subordinated debt, and other debt capital markets products. This is a P&L-owning role. You will carry the revenue budget for the sector, build and convert your own origination pipeline, price and win mandates, and be accountable for the profitability, resourcing, and growth of the practice.

You will own the FIG franchise end to end: cultivating relationships with promoters, CFOs, and treasury teams at NBFCs and other financial institutions, as well as with the credit and investment teams of banks, NBFCs, mutual funds, AIFs, DFIs, and offshore credit funds on the lending side; converting these relationships into signed debt mandates on commercially attractive terms; overseeing the structuring, syndication, and closing of fund-raising transactions through your team; and managing the revenue, cost, and margin outcomes of the vertical.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. P&L Ownership & Business Development**

·
**Revenue & P&L Ownership: Own the Financial Institutions Group (FIG) P&L — set and deliver the annual fee-revenue budget, manage the team cost base and deal expenses, and report performance and forecasts to the firm's leadership**
.

· Origination & Pipeline: Build and own a proprietary pipeline of NBFCs, HFCs, MFIs, fintech lenders, and other financial institutions seeking debt capital, alongside banks, NBFCs, mutual funds, AIFs, DFIs, and other lenders and debt investors, supplemented by the firm's central network and balance sheet.

· Pitch to Win: Lead pitches and bake-offs, presenting deep FIG and debt-market insight and bespoke fund-raising strategies that convert prospects into signed clients.

· 
**Mandate Structuring:**
Draft, negotiate, and finalize Mandate Letters, Engagement Agreements, and fee structures, pricing mandates to protect the practice's margin and the commercial interests of the firm.

**2. Transaction Oversight & Delivery**

· 
**Transaction Management:**
Hold delivery accountability across the entire lifecycle of debt raising and syndication (term loans, NCDs, securitization, direct assignment, co-lending, structured and subordinated debt, and ECB) transactions.

·
**Financial Modeling & Credit Analysis:**
Supervise the creation of complex financial models, credit and cash-flow analyses, asset-liability (ALM) and pool-cut analyses, and the credit story and structuring rationale presented to lenders and rating agencies.

·
**Collateral Preparation:**
Ensure the highest quality production of pitch books, Information Memoranda, lender presentations, rating agency presentations, and pool/portfolio data packs.

**3. Due Diligence & Deal Closing**

· 
**Data Room Management:**
Oversee Virtual Data Rooms (VDR), managing the flow of information between clients, lenders, and debt investors.

·
**Due Diligence Coordination:**
Lead the financial, legal, credit, and portfolio due diligence processes, actively resolving deal-breakers and bottlenecks.

·
**Definitive Documentation:**
Collaborate with legal counsels and debenture trustees to negotiate and finalize term sheets, sanction letters, Facility/Loan Agreements, Debenture Trust Deeds, securitization and assignment documents, security and hypothecation deeds, and other definitive financing documents.

**4. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

· 
**Team Building & Leadership: Hire, manage, mentor, and maximize the utilization and**
productivity of a dedicated team of Vice Presidents, Associates, and Analysts within the Financial Institutions Group.

· 
**Client Management:**
Act as the primary, trusted advisor to promoters, CFOs, and treasury teams of NBFCs and other financial institutions across the full relationship lifecycle, while maintaining strong relationships with bank and institutional credit teams, deepening wallet share and building a durable, repeat client base.

**Qualifications & Experience**

·
**Education:**
MBA from a Tier-1 business school, Chartered Accountant (CA), or CFA charterholder.

·
**Experience:**
15+ years of core investment banking, debt capital markets, or financial-institutions coverage experience within a reputed IB firm, institutional platform, NBFC/bank DCM or treasury desk, or boutique advisory house, including substantial coverage of NBFCs, HFCs, MFIs, and other financial institutions and their debt fund-raising.

·
**Track Record:**
A proven history of successfully closing debt fund-raising and syndication transactions -term loans, NCDs, securitization, direct assignment, co-lending, and structured debt. Must be able to demonstrate an extensive list of closed deals, together with evidence of personally originated revenue and, ideally, prior ownership of a revenue budget or practice P&L.

·
**Sector Expertise:**
Deep domain knowledge of the financial institutions sector and NBFC business models (asset finance, housing finance, microfinance, MSME and consumer lending, gold loans, and fintech lending), fluency in sector and credit metrics (AUM growth, net interest margin, cost of funds, capital adequacy/CRAR, gearing and leverage, asset-liability management, and asset quality), familiarity with the relevant regulatory regime (RBI scale-based regulation for NBFCs, securitization and direct-assignment guidelines, co-lending norms, and priority-sector lending), and active networks among bank and NBFC credit teams, mutual funds, AIFs, DFIs, insurance companies, and offshore credit funds on the lending side, and founder/promoter and CFO/treasury groups on the borrower side.

·
**Skills:**
Proven business-development and client-origination ability, commercial and P&L management judgment (pricing, resourcing, cost control), master-level negotiation skills, strong understanding of debt documentation and financing structures, and sharp credit and analytical acumen.

title: Process Control Manager
description:
**Job Description: Processes, Controls & Governance (Big4)**

**Position:**
Consultant to Senior Manager – Processes, Controls & Governance

**Experience:**
As per the applicable designation and hiring requirements

**Preferred Industries:**
Banking, NBFCs, and Fintech

**Preferred Background:**
Big 4 / Big 6 consulting firms or internal controls teams within banks and NBFCs

**Role Overview**

We are looking for experienced professionals in Processes, Controls & Governance to lead and execute engagements involving Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCoFR), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, and risk and control transformation.

The role involves working with clients in the banking, NBFC, and fintech sectors to assess control environments, identify risks and control gaps, implement effective control frameworks, and strengthen governance and compliance practices.

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of SOX, COSO, IFC, and IFCoFR frameworks, along with experience in engagement management, client relationship management, team leadership, and preparation of technical reports and proposals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Internal Controls & SOX Advisory**

* Lead engagements involving the design, implementation, assessment, testing, and optimization of internal control frameworks.
* Evaluate existing control environments to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas of non-compliance.
* Develop and review Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs), process narratives, flowcharts, and control documentation.
* Conduct process walkthroughs to understand business processes, identify key risks, and evaluate the adequacy of controls.
* Assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls through Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Operating Effectiveness (ToE).
* Support clients in implementing SOX compliance frameworks, particularly controls over financial reporting.
* Recommend improvements to strengthen control effectiveness and reduce operational and financial reporting risks.

**2. Controls Testing, Remediation & Transformation**

* Plan and execute controls testing across financial, operational, and technology-enabled business processes.
* Identify control deficiencies, assess their potential impact, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support clients in remediation of control deficiencies and monitor the implementation of agreed action plans.
* Refresh existing control frameworks in response to changes in business processes, systems, regulations, and risk environments.
* Drive control transformation and optimization initiatives, including standardization of controls, elimination of redundant activities, and improvement of control efficiency.
* Assist clients during internal and external audits by coordinating evidence, responding to queries, and tracking open observations.

**3. Banking, NBFC & Fintech Sector Exposure**

* Lead risk and control assessments across relevant financial services processes.
* Evaluate controls relating to lending, loan disbursement, collections, financial reporting, reconciliations, payments, and other applicable business cycles.
* Assess controls over transaction processing, system access, approvals, data integrity, and financial reporting, depending on the engagement scope.
* Understand sector-specific regulatory requirements and incorporate relevant compliance considerations into control assessments.
* Apply industry practices to identify control weaknesses and recommend practical, risk-based solutions.

**4. Governance Frameworks & Technical Standards**

* Apply the COSO Internal Control Framework and relevant SOX requirements to control assessments and implementation engagements.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of IFC and IFCoFR requirements and their application to financial reporting.
* Interpret relevant technical guidance, regulatory developments, and industry practices relating to internal controls and governance.
* Ensure engagement methodologies and deliverables comply with applicable professional standards and client requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation to support control conclusions, testing results, and remediation recommendations.

**5. Engagement & Team Management**

* Manage multiple client engagements, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to defined quality standards.
* Manager should lead and supervise a team of approximately 4–6 professionals, including work allocation, guidance, review, and performance monitoring.
* Review RCMs, testing workpapers, evidence, observations, and final reports prepared by team members.
* Monitor engagement progress, identify delivery risks, and communicate status updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with client process owners, finance teams, risk teams, compliance teams, and senior management.
* Ensure that deliverables are accurate, evidence-based, and aligned with engagement objectives.

**6. Client Deliverables & Business Development**

* Prepare and review detailed assessment reports, control testing reports, gap assessment reports, and remediation trackers.
* Develop proposals, presentations, service flyers, and other business development materials.
* Support preparation of engagement scope, methodology, timelines, resource plans, and commercial proposals.
* Present audit and control findings to clients and communicate recommendations in a clear, actionable manner.
* Contribute to the development of internal methodologies, knowledge materials, and best-practice documentation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification, if specified for the position.
* Relevant experience leading internal controls, SOX advisory, implementation, testing, refresh, transformation, or optimization engagements.
* At least three years of relevant sector exposure in banks, NBFCs, or fintech companies, subject to confirmation of the precise experience requirement.
* Strong knowledge of IFC, IFCoFR, SOX, COSO, risk assessment, and internal control testing methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with process walkthroughs, RCM preparation, ToD/ToE testing, deficiency assessment, and remediation.
* Experience managing teams of approximately 4–6 members.
* Strong report-writing, analytical, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience with Big 4 / Big 6 professional services or consulting firms.
* Consultant - 1-2 years, AM - 3+ years, Manager - 5+, Sr. Manager - 8+
* Alternatively, relevant internal controls, SOX, risk, or governance experience within banks and NBFCs.
* Experience preparing proposals, detailed client reports, presentations, and technical documentation.
* Exposure to control transformation, process improvement, and governance enhancement initiatives.

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster).
