The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise SharePoint Online environment. Job Category: IT
  
  
**Job Description**
Zurich Cover-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
  
  
In the post-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
  
  
**So, what’s the job?**

* You'll provide day-to-day Level 2 support for the Salesforce platform, ensuring timely resolution of user issues and platform-related requests.

* You'll collaborate with Salesforce users to gather feedback, understand pain points, and recommend platform enhancements.
* You'll assist users with production verification testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure successful deployment of changes.
* You'll support the testing team by participating in Salesforce regression testing for new releases and system updates.
* You'll manage Salesforce data and database integrity, including data cleansing, sandbox preparation, backup and restore activities, object optimization, and security settings.
* You'll maintain the overall health and security of the Salesforce org, including applying security updates, managing certificates, and ensuring platform stability

**And what are we looking for?**

* You'll hold a relevant qualification in IT, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* You'll bring 5+ years of experience working with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, with Experience Cloud and Pardot knowledge considered an advantage.
* You'll possess Salesforce certifications such as ADM301 or equivalent credentials.
* You'll have hands-on experience building and maintaining Salesforce Reports, Dashboards, and Lightning templates.
* You'll be familiar with Salesforce add-ons such as Conga, OwnBackup, or similar tools, which would be highly beneficial.
* You'll have experience delivering end-user training and supporting user adoption of Salesforce solutions.
* You'll demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You'll have proven experience working in complex Salesforce environments and applying strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve root causes.
* You'll bring a proactive mindset, a strong willingness to learn, and a positive "can-do" attitude toward challenges and continuous development.

**So, why choose us?**
**We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.**
We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
  
  
**Job flexibility**
. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
  
  
**Career growth**
. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business - not for the business!
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion.**
We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
  
  
Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
  
  
**We also offer some other perks including:**

* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**About Millennium**
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.
  
  
Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.
  
  
**Meet the Team**
Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s Information Technology organization supports a flexible, scalable technology environment and advanced proprietary systems across the firm. Within that organization, the global Network & Datacentre team manages critical datacentre and office technology infrastructure that underpins regional growth, operational resilience, and connectivity across Millennium’s platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the day-to-day physical operation of Millennium’s India datacentre facility and associated office technology rooms, including power, cooling, space, cabling, and security.
* Perform hands-on datacentre work including racking and stacking, structured copper and fibre cabling, labelling, patching, and maintaining strong cable hygiene standards.
* Manage hardware lifecycle activities across servers, storage, and network equipment, including installations, upgrades, moves, adds, changes, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate and execute hardware replacements and RMAs with local and international vendors, while helping maintain service continuity.
* Monitor infrastructure and environmental alerts, respond to incidents, perform first-line troubleshooting, and support a 24x7 operating environment through maintenance windows and extended-hours work as needed.
* Work within established ITIL and ITSM processes for incidents, requests, and changes, while maintaining accurate asset, location, and connectivity records in platforms including ServiceNow and Nlyte.
* Support network device deployment and basic configuration under the direction of Network Engineering, including physical connectivity, VLAN validation, link checks, and basic Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting.
* Contribute to tooling, automation, and integration efforts across DCIM, monitoring, logging, CMDB, and capacity platforms, while improving runbooks, SOPs, and recurring operational processes.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in a datacentre or large-scale infrastructure environment, ideally within financial services or another mission-critical setting.
* Proven hands-on experience managing racks, cabling, hardware installations, and decommissioning across multi-cabinet environments.
* Experience supporting office technology rooms or comms rooms, including IDF and MDF environments, in addition to core datacentres.
* Strong working knowledge of datacentre power and cooling concepts, including PDUs, UPS, dual feeds, capacity management, and hot aisle or cold aisle design.
* Solid CCNA-level networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, trunking, subnetting, basic routing, and access control concepts, with the ability to perform CLI-based troubleshooting on enterprise network devices.
* Experience working with remote management and operational tooling, including technologies such as IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, console servers, ServiceNow, Jira, and DCIM or CMDB platforms.
* Basic scripting capability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support task automation, reporting, and data handling.
* Strong documentation, communication, and coordination skills, with a high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with local facilities teams, vendors, and global stakeholders across time zones.

title: Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
VMware NSX-T Data Center
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
HCX Core Support
  
  
Deploy and configure VMware HCX Connector, HCX Manager, and Service Mesh appliances across source and destination sites
  
  
Support bi-directional VM migrations using vMotion, Bulk Migration, Cold Migration, and Replication Assisted vMotion (RAV)
  
  
Manage HCX site pairing, fleet upgrades, and appliance lifecycle operations
  
  
Troubleshoot HCX interconnect, WAN optimization, and tunnel failures
  
  
MON — Mobility Optimized Networking
  
  
Configure and manage HCX Network Extension with MON to enable migrated VMs to reach segments within the SDDC without sending packets back to the source environment router Broadcom
  
  
Set Target Router Location (Cloud/On-premises) at per-VM granularity for vMotion- and RAV-migrated workloads
  
  
Configure and validate MON policy routes that define which traffic is routed through the source gateway versus traffic routed through the cloud gateway Broadcom
  
  
Diagnose and resolve network tromboning issues on Layer-2 extended segments
  
  
Enable/disable MON at the time of stretching a network or on already extended networks, and on an individual VM basis for VMs residing on extended networks in the SDDC Broadcom
  
  
NSX & Network Integration
  
  
Ensure NSX Tier-1 router is connected to a Tier-0 router in the cloud environment prior to enabling MON, and that Layer-2 network extensions terminate correctly on Tier-1
  
  
Validate NSX requirements for extended segments and troubleshoot Gateway/DHCP IP conflicts
  
  
Work with NSX-T constructs (T0/T1, segments, distributed routing) in destination SDDC environments
  
  
Cloud Platform Support
  
  
Support HCX deployments on VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, or Google Cloud VMware Engine
  
  
Ensure HCX Enterprise license activation for MON features
  
  
Coordinate with cloud platform teams for SDDC Compute Gateway configuration related to MON
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
6 - 7 years of experience in VMware virtualization and data center infrastructure
  
  
Hands-on experience with VMware HCX deployment and operations (HCX 4.x preferred)
  
  
Solid understanding of Mobility Optimized Networking (MON) and how it prevents network tromboning on extended L2 segments
  
  
Strong NSX-T knowledge: T0/T1 routers, segments, distributed firewall
  
  
Familiarity with VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vMotion, DRS)
  
  
Understanding of L2 network extension, VLAN stretching, and hybrid cloud networking
  
  
Experience with VMware Cloud on AWS or Azure VMware Solution is a plus
  
  
Knowledge of HCX Enterprise licensing requirements for MON activation
  
  
Proficiency in network troubleshooting (packet capture, routing tables, MTU/path analysis)
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**
VMware certifications: VCP-NV, VCP-DCV, VCAP, or HCX Specialist
  
  
Exposure to Broadcom/VMware support portal and KB-based troubleshooting
  
  
Scripting skills for automation (PowerCLI, Python, REST API for HCX)
  
  
Experience with FHRP (HSRP/VRRP) interactions with MON (a known compatibility consideration in HCX 4.7+)
  
  
Familiarity with HCX HA (High Availability) for Network Extension appliances
  
  
Key Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset for complex hybrid cloud network issues
  
  
Ability to collaborate across infrastructure, cloud, and network teams
  
  
Customer-facing support experience (L2/L3 escalation handling)
  
  
Clear documentation skills for runbooks and migration plan.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Maharashtra

description:

Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

**What we need:**

The MCIM Engineer is accountable for country and site-level administration, data integrity, workflow compliance and operational adoption of the Mission Critical Infrastructure Management platform across assigned data center facilities. Reporting directly to the in-country Manager, Operations Support, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the platform Director, MCIM and Asset Management, the role ensures critical assets, maintenance activities, incidents, operational changes, corrective actions and supporting evidence are accurately managed through MCIM as the authoritative operational system of record.

The role acts as the primary interface between Facility Operations and the central MCIM Platform team, translating platform standards, asset taxonomies, workflows and governance requirements into disciplined country and site-level execution. The MCIM Engineer supports users, monitors compliance, validates operational data, coordinates system improvements and ensures activities undertaken by employees, contractors and service providers are complete, traceable and audit-ready.

The Director, MCIM and Asset Management owns platform strategy, system standards, core workflow design, configuration governance, asset taxonomy and cross-country standardization. The in-country Manager, Operations Support owns local leadership, prioritization and integration of MCIM requirements into country operations. Facility Operations remains accountable for the safe and correct execution of operational work. The MCIM Engineer does not replace these accountabilities but ensures the work is properly planned, controlled, recorded and evidenced through the platform.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own country and site-level MCIM administration, adoption, data integrity and workflow compliance across assigned data center facilities, ensuring the platform is consistently used for applicable asset, maintenance, incident, change, corrective-action and operational activities.
* Maintain complete and accurate critical infrastructure asset records, including asset classifications, hierarchies, technical attributes, equipment relationships, dependencies, maintenance requirements, lifecycle status and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate asset-data preparation, validation, migration and reconciliation during new facility delivery, commissioning, operational readiness, expansion, retrofit, equipment replacement and decommissioning activities.
* Administer preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance workflows within MCIM, ensuring work orders are properly planned, authorized, assigned, executed, evidenced, reviewed and closed in accordance with approved maintenance strategies and operating requirements.
* Govern site-level incident, root cause and corrective-action records, ensuring events are correctly classified, escalated and linked to affected assets, with complete evidence and timely investigation, verification and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Administer operational change workflows, verifying that changes include the required scope, risk assessment, technical and operational review, authorization, implementation planning, asset linkage, communications, execution evidence and post-implementation validation.
* Monitor data quality and workflow performance, identifying incomplete records, untracked activities, duplicated data, configuration inconsistencies, control gaps and deviations from approved platform standards, and coordinating timely corrective action.
* Support MCIM implementation, configuration, enhancement, upgrade, integration, pilot and user acceptance testing activities, documenting operational requirements and validating that workflows and system outputs are effective for live data center operations.
* Develop operational dashboards and recurring reports, provide user training and first-line process support, and support internal and customer audits through accurate records, traceable workflows, complete evidence and timely remediation of identified gaps.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**The successful candidate:**

* Relevant experience in data center operations, critical facilities, infrastructure asset management, maintenance planning, operational systems administration or a comparable mission-critical or high-availability environment.
* Relevant degree, diploma or professional qualification in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, building services engineering, facilities management, information systems, asset management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Practical experience using or administering CMMS, DCIM, EAM, work-order management, asset-management, maintenance-management or comparable operational platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of asset lifecycle management, preventive and corrective maintenance, incident management, change control, operational risk assessment, corrective-action management and audit evidence requirements.
* Demonstrated experience maintaining accurate asset and operational data, resolving data-quality issues and record inconsistencies, and producing reliable operational reports and dashboards.
* Experience supporting system implementation, workflow configuration, data migration, platform enhancement, user acceptance testing or the integration of operational technology and enterprise systems.
* Sound understanding of data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, controls, monitoring, life-safety and associated building systems.
* Proven ability to work across Facility Operations, Engineering Operations, digital platform teams, project teams, contractors, vendors and service providers, supported by strong analytical, organizational, documentation and problem-solving capability.
* Must have strong English-language verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver user training, prepare high-quality operational reports, communicate compliance requirements and engage technical and senior stakeholders; familiarity with applicable asset management, quality, information security, business continuity, safety, environmental and ISO management systems is advantageous.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.
  
  
**What The Team Owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

**Required**
Your skills and experience that will help you excel
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.
  
  
MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please email Disability.Assistance@msci.com and indicate the specifics of the assistance needed. Please note, this e-mail is intended only for individuals who are requesting a reasonable workplace accommodation; it is not intended for other inquiries.

title: Vendor Personnel
description:
**Job Description**
**Shift – 24\*7 (Rotational)**
**Critical Infrastructure Engineer – Reliability & Infrastructure Analytics – For backlog and proactive gap fixing (L2/L3)**
**Role Purpose**
The Critical Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and improving the reliability of critical infrastructure supporting telecom and data centre operations. The role focuses on ensuring high availability of power, cooling and environmental systems while proactively identifying infrastructure risks, recurring alarms and opportunities for permanent corrective action. The engineer is expected to move beyond reactive incident handling by driving backlog reduction, equipment refresh planning and long-term infrastructure reliability improvements. This aligns with the current CI direction of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Critical Infrastructure Engineers/Technicians, ensuring effective shift coverage, operational governance, coaching, workload balancing and adherence to operational standards.
* Analyze infrastructure trends and proactively identify recurring alarms, noisy sites, aging infrastructure and operational gaps impacting service reliability.
* Drive Top Talker analysis, identify recurring failure patterns and develop permanent corrective action plans to eliminate repeat alarms and unnecessary dispatches.
* Review historical incidents, alarm trends and backlog tickets to identify systemic issues and recommend engineering improvements.
* Prepare and present analytical reports, dashboards and executive summaries highlighting recurring issues, infrastructure risks, equipment performance and operational improvements.
* Identify End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) equipment, evaluate operational risk and prepare structured equipment refresh and replacement plans for management review.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Vendors and Field teams to drive permanent remediation, equipment replacement and closure of long-pending infrastructure issues.
* Maintain ownership of backlog reduction initiatives and ensure ageing tickets are continuously reviewed, tracked and driven to closure.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies and proactive monitoring enhancements. This aligns with the CI objective of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.

**Additional Required Skills**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to identify recurring alarms, noisy sites and infrastructure risks using data analysis and operational reporting.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills with experience managing technical teams, conducting coaching sessions and driving operational governance.
* Excellent documentation skills with the ability to create and maintain detailed operational records, RCA reports, equipment history, maintenance documentation and knowledge articles that can be used for future troubleshooting, audits and continuous improvement.
* Ability to prepare executive-level reports and present infrastructure risks, backlog analysis, EOL/EOS recommendations and permanent-fix roadmaps to management.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across Operations, Engineering, Vendors, OEMs and Field teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Must have prior experience leading technical teams in a Telecom, Data Center or Critical Infrastructure environment.
* Experience preparing SOPs, MOPs, RCA documentation, equipment history records, maintenance logs and audit documentation.
* Experience working with BMS/DCIM/EMS platforms and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Exposure to asset lifecycle management, equipment refresh programs and preventive maintenance planning.
* Experience analyzing recurring infrastructure incidents and implementing permanent corrective actions.

**Key Deliverables**

* Reduction in recurring alarms and noisy sites through permanent corrective actions.
* Proactive identification and reporting of infrastructure risks, ageing assets and EOL/EOS equipment.
* Improved infrastructure reliability through analytical trend monitoring and preventive maintenance.
* Reduction in backlog and ageing infrastructure tickets.
* Comprehensive documentation and knowledge repositories that improve future troubleshooting, onboarding and operational continuity.
* Strong team performance, governance and continuous coaching to improve operational maturity.

  .

  .

  .

  **AI-assisted development / vibe coding**

  where useful.
* Identify
  **partnerships, strategic opportunities, and new business avenues**

  .

**What We're Looking For**

* **2–5 years of experience**

  , preferably from a
  **technology, product, engineering, analytics, or technical consulting background**

  .
* Strong understanding of
  **business, GTM, growth, and product thinking**

  .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

  **data, technology, and business problems simultaneously**

  .

  **decks, business cases, market analyses, and strategic recommendations**

  .

  **SEO, digital marketing, SaaS metrics, and growth**

  .

  **AI tools and vibe coding**

  .

**More Important Than Any Tool**

We are
**not hiring someone because they know Claude, ChatGPT, or vibe coding.**

These are tools that anyone can learn.

What matters is whether you can
**use your judgement**

:

* Can you identify the right problem?
* Can you ask the right questions?
* Can you distinguish a good idea from a bad one?

* Can you understand both the
  **technology and the business impact**

  ?

**We are looking for someone who uses AI to amplify their thinking — not someone who uses AI instead of thinking.**

title: L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer - Location - Mumbai
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer**

*Enterprise Backup • Commvault • DR/NDR • Data Protection*

**Position**

L2  Backup Administrator Engineer

**Experience**

5–10 Years

**Employment Type**

[Full-Time / Contract]

**Location**

Mumbai

**Primary Technology**

Commvault Backup & Recovery

**Preferred**

Veritas / Cloud Backup/Commvault

1. Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Commvault, with additional knowledge of Veritas for migration activities.

The engineer will manage backup and recovery across virtual machines, physical servers, databases, Kubernetes, storage infrastructure, and enterprise applications, while supporting DR/NDR operations, backup migrations, restoration, capacity planning, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

2. Key Responsibilities

Backup Solution Design & Implementation

**•**
Design, implement, configure, and manage enterprise backup solutions for critical systems, applications, and databases.

**•**
Understand application and infrastructure requirements and design appropriate backup policies and protection strategies.

**•**
Build new backup environments/solutions from scratch based on business and technical requirements.

**•**
Perform workload onboarding and migration to new backup platforms with minimum business disruption.

**•**
Configure backup policies, schedules, retention, storage pools, deduplication, compression, and auxiliary copy requirements.

**•**
Ensure backup solutions meet defined RPO, RTO, retention, and business continuity requirements.

Commvault Administration

**•**
Administer and troubleshoot Commvault Backup & Recovery environments, including CommCell, MediaAgents, storage pools, deduplication databases, libraries, policies, and schedules.

**•**
Manage backup, restore, auxiliary copy, retention, and storage operations.

**•**
Monitor backup health, failed/pending jobs, storage utilization, deduplication, and overall environment performance.

**•**
Troubleshoot Commvault configuration, infrastructure, connectivity, and performance issues.

**•**
Raise and manage OEM/vendor support cases and coordinate resolution through closure.

**•**
Implement applicable Commvault security and hardening capabilities.

Backup Monitoring & Operations

**•**
Monitor backup operations and ensure successful completion within agreed SLAs.

**•**
Review daily backup reports and identify failed, missed, pending, or abnormal jobs.

**•**
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring backup failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**•**
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly backup operational reports and dashboards.

Backup Troubleshooting & Restoration

**•**
Handling incidents and complex backup-related technical issues.

**•**
Troubleshoot backup and restore failures across VMware/VMs, physical servers, Linux, Windows, Solaris, Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, and enterprise applications.

**•**
Perform file-level, VM-level, database-level, and application-level restoration.

**•**
Validate restoration integrity and prepare RCA/corrective action plans for major incidents.

Disaster Recovery – DR/NDR

**•**
Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures.

**•**
Configure and maintain backup/replication copies at DR and NDR locations.

**•**
Enable backup protection for workloads migrated to DR and maintain required secondary copies.

**•**
Participate in DR drills, BCP exercises, and disaster recovery activities.

**•**
Validate restoration capability during DR drills and document observations and corrective actions.

Backup Migration

**•**
Plan and execute migration from legacy backup platforms to Commvault or other target platforms.

**•**
Support Veritas-to-Commvault workload migration.

**•**
Analyze existing policies, retention, storage consumption, and application dependencies before migration.

**•**
Validate successful backup and restoration after migration.

Capacity Planning & Optimization

**•**
Perform backup data sizing and capacity planning.

**•**
Monitor storage growth, deduplication ratios, compression, and retention consumption.

**•**
Optimize backup policies, storage utilization, backup windows, compression, deduplication, and auxiliary copy strategies.

Security & Compliance

**•**
Implement backup security and access controls as per organizational policies.

**•**
Support advanced Commvault security features and secure backup practices.

**•**
Support internal/external audits, including RBI and banking regulatory requirements where applicable.

**•**
Maintain audit evidence, backup reports, restoration records, policies, and governance documentation.

Documentation

**•**
Maintain up-to-date backup infrastructure and operational documentation.

**•**
Prepare Backup Architecture, Configuration, Policy Matrix, Backup/Restore SOPs, DR/NDR Configuration, Migration Plans, Health Check Reports, RCA documents, DR Drill documents, and Capacity Reports.

**•**
Update documentation after major configuration or infrastructure changes.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

**•**
Work with Application, Database, Server, Storage, Network, Security, and DR teams.

**•**
Understand application requirements and recommend suitable backup/recovery solutions.

**•**
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for complex issues and technical escalations.

**•**
Participate in change management, implementation planning, and technical reviews.

Extended & Major Incident Support

**•**
Handle complex and critical backup incidents independently.

**•**
Provide L3 support for major backup failures, data recovery issues, and infrastructure incidents.

**•**
Provide support during DR drills, migrations, planned maintenance, and major implementation activities during weekends/night shifts when required.

**•**
Leave/comp-off will be managed as per agreed organizational/customer terms and applicable policy.

Continuous Improvement

**•**
Prepare and implement a quarterly backup process improvement plan.

**•**
Identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.

**•**
Automate repetitive monitoring and operational activities where feasible.

**•**
Reduce recurring incidents through permanent corrective actions.

3. Mandatory Technical SkillsBackup Technologies

**•**
Strong hands-on experience with Commvault Backup & Recovery.

**•**
Enterprise backup administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, restore, retention, deduplication, compression, auxiliary copy, and capacity management.

Protected Workloads

**•**
VMware / Virtual Machines; Physical Servers; Linux; Windows; Solaris; Oracle; Microsoft SQL Server; PostgreSQL; MySQL; Kubernetes; Enterprise applications.

Storage & Infrastructure

**•**
Hands-on understanding of SAN, NAS, disk-based backup storage, backup repositories, storage capacity/performance, and deduplication storage.

**•**
Understanding of backup servers, MediaAgents, Fibre Channel, Ethernet networking, server hardware, and RAID concepts.

DR/NDR & Migration

**•**
Disaster Recovery concepts, secondary/replicated backup copies, DR/NDR architecture, DR drills, RPO/RTO, and restoration validation.

**•**
Experience migrating workloads from Veritas or other legacy platforms to Commvault.

4. Preferred Skills & CertificationsCertifications

**•**
Commvault certification.

**•**
Veritas Backup certification/experience.

**•**
Relevant cloud backup certification.

Additional Knowledge

**•**
Aws , GCP , Hitachi Vantara and Commvault backup technologies.

**•**
VMware and Kubernetes backup/recovery.

**•**
Backup security, ransomware protection, immutable backup, and air-gapped backup concepts.

**•**
Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall concepts, and required ports.

**•**
ITIL / ITSM processes and Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

5. QualificationsEducation

**•**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

**•**
5–10 years of experience in enterprise Backup Administration.

**•**
3+ years of hands-on Commvault experience preferred.

**•**
Experience in L2/L3 support, implementation, troubleshooting, migration, and DR operations.

6. Key CompetenciesProfessional Competencies

**•**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

**•**
Ability to perform RCA for complex technical issues.

**•**
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**•**
Ability to work independently at L2/L3 level.

**•**
Good documentation and reporting skills.

**•**
Ability to coordinate with multiple technical teams and vendors.

**•**
Ability to work under pressure during critical incidents and DR activities.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance Measures

**•**
Backup success rate and SLA adherence.

**•**
Backup failure resolution time.

**•**
Restoration success rate.

**•**
RPO/RTO and retention compliance.

**•**
DR/NDR backup availability and successful DR drills.

**•**
Backup storage and capacity optimization.

**•**
Reduction in recurring backup incidents.

**•**
Timely RCA and corrective action implementation.

**•**
Documentation and audit compliance.

**•**
Quarterly process improvement implementation.

8. Ideal Candidate ProfileProfile

**•**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on L2/L3 Backup Administrator with strong Commvault expertise, capable of independently managing enterprise backup infrastructure, troubleshooting complex backup/restore issues, supporting DR/NDR environments, performing Veritas-to-Commvault migration, handling database and Kubernetes backups, and driving continuous improvement.

**•**
Candidates with experience in large enterprise or banking environments, particularly those familiar with RBI/compliance requirements, DR drills, NDR, air-gapped/secure backup, and critical application recovery, will be preferred.

title: Data Center Technician (DCO), Data Center Operations

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
  
  
ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.
  
  
At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
A Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:
  
  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

A day in the life
  
  

* You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
* You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.
* You will perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.

title: Senior Associate - Atlassian Workplace Platforms
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The Atlassian Platform team owns the governance, configuration, and continuous improvement of MSCI’s Atlassian Cloud environment — Jira Software, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery, and Rovo — which serves as the operational backbone for approximately two-thirds of MSCI’s global workforce. We keep the platform reliable, well-governed, and strategically aligned with how MSCI works. Beyond keeping the lights on, we are the internal centre of expertise for what the Atlassian platform can do — including its rapidly expanding AI capabilities — and how to use those capabilities in ways that are practical, cost-justified, and genuinely useful to the teams that depend on us.
  
  
We are establishing a presence in Mumbai to extend our operational coverage into the APAC timezone and build a trusted platform relationship with MSCI’s India-based stakeholder community. This role is that presence. You will enter through deep operational immersion — learning how a regulated financial technology firm uses Atlassian at enterprise scale — and grow into a broader mandate as you demonstrate the judgment and organizational fluency to advise internal teams on how to solve their real problems using the platform, including where AI fits and where it does not.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary APAC point of contact for the Atlassian Platform Support queue: triaging and resolving platform requests covering Jira project setup, Confluence space configuration, API token provisioning and renewal, board configuration, permission management, and user access — handling these with both technical accuracy and clear stakeholder communication.
* Manage Atlassian REST API tokens and service account credentials for teams integrating Jira and Confluence into automation pipelines, reporting tools, and AI agents — including provisioning, expiry monitoring, rotation, and advising requestors on appropriate access scoping.
* Execute platform administration and KTLO activities: Jira and Confluence configuration maintenance, sandbox environment lifecycle management, licensing inventory support, and governance documentation — building operational depth that becomes the foundation for everything else.
* Advise internal stakeholder teams on how to solve workflow and collaboration problems within the Atlassian platform, distinguishing between requests that need configuration work, requests that could benefit from AI-assisted automation, and requests where the right answer is a simpler process rather than a new tool.
* Evaluate AI use cases within the Atlassian ecosystem — Rovo agents, AI-assisted automation rules, Confluence AI features — with a practical lens: does this use case justify its token cost, does it solve a real process problem, and is it sustainable at scale? MSCI’s Procurement function monitors AI spend, and your advisory work directly informs those cost decisions.
* Build and maintain documentation in Confluence for platform standards, support procedures, and recurring processes — progressively converting tribal knowledge into institutional knowledge accessible to the teams that need it.
* Develop working relationships with MSCI’s internal stakeholder functions — InfoSec, IT Risk, Privacy, Compliance, PMO, Product, and Finance — learning their constraints, building credibility, and becoming the person those teams trust to engage when they have a platform or AI tooling question.
* Participate in Atlassian Platform Roadmap sprint ceremonies with the Monterrey (Mexico) team, contributing operational insight from the APAC support queue to inform platform roadmap prioritization and governance decisions.

Your Growth Path
  
  
This role is support-first by design, not by limitation. The Atlassian platform at MSCI is complex, highly governed, and deeply embedded in how the firm operates. Understanding it well enough to give good advice takes time and direct exposure — and that exposure comes through the support queue.
  
  
The progression to broader platform ownership — including contribution to integration decisions, enterprise reporting, and firm-wide AI tooling advisory — is earned through a specific kind of readiness: the ability to independently navigate MSCI’s internal stakeholder landscape. You will be ready when you can engage InfoSec on API governance, work through IT Risk on platform change approvals, align with Privacy on Confluence data handling, and advise PMO, Product, and Finance on platform configuration choices without requiring escalation. The team will invest actively in getting you there.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* 3–5 years of experience working with Jira Cloud and/or Confluence Cloud in an enterprise environment, with hands-on familiarity with project and space administration, workflow configuration, and permission management.
* Working knowledge of Atlassian REST APIs: you understand token-based authentication, can help a team diagnose an access failure, and know the difference between what should be an API integration and what should just be a native automation rule.
* Genuine, applied AI fluency — not familiarity in theory but changed behavior in practice. You use AI tools to do your actual work faster and better. Critically, you also know when not to use AI: when a simpler approach is more reliable, more maintainable, or more cost-effective. That judgment is as valuable as the capability.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, with the professional confidence to engage senior internal stakeholders clearly, manage expectations accurately, and translate technical platform constraints into language that non-technical audiences can act on.
* A service mindset with operational discipline: you treat support as a craft, not a waiting room. You document what you learn, identify patterns in recurring requests, and look for the upstream fix rather than just closing the ticket.
* Comfort in an asynchronous, distributed team model with a significant timezone gap. You own your queue independently, keep the Monterrey (Mexico) team unblocked, and communicate proactively rather than waiting to be asked.
* This is an individual contributor role. Atlassian certifications are a plus but not a prerequisite. Deep scripting experience is not required at entry. What matters most is platform judgment, communication credibility, and the kind of AI literacy that makes you a trusted advisor rather than an enthusiast.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.
  
  
MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please email Disability.Assistance@msci.com and indicate the specifics of the assistance needed. Please note, this e-mail is intended only for individuals who are requesting a reasonable workplace accommodation; it is not intended for other inquiries.

MSCI does not accept unsolicited CVs/Resumes. Please do not forward CVs/Resumes to any MSCI employee, location, or website. MSCI is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs/Resumes.

title: Configuration Manager
description:
Job description:
  
  
Configuration Manager

**Location:**
India, Mumbai

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business-to-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.

 About the Role

Agfa is seeking a
**Configuration Manager**
to join its Global ICS (Information & Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and governance of configuration and asset information across Agfa's global IT environment. You will own the Configuration Management process and ensure that the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) accurately reflects the current state of IT services, infrastructure, applications, and assets throughout their lifecycle.

As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will support critical IT processes including Change Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Asset Management, and Risk Management. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, business units, service providers, and technology partners to ensure reliable data, effective governance, and operational excellence.

 About You (Skills Required)

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about data quality and governance. You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders, improving processes, and creating transparency across complex IT environments.

You possess:

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* A structured and process-driven mindset.
* Strong understanding of data quality, governance, and compliance principles.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

 What You'll Do (Duties & Responsibilities)

* Own and continuously improve the Configuration Management process.
* Ensure Configuration Item (CI) records remain accurate, complete, and up to date throughout their lifecycle.
* Manage, maintain, and enhance the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), including data structures, standards, and governance controls.
* Support Change Management by ensuring configuration data is available, accurate, and aligned with approved changes.
* Conduct configuration audits and verification activities to ensure compliance and data accuracy.
* Monitor and improve data integrity and quality across configuration and asset records.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, business units, vendors, and service providers to maintain accurate configuration information.
* Validate and reconcile managed Configuration Items with Agfa business units.
* Ensure timely tracking and return of leased devices to leasing companies.
* Produce governance reports, metrics, and compliance reporting related to configuration and asset management.
* Manage configuration-related escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Act as backup for the Change Manager when required.

 What You'll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Configuration Management, Asset Management, IT Service Management, or IT Operations.
* Strong understanding of Configuration Management principles, CMDB governance, and IT asset lifecycle management.
* Experience working with CMDB platforms and asset management solutions.
* Solid understanding of IT Service Management processes, including Change, Incident, and Problem Management.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and collaborating with external service providers.
* Strong reporting, data governance, and process management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
* ITIL Foundation certification or comparable IT Service Management certification is considered an asset.

 Why Join Us

* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that underpins business-critical operations worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, and operational stability across Agfa's global IT landscape.
* Help build a reliable and transparent IT environment that enables effective service delivery and informed decision-making.

If you are passionate about Configuration Management, governance, data integrity, and continuous improvement, and you enjoy working in a global IT environment, we invite you to join Agfa and contribute to the reliability and effectiveness of our worldwide IT services.

**SUSTAINABLE, AGILE, CONNECTED, FORWARD LOOKING**

Ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of Procurement? Join the team and bring your expertise on board! As part of DHL Group, you will be working with a global network of Procurement colleagues and benefit from a wide range of development opportunities.
  
  
We are looking for an immediate, full-time, permanent position in APAC at Mumbai, India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**

* Lead the global roll-out and operational administration of Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) solutions within the Source-to-Contract (S2C) landscape. Drive successful deployment, user adoption, and continuous improvement of CLM tools and integrations, ensuring compliance with procurement standards and policies. Act as the primary point of contact for system administration, run support, and change management, delivering service excellence.
* Own the end-to-end configuration workstream by consolidating local requirements into standardized processes. Document business requirements with BPOs and translate them into automated tool workflows. Serve as the subject matter expert for functional, integration, and user acceptance testing of the CLM application.
* Focus on optimizing contract management and S2C processes through AI-powered tools and automation. Play a key role in enhancing efficiency, reducing risk, and strengthening overall contract management capabilities.

**Your tasks:**
**CLM application governance**

* Translate stakeholder requirements (legal, procurement, business) into scalable technical solutions.
* Advise business process experts on tool-supported solutions to meet functional needs.
* Lead end-to-end functional and integration testing, including scenario design and execution for CLM features.
* Analyze current contract management processes and workflows to identify automation and efficiency opportunities.

**Roll-out Management:**

* Execute global CLM roll-outs, including testing, migration, and stakeholder onboarding.
* Coordinate within Procurement the release management, change requests, and incident handling to ensure business continuity.
* Develop and deliver training materials and user documentation in collaboration with other workstreams to drive adoption.

**Run Administration:**

* Act as system administrator for CLM applications, managing configurations, workflows, and integrations. In charge of the application governance.
* Monitor system performance, manage ticket triage, and implement measures to reduce incidents.
* Conduct service reviews and ensure SLA compliance for support activities.

**Continuous Improvement & Governance:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process optimization opportunities.
* Maintain governance of templates, clauses, and metadata in CLM systems.
* Drive automation initiatives and apply AI/LCNC tools to enhance efficiency.

description:

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted business motions.
