title: Vocational Teacher
description:
Job Title - Vocational Teacher
  
  
Location- Mumbai,Navi Mumbai, Thane
  
  
Job Type- Full-Time
  
  
Reports to- Programme Lead
  
  
Salary- 40,000 pm - 50,000 pm
  
  
**About The Project**
Sol’s ARC is an NGO working to create inclusive opportunities for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) in education and livelihoods.
  
  
This role is part of our
**Vocational Training Programme**
, which prepares PwDs for work through structured batches (June–December and January–April) and supports them into internships, on-the-job training and jobs.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a
**teaching-plus-placement role**
that covers the full journey of a student. The person will be responsible for
**mobilising students, planning and delivering classes, mapping each student to a suitable job, and supporting them after placement so that they stay and grow in their work**
.
  
  
The role requires someone who enjoys teaching, understands the learning and support needs of PwDs, and can balance
**classroom management, community outreach and employer coordination**
.
  
  
The person will divide their time between the classroom and the field — visiting communities for outreach, workplaces for job analysis and sensitisation, and placed students for follow-up.
  
  
**What Will You Typically Do?**
You will run two batches a year (June–December and January–April), working across the classroom, the community and partner workplaces.
  
  

* Outreach and Admissions
* Build partnerships with NGOs, schools and community organisations — at least 2 per batch cycle — to generate student referrals.
* Conduct at least 5 outreach activities (calls, visits, sessions) per batch cycle to mobilise prospective students.
* Enrol at least 10 students in each batch.
* Conduct baseline assessments for all candidates before the batch begins.
* Collect, verify and upload all candidate documents and assessment records to the designated drive on time.
* Plan the Curriculum and Schedules
* Develop curriculum and session plans, with objectives and teaching resources, before each batch starts.
* Prepare monthly and weekly schedules for teachers and trainers, balancing academic and skill-building sessions.
* Conduct endline assessments for all students within one week of training ending.
* Manage the Classroom
* Run sessions smoothly by maintaining discipline, following lesson plans and keeping students engaged.
* Complete attendance for all ongoing batches by end of day.
* Complete 100% of lesson plans as per the monthly teaching schedule.
* Maintain each student’s performance record — attendance, work pace, communication, behaviour, task completion and level of independence.
* Map Students to Suitable Jobs
* Profile each student’s skills, interests, abilities and support needs before placement.
* Conduct workplace and task analysis with partner employers, covering physical, communication and behavioural requirements.
* Match students to suitable job roles and confirm requirements with candidates and parents.
* Maintain complete job mapping sheets and supporting documents.
* Placement and Post-Placement Support
* Facilitate internships, on-the-job training and placements, and visit workplaces to guide students.
* Conduct sensitisation sessions at the workplace within 3 days of each student’s joining and prepare a sensitisation report.
* Follow up monthly with placed students and employers; provide counselling and resolve challenges as per the post-placement SOP.
* Maintain post-placement tracking sheets and counselling records for all placed students.

**How will your success be measured for your role?**
**KPI**
**Success Measure**
**Outreach & Admissions**
5+ outreach activities and 2+ partnerships per cycle; at least 10 students enrolled per batch
**Assessments**
Baseline done for all students before batch start; endline within 1 week of training end
**Curriculum Planning**
Curriculum and session plans ready before batch start; batches run to schedule
**Classroom Management**
Daily attendance completed; 100% lesson plans delivered on schedule
**Session Quality**
80%+ positive student feedback on engagement and delivery
**Job Mapping**
90%+ of eligible students mapped to suitable job roles
**Placement**
40%+ of students selected for internship or placement
**Retention**
Placed students retained, with monthly follow-ups as per SOP
**Documentation**
All student, assessment, job mapping and post-placement records complete and uploaded on time
  
  
**Who Are We Looking For?**

* Holds a graduate degree in Special Education, a related field; B.Ed./D.Ed. in Special Education is complusory
* Has 2–4 years of experience in teaching, vocational training or skill development, ideally with PwDs.
* Can plan lessons, run assessments and manage a classroom of learners with different abilities and support needs.
* Has experience with job mapping, placements or employer engagement, or is keen to learn.
* Can build trust with students, parents, partner organisations and employers.
* Is organised and good at documentation, follow-up and meeting timelines.
* Can use basic digital tools — Google Drive, Sheets and mobile apps.
* Can communicate clearly in the local language and Hindi; basic English is an advantage.
* Believes that Persons with Disabilities have the right to learn, work, earn and make their own choices.
* Is willing to travel locally for outreach, workplace visits and post-placement follow-ups.

**What We Offer**

* Fair and competitive pay — Salary as per Sol’s ARC pay scale, based on your experience and skills.
* Travel support — Reimbursement for programme-related outreach, workplace and follow-up visits.
* Health & accident cover — Insurance support to give you greater peace of mind successfully completed probation period
* Flexibility with accountability — Clear outcomes and targets, with the freedom to plan your classes and fieldwork.
* Learning & growth — Hands-on training, regular guidance and support from an experienced programme team.
* Meaningful work — The opportunity to teach Persons with Disabilities and help them build pathways to employment, independence and greater choice.

title: Service Desk Analyst – APAC
description:
**About Monster Energy**
Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
As a Service Desk Analyst, you'll power the business by delivering fast, reliable IT support through phone, Microsoft Teams, email, and ServiceNow. You'll take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving hardware, software, account access, and mobile device issues, partnering with Desktop Support, global IT teams, and external vendors to drive solutions when escalation is needed.
  
  
You'll support users primarily in English while assisting a diverse global workforce, maintain accurate ticket documentation, contribute to our knowledge base, and ensure issues are resolved within SLA commitments. Success in this role means combining technical expertise, a customer-first mindset, and a relentless focus on keeping our teams connected and productive.
  
  
**The Impact You'll Make**

* Serve as the first point of contact for Monster Energy employees across APAC, handling technical support requests by phone, Microsoft Teams, email and the ServiceNow self-service portal.
* Log, categorize, prioritize and track all incidents and service requests in ServiceNow, and monitor the queue so tickets are resolved and closed within SLA with clear troubleshooting and resolution notes.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software and connectivity issues remotely using remote support tools, and provide walk-up support at the India office in partnership with local Desktop Support.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint and the Office apps.
* Manage user accounts, group memberships and password resets in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and self-service password reset support.
* Enroll, configure and troubleshoot Windows, macOS and iOS devices in Microsoft Intune, including app deployment, compliance policies and remote lock, wipe.
* Support remote onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access requests, and coordinating equipment logistics with local offices and vendors, and keep asset and software license records in ServiceNow accurate.
* Identify and escalate major incidents under incident management procedures, route issues with complete information to the right resolver groups (Desktop Support, Infrastructure, Applications, Security), and work with APAC vendors such as wireless carriers and hardware providers to resolve issues.
* Create and maintain ServiceNow knowledge base articles in English and, where appropriate, Hindi; guide users to self-service solutions; provide basic end-user training; and tell APAC users about relevant system changes.
* Provide follow-the-sun coverage by giving clear shift handoffs to the Americas and EMEA Service Desk teams, work flexible schedules that include occasional after-hours or weekend support for critical issues, and follow IT, security and local data privacy policies.

**Who You Are**

* Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of -- Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* Flexible to work 6:30 AM to 3:30 PM IST, Monday through Friday, ensuring seamless support coverage across multiple time zones and maintaining service availability during designated support hours.
* Additional Experience Desired: Minimum 1 year of experience in an IT help desk role using a ticketing system
* Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in supporting users in multiple countries
* Computer Skills Desired: Windows and Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment. Active Directory and ITIL-based processes (incident, request, and problem management), ServiceNow ITSM
* Preferred Certifications: CompTIA A+, ITIL 4 Foundation, and/or Microsoft certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate) preferred
* Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Fluent in English and Hindi, both written and spoken

The role focuses on AI model validation, data quality assessment, performance testing, responsible AI compliance, and the automation of testing processes to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, secure, and high-quality AI solutions.As MUFG Retirement Solutions continues to embed AI across its technology landscape, this role plays a key part in driving the adoption of AI-enabled testing practices and automation capabilities. The position is responsible for identifying innovative and cost-effective solutions, leveraging AI to enhance testing efficiency, quality, and coverage while promoting industry best practices.The role also ensures that the AI testing and automation strategy aligns with business objectives, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and the broader technology vision of MUFG Retirement Solutions.Key Accountabilities and main responsibilitiesStrategic Focus Develop and execute testing strategies for AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, performance, and business value. Define and implement robust AI test frameworks, methodologies, and automation solutions covering functional, integration, API, system, end-to-end, model validation, data validation, prompt validation, and adversarial testing scenarios. Establish comprehensive validation processes for AI model outputs against business requirements, acceptance criteria, Responsible AI principles, regulatory standards, and organizational governance policies. Drive quality assurance across the complete AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and reporting. Assess AI solution performance across dimensions such as accuracy, relevance, consistency, explainability, fairness, robustness, and reliability. Integrate AI testing activities and test automation framework & scripts with continuous integration, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support continuous testing and deployment of AI solutions. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and project managers to define testing requirements, success criteria, and quality measures. Manage the execution of automated test suites, monitor the test results and collaborate with teams to troubleshoot and resolve the issues promptly. Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk management activities, ensuring timely resolution of issues impacting AI model performance and business outcomes. Champion the adoption of AI-enabled testing tools, intelligent automation techniques, synthetic test data generation, and predictive quality engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and coverage. Drive research and evaluation of emerging AI testing methodologies, LLM evaluation frameworks, model benchmarking techniques, automation technologies, and industry best practices, providing strategic recommendations for continuous improvement. Establish and govern enterprise standards, processes, controls, and best practices for AI testing, validation, Responsible AI compliance, and model quality assurance across multiple AI initiatives. Operational ManagementDesign, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for AI, ML, and Generative AI applications. Validate data quality, data integrity, and data lineage across AI systems and supporting platforms. Lead functional, integration, API, regression, user acceptance, and end-to-end testing of AI-enabled solutions. Assess AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucinations, explainability, fairness, and alignment with business requirements and responsible AI standards. Execute prompt testing, response validation, and scenario-based testing for Generative AI solutions. Execute model validation and inference testing activities, ensuring AI solutions perform consistently across diverse datasets, use cases, and operating conditions. Monitor and analyse test execution results, quality metrics, and model performance indicators, producing actionable insights and comprehensive test reports for stakeholders. Identify, document, track, and drive resolution of defects, model performance issues, data quality concerns, and AI-specific risks throughout the testing lifecycle. Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality AI solutions. Support test data preparation, environment validation, and model release verification activities. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities. Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices. Mentor junior testers and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives. Governance & RiskIdentify quality, model, data, security, privacy, ethical, and compliance risks associated with AI solutions and proactively support mitigation activities. Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards. Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns. Maintain appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements. Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes. The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.Experience & Personal AttributesExperience5+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, and AI-driven testing, with preference for candidates having 4+ years of experience in Retirement Solutions, Financial Services, or BFSI domains. Strong experience in designing, developing, and executing AI-powered test automation frameworks and quality assurance solutions using tools such as Selenium, Appium, UFT/OpenText (at least one mandatory), Python, Maven, Postman, REST APIs, SoapUI, Cortex, and Snowflake. Hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted testing tools and technologies for test case generation, test optimization, defect prediction, intelligent test execution, and quality analytics. Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices, including test strategy, test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, reporting, and test governance. Experience validating AI/ML-enabled applications, including model testing, data quality validation, prompt testing and optimization, response evaluation, bias and fairness assessment, hallucination detection, adversarial testing, explainability validation, and performance assessment of AI-powered systems. Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Quality Assurance (SQA) processes across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Azure Repos, Bitbucket, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define quality standards, establish AI testing governance, track AI model evaluation metrics and quality KPIs, automate validation processes, and ensure reliable, scalable, and secure AI-driven applications. Experience with cloud platforms, data validation, API testing, integration testing, and complex enterprise environments is highly desirable. Lead AI testing strategy and provide technical leadership for AI testing initiatives. Collaborate with Developers, Testers, and Business Analysts to design test cases and develop them using AI and automation testing tools. Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and API testing using tools such as Postman and REST Assured. Manage defects through JIRA and Azure DevOps and produce comprehensive test evidence documentation. Develop and execute end-to-end test automation solutions covering the entire data lifecycle, from raw data through to the reporting layer. Mentor team members and support the onboarding, training, and upskilling of testers in AI and automation testing tools, frameworks, and best practices. Automotive/Insurance Brokership (Modi Hyundai / Krishiv Insurance Broking LLP-Principal Officer) operates at the intersection of automotive sales and insurance services, supporting customers through vehicle purchase, policy selection, and renewals. * A minimum of a high school diploma; a graduate degree in any discipline is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of English and local languages used in Thane is preferred.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
description:
**We’re Hiring | Executive Assistant to the Founder – CashFlo**
Location: Andheri East, Mumbai
  
  
**Experience: 0–2 years**
CashFlo is looking for a proactive, organised, and dependable Executive Assistant to work closely with the Founder. The role involves managing calendars, coordinating meetings, planning travel, and ensuring day-to-day priorities run smoothly.
  
  
**Introduction**
$11 trillion of money flows every year between companies in India. It typically takes avg. 70 days for a business to get paid, and it’s increasing 5% every year. Formal funding options are limited, and cover < 5% of the addressable market. We are building India’s largest B2B Payments Platform that transforms how businesses pay and get paid. The platform already processes INR 20,000+ Crores of invoices every month, across 300,000 MSMEs and 1200+ corporates; with 30+ lenders plugged in for credit. Globally, companies in this space, like Coupa, Bill.com, Melio, C2FO, Tipalti, have witnessed tremendous success over the past decade doing $ Billion+ disbursements weekly and cumulatively valued over $50 Billion. You will join our core team that currently consists of ex-BCG and ISB / IIM alumni with a team of industry veterans serving on the advisory board. We are backed by Elevation Capital (one of the most successful VCs in India) and General Catalyst ($15 Billion+ global fund, and early investors in Stripe, Airbnb etc.). We share our lineage with HCS, a 25 year old investment bank and a registered NBFC. We are a team of passionate problem solvers and we’re building a technology company with a strong product innovation mindset. We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive and unflappable. S/he is a self-starter, thrives in a dynamic, small start-up environment, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of getting things done. If you check these boxes - we want to talk to you!
  
  
**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Manage the Founder’s calendar, schedule meetings, and handle reschedules and conflicting priorities.
* Plan and book domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, cabs, and detailed itineraries.
* Coordinate with investors, clients, internal teams, and other stakeholders.
* Prepare meeting agendas, take notes, and track action items and follow-ups.
* Manage emails, draft professional communications, and ensure timely responses.
* Handle travel expenses, reimbursements, and other administrative requirements.
* Support the Founder’s Office with day-to-day coordination and special assignments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 0–2 years of experience in executive assistance, administration, coordination, or a similar role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Hindi is a plus.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive, dependable approach with the ability to anticipate needs and work independently.
* High integrity and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace / Microsoft Office and calendar management tools.
* Prior experience leading teams or being actively involved in college societies, student committees, or event coordination is a strong plus.

**The ideal fit:**
Someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and can stay organised in a fast-paced startup environment. This is an opportunity to work directly with the Founder and gain exposure to leadership, decision-making, and how a company is built and run.
  
  
**Interested?**
Send your resume to careers@cashflo.io.

title: Lead - Teacher Recruitment
description:
**Our Company**

Artium is a global music learning platform founded with the vision of making world-class music education accessible to learners everywhere. By combining the expertise of legendary musicians, a structured curriculum, cutting-edge technology, and a thriving learner community, Artium is reimagining how music is taught, learned, and experienced at scale. Using our proprietary technology platform and a network of more than 350+ highly trained teachers, we deliver music education to more than 45000 learners across 17+ countries.

As India's first music education platform offering internationally accredited pathways, Artium is building the future of music education for learners across the world.

*“Immerse yourself in a culture that celebrates both your artistic passion and personal*

*development”*

**The Opportunity**

As Lead-Teacher Recruitment, you will own teacher hiring across Artium’s online and offline centres. Our teaching network is growing fast, so you will run high-volume, high-speed hiring while keeping a high bar on teaching quality. You will build and lead the hiring engine: sourcing, screening, demo evaluation, offers and onboarding handover.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own end-to-end hiring of music teachers (vocals, guitar, piano/keyboard) for online and offline centres
* Run bulk hiring drives, including walk-ins, virtual drives and multi-city hiring
* Build teacher pipelines through job portals, social media, music schools and referrals
* Forecast teacher demand with academic and centre leadership
* Manage screening, demo classes and panel evaluations
* Track time-to-hire, offer-to-join ratio and quality of hire
* Mentor a small team of recruiters as volumes grow
* Strengthen Artium’s employer brand among musicians and educators

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4-8 years in recruitment, with 2+ years in a lead role
* Proven bulk and high-volume hiring experience
* Comfort with fast-paced, deadline-driven hiring
* Strong sourcing skills, including social and community-led channels
* Experience hiring for both online and on-ground roles
* Data-driven, with working knowledge of ATS tools and reporting

**Good to Have**

* Education, ed-tech or creative industry hiring experience
* Interest in music and the performing arts
* Experience with demo or audition-based hiring

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of India’s first music education platform with internationally accredited pathways
* Work with legendary musicians and a fast-growing global community
* High ownership and real impact on how music is taught at scale

title: SOC Analyst
description:
We are hiring a full-time SOC Analyst who is technical, dedicated to learning new things, security-minded, has strong initiative, and is able to manage projects autonomously. The Information Security team defends the company’s digital infrastructure by designing, implementing, and improving the company’s cybersecurity architecture. This is a critical role responsible for protecting infrastructure, cloud, edge devices, and data against unauthorized use, modification, exfiltration, or damage. If you’re excited to be part of a fast-growing, then Medpace is a great place to grow your career.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Engineer security solutions without oversight while collaborating with multiple internal departments and vendors;
* Analyze security systems and seek continuous improvements;
* Research vulnerabilities, perform vulnerability scanning and alleviate threats;
* Mature security best practices and policies internal to the organization;
* Develop new processes while cross-training coworkers and assisting employees on security-related matters;
* Provide security awareness training and testing for employees to verify proper security protocols are being adhered to;
* Performing cyber security incident triage, reviewing logs, and performing remediation activities; and
* Review and reduce inappropriate/overprovisioned access to drive least privileged access.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of bachelor's degree, preferably in Cybersecurity or Information Technology;
* Prior Internship/co-op experience within Information Security
* Understanding of security best practices and how to implement them at a business-wide level
* Experience with using and maintaining some of the following:

+ SIEM
+ Endpoint Detection & Response
+ Cloud based architecture such as Azure
+ Privileged Access Management/Identity Access
+ Active Directory

* Soft skills including exceptional communication skills, working well in small groups, and analytical thinking with the ability to solve complications
* Fundamental scripting skills, such as PowerShell/Python

**Medpace Overview**
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.
  
  
**Why Medpace?**
When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
***Purpose-Driven Work***




+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

***Collaborative Culture***




+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***




+ Office based environment with on-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

**Other Employee Benefits**




+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company-sponsored social events

*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*
**What To Expect Next**
A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

  **e-commerce, retail, or fast-paced business environment**
  .

  **recruitment, payroll, employee relations, attendance, disciplinary procedures, and HR administration**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **Indian labour laws and statutory compliance**
  .

  **PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, and payroll processes**
  will be preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and sensitive matters professionally.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Good working knowledge of
  **MS Excel and HR/payroll systems**
  .

title: AREBIC SHAWAYA CHEF
description:
**Company Description**
Restrosmart Hospitality Consultancy is a growing hospitality advisory firm that supports restaurants and food service businesses with concept development, kitchen planning, and operational optimization. The consultancy partners with clients to design menus, streamline workflows, and improve customer experience across diverse culinary formats. By combining industry expertise with practical guidance, Restrosmart helps businesses build sustainable and efficient operations. **Role Description**
The Arabic Shawaya Chef will be responsible for planning, preparing, and cooking authentic Arabic shawaya dishes, ensuring consistent quality, taste, and presentation. Day-to-day tasks include marinating and grilling meats, managing portion sizes, overseeing food safety and hygiene standards, and coordinating with kitchen staff to meet service timelines. The chef will assist in menu development, standardize recipes, control food costs, and maintain inventory levels for ingredients and supplies. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Mumbai, with primary work at client locations or test kitchens and limited work-from-home time for menu planning, documentation, and coordination. The role also involves training junior staff on techniques, participating in tastings with clients, and providing input on equipment and kitchen layout related to shawaya operations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in Arabic cuisine, specifically shawaya preparation, marination, grilling techniques, and flavor profiling.
* Proficiency in kitchen operations, including food safety, hygiene practices, recipe standardization, and portion control.
* Experience in menu development, costing, and inventory management within a restaurant or catering environment.
* Ability to train and supervise kitchen staff, collaborate with consultants and clients, and maintain clear communication.
* Prior experience as a chef or cook specializing in Middle Eastern or Arabic cuisine; exposure to hospitality consulting is an advantage.
* Willingness to work in a hybrid setup in Mumbai, with flexibility for client visits, evening or weekend service as needed.
* Basic written documentation skills for recording recipes, procedures, and operational guidelines; familiarity with digital tools is beneficial.
* Professional culinary training or certification is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with strong practical experience.

* **Minimum % Required:**

  8-10 years

***B. Preferred Criteria (if applicable)***

* **Must Have Skills:**

1. Strong exposure to HR Strategy, performance management, Learning & Development and talent acquisition.
2. Strong capability in developing, documenting, and standardizing HR policies and SOPs aligned with organizational objectives.
3. Hands-on experience in large organizations with pan-India operations, managing and navigating complex, multi-layered organizational structures.
4. Experience in environments where HR policies are centrally designed and locally executed, ensuring consistency while addressing regional needs.
5. Good understanding of core HR functions and processes.
6. Experience in employee lifecycle management tools.
7. Ability of cross functional coordination and stakeholder management.
8. Strong communication, interpersonal skills, analytical skills and problem-solving skills.
9. Strong documentation and data management skills.
10. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
11. Experience in engagement with HR Consultants (Preferred)

*Relevant Industry/Domain Experience: Housing finance/financial services ecosystem*

* **Certifications (if any):**
  Certification in Excel
* **Languages Required:**
  English / Hindi

**3. Interview & Selection Process**

* **Interview (Online / In-person):**
  Face to Face Interview

**4. Roles & Responsibilities:**

**1. Recruitment & Staffing**

• Manage end-to-end hiring for all cadres and critical roles.

• Develop manpower plans in collaboration with the business heads.

• Shortlist candidates, schedule interviews, conduct HR rounds and coordinate assessments.

• Maintain recruitment trackers, dashboards, and MIS.

• Liaise with recruitment agencies for sourcing and onboarding.

• Support onboarding of apprentices including identification of vacancies and participating in recruitment drives through agencies.

**2. Training & Development**

• Coordinate training programs, nominations, attendance, logistics, and content collation.

• Conduct Training needs identification with Heads.

• Design Learning & Development framework aligned with regulatory & organizational requirements.

• Maintain training MIS, feedback reports and training effectiveness documentation.

• Plan monthly/quarterly training calendars.

• Facilitate arrangements for training infrastructure for functional and induction programs.

• Coordinate with expert agencies, external organizations and external faculty for training delivery.

• Float training feedback forms in eHRMS and track responses.

**3. HR Operations & employee lifecycle management**

• Manage employee onboarding, documentation, joining formalities and induction process.

• Maintain employee files, HRMS data and assist in employee confirmations.

• Support leave & attendance, transfers, travel reimbursements and general HR administration.

• Assist in preparation of monthly HR dashboards and compliance reports.

• Float communication and ensure timely submission of Property Returns.

• Support consolidation of apprentice attendance data from Regional Offices & payment of stipend as per regulatory norms.

• Handle settlement of HR-related bills, invoices and ensure timely processing of payments.

• Process and issue NOCs related to part-time studies, external exams, and interview permissions.

• Provide day-to-day support to Regional Offices for HR processes, queries and documentation.

**4. Employee Master Data & HRMS Management**

• Create employee master records in eHRMS for new joiners and deputed officials.

• Facilitate creation of login access for all new employees and deputed officials across applications.

• Update employee master data based on verified requests and documentation.

• Identify inconsistencies in HRMS and coordinate bulk rectification activities.

**5. Performance Management Support**

• Coordinate with departments for review and updating of Annual and Special Appraisal parameters.

• Ensure KRA/KPI alignment with business objectives.

• Float Appraisal parameters in the system and communicate guidelines.

• Verify reporting hierarchy, department mapping and HOD allocation for appraisal workflows.

• Follow up for timely completion and submission of Employee Appraisals.

• Support consolidation and validation of appraisal-related data.

**6. Wage Revision & Compensation Support**

• Assist in salary benchmarking, internal parity checks and preparation of salary fitment proposals.

• Maintain confidential salary records and coordinate with Payroll teams as required.

• Assist in CTC modelling and compensation-related documentation.

**7. Employee Engagement & Welfare Activities**

• Coordinate employee engagement programs, celebrations and communication initiatives.

• Assist in planning and organizing employee engagement events (e.g., marathons, cultural events).

• Organize welfare activities such as health camps, wellness programs and awareness sessions.

• Support grievance handling processes and employee communication drives.

**8. End of Service & Exit Management**

• Handle end-to-end resignation processing including document verification, approval note preparation and issuance of relieving/experience letters.

• Coordinate with Regional Offices for cases where Regional Managers are the approving authorities.

• Ensure accurate and timely updates in HRMS and related systems for exit cases.

**9. Policy Development & Compliance**

• Assist in framing, reviewing and updating HR policies and SOPs.

• Support the annual review of existing HR policies.

• Help prepare data and documentation for statutory reporting (RBI, NHB, BRSR, Annual Reports).

• Issue HR circulars and ensure timely communication across departments and regions.

• Support data consolidation and purification for statutory audits and reporting requirements.

**10. Engagement with HR Consultants**

Experience in engaging & coordinating with HR Consultants for organization transformation, HR process improvement initiatives & other relevant functions.

title: Content Creator / SME
description:
**Content Creator / Social Media Executive**

If you can make a cup of coffee look like a craving and a chair look like a lifestyle, and you love building content that actually moves products, we have an opening for you at The Hype Capital™.

**What would your core job responsibilities be?**

▶ Manage end-to-end social media for our product brands — content calendar, grid planning, scheduling, captions and publishing.

▶ Ideate, script, shoot and edit short-form video content: product reels, unboxings, "how it's made", styling and setup videos, recipes, room transformations and trend-led formats.

▶ Plan and execute product shoots — flat lays, lifestyle setups, close-ups and in-store/on-location content that makes the product the hero.

▶ Turn product features (taste, ingredients, materials, comfort, design, durability) into hooks and stories people stop scrolling for.

▶ Create content that supports sales: launches, offers, festive campaigns, collaborations and ad creatives for performance campaigns.

▶ Coordinate with creators, influencers and UGC talent for product seeding, collaborations and reviews.

▶ Engage with the community — reply to comments and DMs, reshare customer content, and flag product feedback to the team.

▶ Track content performance (reach, saves, shares, profile visits, website clicks) and use it to refine formats and hooks every month.

▶ Keep a finger on the pulse of trends across food & beverage, café culture, interiors and home décor.

▶ Work closely with the core team and clients on shoots, account reviews and content approvals.

**Who would be a good fit?**

▶ Someone who loves product content and has a strong eye for styling, lighting, framing and grid aesthetic.

▶ Someone who can make the same product feel fresh week after week without repeating the same video.

▶ Someone with a portfolio of product, food/beverage, lifestyle or interior content they've shot and edited themselves.

▶ Someone with brilliant storytelling and copywriting skills — hooks, captions and on-screen text that convert.

▶ Someone who is comfortable in front of the camera as well as behind it.

▶ Someone highly proficient in mobile editing apps (CapCut, VN, InShot) and/or Premiere Pro, and comfortable with Canva.

▶ Someone who understands how organic content and paid ads work together (Meta ads exposure is a plus).

▶ Someone with impeccable attention to detail — a smudged cup or a crooked cushion should bother you.

▶ Someone who doesn't fold under pressure and handles launch deadlines calmly.

▶ Someone who is okay and comfortable with odd working hours, weekends and on-location shoots.

**Don't apply if any of these things describe you**

▶ You find product content boring and only want to make "creative" content with no business goal.

▶ You see account management and content creation as a chore rather than a passion.

▶ You're not driven (doesn't have to be driven to the job, but it has to be something in life).

▶ You are not punctual (delaying things shouldn't be your personality, especially shoot and publishing deadlines).

▶ You can't learn from your mistakes (make mistakes, but not the same ones).

▶ You don't have a growth mindset.

**Experience:**
Minimum 1 year in a marketing / social media role, or you run your own page / create content.

**Location:**
Mumbai (hybrid, onsite for shoots and reviews)

**Salary:**
₹1,80,000 – ₹3,00,000 per annum depending on experience and skill level

description:
**Job Purpose**
The Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing advanced technical support, incident resolution, and operational management across enterprise IT infrastructure. The role involves diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues, performing administration activities, implementing changes, supporting problem management, and mentoring L1 engineers while ensuring high service availability and SLA compliance.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure Administration & Operations**

* Administer and maintain Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup and GPU infrastructure to ensure high availability and operational stability.
* Perform proactive health checks, capacity monitoring, performance tuning, and preventive maintenance activities.

**Advanced Incident Management**

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 2 infrastructure incidents within defined SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and coordinate with L3 teams for permanent resolution.
* Review escalations from L1 teams and provide technical guidance during incident resolution.
* Participate in Major Incident Management and support service restoration activities.

**Windows Server & Active Directory Administration**

* Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Services, and Windows services.
* Manage user accounts, organizational units, security groups, permissions, and authentication-related activities.
* Troubleshoot server performance, replication, authentication, and domain-related issues.

**Linux Administration**

* Perform Linux server administration, including user management, package management, service configuration, performance tuning, and security patching.
* Analyze system logs, troubleshoot kernel and OS issues, and optimize server performance.

**Virtualization Administration**

* Administer Cloud native/VMware/Hyper-V environments, including VM provisioning, snapshots, cloning, migration, and resource optimization.
* Monitor hypervisor performance and troubleshoot virtualization platform issues.

**Kubernetes Administration**

* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including node management, workload deployment, pod lifecycle management, namespace administration, and cluster health monitoring.
* Troubleshoot cluster failures, resource constraints, networking, and orchestration issues.

**Storage & Backup Administration**

* Administer enterprise storage systems, LUN provisioning, storage allocation, capacity management, and performance optimization.
* Manage enterprise backup solutions, perform backup validation, restore operations, and troubleshoot backup failures.

**GPU Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer GPU-based infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Monitor GPU utilization, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, perform firmware validation, and coordinate hardware replacement activities.

**Hardware & Data Center Support**

* Diagnose server hardware failures involving CPU, memory, storage, RAID, power supplies, and network interfaces.
* Coordinate hardware replacements with vendors and perform post-maintenance validation.

**Change & Problem Management**

* Execute approved infrastructure changes following organizational change management processes.
* Participate in Problem Management by identifying recurring issues and implementing preventive actions.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor L1 engineers and contribute to operational excellence and automation initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.

**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Windows/Linux Administration, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, Kubernetes, Storage & Backup Administration, Network Operations, GPU Infrastructure Administration, Troubleshooting, Incident, Problem Management and Infrastructure Troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting mission – critical production environments with 24 x 7 operations
* 4–6 years of experience in Hardware Support, Change Management, Documentation, ITIL Processes, Vendor Coordination, Automation (PowerShell/Bash/Python), Operational Reporting, and Team Collaboration.
* Preferred Exposure: Experience working with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, cloud native virtualization platforms, VMware, Nutanix, Kubernetes/Openshift environments, cloud native storage, Enterprise storage like NetApp & HPE etc. Backup Solution like Commvault & Cloud native backup tools, enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Zoho etc. & ITSM Platform including Manage Engine & Service Now etc. and GPU infrastructure supporting AI/ML workload is preferred

title: JR. Growth & CRO Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Growth & CRO Specialist who can take ownership of the complete digital customer funnel from audience targeting and acquisition to conversion, retargeting and repeat purchase.

We are looking for someone who understands why customers convert, why they drop off, and how to systematically improve every stage of the funnel through data, experimentation and precise targeting.

The person will work closely with the marketing, creative, technology and business teams to continuously improve traffic quality, conversion rate, CAC, ROAS and overall revenue.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Audience Targeting & Customer Segmentation**

Develop highly relevant target audiences based on customer demographics, behaviour, interests, intent and purchase history.

Identify high-value customer segments and create differentiated acquisition strategies for each.

Develop customer journeys for cold, warm and high-intent audiences.

Continuously analyse audience performance and refine targeting based on conversion and revenue data.

**2. Funnel Strategy & Optimization**

Own the complete funnel:

Ad → Landing Page → Product/Service Page → Lead/Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase

Identify leakage and drop-offs at every stage of the funnel.

Build strategies to improve conversion at each stage.

**3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**

Analyse website behaviour and identify conversion barriers.

Improve landing pages, product pages, forms, CTAs, navigation, checkout and overall user experience.

Conduct A/B and multivariate testing wherever relevant.

Test creatives, content, trust elements and other conversion triggers.

Use data and user behaviour rather than assumptions to make optimization decisions.

**4. Performance Marketing & Acquisition**

Plan and optimize campaigns across Google, Meta and other relevant digital platforms.

Analyse campaign performance at audience, creative, placement, keyword and funnel level.

Continuously optimize CAC, ROAS, conversion rate and customer quality.

**5. Retargeting & Remarketing**

Build retargeting journeys based on user behaviour, including:

Website visitors

Product/page viewers

Video viewers

Engaged users

Leads

Add-to-cart users

Checkout abandoners

Previous purchasers

High-value customers

Develop different messaging and offers for each stage rather than using one generic retargeting campaign.

**6. Analytics & Customer Behaviour**

Own funnel analytics and conversion tracking.

Analyse GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads and other analytics platforms.

Use heatmaps, scroll maps and session recordings to understand user behaviour.

Identify patterns behind conversions and drop-offs.

Build dashboards and reports covering:

CAC, ROAS, Conversion Rate, Cost per Lead/Purchase, Add-to-Cart Rate, Repeat Purchase Rate, Revenue by channel/audience

**7. Landing Pages & Creative Optimization**

Modify/Create creatives basis the reports for maximum ROI

**Required Skills**

Strong understanding of CRO and digital customer journeys

Strong performance marketing knowledge

Advanced understanding of Meta Ads and Google Ads

Strong analytical and data interpretation skills

Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking

Experience with heatmaps/session-recording tools such as Clarity or Hotjar

Understanding of A/B testing and experimentation

Strong understanding of landing-page optimization

Audience segmentation and retargeting expertise

Strong understanding of attribution and funnel analytics

Ability to work with creative, technology and marketing teams

**Experience**

2–4 years of relevant experience in Growth, CRO, Performance Marketing, D2C or E-commerce. Candidates should preferably demonstrate actual case studies/results where they have improved conversion rates, reduced CAC, increased revenue or scaled a digital funnel.

title: Assistant Manager, Agentic Search
description:
**Company Overview**

We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. **Overview**
The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.
  
  
As the Agentic Search - Assistant Manager, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross-functional partners. In addition, you will be directly responsible for hiring, mentoring, and coaching another Agentic AI Analyst, who will be reporting to you. As a thought leader, you will be building cross-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.
  
  
This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.
  
  
Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Data Analysis & Performance Diagnostics: Analyze large, nuanced datasets from LLM optimization platforms to diagnose what is working, what is not, and where search visibility can be improved.
* Market & Competitor Trend Tracking: Maintain a proactive external view of relevant digital topics, retailer landscapes, and competitor movements to surface emerging generative search trends for internal teams.
* Strategic Planning & Prioritization: Translate complex, rapidly evolving AI engine outputs into prioritized, phased optimization plans that focus resources on the highest-value business opportunities.
* Cross-Functional Implementation: Coordinate closely with cross-functional partners to support the accurate, timely execution of approved optimization initiatives.
* Stakeholder Reporting & Capability Building: Track optimization outcomes, maintain organized reporting, and surface risks and follow-up opportunities to stakeholders while documenting learnings to refine the team's analytical approach over time.
* Global Operating Model Support: Enable a consistent, scalable way of working between U.S.- and India-based teams through proactive communication, strong organization, and clear documentation.
* Pillar Leadership: Build a high performing Agentic Analysis team in GIC, as an extension on the US Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation team. This involves both building the team, being responsible for deliverables – learning, context and acumen, and building capabilities/tools that may be required for the pillar.
* Influence and Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate and provide leadership in meetings, influence decision making by proactively reaching out to stakeholders, ensuring timelines are met, meetings are productive and priorities are met timely.
* Mentor and coach the associate in India on best practices and remove roadblocks if any, with support from your manager
* Facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the larger Agentic Search team
* Stay current on industry trends and consumer behavior insights, applying knowledge to refine and inform AI search optimization strategies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field, with an MBA in Marketing / International Business.
* 4–6 years of experience in SEO, organic search, content optimization or digital marketing, with 2+ years in AI Marketing Agents, AI Search Optimization, AEO, GEO or LLM-based search.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, semantic/entity optimization, structured data, content strategy and AI-powered search platforms.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini/Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity and concepts such as LLMs, RAG and AI citations.
* Strong analytical, communication, project management and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to generate actionable insights to optimize brand strategy execution.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Navigating Tableau dashboards, R/SQL a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush/Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
* Strong understanding of search relevance, ranking, personalization, and evaluation metrics.
* Data-driven approach to experimentation, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable search solutions and product roadmaps.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:

**Rusk Media | Mumbai, Maharashtra | On-site | 5–7 Years of Experience**

**"About Rusk Media"**

Rusk Media is building the future of entertainment for the next generation. We create and distribute youth-first entertainment across the AVOD, SVOD and OTT ecosystem, combining original IPs, branded entertainment and compelling storytelling.

Our portfolio includes Alright, Binge, LIT and Playground, with content reaching audiences across leading digital and OTT platforms.

We are looking for a commercially driven, strategic and creative
**Brand & Marketing Manager**
to lead brand strategy, integrated marketing and go-to-market initiatives for
**Alright TV's original content portfolio, including microdramas, web series and long-form entertainment**
.

This is an end-to-end marketing role for someone who understands how to build brands, translate consumer insights into marketing strategies, execute high-impact campaigns and deliver measurable business outcomes.

You will own marketing initiatives from strategy and planning through execution and performance measurement, working closely with content, creative, digital, sales, partnerships and external agencies. * Identify opportunities to build distinctive brand properties, improve audience affinity and drive long-term brand equity.

* Build campaign narratives and audience acquisition strategies tailored to different content formats and target segments.
* Coordinate campaign calendars, creative development, production, agencies and execution to ensure timely and effective launches.

**3. Consumer Insights & Audience Growth**

* Analyse audience behaviour, market trends, competitor activity and content consumption patterns to identify growth opportunities.
* Translate consumer insights into compelling campaign concepts, audience engagement initiatives and brand communication.
* Develop strategies to increase content discovery, awareness, engagement, viewership and repeat consumption.
* Use research and campaign insights to continuously refine marketing strategy.

**4. Commercial Ownership & Marketing Effectiveness**

* Own marketing budgets, resource allocation and campaign planning, ensuring efficient utilisation of spends.
* Define campaign KPIs and evaluate performance across reach, engagement, viewership, acquisition and ROI.
* Use data and performance analytics to optimise campaigns and improve marketing effectiveness.

* Manage external agencies, vendors, creators and strategic partners to deliver high-quality campaigns.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders across content, creative, production, digital, PR and business teams to drive execution.

* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in brand management, integrated marketing, consumer marketing or digital marketing, preferably within entertainment, OTT, media, digital-first businesses or consumer brands.

* Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns, brand-building initiatives or go-to-market strategies.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning, consumer insights, marketing strategy and campaign effectiveness.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, measuring campaign ROI and translating business objectives into actionable marketing plans.
* Ability to connect creative storytelling with commercial outcomes and audience growth.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and project management skills.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving entertainment environment.

**Added advantage:**
Experience with content launches, OTT platforms, branded content, influencer ecosystems, digital audience acquisition or youth-focused entertainment.

**Why Join Rusk Media?**

* Own marketing strategy for original entertainment IPs and an ambitious digital-first entertainment brand.
* Work at the intersection of content, consumer brands, OTT and youth culture.
* Collaborate with creators, advertisers, OTT platforms and cross-functional leadership teams.
* Build and scale marketing initiatives in a fast-growing entertainment business.

title: Copywriter
description:
About Emeritus

Emeritus is a global education company focused on making high-quality education accessible and affordable. It collaborates with leading universities across multiple regions and offers short courses, degree programmes, professional certificates and senior executive programmes, supported by technology, curriculum innovation and hands-on instruction.

Emeritus India is headquartered in Mumbai and operates in the higher-education and professional-learning space, working with leading institutions to deliver online certificates and programmes to learners.

About Daskalos

Daskalos is a strategic initiative of Emeritus focused on transforming higher education in India by enabling leading global universities to establish and expand their presence in the country. The initiative aims to bring international universities and their academic offerings closer to Indian students while supporting these institutions in building their presence and operations in India.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and creative Copywriter with 7–8 years of relevant experience to join our marketing and creative team. The ideal candidate will have a strong portfolio and experience developing compelling, audience-focused copy across digital and offline marketing channels. The role will work closely with creative, design, performance marketing and internal stakeholder teams to develop content aligned with campaign objectives, brand guidelines and audience needs.

Core Responsibilities

* Write copy for performance ads, social media creatives, emails, landing pages, brochures, flyers,website content and other marketing collaterals.

* Work closely with designers, performance marketing teams and internal stakeholders to create content that supports campaign objectives.

* Conduct research on courses, industries, audience needs and relevant topicsto support accurate and effective communication.
* Use digital research tools to identify search trends and create content that supports discoverability and marketing goals.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions with creative, design and performance marketing teams.

* Analyse existing creatives and suggest copy improvements based on feedback, performance data and campaign learnings.
* Manage multiple copy tasks simultaneously and deliver within documented timelines.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables, revisions and approvals.
* Stay updated on trends in digital marketing, performance advertising, content formats and AI-enabled writing tools.

Ideal Skills & Expertise

* 7–8 years of relevant experience in copywriting, content, communications, advertising or marketing.
* Strong portfolio in copywriting, content, communications or marketing, with a Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing or an equivalent level of knowledge gained through education, training and professional experience.
* Strong copywriting skills with the ability to communicate complex information in a clear, concise and compelling way.
* Good understanding of branding, customer/user journey, performance marketing and audience-led communication.
* Strong editorial discipline, with the ability to produce error-free copy across formats and channels.
* Experience writing for digital, print, social, email, performance marketing and other marketing communication formats.
* Experience using AI-enabled writing and research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms to support ideation, research, drafting and content optimisation.
* Familiarity with agile project management tools such as Asana, Wrike or Jira, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Ability to understand briefs, incorporate feedback and deliver revised copy efficiently.
* Good interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in Education, EdTech, Higher Education, Digital Marketing, Advertising or Performance Marketing will be an advantage.
* Experience working with university, education or international-education brands will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of digital-first, audience-led and conversion-focused copywriting.

title: D2C Growth Head
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-office)

**Function:**
D2C Growth & Performance Marketing

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. This is a leadership role: you'll own the D2C (earthful.me) growth number end to end, and build the team behind it as the channel scales — not just run campaigns, but decide where the channel goes next.

**Role Overview**

This role leads Earthful's D2C growth engine — full ownership of the website's revenue number, driven through performance marketing, conversion optimization, and a high-velocity creative pipeline. You'll be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), decide how budget is allocated across products, and build the team needed to scale that ownership over time. You'll work closely with the organic/content team, the creative team, and the website team — this starts as a hands-on individual role, but is expected to grow into leading a small team as the channel scales.

**What You'll Own**

**D2C Revenue Growth & Ownership**

• Own the D2C (earthful.me) revenue number end-to-end, driven primarily through performance marketing across Meta, Google, and other paid channels

• Be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the AOP

• Coordinate with the organic/content team so paid and organic efforts reinforce each other rather than working at cross purposes

**Creative Pipeline for Performance**

• Direct the creative team's output for performance — a steady flow of new hooks, angles, and formats

• Run structured creative testing across campaigns

• Brief the next round of creative based on what the data shows is actually working

**Budget, ROAS & Site Conversion**

• Decide how budget is allocated across products — what to scale up, what to scale down, and the ROAS target for each

• Own website conversion end-to-end — landing page CVR, checkout drop-off, and AOV — directing the website team's roadmap around what actually moves conversion

• Own the full D2C P&L view — revenue, ad spend, and contribution margin — not just a topline growth number

**Team Building & Leadership**

• Build and lead a small performance marketing/growth team as the D2C channel scales — this starts as a hands-on, individual role but is expected to grow into managing others

• Set the growth roadmap and testing cadence for the function, not just execute your own campaigns

**Cross-Functional (Suggested Additions)**

• Track CAC and LTV alongside channel-level ROAS, so budget decisions aren't driven by vanity metrics that look good in a single channel but don't hold up at the business level

• Coordinate with Supply Chain on demand forecasting tied to growth targets — aggressive scaling only works if inventory can back it up

• Maintain a structured testing roadmap/calendar for creative and channel experiments, rather than running tests ad hoc

**Optional Scope Extensions (decide before posting)**

• Own or co-own retention/CRM levers (email, WhatsApp, repeat purchase) — a natural extension if you want this role to cover full-funnel D2C, not just acquisition and conversion

• Weigh in on on-site pricing and promotions strategy, since these directly affect conversion and AOV

**What We're Looking For**

• Ideally has been part of a D2C/e-commerce brand's growth or marketing team during a scale-up phase — joining when revenue was roughly ₹0–30 Cr and helping scale it to ₹300 Cr or more

• MBA from a top-tier B-school strongly preferred, with 4–6+ years of post-MBA experience in performance marketing or growth

• At least 2+ years of experience owning a full P&L or AOP-style revenue number

• Direct, hands-on experience running and optimizing paid campaigns on Meta and Google Ads

• Prior experience building or leading a team, or clear readiness to do so as the role grows — this is a leadership-track role, not a purely individual-contributor one

• Comfortable making budget allocation calls across multiple products, trading off scale versus ROAS

• Understanding of website conversion levers (CVR, checkout drop-off, AOV) and experience working with a website/CRO team

• Strong analytical and Excel skills — comfortable building and interpreting performance dashboards
