description:
Our client, a leading food and Agri conglomerate, is looking for a hands-on Brand Manager to support the execution of key marketing and innovation priorities. The individual will work across their brands, partnering with internal teams and external agencies to ensure strong, timely delivery of brand initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities-**

• Lead the planning and execution of assigned brand campaigns across digital, e-

commerce, quick commerce, modern trade and other relevant channels.

• Manage brand initiatives end-to-end—from briefing agencies and evaluating creative

work to execution and performance tracking.

• Support new product launches, including proposition development, packaging,

pricing, launch planning and go-to-market coordination.

• Work closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, R&D, Packaging, Supply Chain, Finance and

Legal to drive timely project delivery.

• Partner with creative, media, research and digital agencies and ensure adherence to

timelines, budgets and brand guidelines.

• Track category, consumer and competitive developments and translate them into

actionable recommendations.

• Monitor brand and business performance, including sales, market share, distribution,

campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investments.

• Support development of presentations, business reviews, consumer research and

annual brand-planning inputs.

Skills Required

• MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a recognised institution.

• Approximately 3–6 years of brand-management experience, preferably in FMCG,

food, consumer goods or a related category.

• Experience in campaign execution, innovation/NPD and cross-functional project

management.

• Good understanding of digital marketing, e-commerce and quick-commerce

platforms.

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Comfortable working independently and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• A bias for action, attention to detail and the ability to deliver within tight timelines.

**Preferred Experience**

• Experience in food, frozen foods, snacking or packaged consumer products.

• Exposure to consumer research, packaging development and media planning.

• Familiarity with P&L, market-share and channel-performance metrics.

• Prior experience managing agencies and working with cross-functional commercial

teams

title: Cross Discipline - Associate Director
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Associate Director Cross channel who will do:
  
  

* Client & Channel Leadership Act as the lead and primary point of contact for key digital marketing channels—including Search, Social, Programmatic Buying Units (PBU), Ad Operations, or Commerce (all or couple of them). Represent the Global Operations Center (GOC) in all channels wise agency/market interactions, ensuring expectations are managed and consistently met. Serve as the custodian of activation excellence for assigned channels, driving trust and accountability across global stakeholders.
* Campaign Activation & Performance Oversight Oversee the activation, and optimization of campaigns across multiple channels and designated markets. Ensure flawless execution that aligns with broader media strategies and brand objectives. Work in close partnership with local and regional teams to maintain consistency, enhance performance, and deliver measurable impact through detailed reporting and actionable insights.
* Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership Build and maintain strong relationships with internal market teams (Europe, U.S., Asia, MEA, AUNZ), agency partners, and cross-functional groups. Act as a strategic advisor, offering data-driven solutions tailored to regional needs while upholding global standards. Partner with leadership and internal clients to drive innovation, resolve challenges, and influence strategic decisions that contribute to business growth.
* Operational Excellence & Governance Design, implement, and manage scalable workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance operational efficiency, campaign quality, and consistency. Enforce compliance with global taxonomy, quality assurance, and platform governance standards. Analyze operational data and feedback to identify improvement areas, ensure process adherence, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
* Team Leadership & Talent Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of subject matter experts responsible for campaign execution, optimization, and reporting. Foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team culture. Ensure efficient team resourcing, continuous skills development, and alignment with organizational objectives through regular feedback, coaching, and performance evaluation.
* Innovation, Automation & Business Growth Proactively identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and emerging markets. Collaborate with directors and senior leadership to develop compelling discussions for onboarding new scopes of work. Champion the adoption of internal and external automation tools and technology solutions to drive operational efficiency and future-proof activation capabilities.
* Coordination with internal team to overall smooth running for operations.

****Skills And Experience****
If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:
  
  

* Graduation or Post Graduation Degree in Any stream
* 8+ year's professional experience in digital media execution
* You are an expert & executed on respective channel platforms
* You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheet
* Working knowledge in HubSpot, Smartly, 4C, Scibids, or third-party tools like Dataroma, Google Studio is an added advantage
* Experience managing multi-location media activation teams.
* Experience training and maintaining quality standards at scale.
* Experience providing service to local teams from a centralized location.
* Passion for everything digital, with an active interest and understanding of online advertising industry trends.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Possess a solution-oriented mindset and analytical skillset.
* Proactive, display exemplary leadership with a positive go-getter attitude.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Key Account Manager (E-Commerce)
description:
**Job Description: Key Account Manager (E-commerce)**
The
**Key Account Manager (E-commerce)**
is responsible for driving online sales, brand visibility, and customer experience across LUXASIA's e-commerce channels, including brand.com, marketplaces, and key retail partner platforms. This role leads commercial planning, campaign execution, platform optimization, and cross-functional coordination to deliver sustainable growth for prestige beauty brands in line with business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial management**

* Own e-commerce sales performance and deliver against monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets
* Build and execute commercial plans across direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels
* Manage online assortment, pricing, promotions, bundles, and launch calendars in alignment with brand strategy
* Monitor sales, traffic, conversion, AOV, and other performance metrics to identify growth opportunities and risks
* Drive sell-out through effective campaign planning, trading actions, and demand generation

**Channel management**

* Manage day-to-day operations of brand websites, marketplaces, and third-party e-retail platforms
* Ensure product listings, content, visuals, navigation, and merchandising are accurate, optimized, and on-brand
* Partner with regional, local, and brand teams to ensure strong online execution across all key channels
* Build strong relationships with platform and marketplace account managers to unlock growth opportunities

**Campaigns and digital execution**

* Lead end-to-end execution of online campaigns, product launches, and key trading moments
* Coordinate with marketing, CRM, media, design, and brand teams to ensure timely and effective campaign roll-out
* Support traffic generation through paid media, affiliates, SEO/SEM, social commerce, and CRM where relevant
* Ensure all online activations reflect brand guidelines and premium customer experience standards

**Site merchandising and optimization**

* Oversee website and marketplace merchandising to maximize discoverability and conversion
* Use data and customer insights to improve landing pages, product detail pages, search, and onsite journeys
* Recommend and implement A/B testing, UX improvements, and conversion rate optimization initiatives
* Maintain high standards for content quality, stock visibility, and campaign readiness

**Operations And Customer Experience**

* Work closely with supply chain, customer service, finance, and operations teams to ensure smooth order fulfillment and service levels
* Monitor stock availability, forecasting inputs, and stock health to minimize lost sales and overstock risks
* Resolve operational issues impacting customer experience, including order flow, returns, cancellations, and fulfillment delays
* Ensure e-commerce processes comply with internal controls, platform requirements, and local regulations

**Analytics and reporting**

* Prepare regular business reviews with clear insights on sales, traffic, campaign performance, customer trends, and channel profitability
* Analyze product, channel, and campaign performance to shape future investment and trading decisions
* Track competitor activity, online trends, and category developments to identify opportunities for growth
* Provide actionable recommendations to management and brand stakeholders

**Stakeholder management**

* Act as the key e-commerce contact across internal teams and external partners
* Collaborate with brand principals, regional stakeholders, and local commercial teams on growth strategies and execution plans
* Manage agencies, vendors, and platform partners where applicable
* Support capability building and best-practice sharing across e-commerce teams

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, Digital, or a related field
* 5-8 years of experience in e-commerce, digital commerce, online trading, or marketplace management
* Experience in beauty, FMCG, retail, luxury, or consumer brands preferred
* Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs, online merchandising, campaign planning, and marketplace operations
* Proven track record of delivering online sales growth and managing multiple channels
* Familiarity with platforms such as Shopify, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Lazada, Shopee, Amazon, Sephora, or similar is a plus
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into commercial actions
* Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills
* Strong communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
* Proficiency in Excel, reporting tools, and web analytics platforms such as GA4, Looker Studio, or equivalent

**Preferred Competencies**

* Commercial acumen
* Digital and e-commerce expertise
* Data-driven decision making
* Project and campaign management
* Attention to detail
* Agility and problem solving
* Collaboration and influencing skills
* Customer-centric mindset

title: Manager - Brand Content Ops ( Alps Goodness)
description:
Job Description: Manager - Brand Content Ops (Alps Goodness)
  
  
(Performance Creative & Asset Engine)
  
  
Role summary
  
  
You will run thecontent operations enginethat ensures the brand and its product lines arenever short of high-quality, high-performing marketing assets. This role owns the end-to-end system forplanning, producing, repurposing, editing, storing, and deployingcontent forperformance and digital marketingacross products and geographies—whether the source isinfluencer content turned into ads, brand shoots, agency outputs, or AI-generated creatives.
  
  
In short: you ensure we always havethe right assets, in the right formats, at the right quality bar, at the right speed.
  
  
Reporting & org context
  
  

* Reports to:Brand Head / Senior Brand Manager (Brand Pod Lead)
* Works closely with:Brand Managers (product-line owners), Influencer Marketing team, Performance Marketing, GLAMRS creatives/designers, external agencies/production partners, editors, photographers/videographers, AI creators, and DAM stakeholders.

What you will own
  
  

* Always-on Creative Inventory (Asset Stock)
* Build and maintain a rollingasset pipelinefor each hero SKU and priority geography.
* Ensure “never out of stock” availability of ad-ready assets across:

+ Meta / YouTube / Google formats
+ Hooks, UGC, demos, testimonials, problem-solution, ingredient proof, routines
+ Static, motion, short-form, long-form cutdowns

* Maintain a clear view of what’s live, what’s working, what’s fatigued, and what needs replenishment.
* Performance Creative Production & Repurposing
* Convert influencer videos into performance-ready creatives: select winners, brief edits, create multiple cutdowns, test hooks/thumbnails/captions/CTAs.
* Plan and execute non-influencer shoots when required (product demos, ingredient story, brand films, before/after frameworks, expert-led content).
* Own the workflow to generate content viaAIwhere appropriate (iterations at speed while keeping brand/claim safety intact).
* Creative Ops: Systems, Process, and Execution
* Run the content ops cadence: weekly/monthly plans, briefs, production calendars, prioritization, approvals, and delivery tracking.
* Create a structured briefing system for:

+ Product-specific claims and RTBs
+ Target cohorts and funnel stage
+ Geo-specific nuance and language needs
+ Channel placements and specs

* Build SLAs for stakeholders (brand managers, performance marketing, agencies/editors) and ensure predictable delivery.
* Digital Asset Management (DAM) & Content Library
* Own the brand’sasset library: storage, tagging, version control, easy retrieval, and reuse.
* Ensure assets are archived with correct metadata:

+ SKU, claim, concept, funnel stage, creator/source, date, platform specs, rights usage

* Maintainsingle source of truthfor what can be used where (including rights and expiry tracking).
* Agency & Partner Management
* Manage a bench of editors, studios, agencies, freelancers, and creators for quick turnaround.
* Own budgets allocated for shoots/edits/tools; drive efficiency without quality compromise.
* Ensure external partners work to a consistent quality bar, file hygiene, and timelines.
* Cross-functional alignment
* Align with Brand Managers on product priorities (hero SKUs vs new launches), claims/RTBs, and geo expansion plans.
* Align with Influencer Marketing team to systematically capture and reuse influencer outputs.
* Align with Performance Marketing to translate learnings (winning hooks/angles) back into the content pipeline.

Key outputs / deliverables
  
  

* Monthly/weekly creative production plan by SKU + geography + funnel stage
* Complete set of ad-ready assets delivered per sprint (with cutdowns + variations)
* Up-to-date asset library (DAM) with correct tagging/versioning
* Performance creative learning loop (what worked, what didn’t, what’s next)
* Partner roster + rate cards + turnaround SLAs

Success metrics (KPIs)
  
  

* Asset availability:zero “creative stock-outs” for hero SKUs / priority geos
* Speed:average turnaround time from brief → first delivery; iteration speed post-performance feedback
* Quality bar:pass rate on first submission; reduction in rework due to spec/brand/claim issues
* Performance enablement:share of spend supported by fresh creatives; creative refresh cadence; reduction in creative fatigue incidents
* Efficiency:cost per usable asset / per edit; partner productivity; utilization of repurposed content vs new shoots
* Library health:% assets correctly tagged, searchable retrieval time, rights/compliance adherence

What “great” looks like
  
  

* Brand teams never say “we don’t have assets” or “we’re blocked on creative.”
* Winning angles are scaled fast, and fatigue is anticipated before it hits performance.
* The system runs like a newsroom + production studio: high velocity, high standards, low chaos.
* Assets are easy to find, reuse, and adapt across SKUs and geographies.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong understanding ofperformance marketing creative(Meta/YouTube/Google): hooks, formats, thumb-stopping patterns, iteration loops.
* Excellentproduction + creative opscapability: briefing, scheduling, tracking, vendor management, approvals.
* Ability to judge content quality: storytelling, pacing, editing patterns, visual clarity, claim safety.
* Hands-on comfort with tools/workflows (not necessarily editing yourself, but can direct edits well):

+ Creative spec management, DAM systems, spreadsheets/notion trackers, review tools, basic AI creative tools.

* Strong stakeholder management: can work with Brand Managers, performance teams, creators, and agencies without bottlenecks.

Experience (indicative)
  
  

* 5–8 years in content operations, performance creative production, digital content studios, or growth creative roles (consumer brands preferred).
* Prior experience runninga high-volume creative pipelinewith multiple stakeholders and external partners is a strong plus.

Working style
  
  

* High ownership, high urgency, high taste.
* Structured operator who thrives in a fast-moving environment.
* Clear communicator who can enforce process without slowing down execution.

title: Influencer operations & content executives
description:
**About the job

Job Description - Influencer Operations & Content Executive

Company: URPopular

Role: Influencer Operations & Content Executive

Salary: ₹25,000-₹30,000 per month

Function: Influencer Marketing |

Content |

Production |

Operations

URPopular is looking for a highly execution-oriented Influencer Operations & Content Executive who can manage influencer programs as well as coordinate content, video production, events, and digital content initiatives for our clients.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with creators, coordinating multiple moving pieces, and getting things executed from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

Influencer Discovery & Activation: Search and identify relevant influencers across Instagram, YouTube and other platforms based on client requirements; reach out to creators at scale and build an active creator pipeline.

Affiliate Influencer Onboarding: Contact, negotiate with and onboard a large number of influencers onto affiliate and performance-based influencer programs for our clients. Continuously expand and manage these creator communities.

Influencer Program Management: Coordinate campaigns from onboarding to execution, including briefs, communication, content timelines, approvals, tracking, links, deliverables and campaign reporting.

Creator Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with influencers, solve execution issues and ensure creators remain active and engaged with ongoing programs.

Content Operations: Coordinate scripts, concepts, shoots, edits, approvals and publishing of videos/ content for clients and URPopular initiatives.

Video & Production Coordination: Work with creators, videographers, editors, designers and internal teams to ensure shoots and productions are completed on time.

Event Operations: Support and coordinate influencer events, brand activations, shoots and on-ground production requirements.

YouTube Channel Operations: Work with internal staff and external creators to launch and operate YouTube channels, including creator coordination, content planning, production scheduling and publishing.

Team Coordination: Work with other executives, interns, creators and production partners to ensure campaigns and content projects move smoothly.

Execution & Tracking: Maintain trackers and ensure every creator, video, campaign, production and client deliverable is followed through until completion.

Who We Are Looking For

Someone who is fast, organised, highly proactive and comfortable with constant follow-ups. The person should enjoy speaking with creators, searching for influencers, coordinating shoots and handling multiple projects simultaneously. Experience in influencer marketing, creator management, social media, content production, video production or event operations will be preferred. Strong communication skills, good internet research ability and comfort with Google Sheets/Excel are important.

This is primarily an execution role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, coordinate people and make sure things actually get done. Salary: ₹25,000-₹30,000/month, depending on experience and capabilities**

Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.What a week looks likeMonday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.What you’ll doScope the right thingRun discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.Own the client relationshipBe the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.Design the systemOwn the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.Build, verify and deployWrite backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.Design the experience and drive adoptionDesign screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.What you need3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.Fluent Hindi and English.Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.Nice to haveYou’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.Who succeeds hereYou have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.Work setupLocation: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.Travel: Regular visits to client sites.Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.Reports to: Tuning Research founders.Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.What success looks like30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.How we hireIntro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.Fill out the form https://forms.gle/L9M6MDArXLP6KFFc8

title: Founder’s Office (EA)
description:
* Location: Mumbai
* Experience: 7+ Years
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Compensation: 70-80K Per Month
* Industry: Real Estate
* Reporting To: Founder

**About The Role**
We are a Mumbai-based real estate company looking for an experienced
**Executive Assistant to work directly with the Founder**
.
  
  
You will be the Founder’s first point of contact and representative, responsible for protecting his time and ensuring that the right people, priorities, and issues reach him.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role requiring strong judgement, organisation, discretion, and confidence. You will manage the Founder’s calendar, travel, communication, coordination, and follow-ups while ensuring his day-to-day commitments run smoothly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Calendar & Priority Management**

* Manage the Founder’s calendar, meetings, appointments, and daily priorities
* Organise schedules to ensure effective use of the Founder’s time
* Coordinate meetings with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively
* Ensure important priorities and follow-ups are tracked through completion

**Travel Management**

* Plan and coordinate domestic and international travel end to end
* Manage flights, accommodation, transportation, itineraries, and other travel arrangements
* Handle last-minute changes and unexpected situations with practical judgement
* Maintain organised travel schedules and relevant documentation

**Gatekeeping & Founder Support**

* Act as the Founder’s gatekeeper and first point of contact
* Filter incoming requests and determine what requires the Founder’s direct attention
* Route matters to the appropriate internal point of contact when required
* Confidently and professionally decline or redirect requests when necessary
* Protect the Founder’s time while ensuring important matters are addressed

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate across internal teams, staff, and external stakeholders on the Founder’s behalf
* Communicate requirements and follow up on action items
* Build effective working relationships with people across different levels
* Ensure information reaches the right stakeholders accurately and on time

**Documentation & Follow-Ups**

* Maintain well-organised records and documentation
* Track meetings, commitments, action items, and follow-ups
* Ensure pending matters are followed through to completion
* Maintain clear and easily accessible information when required

**Confidentiality & Discretion**

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion
* Maintain professionalism when dealing with internal and external stakeholders
* Exercise sound judgement when managing sensitive matters on the Founder’s behalf

**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* 7+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant
* Based out of Mumbai
* Prior experience working in a startup (Preferred)
* Prior experience supporting a Founder or senior leadership is strongly preferred
* Experience within a founder’s office, startup, or real estate company is preferred
* Strong-minded and composed under pressure
* Confidence to establish and maintain boundaries firmly but politely
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills
* Comfortable working with employees and stakeholders at every level
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail
* Strong documentation and follow-through
* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of important details
* High level of discretion and confidentiality
* Digitally inclined and comfortable using:

+ Calendars
+ Email
+ Productivity tools
+ Collaboration tools

* Some travel experience and broader exposure to planning complex itineraries

**The Ideal Candidate**
We’re looking for someone who can do much more than manage a calendar.
  
  
You should understand how to
**protect a Founder’s time, prioritise competing requests, coordinate with different personalities, and make practical decisions independently**
.
  
  
You should be confident enough to say no when necessary, composed enough to handle pressure and last-minute changes, and organised enough to ensure commitments and follow-ups never fall through the cracks.
  
  
Above all, you should be someone the Founder can trust to represent him professionally and handle sensitive information with complete discretion.
  
  
Skills: founder support,travel management,stakeholder management,discretion

title: Associate Business Manager - Paid Media (1:30pm - 10:30pm)
description:
**Associate Business Manager - Paid Media**
**Experience:**
2-3 Years
  
  
**Function:**
Paid Media / Performance Marketing
  
  
Shift Timing : 1:30pm - 10:30pm
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an
**Associate Business Manager - Paid Media**
to join our growing Paid Media team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in
**planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital advertising campaigns**
across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and other paid media channels.
  
  
This role requires someone who is
**analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing day-to-day client communication**
, while collaborating with internal creative, analytics, and marketing teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Campaign Planning & Execution


+ Support the planning and execution of paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, and other digital platforms.
+ Coordinate campaign schedules, deliverables, and timelines.
+ Monitor campaigns regularly and support ongoing optimization to improve performance.

* Data Analysis & Reporting


+ Analyze campaign performance and identify actionable insights.
+ Track key performance indicators and highlight areas for optimization.
+ Prepare regular campaign reports and performance updates.
+ Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and next steps.

* Creative Coordination


+ Collaborate with creative teams to ensure timely development and delivery of campaign assets.
+ Coordinate ad copies, visuals, and other creative requirements.
+ Support A/B testing of creatives, messaging, and formats to improve campaign performance.

* Budget Management


+ Monitor and track advertising spends across campaigns.
+ Ensure budgets are allocated effectively and remain aligned with campaign objectives.
+ Support financial tracking, reporting, and budget analysis.

* Market & Audience Research


+ Conduct research on industry trends, competitors, audiences, and emerging opportunities.
+ Identify insights that can help improve campaign strategies.
+ Contribute to audience targeting and media planning recommendations.

* Client Management


+ Act as a key point of contact for clients for day-to-day operational queries, campaign updates, and requirements.
+ Maintain regular communication and ensure client expectations are managed effectively.
+ Support presentations, campaign reviews, proposals, and client documentation.

* Team Collaboration & Mentorship


+ Work closely with cross-functional teams including Creative, Analytics, Marketing, and Content.
+ Coordinate across teams to ensure smooth and timely campaign delivery.
+ Guide and mentor junior analysts on campaign management, reporting, and analytical best practices.
+ Contribute towards building a collaborative and learning-focused team environment.

**What We’re Looking For**




+ 2-3 years of relevant experience in Paid Media, Performance Marketing, Digital Advertising, or a similar role.
+ Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
+ Hands-on understanding of platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
+ Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance data.
+ Understanding of campaign optimization, audience targeting, budget management, and performance reporting.
+ Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
+ Ability to manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
+ Good command of Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with digital marketing and reporting tools.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills.
+ Comfortable interacting with clients and coordinating with multiple internal stakeholders.

**Who Would Be a Great Fit?**
Someone who enjoys working with
**data as much as campaigns**
, understands what drives paid media performance, communicates confidently with clients, and can take ownership while working collaboratively with a fast-paced team.

**About the Role**

JOB DESCRIPTION

**HR Executive – Recruitment & Operations**

Transganization is looking for a proactive, organized, and result-oriented HR Executive to manage recruitment and HR coordination for multiple Food & Beverage (F&B) brands associated with FSO, including Mi Hi Koli, Banjos, and other brands within the portfolio. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end recruitment, coordinating interviews, managing candidate pipelines, facilitating onboarding, and supporting staffing requirements across outlets and office operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities

1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

* Handle end-to-end recruitment for multiple F&B brands associated with FSO.
* Understand manpower requirements from outlet managers, chefs, department heads, and management.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, recruitment agencies, walk-ins, and other channels.
* Recruit for various positions, including restaurant managers, captains, stewards, chefs, kitchen staff, housekeeping staff, and corporate office roles.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, assess candidate suitability, and coordinate subsequent interview rounds.
* Maintain an active database of candidates for current and future vacancies.
* Follow up with selected candidates regarding offers, documentation, and joining dates.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies based on business requirements.

2. Manpower Planning & Coordination

* Coordinate with outlet managers and management to understand current and upcoming manpower requirements.
* Maintain a vacancy tracker for all associated brands and outlets.
* Monitor recruitment progress, candidate availability, and expected joining dates.
* Coordinate staff deployment and replacements across outlets, wherever required.
* Support recruitment planning for new outlet openings and business expansion.

3. Onboarding & Joining Formalities

* Coordinate joining formalities and collect the required employee documents.
* Prepare and maintain employee records, joining reports, and onboarding checklists.
* Communicate company policies, attendance procedures, reporting structures, and other joining-related information.
* Coordinate with outlet managers to ensure new employees receive the necessary induction and training.
* Follow up with candidates and managers to minimize last-minute dropouts and early attrition.

4. HR Administration & Documentation

* Maintain updated employee databases and recruitment records for all associated brands.
* Maintain records of offers released, candidates selected, employees joined, and candidates who declined offers.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports.
* Assist with attendance, leave records, employee documentation, and other HR administrative activities as assigned.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and company records.

5. Employee Coordination & Retention

* Act as a coordination point between employees, outlet managers, and management for routine HR-related matters.
* Follow up with newly joined employees during their initial employment period.
* Track employee attrition and identify recurring recruitment or retention challenges.
* Assist management with exit formalities, employee feedback, and replacement requirements.
* Support the implementation of HR policies and processes across outlets.

Work Expectations

* Manage recruitment requirements for multiple brands and outlets simultaneously.
* Maintain regular communication with hiring managers and candidates.
* Provide timely updates on recruitment progress and pending vacancies.
* Ensure proper documentation and systematic tracking of all recruitment activities.
* Demonstrate accountability, responsiveness, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of vacancies across assigned brands.
* Number of successful joinings against manpower requirements.
* Quality and suitability of candidates hired.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Candidate follow-up and joining conversion rate.
* Accuracy and timely updating of recruitment trackers.
* Effective coordination with outlet managers and management.
* Support for recruitment during new outlet openings.
* Employee retention during the initial joining period.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR professional who enjoys recruitment, is comfortable hiring for high-volume F&B positions, and can coordinate effectively with multiple outlet teams. The candidate should be proactive in sourcing talent, persistent with follow-ups, and focused on ensuring that each brand has the required manpower within the expected timelines.

**Qualifications**

Educational Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Prior experience in recruitment or HR operations is preferred.
* Experience recruiting for restaurants, cafés, QSRs, hotels, or other F&B businesses will be an advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication, coordination, and sourcing skills may also be considered.

**Required Skills**

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good sourcing, screening, and candidate management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies across different brands simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and basic HR documentation.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing manpower requirements.
* Strong time management and problem-solving skills.
* Professionalism and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

title: Director, Salesforce Program Leader

**Description**
As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.
  
  
You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long-term success on the platform.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation & ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk & Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, industry trends, and best-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at-risk customer environments.
* Cross-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer & internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2) and having Salesforce Certification is an asset. An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging repairs or planning the next holiday. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

****How will we do it?****

There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:

* **Lifestyle Manager:**
  Armed with irrefutable professional attention and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated team helps customers with everything from sending flowers to recommending the latest home products.
* **Trained Professionals:**
  Customers are served by a team of home specialists who handle all housework. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential.
* **Technology:**
  Our back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.

****The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family****

A
**Lifestyle Manager**
at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people, and is committed to improving lives for the better. S/he is warm, courteous, patient, and a good listener with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even
**anticipate or pre-empt their needs**
.

****Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager****

* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life in a transformative manner.

**2. Solution Deployment**

* Define and agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling customer requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps and undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to
  **Operations Associates**
  and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.

**3. Partner Management**

* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions.
* Onboard and work with local quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location.
* Oversee the quality of work done by partners and provide feedback to central teams.

**4. Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Have deeper dialogues with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages:
  **pain, convenience, pleasure, delight, and transformation**
  .
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.

**5. Customer Feedback & Service Improvement**

* Determine customer satisfaction and identify areas of improvement.
* Iterate the solution design to continually enhance customer service.
* Raise and highlight any complaints or grievances to the relevant teams for resolution.

****Who are we looking for?****

* **Passionate**
  about the cause the company is working towards.
* **Self-motivated**
  and loves taking initiative.
* **Growth mindset**
  , focused on improving business outcomes.

  **hustle**

  with a solution-oriented mindset.

  **team player**
  with the ability to multitask.

* **Preference:**

title: Senior Python Engineer - Data ( Remote, Full-Time) [AS340]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior Python Engineer (Backend / Data), you will join an existing engineering team to strengthen backend development and data engineering capabilities. This is a long-term, ongoing opportunity (subject to confirmation), focused on building and maintaining reliable production systems.

  

You will work closely with the engineering team and an existing DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure, deployments and releases. The role requires independent ownership of assigned work, collaboration across engineering functions and an understanding of how data pipelines support the wider product.

  

You will contribute to engineering decisions, maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing, and propose solutions rather than simply execute assigned tasks. Reliability and thoroughness in production are key priorities.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines in Python on AWS.
  
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Django and FastAPI.
  
* Model, query and optimise data across PostgreSQL and search/NoSQL databases, including OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and DynamoDB.
  
* Deploy and run services on Kubernetes, working alongside the DevOps engineer.
  
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned work, including design, testing, code reviews, releases and production support.
  
* Work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating closely with the engineering team and DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure and releases.
  
* Maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing while understanding how data pipelines contribute to the wider product.
  
* Follow established engineering practices, including code reviews and CI/CD, while adapting to changing priorities.
  
* Proactively identify problems, propose solutions and challenge technical decisions when necessary rather than simply executing tickets.
  
* Prioritise thoroughness, reliability and production stability when developing and maintaining data pipelines and data stores.
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years of commercial Python development.
  
* 5+ years of Python backend development experience, with strong hands-on engineering capabilities.
  
* 3+ years of experience in data pipelines and data engineering, including ETL/ELT processes and batch processing. Relevant technologies include Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, AWS Glue and Step Functions.
  
* 3+ years of AWS experience, with practical experience developing and maintaining cloud-based backend services and data pipelines. Strong GCP or Azure experience may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  
* 3+ years of experience with Python web frameworks, particularly Django or FastAPI. Flask is an acceptable alternative.
  
* 3+ years of PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling, querying and optimisation. MySQL or SQL Server experience may be considered where strong SQL expertise is demonstrated elsewhere.
  
* 2+ years of experience with non-relational or search databases, such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or DynamoDB. Relevant alternatives include MongoDB, Redis and Cassandra.
  
* 2+ years of Kubernetes experience, including deploying and running services. Docker combined with ECS or EKS exposure may be considered as an alternative.
  
* Ability to independently own technical tasks from design through implementation, testing, release and production support.
  
* Strong attention to data quality, correctness, testing and production reliability.
  
* Ability to collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams while independently proposing solutions and challenging decisions where appropriate.
  
* Ability to follow engineering practices and adapt to changing priorities.
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* 1+ year of experience with workflow orchestration, using Airflow or similar technologies. Alternatives include Celery and cron-based schedulers.
  
* 1+ year of experience with streaming or event-processing technologies, such as Kafka, Kinesis or SQS. RabbitMQ is an acceptable alternative.
  
* 1+ year of experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, including Terraform and GitHub Actions. Alternatives include Pulumi and GitLab CI.
  
* Previous experience leading a technical project or taking complete end-to-end ownership of a data pipeline or backend service

title: Telesales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Prevoir IVF is a fertility care provider dedicated to making parenthood accessible, ethical, and affordable for individuals and couples across Maharashtra. Since 2014, the organization has focused on transparent, empathetic, and clinically sound fertility treatments that prioritize patient trust and comfort. Under one roof, Prevoir IVF offers advanced IVF and ICSI, IUI, donor programs, fertility preservation, and related surgical procedures, along with legal and emotional support for surrogacy. Care plans are tailored to each person’s medical needs, emotional wellbeing, and life goals, guided by an experienced team of fertility experts, embryologists, and counselors. The clinic follows internationally recognized protocols and uses advanced laboratory technologies to optimize outcomes while empowering patients with clear information and choices.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Telesales Executive role based in Thane. The Telesales Executive will engage with prospective patients and inquiries over phone and digital channels, providing clear information about Prevoir IVF’s services and booking consultations. Day-to-day responsibilities include making outbound calls, responding to inbound leads, qualifying and nurturing prospects, and maintaining accurate records in the CRM system. The role involves collaborating with clinic staff to coordinate appointments, following up with potential patients, and supporting campaigns aimed at increasing awareness of fertility services. The Telesales Executive is expected to handle sensitive conversations with empathy, uphold confidentiality, and represent the organization’s values of transparency and patient-centric care.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear spoken and written communication and active listening.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Support skills to handle inquiries, resolve concerns, and ensure a positive patient experience.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Lead Generation skills to convert inquiries into appointments and support revenue growth.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in telesales, inside sales, or call center operations, preferably in healthcare or service-oriented sectors.
* Candidates should be comfortable working with CRM or call management tools, maintaining accurate data, and following structured processes.
* Candidates should demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
* A minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent is required; a degree in business, marketing, or a related field is an advantage.
* Proficiency in English and local languages, along with the ability to work flexible hours as needed, will be beneficial.

* Communicate requirements and follow up on action items
* Build effective working relationships with people across different levels

**Documentation & Follow-Ups**

* Maintain well-organised records and documentation
* Track meetings, commitments, action items, and follow-ups
* Ensure pending matters are followed through to completion
* Maintain clear and easily accessible information when required

**Confidentiality & Discretion**

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion
* Maintain professionalism when dealing with internal and external stakeholders
* Exercise sound judgement when managing sensitive matters on the Founder’s behalf

**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* 7+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant
* Based out of Mumbai

* Experience within a founder’s office, startup, or real estate company is preferred

* Comfortable working with employees and stakeholders at every level
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail
* Strong documentation and follow-through
* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of important details

+ Calendars
+ Email
+ Productivity tools
+ Collaboration tools

* Some travel experience and broader exposure to planning complex itineraries

You should understand how to

.

description:

Location:
  
  
Navi Mumbai, MH, IN, 400708
  
  
Requisition ID: 19639
  
  
**About Holcim**
Holcim builds progress for people and the planet. As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of its strategy Holcim is becoming a net zero company, with its people and communities at the heart of its success. The company is driving the circular economy as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. Holcim is the company behind some of the world’s most trusted brands in the building sector including ACC, Aggregate Industries, Disensa, Firestone Building Products, Geocycle, Holcim and Lafarge. Holcim is 70,000 people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions & Products.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Order to Cash (OTC) Specialist to manage end-to-end OTC sub-processes while maintaining key interfaces with the Record to Report (RTR) function. The ideal candidate will possess solid hands-on experience in SAP, strong numerical analytical skills, and proficiency in MS Office to ensure accurate revenue accounting and operational efficiency. The Accounts Receivable Associate is responsible for executing activities relating to collections, revenue assurance & month end data reporting in a manner so as to ensure that overall delivery of services meets or exceeds agreed KPIs and SLAs defined between Operating Companies and BSC and is within a strong internal control framework.
  
  
Transactional Activities
  
  

* Process sales orders accurately and ensure timely, compliant generation and distribution of customer invoices in SAP.
* Evaluate customer credit applications, analyze creditworthiness, and assist in setting credit limits in accordance with company policy.
* Match, post, and apply incoming customer payments (wire transfers, checks, ACH) against outstanding open invoices accurately in SAP.
* Identify, investigate, and log invoice short payments, deductions, and billing disputes, collaborating with sales and customer teams for swift resolution.
* Perform regular ledger reconciliations of customer accounts, issue periodic balance confirmations, and clear open items.
* Assist with month-end closing activities, including revenue accruals, unapplied cash monitoring, and basic journal entries relating to AR/OTC
* To execute the activities related to cash application in the system for all customer payments.
* To upload data in SAP regarding all collection (CMS/e-collection), Bank statement upload with MT940 format
* To resolve issues arising out of reconciliation;
* To resolve pending items / errors by liaising with relevant teams;
* To perform month end/annual activities like reconciliation &stock verification, classification of debtors into various categories, running of month end programs, provision creation, posting interest on security deposit and conducting reconciliation of customer balances with sub ledger.
* To prepare MIS reporting & provide analytics for business support
* To prepare audit templates & provide first level query resolution, as & when required;

Service Excellence
  
  

* Ensure that overall delivery of services to Op-cos meets or exceeds agreed KPIs and SLAs defined between Operating Companies and BSC and is within a strong internal control framework.
* Partner with the Service Management team to:

+ Provide input to service reporting.
+ Facilitate service transition when required.
+ Analyse issues and resolve them in a timely manner.

Work with the BSC Service Management Lead to track Service Level Agreements (SLA) and ensure that all engagements with the customer are aligned, understood and that Customer needs are being documented and prioritized for action
  
  
Skills & knowledge
  
  

* Must have hands-on experience of working on SAP (SD/FI modules)& proficiency in Microsoft excel.
* Knowledge of general accounting practices & financial management.
* Ability to utilize information from a wide variety of sources through good analytical skills

Strong analytical capabilities, high attention to detail, and excellent verbal and written communication skills for managing customer interactions. Result oriented, with high level of motivation for self-growth;
  
  
Bachelor’s Degree in accounting related field
  
  
1 to 3 years of experience in relevant function

title: Sr CSR Fundraising Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Kokan Kala Va Shikshan Vikas Sanstha (Kokan NGO India) is a nationally recognized non-profit organization, established in 2012 to build a socio-economically inclusive ecosystem with equal opportunities for development. The organization drives social impact through CSR initiatives and innovative programs focused on sustainable development. Its work spans education, child rights, skill development, healthcare, rural development, and women’s empowerment, reaching rural, tribal, and urban communities across India. Kokan NGO aims to empower 3 million marginalized individuals by 2030 through collaborative, sustainable solutions that address grass-roots challenges. Guided by the belief that everyone deserves a dignified life, the organization promotes inclusivity and ensures every voice is heard and valued.

**Role Description**

1. **Develop and lead the overall fundraising strategy**

   of the organisation to achieve annual and long-term funding targets.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with
   **corporates, CSR teams, foundations, philanthropists, HNIs, institutional donors, and other funding partners**

   .
3. Identify new funding opportunities and lead efforts to
   **secure CSR funding, grants, institutional funding, philanthropy, and major donations**

   .
4. Use existing networks and develop new relationships with
   **corporate leaders, CSR decision-makers, foundations, and major donors**

   .
5. Lead donor meetings, fundraising pitches, presentations, negotiations, and
   **high-value funding closures**

   .
6. Develop and maintain a strong
   **fundraising pipeline**

   , including potential donors, funding opportunities, proposals, follow-ups, and expected closures.
7. Understand the organisation’s programmes and work closely with the programme team to develop
   **strong funding propositions and fundraising opportunities**

   .
8. Oversee the preparation of
   **proposals, concept notes, grant applications, presentations, budgets, donor reports, and other fundraising documents**

   .
9. Lead and guide the
   **Fundraising Manager and fundraising team**

   , set targets, monitor performance, and provide regular guidance and support.
10. Monitor fundraising performance against targets and prepare
    **regular fundraising reports and updates for senior management**

    .
11. Build long-term donor relationships and ensure effective
    **donor engagement, communication, and retention**

    .
12. Explore new fundraising channels, partnerships, and opportunities to
    **increase and diversify the organisation’s funding sources**

    .
13. Represent the organisation in
    **donor meetings, CSR forums, networking events, conferences, and relevant external platforms**

    .
14. Ensure fundraising activities are carried out professionally, ethically, and in accordance with
    **organisational policies and applicable requirements**

    .
15. The primary responsibility will be to
    **lead the organisation’s fundraising function and generate and secure sustainable funding**

    to support its programmes and long-term growth.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer-focused skills, including Customer Service and Customer Experience, to build trusted relationships with corporate partners and donors.
* Ability to manage and support stakeholder interactions, leveraging Customer Support and Customer Service Representatives experience in a CSR or fundraising context.
* Demonstrated commitment to Customer Satisfaction, ensuring responsive communication and high-quality engagement for all CSR partners.
* Proven experience in CSR fundraising, corporate partnerships, or business development, preferably in the nonprofit or social impact sector.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and proposal-writing skills, with strong proficiency in English and familiarity with corporate CSR language.
* Solid understanding of India’s CSR regulations, fundraising best practices, and impact reporting methodologies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Social Work, Development Studies, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai, collaborate across diverse teams, and manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: Consumer Engagement Associate
description:
At AMINU, marketing is not just about sending a message or creating a campaign. It’s about
 
**understanding our consumers, listening to what they need, and building meaningful conversations** 

 that make them want to stay connected with the brand..
 





 You’ll get the opportunity to
 
**work closely with AMINU’s co\-founders** 

 , seek guidance from them and learn how decisions are made in a growing premium brand. You’ll also get first\-hand exposure to how
 
**premium consumers think, communicate and interact with a brand** 

 —and what it takes to build trust and loyalty with them.
 




  





**Why This Role is the Future** 





 Luxury retail in India is evolving rapidly, and AMINU is building at the forefront of this space. This role gives you the opportunity to understand how a premium Indian brand builds relationships with its consumers, not just how it sells to them.
 




  






 You’ll start by speaking to consumers directly, understanding their questions, expectations, behaviour and purchase decisions. As you grow, you’ll move from understanding conversations to building communication strategies across WhatsApp, email, AI, CRM and other consumer touchpoints.
 




  






 Step 1 is about learning the consumer. Step 2 is about learning how to communicate with them.
 




  






 By the end of the journey, you should be able to look at a consumer segment and think about what they need to hear, how AMINU should say it, where we should say it and how we know if it worked.
 




  






 The goal is to give you a foundation in consumer psychology, luxury communication and retention strategy and eventually enable you to contribute to how AMINU builds its relationship with consumers.
 




  




**What You'll Do** 

**Consumer Experience \& ORM** 




**Stage 1:** 



* Handle consumer conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram and email around skincare, products, orders, shipments and offers.
* Understand consumer concerns, analyse conversations and identify patterns and insights.
* Create customer\-facing creatives, copy and communication to educate and assist consumers.



**Stage 2:** 



* Train and improve
 
**AI\-powered customer communication bots** 

 and response flows



**CRM \& Retention** 




**Stage 1:** 



* Write copy, build audience segments and work with the creative team on campaign assets.
* Build and test customer journeys such as
 
**welcome, post\-purchase, restock and checkout abandonment** 

 .



**Stage 2:** 



* Track campaign performance and use learnings to improve future communication.
* Plan and execute end to end WhatsApp, email and SMS campaigns.



**Conversion \& Growth**

title: Contact Center Technology Engineer
description:

**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.**

 This position is responsible for managing a variety of tasks supporting the overall contact center technology ecosystem including phone \& messaging platforms, IVR, and reporting. This individual must monitor system uptime, conduct periodic testing, investigate technology issues, plan, design, track, and modify IVR\-enabled telecommunications systems using Amazon Connect or similar technologies.

Work through outsource partner counterparts to remedy service degradations and develop proper preventive measures as needed to prevent future service failures. Manage day to day technology issues/concerns at our contact centers globally.


**Who You Are**
* 3\+ years in technology or a related field.

* Prior call center operations experience is preferred.

* Effectively communicate with individuals at all levels internally and externally.
* Solid analytical, follow\-up, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to operate successfully in a time\-sensitive and fast\-paced contact center environment,
* Access Management, Troubleshooting and remediation of tech issues reported at our contact centers.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.

**Who We Are**
 WE ARE PRICELINE.
   

  

 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
   

  

**Flexible work at Priceline**
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
