description:
**BMI is currently seeking an Associate Director or Director, Risk Advisory – Credit Risk Modelling, based out of our Mumbai office.**
 BMI's systematic, independent and data\-driven market insights, analysis and forecasts enable customers to recognize and assess risks and opportunities across markets and industries. For almost 40 years, we have provided impartial views to support our customers’ strategic plans and investment decisions.
   

  

 At BMI, we’re proud of the work we do to help our clients manage risks and opportunities in global markets, which began in 1984 and continues to this day. By stepping into a role here, you will help shape the strategic decisions of the world’s leading organizations. As a member of our team, your role will go beyond conventional boundaries. You will collaborate with industry experts, thought leaders, and visionary executives, collectively working towards shaping the future of businesses that span a multitude of sectors. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we continuously strive to offer our colleagues a great place to work, with opportunities to learn, innovate, develop their careers, and serve the community.
   

  

 Want to learn more about a career at BMI? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/BMI/
   

  

**About The Team**
 BMI's Risk Advisory team provides specialist advisory services across credit risk modelling, model validation, IFRS 9 implementation, portfolio analytics and regulatory risk management. Working closely with financial institutions and corporate clients, the team combines deep technical expertise with practical industry experience to design and deliver data\-driven risk solutions that support effective decision\-making, governance and regulatory compliance.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Credit Risk Model Development \& Delivery**
* Develop and review credit risk models using Excel\-based rating agency frameworks, Python and statistical techniques including logistic regression, decision trees and ensemble methods.
* Build and enhance IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, including PD, LGD, EAD and CCF components across both simplified and general approaches.
* Develop roll\-rate\-based PD models using customer\-level receivables data, portfolio\-level data and ageing cohort analysis.
* Apply advanced methodologies including TTC\-to\-PiT conversion, Vasicek modelling, survival PDs and term PD structures.
* Partner with senior subject matter experts to scope engagements, define analytical frameworks and deliver robust, client\-ready solutions.


**Model Validation, Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Conduct credit risk model validations aligned with OCC 2011\-12 guidance and Basel requirements, assessing discriminatory power, calibration, model stability and population stability.
* Perform parameter\-level validation including WoE, IV analysis, backtesting and out\-of\-time performance testing.
* Evaluate statistical, scorecard and hybrid risk models to ensure analytical integrity and regulatory compliance.
* Produce clear, defensible and auditable validation reports, technical documentation and client deliverables.
* Drive continuous improvement through evaluation of new methodologies, technologies and emerging modelling practices.


**Client \& Commercial Partnership**
* Serve as a subject matter expert in client discussions, supporting solution design, proposal development and project delivery.
* Translate client requirements into practical modelling approaches and commercially relevant analytical outputs.
* Present modelling methodologies, validation findings and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements through value\-added risk advisory solutions.


**Technical Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Support the development of the wider Advisory team's credit risk modelling and validation capability through mentoring, coaching and knowledge sharing.
* Create reusable modelling templates, validation frameworks and best\-practice guidance to improve consistency and efficiency.
* Help colleagues develop expertise in statistical modelling, IFRS 9/ECL methodologies, model validation standards and emerging AI\-related risk concepts.


**You May Be a Good Fit If**
* Significant hands\-on experience in credit risk model development, model validation, IFRS 9/ECL modelling, credit analytics or related risk advisory functions.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and Python for statistical analysis, model development and validation.
* Deep understanding of credit risk methodologies, scorecard development, rating frameworks, model lifecycle management and regulatory model governance.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex analytical projects and client engagements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.


**What Would Make You Stand Out**
* Experience in stress testing, reverse stress testing and scenario\-based portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing or validating Early Warning Systems (EWS) and related monitoring frameworks.
* Exposure to AI, machine learning or deep learning model validation in credit risk applications.
* Experience supporting business development activities, proposals and client solution design.


**Why Choose Fitch**
* Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* A Culture of Learning \& Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals
* Promoting Health \& Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* Supportive Parenting Policies: Family\-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* Inclusive Work Environment : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community


 At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision\-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day\-to\-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI\-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
   

  

 Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.
   

  

 Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

**UNEXPECTED REWARDS**
 This role takes you on a journey through travel and excitement which will allow you to make a difference on a large scale through the enhancement of pharmaceuticals and medical devices. The CRA position provides many other distinctive advantages including:

* Defined CRA promotion and growth ladder with potential for mentoring and management advancements
* Competitive pay and opportunity for significant travel bonus


**Responsibilities**
 As a CRA Entry, you will specifically be responsible for the following:
   

  

* Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
* Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
* Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
* Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
* Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
* Regulatory document review;
* Medical device and/or investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
* Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
* Assessing the clinical research site’s patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
* Completion of monitoring reports and follow\-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies, and recommended actions to secure compliance.


**Qualifications**

* Candidate with Clinical Research Coordinator experience is an advantage:

* Familiarity with Microsoft® Office; and
* Strong communication and presentation skills a plus.


**Medpace Overview**
 Medpace is a full\-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l\-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. title: ETP & STP Operator
description:
**This role is for Zepcruit's client**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Company Name \- Parker Hannifin India Pvt.Ltd.**
* Operate and maintain ETP \& STP plants efficiently.
* Monitor and control all treatment processes to ensure treated water quality within norms.
* Ensure compliance with pollution control board
* (PCB) norms and company standards.
* Carry out preventive maintenance and minor repairs of equipment.
* Maintain records, logs and reports of daily operations and water analysis.
* Ensure good housekeeping and safe working conditions in the plant.
* Report any breakdowns or abnormalities to supervisor/maintenance team.
* Support in achieving zero discharge and environmental compliance.


**Daily routine work**
* Check and record inlet \& outlet flow, pH, TDS, COD, BOD, TSS and other parameters.
* Monitor and operate all units: Collection Tank, Equalization Tank, Aeration Tank, Settling Tank, Filter Feed Tank, etc.
* Start/stop and monitor operation of pumps, blowers, motors, mixers, and dosing systems.
* Check chemical dosing (pH adjustment, coagulant, polymer, chlorine, etc.) as per requirement.
* Perform sludge handling \- drying beds, sludge transfer and disposal.
* Clean screens, barracks, filters and remove any blockage.
* Check DO (Dissolved Oxygen), MLSS, and maintain biological activity in STP.
* Check and maintain instruments \- pH meter, DO meter, MLSS, flow meter, etc.
* Record daily readings, maintain logbook and submit reports.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and safety in ETP \& STP area.


**Required Knowledge \& Skills**
* Good knowledge of ETP \& STP processes and equipment.
* Knowledge of water treatment chemicals and dosage control.
* Can read and understand process flow diagrams.
* Basic knowledge of pumps, motors, blowers and instrumentation.
* Can carry out minor maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Good observation, record keeping and reporting skills.
* Must follow safety and environmental norms.

**About Project Noon:** 




 Most people think sun care begins and ends with sunscreen.
 



 We don't.
 



 Project Noon is building India's first Sun Control brand\- reimagining how people protect, comfort, and recover from everyday sun exposure. We believe the future of sun care goes far beyond sunscreen, and we're creating an entirely new category of products designed to help people live better under the sun.
 



 Built at The Foundery, backed by Nikhil Kamath, Kishore Biyani, and Ronnie Screwvala, Project Noon is being built as a next\-generation consumer brand with the ambition to define a new category from India for the world. By combining breakthrough product innovation, thoughtful design, and world\-class brand building, we're creating a company that's changing the way millions of people experience the sun.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 





 We are looking for our Founding Supply Chain \& Operations Lead to build and lead Project Noon’s end\-to\-end supply chain and operations function. This is a high\-ownership leadership role where you won't just manage operations, you'll establish them. From designing planning systems and inventory processes to building relationships with manufacturers, logistics partners, warehouses, and overseas suppliers, you will lay the operational foundation for the business as it scales.
 




  






 The role covers planning, procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics, fulfilment, order management, technology implementation, and operational excellence across D2C, E\-commerce, and Quick Commerce channels.
 




  






 This role reports directly to the Founder and offers significant opportunities for growth as the company grows.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Supply Chain Strategy \& Planning** 




  






 • Build and own Project Noon's end\-to\-end supply chain strategy.

**Order Management \& Fulfilment**

 • Drive fulfilment accuracy, service levels and customer experience.
 




  





**Logistics \& Distribution** 




  






 • Oversee first\-mile, middle\-mile and last\-mile logistics.
 




  






 • Manage warehouse partners, freight providers and 3PLs.
 




  






 • Optimise logistics costs without compromising service quality.
 




  





**Inventory \& Warehouse Operations** 




  






 • Build inventory planning and replenishment systems.
 




  






 • Maintain healthy inventory while reducing stock\-outs and excess inventory.
 




  






 • Drive warehouse productivity and inventory accuracy.
 




  





**Operations Excellence** 




  






 • Develop dashboards and KPIs.
 




  






 • Implement technology and automation to improve operational visibility.
 




  






 • Drive continuous improvement across the supply chain.
 




  





**Cross Functional Collaboration** 




  






 • Partner closely with Product, Brand, Finance and Growth teams.
 




  






 • Coordinate with manufacturers, packaging vendors, logistics partners and overseas suppliers to ensure seamless execution.
 




  





**Team Building** 




  






 • Help build and mentor the operations function as the company scales, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
 




  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  






 • A minimum of 3\- 5 years of experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Planning or Logistics.
 




  






 • Experience working with D2C brands, personal care, beauty, skincare, wellness or consumer products.
 




  






 • Strong understanding of demand planning, procurement, inventory management, warehousing, logistics and fulfilment.
 




  






 • Strong understanding of first\-mile, middle\-mile, and last\-mile logistics.
 




  






 • Experience working with contract manufacturers and 3PL partners.
 




  






 • Experience managing D2C, Marketplace and Quick Commerce operations.
 




  






 • Strong analytical, commercial and problem\-solving skills.
 




  






 • Comfortable building systems and processes in a fast\-paced startup environment.
 




  






 • Experience implementing technology, ERP, WMS, or supply chain automation initiatives

**Preferred Background:** 




  






 • Experience in D2C, personal care, skincare, beauty, wellness or consumer brands preferred.
 




  






 • Experience with overseas sourcing and international supplier management is an added advantage.

**Preferred Traits:** 




  






 • Entrepreneurial builder mindset.
 




  






 • Strategic thinker with exceptional execution capability.

title: Clinical Lead
description:
**About Lyra**
 Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.

* Quality Oversight: Design and oversee robust quality assurance activities, including systematic clinical audits, in\-depth case reviews, and continuous outcome monitoring (CORE\-10/Work Impact).
* Incident Management: Lead investigations into serious clinical incidents and formal complaints, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure corrective actions and systemic learning.
* Senior Escalation: Act as the final clinical escalation point for complex queries, ethical dilemmas, and high\-risk situations, providing expert guidance and resolution.
* Clinical Delivery Oversight \& Team Management
* Team Leadership: Provide senior clinical oversight and leadership to teams responsible for direct service delivery, including Intake Counselors, Clinical Case Managers, and Structured Counselors.
* Fidelity \& Pathways: Ensure consistent application of Lyra’s clinical pathways, standardized assessment tools, and evidence\-based intervention protocols across all delivery teams.
* Capacity Planning: Contribute to strategic planning regarding clinical team capacity and resource allocation to align with service demand and operational efficiency.
* Professional Development: Oversee onboarding and continuous professional development programs, focusing on clinical fidelity and the sophisticated use of Lyra’s methodologies.
* Mentorship: Foster a high\-performance environment by providing direct mentorship and supervision to Clinical Team Leaders.
* Case Management Excellence
* Clinical Integrity: Maintain overall responsibility for the clinical integrity and effectiveness of the case management function.
* Data\-Driven Optimization: Analyze aggregate case management data and trends to identify areas for process refinement and improved client outcomes.
* High\-Acuity Consultation: Provide direct clinical guidance on high\-acuity or highly sensitive cases requiring senior\-level review and intervention.
* Care Coordination: Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in care coordination, inter\-provider collaboration, and referral pathways across the service spectrum.
* Interdepartmental Collaboration \& Strategic Input
* Network Partnership: Partner with the Network Operations Manager to ensure the provider network aligns with Lyra’s standards, providing clinical input on recruitment criteria and performance expectations.
* Strategic Advisory: Provide essential clinical expertise to Product Development, Commercial, and Client Success teams to inform service evolution and market strategy.
* Thought Leadership: Represent Lyra’s clinical approach and quality standards in external forums, conferences, and industry discussions.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in a clinical field (e.g., Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work).
* Optional: Valid and current professional registration/licensure to practice independently in India (e.g., RCI registration for Clinical Psychologists or equivalent recognized national bodies).


**Experience**
* Several years of extensive post\-qualification clinical experience in mental health, including direct assessment, diagnosis, and evidence\-based interventions.
* Several years of progressive experience in a clinical leadership, supervisory, or programmatic oversight role within India.
* Deep understanding of the Indian mental healthcare landscape and regulatory compliance.
* Fluency in English and Hindi is essential; knowledge of other major regional languages is a significant advantage.


**About You**
* Clinical Acumen: Exceptional clinical understanding and the advanced ability to identify, assess, and manage high\-level clinical risk and complex psychological presentations.
* Problem Solver: Highly analytical with superior problem\-solving skills, capable of navigating intricate clinical and operational challenges independently.
* Autonomous \& Accountable: Able to work independently without close supervision, while ensuring all key issues are escalated appropriately and critical decisions are clinically sound.
* Detail\-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of data, maintaining strict confidentiality, and adhering to complex clinical procedures.
* Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders internationally.
* Proactive \& Adaptive: Strong continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to innovate and refine clinical processes. Flexible, adaptable, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Organized: Highly organized with exceptional ability to plan, prioritize, and manage a high\-volume, complex clinical function effectively.
* Collaborative: A strong team player who readily accepts change and collaborates effectively with internal and external partners.


**Miscellaneous**
* Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy.
* Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed\-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and care outcomes.
* Workshop \& Content: Lead the delivery of onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of training manuals and affiliate\-facing materials.
* Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote Lyra’s transformative care model and clinical research.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Five9, contact center technologies, Work Flow Automation, CRM integrations, workforce management and AI\-powered contact center capabilities.**

title: Private Chef
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: PRIVATE CHEF FOR HNI HOUSEHOLDS** 




**Position:** 

 Private Chef (In\-Home)
 




**Location:** 

 Mumbai (client residences — South Mumbai, Bandra, Juhu, Worli and surrounding areas)
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time, long\-term placement (live\-in or live\-out, depending on the household)
 




**Compensation:** 

 ₹50,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month, based on profile, culinary range and experience
 




**About Chef\-Hire** 





 Chef\-Hire places exceptional professional chefs with high\-net\-worth households, family offices and luxury residences. We are not a catering agency — we match career chefs with families who value world\-class food, discretion and long\-term relationships. Our clients expect hotel\-grade quality delivered in the comfort and privacy of their own homes.
 




**Role Overview** 





 We are seeking a talented and versatile Private Chef to cook daily for a high\-net\-worth family in their Mumbai residence. You will own the household's kitchen end to end — planning menus, sourcing the finest ingredients, and delivering restaurant\-quality meals tailored to the family's tastes, dietary needs and lifestyle. This is a role for a chef who takes pride in consistency, presentation and quiet professionalism.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 





 Plan and prepare daily meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks) as per the family's schedule and preferences
 





 Design rotating weekly and monthly menus, keeping meals interesting, seasonal and nutritionally balanced
 





 Cook for family events, dinners, festivals and small private gatherings hosted at the residence
 





 Manage kitchen operations: inventory, sourcing, vendor relationships and hygiene standards
 





 Source premium ingredients — fresh produce, specialty imports and quality meats/seafood — and manage the kitchen budget efficiently
 





 Accommodate dietary requirements: vegetarian/Jain households, allergies, religious guidelines and doctor/adviser\-directed plans
 





 Maintain impeccable cleanliness, food safety and organisation in the client kitchen at all times
 





 Travel with the family domestically (and internationally, where agreed) when required
 





 Coordinate discreetly with household staff, estate managers and the family office where applicable
 




**Culinary Expertise Required** 





 Multi\-cuisine proficiency: Indian (regional specialities), Continental, Asian and Mediterranean cooking
 





 Fine\-dining / gourmet presentation standards — plating, texture and flavour balance at a luxury\-hotel level
 





 Strong grounding in Indian regional cuisines — from Punjabi, Mughlai and Gujarati/Marwari to coastal, Konkani and South Indian cooking
 





 Health\-focused cooking: calorie\-counted, macro\-balanced, keto, paleo, ayurvedic and other physician/nutritionist\-prescribed diets
 





 Comfort with international techniques: grilling, baking, sous\-vide, pasta\-making, fermenting and garde manger
 




**Requirements** 





 Minimum 3 years of professional culinary experience — in 5\-star hotels, fine\-dining restaurants, luxury catering or private households
 





 Prior experience as a private chef for HNI/UHNW families is a strong plus
 





 Culinary degree or diploma (hotel management / culinary arts) preferred, though exceptional experience can substitute
 





 Discretion, confidentiality and polished personal presentation — non\-negotiable for this client base
 





 Fluent communication in English and Hindi; Marathi or Gujarati is a bonus
 





 Flexible with hours, including weekends and festival periods; comfortable in live\-in arrangements (or open to live\-out depending on the household)
 





 Valid identity documents, background verification readiness and references from previous employers
 





 Mumbai\-based candidates or those willing to relocate to Mumbai preferred
 




**What We Offer** 





 Salary of ₹50,000 to ₹1,50,000 per month, commensurate with your profile, taste and experience
 





 A stable, long\-term placement with a respectful and appreciative household
 





 Ongoing support and professional development through Chef\-Hire's chef network, with creative freedom in the kitchen and access to premium ingredients and equipment
 





 Live\-in or live\-out arrangements, depending on the client and your preference
 




**How to Apply** 



* Send your CV with photographs of your best dishes and, if possible, a short introduction video to Chef\-Hire. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a tasting round and a personal interview. Every application is reviewed in confidence.

title: Clinical Operations Consultant
description:
**About Lyra**
 Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.
   

  

 The Clinical Operations Associate serves as the primary operational backbone for Lyra's onsite clinic network, customer training initiatives, and intake workflows in India. Reporting to the Network Operations Manager, this role oversees end\-to\-end clinic logistics, clinician onboarding, shift rotas, and appointment turnaround times while managing client and affiliate escalations. Additionally, the position drives customer training request intake, handling feasibility assessments, scheduling, platform setup, and post\-session feedback evaluation. Requiring a clinical background—such as a degree in Psychology, Counseling, or Social Work—and at least two years of healthcare administrative experience, the associate ensures operational compliance, seamless cross\-functional communication, and data accuracy across all service delivery channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Onsite Clinic Management \& Coordination:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the operational aspects of Lyra’s Onsite Clinics in India, under the guidance of the Clinical Operations Manager.
* Coordinate the scheduling and logistical arrangements for Onsite Clinic operations, including room bookings, IT setup, and material preparation.
* Manage communication between Lyra, the client, and the clinicians involved in Onsite Clinics.
* Support the onboarding of clinicians for Onsite Clinic engagements, ensuring they have the necessary information and resources.
* Track and manage clinician availability and capacity for Onsite Clinic assignments.
* Assist in the collection and reporting of key operational metrics related to Onsite Clinics.
* Support the implementation of clinical and operational protocols specific to Onsite Clinics.
* Liaise with administrative and support teams to ensure the smooth functioning of Onsite Clinic operations.


**Training Request Coordination**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the intake and initial processing of training and workshop requests from Lyra’s Onsite Clinic customers in India.
* Coordinate with internal clinical teams and external trainers to assess the feasibility and scope of customer training requests.
* Manage the scheduling and logistical arrangements for customer\-facing training sessions, workshops, and webinars, including venue booking (if applicable), virtual platform setup, and material preparation.
* Communicate training schedules, content outlines, and logistical details to customer contacts.
* Track and manage customer participation in scheduled training sessions.
* Assist the Clinical Operations Manager in developing tailored training proposals and materials for customers.
* Support the collection of feedback from customers on training sessions and assist in the evaluation of training effectiveness.
* Maintain organized records of customer training requests, schedules, and feedback.
* Liaise with client success and account management teams to ensure seamless coordination of customer training initiatives.


**Intake Team Management**
* Creating monthly Rota to allocate duties
* Ensure supervision on successful completion of shifts and data recording in timely manner
* Ensure smooth communication on slack to avoid missing on any data capturing and scheduling of sessions
* TAT for appointment schedule
* Timely preparation of report of intake referrals
* Ensure support on escalation from client/ affiliate with regards to appointment with 100% resolution

title: Executive Assistant - Fixed Term Contract [12 Months]
description:
**Main purpose** 








 The Executive Assistant will be an integral part of Trafigura's executive support function, working directly with senior global leaders across the organisation. The role exists to enable leadership effectiveness by seamlessly managing schedules, travel, communications, and administrative operations in a high\-paced, globally connected trading environment. The EA will act as a trusted operational partner anticipating needs, managing competing priorities, and ensuring that every interaction with the executive's office reflects Trafigura's standards of professionalism.
 











**Key responsibilities** 




**Calendar \& Schedule Management** 



* Manage complex, multi\-time\-zone calendars for one or more senior executives, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts and prioritising commitments.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings across Trafigura's global offices (London, Singapore, Geneva, Houston, Mumbai), accounting for time zone differences.
* Maintain a forward\-looking view of executive commitments and flag potential clashes or over\-commitments in advance.
* Send meeting invites, confirmations, and reminders in a timely manner; manage last\-minute changes calmly and efficiently.



**Travel Coordination** 



* Arrange complex, multi\-leg international travel including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and documentation.
* Build detailed, real\-time travel itineraries and dossiers covering all bookings, contacts, and contingency information.
* Manage changes, cancellations, and last\-minute travel disruptions swiftly and without escalation.
* Liaise with Trafigura's travel management partners and vendors to ensure policy compliance and cost efficiency.



**Expense Management \& Workday** 



* Process and submit expense reports accurately and on time, ensuring full compliance with Trafigura's expense policy.
* Prepare, reconcile, and track expense claims on behalf of executives; follow up on approvals and reimbursements proactively.
* Maintain organised records of receipts, invoices, and financial documentation for audit readiness.
* Flag policy exceptions, anomalies, and pending approvals to ensure nothing is delayed or missed.
* Experience with Workday's expense management module is an added advantage.



**Meetings \& Minutes of Meeting (MOMs)** 



* Prepare agendas, pre\-read materials, and briefing notes ahead of senior\-level meetings.
* Attend or facilitate key meetings and produce accurate, concise Minutes of Meeting (MOMs), capturing decisions, action items, and owners clearly.
* Distribute MOMs in a timely manner and proactively track open action items through to completion, following up with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain a structured repository of meeting records for governance and reference purposes.



**Stakeholder \& Communication Management** 



* Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders reaching the executive(s), managing correspondence with professionalism and discretion.
* Build strong working relationships with global counterparts — EAs, Chiefs of Staff, and business leads — across Trafigura's international offices.
* Draft, proofread, and send communications on behalf of executives as required.
* Screen and prioritise incoming requests, emails, and calls, ensuring appropriate urgency and delegation







**Administrative Support** 



* Maintain organised digital and physical filing systems for contracts, correspondence, and key documents.
* Coordinate logistics for town halls, offsites, leadership visits, and other executive events.
* Raise purchase orders, manage vendor invoices, and liaise with Finance and Procurement as needed.
* Handle ad hoc research, data collation, and presentation preparation as directed by the executive(s).







**Required qualifications** 



* 3–7 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, or in a senior administrative support role.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi\-time\-zone calendars and travel for senior executives.
* Proven experience coordinating international business travel including multi\-leg itineraries, visas, and last\-minute changes.
* Track record of producing accurate, well\-structured Minutes of Meeting (MOMs) and following up on action items to closure.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite: Outlook (calendar and email management), Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced corporate or professional services environment.
* Exposure to global or multinational organisations and managing global stakeholders is a strong plus.











**Skills** 







* Organised, detail\-oriented, and process\-driven — able to manage multiple priorities without losing accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to draft professional correspondence independently.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Workday expense management.
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation, including senior global leaders.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to juggle competing demands and meet deadlines consistently.
* High\-quality document and report preparation, with excellent attention to formatting and detail.
* Comfortable navigating digital tools, scheduling platforms, and expense and travel management systems.







**Attributes for success** 



* Proactive and solutions\-oriented — you anticipate what is needed rather than waiting to be asked.
* High degree of discretion and integrity when handling confidential information and sensitive communications.
* Calm under pressure and adaptable in a dynamic, fast\-moving trading environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative, service\-oriented approach.
* Proven ability to prioritise workload effectively and manage time across multiple tasks and principals.
* Culturally sensitive and comfortable engaging with colleagues and stakeholders across different geographies and backgrounds.
* Willingness to take on expanded responsibilities as business needs evolve.

title: Global Command Center Operations Senior Manager
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
 NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Global Command Center Operations Manager is responsible for leading the 24x7 Global Command Center responsible for monitoring, event correlation, incident response, escalation coordination, operational communications, and service reliability across critical infrastructure, applications, networks, job scheduling, and telephony services. This role provides operational leadership for geographically distributed teams and ensures that Command Center functions consistently meet availability, resiliency, compliance, and service management expectations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, metrics\-driven operations leader with strong ITIL/ITSM discipline, deep infrastructure operations awareness, and the ability to translate technical events into clear executive\-level business impact. This leader will drive process maturity, automation, alert quality, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across global operations while maintaining a high\-accountability and service\-focused team culture.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership and Service Reliability
   

  

* Lead day\-to\-day and shift\-based 24x7 Global Command Center operations across monitoring, triage, escalation, incident communications, and operational coordination.
* Oversee functional coverage for server operations monitoring, network operations monitoring, application operations monitoring, lab operations monitoring, Helix/Control\-M job scheduling, Windows and Linux L2 support, and Genesys/IP telephony operations.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, uptime expectations, alert response targets, escalation procedures, and operational performance metrics.
* Drive proactive monitoring, event correlation, alert tuning, runbook quality, and automation to reduce noise, improve response times, and minimize manual intervention.
* Maintain operational readiness for high\-severity events, business\-impacting incidents, planned maintenance windows, and critical change activity.


 Incident, Problem, and Change Management
   

  

* Lead Command Center participation in major incidents by coordinating bridge engagement, ensuring role clarity, maintaining focus on service restoration, and escalating to appropriate technical and leadership teams.
* Partner with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support fast restoration and durable corrective actions.
* Review incident trends, recurring alerts, failed jobs, chronic infrastructure events, and escalation patterns to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support post\-incident reviews, root cause analysis, known error documentation, corrective/preventive action tracking, and lessons\-learned adoption.
* Ensure Command Center teams follow approved change, incident, problem, access, and communication processes.


 Governance, Compliance, and Audit Readiness
   

  

* Create, maintain, and enforce SOPs, technical runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, operational checklists, and process documentation.
* Ensure operational evidence is complete, accurate, timely, and defensible for internal reviews, SOX audits, control testing, and regulatory inquiries.
* Partner with security, risk, compliance, and technology owners to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, access protocols, and data protection expectations.
* Establish governance routines to review operational metrics, control gaps, aged actions, process exceptions, and continuous improvement progress.


 Team Leadership and Talent Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of team leads, engineers, analysts, and operations specialists across multiple shifts and domains.
* Own staffing plans, shift coverage, onboarding, training, performance expectations, development plans, succession planning, and quality accountability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, operational discipline, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to monitor team engagement, morale, readiness, skill gaps, escalation behaviors, and adherence to operational standards.


 Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs including availability, SLA adherence, alert volume, alert aging, MTTA/MTTR, escalation effectiveness, incident recurrence, job failure trends, change\-related incidents, and runbook compliance.
* Prepare concise executive\-level updates on operational health, incident trends, risk areas, improvement plans, staffing readiness, and service reliability.
* Use data to identify systemic issues, automation opportunities, process bottlenecks, and training needs.
* Partner with tool owners and engineering teams to improve dashboards, observability, event correlation, workflow automation, and operational intelligence.


 Vendor and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Manage vendor engagement related to operations tools, monitoring platforms, job scheduling, infrastructure services, telecom platforms, and support escalations.
* Hold vendors and internal service teams accountable for service delivery, timely escalation, issue ownership, and contractual/service commitments.
* Serve as an operational bridge between senior leadership, infrastructure teams, application teams, security, service management, vendors, and site leadership.
* Support budget planning, resource planning, capacity needs, tool rationalization, and operational investment recommendations.


**Skill Requirements/Preferences**
 Required Skills and Experience
   

  

* 12\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, technology operations, command center, NOC/SOC/AOC, service management, or related enterprise technology functions.
* 8\+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, team leads, engineers, analysts, or shift\-based operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing global or multi\-site operations with cross\-functional responsibility for service reliability, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and executive communication.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service level management.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, alerting, ITSM, and job scheduling platforms such as ServiceNow, Helix, Control\-M, SolarWinds, Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, network fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, SD\-WAN, DNS/DHCP, telephony/VoIP, and application operations monitoring.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, performance reporting, service health reviews, incident trend analysis, and continuous improvement plans.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, access control, SOX, control evidence, policy adherence, and operational governance processes.
* Strong vendor management, escalation management, service accountability, and stakeholder communication capabilities.


**Preferred Technical Skills**
* Experience with hybrid cloud environments including Azure, Oracle Cloud, AWS, VMware vSphere, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience improving event management through alert rationalization, event correlation, automation, AIOps, or runbook orchestration.
* Familiarity with resiliency practices including disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity planning, lifecycle management, backup/recovery, high availability, and operational risk reduction.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation concepts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation, or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts.
* Experience leading transformation efforts that modernize command center operations, reduce toil, improve service health visibility, or improve incident response maturity.


 SOME OF THE SOFT SKILLS / ABILITIES REQUIRED FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE INCLUDE
   

  

* Calm, composed leadership during high\-pressure, business\-impacting incidents.
* Clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate communication for executives, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to command and control incident bridges while maintaining accountability, urgency, and respectful collaboration.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision\-making when managing competing business, technical, and operational demands.
* Ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, service health, and actionable leadership updates.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build trust, develop team leads, provide feedback, and reinforce standard work.
* High ownership and follow\-through across open actions, recurring issues, audit items, staffing needs, and operational risks.
* Process discipline with the ability to standardize work, reduce ambiguity, document expectations, and drive consistent execution.
* Strong analytical capability with a focus on metrics, trend analysis, root cause thinking, and measurable improvement.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority and create alignment across geographically distributed stakeholders.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, global, shift\-based environment where priorities may change quickly.


**Additional Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL Managing Professional, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Linux, Cisco, VMware, ServiceNow, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience leading a global command center, NOC, SOC, AOC, infrastructure operations center, managed services operations, or enterprise service reliability function.
* Experience building or maturing operating models, RACI matrices, escalation frameworks, QA programs, knowledge management practices, or operational control points.
* Experience with financial services, payments, ATM, retail banking, regulated infrastructure, or other high\-availability customer\-impacting technology environments.
* Experience supporting business continuity, disaster recovery exercises, command center readiness testing, crisis management, or operational resilience programs.
* Experience managing cross\-cultural teams, offshore/onshore delivery models, and vendor\-supported services.


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related discipline required, or equivalent combination of education and progressive enterprise IT operations experience.
* Master’s degree in Information Systems, Technology Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
* Relevant professional certifications may be considered in combination with demonstrated leadership and enterprise technology operations experience.


 WORK ENVIRONMENT AND EXPECTATIONS
   

  

* Full\-time role based in Mumbai, India with expectation to work from the office five days per week unless otherwise approved by leadership.
* Must be able to support a 24x7 global operations model, including rotational schedules, after\-hours escalations, planned maintenance windows, and major incident response as business needs require.
* Must be comfortable working with global stakeholders across multiple time zones and supporting business\-critical technology services.


 Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.
   

  

**EEO Statement**
 NCR Atleos is an equal\-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job\-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Atleos employees, or any NCR Atleos facility.  The Role: Product Intern
   

  

 You’ll join the Product team and work closely with Product Managers on building and improving products across the investing journey, with a focus on the Mutual Funds and Advisory space.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on product \+ data role where you’ll work across product requirements, analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and execution. You’ll use SQL and product analytics tools to understand how users interact with our products, identify opportunities, and turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and insights into products that customers can use. You won’t just look at the numbers you’ll help understand what they mean for the product and what we should do next.
   

  

 What You’ll Own

* Work with the product backlog — help groom, prioritise, and organise requirements so the team stays focused on what matters.
* Own product analytics — build and analyse dashboards, funnels, and key product metrics to understand user behaviour and feature performance.
* Use SQL to answer product questions — write basic queries using filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data without always depending on the data team.
* Analyse user behaviour through tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude — build funnels, retention reports, and cohorts and understand what the numbers mean for the product.
* Turn data into insights — identify trends, drop\-offs, and opportunities and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Run competitive intelligence across investing, wealth\-tech, and broader fintech platforms. Track product launches, UX changes, features, and pricing.
* Conduct structured product teardowns of competitor products and customer journeys to understand gaps and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and user behaviour.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements and insights into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, SQL analysis, documentation, dashboarding, testing, competitive analysis, and the detailed work that turns product questions into real improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Strong analytical thinking. You enjoy working with numbers, breaking down problems, and finding meaningful patterns in data.
* Comfortable with SQL. You can write basic queries using SELECT, filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data. Deep SQL expertise is not required.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about how users interact with financial products.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Genuine interest in fintech, investing, or financial products is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem or a set of data and turn it into a clear, structured insight.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving
 **Product team** 
 , working on real product problems across the investing journey, with exposure to the
 **Mutual Funds and Advisory** 
 space.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to
 **product management, SQL, product analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 while working on real problems and seeing how your insights translate into product improvements.
   

  

 You’ll learn how to connect
 **data → insights → product decisions** 
 and get direct exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-moving fintech environment.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our
 **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice**

**About the Role and Team:**

In addition to hands\-on design responsibilities, this role focuses on developing team members, fostering a high\-performance culture, and ensuring alignment between UX design activities, product goals, and business objectives.
   

  

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of UX Designers by setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional growth. Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture with strong ownership and accountability.
* UX Design Delivery: Contribute to and lead the design thinking cycle by proactively identifying user problems and opportunities and delivering UX design solutions across all phases of the Product Development Process (discovery, scope analysis, development, and validation).
* Design Quality and Consistency: Ensure high standards of UX design quality across the team by applying and evolving the UX design framework, design system, and best practices. Promote consistency and scalability of design solutions. Designs are web / desktop focused.

* Process Improvement and Best Practices: Contribute to the evolution of UX ways of working, frameworks, and internal processes. Identify improvement opportunities and help scale successful practices across teams.
* Recruitment and Talent Growth: Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of UX Designers. Participate in hiring processes and contribute to building a strong design organization.

title: IT Infrastructure Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 GS E\&C is a leading global contractor from Korea, delivering design and construction services across Civil Engineering, Building, Oil \& Gas, Power Plants, and Renewable Energy. The company leverages extensive international project experience to provide high\-quality, technology\-driven solutions. GS E\&C focuses on long\-term partnerships, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and act as a trusted global business partner. Professionals joining GS E\&C can expect exposure to complex, large\-scale projects and a performance\-oriented environment.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site IT Infrastructure Manager role based in Mumbai. The IT Infrastructure Manager will oversee the planning, implementation, and maintenance of core IT systems, including servers, networks, storage, and related hardware and software. Daily responsibilities include monitoring system performance, ensuring high availability, managing backups and disaster recovery, and coordinating with vendors and service providers. The role will also involve enforcing security policies, managing user access, leading troubleshooting efforts for infrastructure\-related issues, and guiding the IT operations team to support business continuity. The IT Infrastructure Manager will collaborate with global and local stakeholders to align infrastructure standards with corporate requirements and support ongoing and new project needs.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Information Technology and IT Operations skills, with experience managing enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Candidates should possess Network Security skills, including firewall management, VPNs, intrusion detection/prevention, and security best practices.
* Candidates should possess System Administration skills for Windows/Linux servers, virtualization platforms, and storage systems.
* Candidates should possess Troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure, performance, and connectivity issues.
* Relevant experience in managing on\-site IT infrastructure in large organizations or industrial/project\-based environments.
* Knowledge of cloud services, backup and recovery solutions, and IT service management frameworks (e.g., ITIL) is beneficial.
* Strong stakeholder communication, vendor management, and team leadership abilities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, MCSE, CompTIA Security\+) are an advantage.

title: ARIS Architect
description:
**ARIS Administration, Scripting, Architecture \& Technical Expert** 
 is an experienced individual contributor role within the
 **Business Process Management \& Enterprise Architecture** 
 Job Family. As part of the Professional career stream, this role focuses on administering, architecting, integrating, and optimizing the ARIS platform to support enterprise process management, governance, and digital transformation initiatives. The role requires deep technical expertise in ARIS architecture, scripting, APIs, integrations, and platform governance. Professionals at this level operate independently, provide technical leadership, mentor less experienced team members, and serve as subject matter experts for ARIS platform capabilities and best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**ARIS Platform Administration \& Support**
* Administer and maintain ARIS environments, including user management, permissions, repositories, databases, and system configuration.
* Ensure platform stability, performance, availability, and compliance with enterprise IT standards.
* Manage upgrades, patches, migrations, and environment refresh activities across development, test, and production environments.


**ARIS Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Design and maintain ARIS architecture aligned with business process management, governance, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Define and implement platform standards, repository structures, conventions, templates, and governance frameworks.
* Partner with enterprise architecture, process excellence, and IT teams to support strategic process management initiatives.


**ARIS Scripting \& Automation**
* Develop, maintain, and optimize ARIS reports, macros, scripts, and custom solutions using ARIS scripting capabilities.
* Automate repository administration, quality checks, governance workflows, data validations, and reporting activities.
* Create reusable technical components that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability of process management activities.


**Integration \& Technical Development**
* Design and implement integrations between ARIS and enterprise platforms using APIs, web services, databases, and other middleware technologies.
* Support synchronization and data exchange with process mining, workflow, ERP, and analytics platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration, performance, and configuration issues.


**Repository Governance \& Quality Management**
* Establish and enforce modeling standards, method governance, naming conventions, and repository quality controls.
* Develop automated validation and compliance checks to improve process model quality and consistency.
* Monitor repository health and recommend improvements to drive process excellence maturity.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Advisory**
* Collaborate with process owners, business architects, enterprise architects, IT teams, and external vendors to deliver ARIS\-enabled solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on ARIS capabilities, technical feasibility, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches.
* Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable ARIS solutions.


**Technical Leadership \& Knowledge Sharing**
* Mentor ARIS administrators, modelers, and junior technical resources on platform administration and development best practices.
* Develop technical standards, documentation, training materials, and operational procedures.
* Promote adoption of ARIS capabilities and share best practices across the organization.


**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**
* Stay current with ARIS product roadmap, emerging BPM technologies, process mining, workflow automation, and AI\-enabled process management capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to enhance platform utilization, automate manual activities, and improve user experience.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen process governance, operational efficiency, and digital transformation outcomes.


**Required Expertise**
* Deep expertise in ARIS Administration, ARIS Architect, ARIS Connect, ARIS Publisher, ARIS Aware, and ARIS Governance.
* Strong knowledge of ARIS scripting, report development, macros, APIs, and integration frameworks.
* Experience with repository management, BPM governance, process modeling standards, and enterprise architecture frameworks.
* Knowledge of databases, SQL, web services, REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and system integration concepts.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, stakeholder management, and technical communication skills.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The Lead \- Airport Systems is responsible for overseeing the maintenance, operations, and reliability of all airport systems, including but not limited to IT systems, baggage handling systems, passenger boarding bridges, and security systems. The role ensures these systems meet operational, safety, and compliance standards (OMDA, ICAO, DGCA, BCAS and TSA regulations with desired levels of Serviceability \& Availability Levels) while providing optimal performance and user experience
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Systems Management and Maintenance Strategy:**
 Oversee the maintenance, operation, and lifecycle management of critical airport systems.
   

  

 Ensure systems are operationally ready 24/7 with minimal downtime.
   

  

 Develop and implement preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance plans.
   

  

 Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and service providers for timely maintenance.
   

  

 Ensure the serviceability of airport systems as per Concession Agreement (CA) requirements. Maintain system availability at optimal levels to support seamless operations.
   

  

**Budget Management and resource allocation: .**
 Assist in preparing budgets for system maintenance and upgrades, ensuring alignment with overall airport operational goals.
   

  

 Monitor expenditures and ensure cost\-effective use of resources while maintaining high service levels.
   

  

 Ensure the availability of spare parts, tools, and equipment for smooth operations. Execute OPEX and CAPEX works as per the Annual Operating Plan.
   

  

**Spare \& Inventory Management**
 Maintain all\-time availability of critical spares for BHS, PBB, and other systems.
   

  

 Optimize inventory levels to minimize costs while avoiding downtime.
   

  

**Contract \& Vendor Management**
 Monitor vendor performance and adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response times.
   

  

 Generate Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and process vendor billing on time for maintenance services.
   

  

 Develop and revise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and establish robust SLA monitoring processes.
   

  

**Troubleshooting And Support**
 Provide technical leadership during critical system failures or emergencies, guiding the team in troubleshooting and resolution.
   

  

 Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, coordinating with other airport departments as necessary for timely resolution.
   

  

 Analyze incident reports, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
   

  

 Participate in initiatives focused on process excellence, cost reduction, energy savings, and 5S implementation.
   

  

 Address audit points and implement corrective measures.
   

  

**Training \& Development**
 Ensure contractors' staff are adequately trained to meet operational and safety requirements.
   

  

 Conduct training sessions and maintain skill enhancement programs.
   

  

**Special Projects**
 Lead and support projects for modernization, efficiency improvement, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Identify opportunities for innovation and process improvement.
   

  

**Safety Oversight And Compliance**
 Ensure compliance with local regulations, airport policies, and industry best practices related to airport systems and maintenance activities.
   

  

 Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of airport\-specific and global regulatory standards, including those related to security, safety, and sustainability.
   

  

 Develop and implement risk management strategies and contribute to the safety and emergency protocols related to airport systems
   

  

 Monitor operational compliance as per CA, ICAO, DGCA, and BCAS requirements.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to statutory requirements, including weights and measures standards and other applicable regulations.

title: Service Request Manager
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Service Request Manager
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 



  
 


 About the Role
 
 Agfa is seeking a service\-oriented and process\-driven
 **Service Request Manager** 
 to join its Global ICS (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end management and continuous improvement of the Service Request Management process, ensuring that users receive standard IT services efficiently, consistently, and within agreed service levels.
 



 You will work closely with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, and technical teams to optimize request fulfillment, enhance user experience, and improve operational efficiency through governance, automation, and process excellence. As part of the global IT Service Management organization, you will help ensure that service requests are delivered in a scalable, compliant, and customer\-focused manner.
 



  
 


 About You (Skills Required)
 
 You are highly organized, customer\-focused, and passionate about delivering efficient IT services. You enjoy improving processes, collaborating across teams, and leveraging data to enhance service performance and user satisfaction.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* A customer\-centric mindset with a focus on service quality and user experience.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and supplier management skills.
* Strong process governance and organizational capabilities.
* A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation and service optimization.


  What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Own and continuously improve the global Service Request Management process.
* Ensure efficient and timely fulfillment of service requests in accordance with agreed service levels.
* Manage and maintain the IT Service Catalogue, ensuring services remain accurate, relevant, and easy to consume.
* Coordinate the resolution and fulfillment of complex service requests involving multiple teams and service providers.
* Monitor service request performance, identify trends, and drive service improvements through reporting and analytics.
* Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to optimize service delivery and request fulfillment processes.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience.
* Establish and maintain governance controls to ensure compliance with IT Service Management standards and policies.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, service request workflows, and operational procedures.
* Act as backup for the Change Manager when required.


  What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)
 * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in Service Request Management.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Service Request Management principles and best practices.
* Experience in service management, process governance, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience working with outsourced service providers and vendor\-managed environments.
* Strong stakeholder and supplier management skills.
* Excellent customer service orientation and ability to balance user expectations with operational requirements.
* Experience with service catalog management, request fulfillment processes, and workflow optimization.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting, KPI monitoring, and performance management.
* Experience driving process improvement and automation initiatives.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent Service Management certification is considered an asset.


  Why Join Us
 * Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization committed to delivering high\-quality services to users worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams, business stakeholders, and strategic technology partners.
* Drive innovation through automation and process excellence initiatives.
* Play a key role in improving employee experience and service delivery effectiveness across Agfa's global IT landscape.



  
 



 If you are passionate about service management, customer experience, process improvement, and operational excellence, we invite you to join Agfa and contribute to the evolution of our global IT services.
