title: Change Manager (IT)
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Change Manager (IT)
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. Agfa strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by combining innovative technology, deep industry expertise, and a strong commitment to quality and sustainability. Agfa’s headquarters are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 


  About the Role
 
 Agfa is seeking a highly motivated and organized
 **Change Manager** 
 to join its Global IT (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for governing and coordinating changes across Agfa's global IT landscape, ensuring that modifications to infrastructure, applications, platforms, and services are implemented in a controlled and efficient manner.
 



 You will play a critical role in minimizing business risk and service disruption while maximizing the success rate of IT changes. Working closely with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, and external vendors, you will ensure alignment, compliance, and operational excellence across the change management process.
 


  About You (Skills Required)
 
 You are a strong communicator and coordinator who thrives in a dynamic IT environment. You can balance governance and operational needs while effectively managing multiple stakeholders across different teams and vendors.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Excellent planning, coordination, and organizational capabilities.
* Analytical thinking with a structured approach to risk assessment and problem solving.
* The ability to work effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and external service providers.
* A continuous improvement mindset and focus on service quality.


* Flexibility and willingness to work outside standard business hours to support the planning, coordination, implementation, and governance of critical IT changes in a global 24/7 environment.



  
 



  
 


 What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Own and continuously improve the global IT Change Management process.
* Assess, classify, and evaluate changes, including risk and business impact analysis.
* Coordinate and manage changes across multiple vendors and managed service providers.
* Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and facilitate approval processes, including emergency change procedures.
* Maintain and communicate the 12\-month rolling maintenance calendar.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate changes across infrastructure, applications, and services.
* Monitor change performance, reporting metrics, and SLA compliance.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and drive continuous process improvement initiatives.
* Manage stakeholder communications and change\-related escalations.
* Act as backup for Configuration Management activities when required.


  What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in IT Service Management or IT Operations environments.
* Strong understanding of Change Management principles and best practices.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and managing third\-party service providers.
* Technical background with a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and application environments.
* Experience with ITIL processes and service management frameworks is highly desirable.
* Ability to work effectively in a global organization with geographically distributed teams.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional are considered an asset.



  
 



**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that enables innovation and business success across Agfa worldwide.
* Collaborate with international experts and strategic technology partners.
* Influence and improve key IT governance processes with global impact.



  
 



 If you are passionate about IT Service Management, governance, and driving operational excellence in a global environment, we would love to hear from you. Join Agfa and help shape the future of our global IT services.

description:
**Technical Skills:** 




  





 The L2 PIM/PAM Engineer is responsible for day\-to\-day administration, onboarding, and incident troubleshooting across enterprise Privileged Access Management platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Microsoft Entra PIM). In addition to operational maintenance, this role actively validates, audits, and assesses technical controls to ensure privileged accounts adhere to strict zero\-trust and least\-privilege standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Implementation \& Support (L2 Operations)** 



* Handle Day\-2 operations, ticket escalations, and incident resolution for PAM components (Safe management, account onboarding, CPM/PSM failures, and policy errors).
* Onboard target systems (Windows, Linux, databases, network devices, and cloud infrastructure) into PAM vaults with automated credential rotation.
* Manage Just\-In\-Time (JIT) access requests, time\-bound approvals, and role\-activation workflows in Microsoft Entra PIM and PAM solutions.
* Monitor health checks for core PAM services (Vaults, Proxies, Discovery agents, Session Recording servers) and coordinate with vendor support or L3 teams for complex outages.
* Configure, test, and maintain custom plugins, CPM platform management policies, and connection components.



**Technical Controls Assessment \& Validation** 



* Conduct routine technical assessments to verify that credential auto\-rotation, check\-in/check\-out policies, and password complexity controls function across all onboarded targets.
* Validate that Privileged Session Monitoring (PSM) and keylogging controls capture and index administrative sessions without bypassing.
* Audit Entra PIM policies: verify mandatory MFA triggers, justification requirements, approval chains, and maximum activation duration limits.
* Perform discovery scans to identify unmanaged privileged accounts, service accounts, and shadow admins across Active Directory, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Generate compliance evidence and remediate gaps aligned with audit standards (CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, SOC 2\).



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Core Platforms:**

 Transaction:

Good to have knowledge of the warehouse real estate sector, including market dynamics, key players, and investment trends. Experience in establishing and maintaining a network of IPCs and local brokers.

title: Manager - Quantity Surveying
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Quantity Surveying team within Forensic Accounting and Claims Services (FACS) at Knowledge Services \- Marsh Risk. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

 The Knowledge Services team is an integral part of the future strategy of FACS and Risk Consulting. The FACS team in Mumbai is a dynamic and innovative unit within Marsh Risk Consulting, specializing in managing complex insurance claims. We bring together a diverse group of experts, including forensic accountants, lawyers, fraud experts, engineers, and insurance professionals, to deliver comprehensive consultancy solutions to clients managing complex insurance claims or proactively managing risk.
   

  

* Quantity Surveying is a bespoke service offered to Marsh clients by the FACS team. The team works closely with other Marsh colleagues across the globe to support preparation and analysis of insurance claims related to construction projects. This role offers exposure to a variety of insurance claims and the opportunity to develop expertise in post\-loss construction assessment and cost analysis.


**We will count on you to:**
* Assist in the preparation and presentation of insurance claims as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Work with other senior consultants from Global offices of Marsh in reviewing contractors’ and employers’ loss submissions against contracts and insurance policies.
* Analyze construction documents, design drawings, and site reports to identify damage and assess repair requirements.
* Help verify the accuracy of data and documentation provided by clients and contractors.
* Assist in the preparation of client\-ready reports, proposals, and presentations.
* Collaborate with claims managers and insurers’ quantity surveyors during claim settlement discussions.
* Contribute to the development of continuous risk improvement methodologies.
* Maintain compliance with professional standards and company policies.
* Assist in evaluating business interruption impacts resulting from construction delays.
* Support delay and quantum analysis for post\-loss claims to determine financial impacts.


**What you need to have:**
* 3\-5 years of relevant construction experience (quantity surveying, project management, cost control, contact administration) preferably with exposure to insurance claims or construction cost consulting.
* Basic understanding of construction contracts, cost control, cost evaluation and project management principles.
* Experience in undertaking tender analysis and reports.
* Knowledge of JCT Intermediate and Minor works preliminaries and valuations.
* Knowledge of VAR construction re\-build costs.
* Strong analytical and report\-writing skills.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
* Attention to detail and ability to challenge data critically.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant QS software tools.
* Degree/Engineering or diploma in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, or related field.


**What makes you stand out?**
* Relevant professional qualifications (e.g. RICS, CEng, CIArb, RIBA, APM).
* Both employer and contractor side experience is desirable.
* Experience in post\-loss construction services (delay and quantum analysis).
* Experience in UK construction techniques and use of BCIS.
* Prior experience handling Business Interruption insurance claims is highly desirable.
* Advanced knowledge of financial data modelling and loss valuations.
* VBA Macros and experience in automating tasks.
* Building dashboards or visualizations in Excel or PowerBI.
* Professional working proficiency in English required but additional linguistic skills in European languages (Spanish, French, or German) is a plus.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.


 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office\-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Head Information Technology Infrastructure
description:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead IT infrastructure management, security, and endpoint administration.



  




* Develop and implement IT infra strategies, SOPs, and policies.



  




* Ensure compliance with SEBI and regulatory IT governance.



  




* Manage MSPs for effective service delivery.



  




* Plan and execute patch management (ManageEngine Endpoint Central).



  




* Coordinate \& remediate VAPT findings.



  




* Design and maintain disaster recovery (DR) and BCP plans.



  




* Manage IT asset lifecycle, procurement, and licensing.



  




* Handle servers, switches, firewalls, storage, and virtualization.



  




* Manage cloud infra (AWS, Office 365, VMware).



  




* Implement endpoint security (Trend Micro, SIEM, Sectona PAM, Dark Web Monitoring).



  




* Support cybersecurity audits (ISO, SEBI, SOC 2\).



  





  





**Regular Operational Work (Technical Responsibilities)** 




 Network \& Security
 


* **Firewalls (Sophos, Fortinet):** 
 Configure policies, set up VPNs, manage NAT, enable high availability, and fine\-tune security settings.
* **Switching (Cisco):** 
 Implement VLANs, manage port\-level access, ensure network redundancy, and perform troubleshooting.



  





 Server \& Endpoint Management
 


* **Windows/Linux Servers \& Desktops:** 
 Manage AD, DNS/DHCP, GPOs, backups, and patching cycles.
* **ManageEngine Endpoint Central:** 
 Deploy OS and third\-party patches, track assets, provide remote support, and ensure compliance.



  





 Security Tools \& Monitoring
 


* **Trend Micro:** 
 Handle endpoint protection, threat analysis, policy configurations, and alert reviews.
* **SIEM:** 
 Integrate logs, monitor events, configure alerts, create correlation rules, and generate incident reports.
* **Sectona PAM:** 
 Onboard resources, configure workflows, manage credential vaulting, and perform periodic access reviews.
* **Dark Web Monitoring:** 
 Track potential data leaks, assess exposure levels, and initiate preventative measures.



  





 Cloud \& Virtualization
 


* **Microsoft 365:** 
 Manage users/licenses, track email flow, configure MFA, and maintain compliance.
* **VMware:** 
 Provision VMs, manage vCenter, allocate storage, and maintain high availability.
* **AWS (S3, RDS, IAM):** 
 Manage cloud resources, configure IAM roles/policies, and review activity logs via CloudTrail.



  





 Backup \& Telephony
 


* **Barracuda Backup:** 
 Monitor backups, enforce retention policies, validate restores, and prepare reports.
* **IP PBX \& Phone Setup:** 
 Configure extensions, SIP trunks, voicemail, and call routing.



  





 Governance, Risk \& Compliance
 


* **VAPT Coordination:** 
 Support auditors during assessments, track vulnerabilities, and assist in remediation.
* **BCP \& DR Management:** 
 Maintain DR procedures, execute DR drills, and ensure readiness for business continuity.
* **Cybersecurity Audits (ISO, SEBI, SOC 2\):** 
 Provide documentation, participate in audit walkthroughs, and implement infra\-related corrective actions.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* MCA / BE (Computers).



  




* 10–12 years in IT Infra management with 3\+ years in managerial roles.



  




* Expertise in storage, networks, servers, backup, DR.



  




* Strong hands\-on with firewalls (Sophos, Fortinet), Cisco switches, AD, DNS/DHCP.



  




* Cloud experience (AWS, Office 365, VMware) preferred.



  




* Knowledge of databases, web/app servers an advantage.



  




* Strong project management, process automation, and compliance exposure.

**AI Video \+ Reels \+ Campus Content** 




 For ASBS MBA, this person should be

**Why the Requirement Has Changed** 




 Today’s video marketing is moving towards
 **short\-form, vertical, fast\-cut, high\-retention content** 
 . HubSpot’s 2026 marketing data says short\-form video is among the top ROI\-driving formats, and nearly 75% of marketers are using AI for media creation, including video and images. Wyzowl’s 2026 report also says 63% of video marketers have already used AI tools to create or edit marketing videos.
 



 For ASBS MBA, this means the candidate must know how to create videos for
 **Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta Ads, WhatsApp nurturing, LinkedIn, induction videos, testimonial reels, placement proof videos, and admission campaign edits** 
 .
 



 Google’s Shorts ad guidance also clearly prioritizes
 **vertical 9:16 video assets** 
 for Shorts placements, which makes vertical\-first editing important.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a
 **Video Editor \& Motion Graphics Specialist** 
 for ASBS MBA who can shoot basic campus/interview footage, but whose main strength is
 **editing high\-quality reels, ad videos, student testimonial videos, motion graphics videos, and AI\-assisted video content** 
 .
 



 The person should be able to convert raw footage, campaign ideas, placement data, student stories, and admission messages into strong video content that works on social media and lead nurturing platforms.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**1\. Video Editing** 




 The candidate should be able to edit:
 


* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
* Meta ad videos
* LinkedIn videos
* WhatsApp lead nurturing videos
* Student testimonial videos
* Faculty/expert videos
* Campus event videos
* Placement proof videos
* Counsellor\-led admission videos
* Motion graphic explainers



 The person should understand
 **hook, pacing, cuts, captions, music, transitions, thumbnail frame, CTA, and retention** 
 .
 



**2\. Motion Graphics** 




 This is now a must\-have.
 



 The candidate should be able to create:
 


* Animated typography
* Lower thirds
* Logo animations
* Data animations
* Placement number animations
* Recruiter logo animations
* Career pathway animations
* Before/after comparison videos
* Animated charts and icons
* Reel\-style kinetic text



 Adobe After Effects remains an industry\-standard tool for motion design, animated text, graphics, illustrations, and visual effects.
 



**3\. AI Video Creation** 




 The candidate should know how to use AI tools for faster production.
 



 They should be able to create:
 


* AI\-generated B\-roll
* Image\-to\-video clips
* Finance background motion videos
* Campus\-style concept videos
* Career pathway visualizations
* Animated student journey videos
* Storyboard\-to\-video experiments
* AI\-assisted ad variations



 Current AI video tools are moving towards more controlled, reference\-based video generation. Runway Gen\-4 supports visual references to create videos with consistent subjects, locations, styles, and characters. Luma Ray3\.2 is positioned around directable video generation with continuity across cuts. Adobe Firefly also supports text\-to\-video and image\-to\-video workflows, including partner models like Luma AI Ray.
 



**4\. Basic Shooting** 




 The person does not need to be a full cinematographer, but must know how to shoot usable footage.
 



 They should be able to shoot:
 


* Student bytes
* Counsellor videos
* Faculty videos
* Campus reels
* Classroom clips
* Induction/event coverage
* Placement/testimonial interviews
* B\-roll of campus, auditorium, students, experts, and activities



 They should understand basic:
 


* Framing
* Lighting
* Audio recording
* Gimbal/mobile shooting
* Camera focus
* Clean background
* Interview setup
* Vertical video shooting



  





**Tools the Candidate Should Know** 




**Must\-Know Tools** 




**Editing** 



* Adobe Premiere Pro
* DaVinci Resolve
* CapCut
* Final Cut Pro, optional but useful



 Premiere Pro now includes AI features for transcripts, caption translation, audio enhancement, colour adjustment, reframing for social channels, scene edit detection, and generative extend.
 



**Motion Graphics** 



* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Photoshop
* Canva, only for quick templates

**AI Video Tools** 



* Runway
* Luma AI
* Adobe Firefly Video
* Google Veo / Gemini video tools
* Pika
* Kling / similar AI video platforms
* Midjourney or Firefly for image generation
* ChatGPT for scripting, hooks, shot lists, prompt writing



**Audio \& Caption Tools** 



* Adobe Enhance Speech
* Premiere auto captions
* CapCut auto captions
* ElevenLabs or similar voice tools, only if ethically used
* Descript, useful for text\-based editing



 Adobe’s Enhance Speech helps reduce background noise and improve spoken audio quality, which is very useful for student testimonials and faculty videos.
 



  





**ASBS MBA\-Specific Skill Requirement** 




 The candidate should understand how to create videos around:
 


* MBA admissions
* Core finance careers
* Marketing careers
* HR careers
* Healthcare management
* Placement proof
* Student testimonials
* Recruiter proof
* Induction events
* Counselling push videos
* Industry Expert / Faculty Videos
* Lead nurturing content
* Parent/student trust\-building content



 This person should not only edit videos. They should understand how a video moves a student from:
 



**Awareness → Interest → Trust → Enquiry → Counselling → Admission** 




**Content Style Required for ASBS MBA** 




 The candidate should be able to make videos that feel:
 


* Premium
* Career\-focused
* Youthful
* Sharp
* Fast\-paced
* Trust\-building
* Placement\-led
* Not generic
* Not overly filmy
* Not template\-heavy
* Not cheap\-looking



 For ASBS MBA, the video should feel like a
 **career\-first B\-school brand** 
 , not a regular college page.
 



  





**How to Apply**

title: Forward Deployment Architect
description:
**About the Role:** 




 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as a hands\-on senior technical architect on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
 



  





 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
 



  





 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
 



  





 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Customer\-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design \& Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype \& Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud \& DevOps: Hands\-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data\-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.
* **Travel: This role requires approximately 80% travel, primarily for customer implementations, technical workshops and on\-site engagements.**



  





 As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**SENIOR MANAGER – HR**
 Location:
 **Mahalaxmi, Mumbai**
 Experience: 5\+ Years
   

 Salary Budget:
 **₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month**
 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Department: Human Resource
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on Senior Manager – HR to lead and manage end\-to\-end Human Resources operations across the organization. The role will be responsible for ensuring effective HR processes, employee engagement, compliance, manpower planning, HR administration and smooth coordination between employees, management and business teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of HR Operations and Generalist functions, preferably within the hospitality/F\&B industry, with the ability to independently manage HR processes and resolve employee\-related matters.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End HR Operations
   

  

 \* Manage the complete employee lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding to separation and full \& final settlement.
   

 \* Maintain employee records, documentation, HR files and statutory records.
   

 \* Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters and other HR documents.
   

 \* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace concerns.
   

 \* Drive smooth HR operations across multiple locations/outlets.
   

  

 2\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning
   

  

 \* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for corporate, restaurant, hotel and operational positions.
   

 \* Coordinate with department heads and business teams for manpower requirements.
   

 \* Screen candidates, conduct interviews and coordinate selection and joining formalities.
   

 \* Monitor manpower strength, vacancies and attrition.
   

  

 3\. Payroll \& Attendance Management
   

  

 \* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, attendance, leave, overtime and salary inputs.
   

 \* Ensure accurate employee data and timely payroll closure.
   

 \* Manage attendance systems/HRMS and resolve attendance\-related discrepancies.
   

 \* Coordinate with Accounts/Finance for payroll\-related requirements.
   

  

 4\. Statutory Compliance
   

  

 \* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Shops \& Establishments and other applicable regulations.
   

 \* Coordinate with consultants and internal stakeholders for statutory compliance and documentation.
   

 \* Maintain compliance records and support inspections/audits when required.
   

  

 5\. HR Policies \& Processes
   

  

 \* Develop, implement and update HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks and HR processes.
   

 \* Establish standardized HR systems across locations.
   

 \* Ensure effective implementation of company policies and disciplinary procedures.
   

 \* Continuously identify opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience.
   

  

 6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
   

  

 \* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary issues professionally.
   

 \* Conduct employee engagement initiatives, HR meetings, awareness sessions and internal communication.
   

 \* Promote a positive and professional workplace culture.
   

 \* Support managers in handling employee\-related matters.
   

  

 7\. Performance Management
   

  

 \* Coordinate probation, confirmation, appraisal and increment processes.
   

 \* Support managers in performance discussions and documentation.
   

 \* Monitor employee performance\-related concerns and initiate appropriate HR interventions.
   

  

 8\. HRMS \& MIS
   

  

 \* Manage HRMS processes including employee master data, attendance, leave and HR documentation.
   

 \* Prepare and maintain HR MIS reports related to manpower, recruitment, attrition, attendance and other HR metrics.
   

 \* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of employee information.
   

  

 9\. POSH \& Workplace Compliance
   

  

 \* Support implementation of POSH and workplace conduct policies.
   

 \* Conduct/coordinate employee awareness and sensitization initiatives.
   

 \* Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure concerns are handled through the prescribed process.
   

  

 10\. HR Administration \& Coordination
   

  

 \* Coordinate with administration, finance, operations and management for HR\-related requirements.
   

 \* Support employee insurance/benefits and other employee welfare activities.
   

 \* Coordinate with vendors, consultants and external agencies as required.
   

 \* Provide HR support for new outlets, hotels, projects and business expansions.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

 \* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in HR, Human Resources Management, Business Administration or related field.
   

 \* Minimum 5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in Hospitality, F\&B, Hotels, Retail or other multi\-location environments.
   

 \* Strong knowledge of Hospitality Recruitment, HR Operations and Generalist HR functions.
   

 \* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
   

 \* Experience in payroll, attendance and HRMS management.
   

 \* Strong recruitment and employee relations experience.
   

 \* Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage HR operations and work closely with senior management.
   

 \* Strong documentation, coordination and organizational skills.
   

 \* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and HRMS platforms.
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

 \* HR Operations \& Generalist HR
   

 \* Employee Relations
   

 \* Recruitment \& Manpower Planning
   

 \* Payroll \& Attendance
   

 \* Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance
   

 \* HR Policies \& SOPs
   

 \* Performance Management
   

 \* HRMS \& MIS
   

 \* Conflict Resolution
   

 \* Employee Engagement
   

 \* Stakeholder Management
   

 \* Team Management
   

  

 What We Are Looking For
   

  

 A hands\-on HR professional who can independently manage day\-to\-day HR operations and recruitments, build structured HR processes, work closely with business leaders and employees, and ensure that HR practices are aligned with business requirements and organizational policies.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Human Resources Manager
 
 Kolkata, Howrah \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



 Experience: Minimum 3–4 years
 


 Company Description
 
 Diagnex is an integrated healthcare infrastructure and care\-delivery company building a distributed healthcare ecosystem that connects advanced care at home, qualified care management, doctors, hospitals, pharmacy, diagnostics and healthcare technology into one coordinated patient journey.
 



 With a healthcare legacy dating to 1995, Diagnex operates across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Kolkata and Howrah. The organisation is being built around structured care delivery, qualified people, clear accountability, clinical governance and disciplined operating systems. Our focus is to make healthcare easier to coordinate for patients and families while building dependable infrastructure for clinicians, partners and healthcare teams.
 



  




 Role Description
 
 Diagnex is looking for a Human Resources Manager to manage and strengthen people operations for the Kolkata organisation.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who can manage day\-to\-day HR execution while also building the processes required for a growing healthcare company. The role will cover recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, performance management, payroll coordination, employee relations, workforce planning, HR compliance and people reporting across clinical and non\-clinical teams.
 



 The HR Manager will work closely with leadership and functional managers to ensure that hiring decisions, employee processes and workplace practices are consistent, documented and commercially practical. In clinical and patient\-facing recruitment, the role will also coordinate qualification, registration and credential documentation with the relevant clinical or operational owner; assessment of clinical competence remains with appropriately qualified clinical leadership.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for clinical, operational, corporate and support roles, from manpower requirement through joining.
* Build structured recruitment processes including job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, reference checks, offer documentation and candidate tracking.
* Coordinate verification of qualifications, registrations and required credentials for clinical and patient\-facing hires with the relevant clinical owner.
* Own employee onboarding, induction, documentation, personnel records and exit processes.
* Maintain accurate employee information and HR records using appropriate HR systems or structured databases.
* Coordinate attendance, leave, payroll inputs, statutory documentation and benefits administration.
* Support manpower planning and workforce requirements across functions as the organisation grows.
* Implement clear probation, confirmation, performance review and performance\-improvement processes.
* Develop practical KRAs and KPIs with department heads and ensure performance reviews are completed consistently.
* Handle employee relations matters professionally, including grievances, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution and workplace concerns.
* Support managers on people\-management issues, team structure, role clarity and performance conversations.
* Maintain HR policies, employee documentation and processes in line with applicable employment and workplace requirements.
* Coordinate learning, induction and manager\-development initiatives where required.
* Track recruitment, attrition, absenteeism, workforce cost and other relevant people metrics for management review.
* Support culture\-building initiatives based on accountability, professionalism, respect and high standards of patient\-facing conduct.
* Ensure sensitive employee and candidate information is handled confidentially and with appropriate access controls.



  




 What Success in This Role Looks Like
 
 The HR Manager will be expected to establish a people function that is organised, measurable and dependable. Key performance indicators are expected to include hiring turnaround, joining conversion, completion of employee and credential documentation, onboarding completion, payroll\-input accuracy, probation and performance\-review completion, employee retention, HR compliance closure and the quality and accuracy of workforce reporting.
 



 The role should progressively reduce dependence on informal follow\-ups by creating clear processes, ownership, records and management visibility.
 



  




 Qualifications
 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–4 years of relevant HR experience.
* Strong working experience in recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation and HR operations.
* Practical understanding of payroll coordination, attendance, leave administration and HR systems.
* Experience handling employee relations, grievances, performance management and workplace issues.
* Working knowledge of applicable labour and employment compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good judgement when handling confidential or sensitive employee matters.
* Comfortable working with HR data, trackers, reports and management information.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with functional and senior leadership.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through and documentation discipline.
* Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, hospitals, home healthcare or another multi\-location operating environment will be an advantage.
* Professional HR certification is desirable but not mandatory.



  




 Candidate Profile
 
 We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating beyond a purely administrative HR role. The right candidate should be able to recruit effectively, deal with employees fairly, maintain strong documentation, challenge incomplete processes and help managers build disciplined teams.
 



 Healthcare experience is useful, but operating maturity matters more. The person should be comfortable working in an environment where clinical roles require stronger credentialing and governance than conventional corporate hiring.
 



  




 Employment Details
 
 Location: Howrah
 



 Work mode: On\-site
 



 Employment type: Full\-time
 



 Experience required: Minimum 3–4 years

title: Senior Manager Corporate Partnerships (SME)
description:
**Senior Manager – Corporate Partnerships (National Role for SME Vertical)** 









**About Organization**




 Magic Bus India Foundation is one of the leading NGOs in education and skilling in India. Over the past 26 years, the organization has established a strong presence across 22 states and union territories, impacting the lives of young people from underserved communities between the ages of 12 to 25 years. Through its two distinct programmes \- the Adolescent Programme and Livelihood Programme, Magic Bus equips young people with essential life and employability skills to help them move out of poverty and lead sustainable lives.
 



  





 The Adolescent Programme empowers adolescents (12\-18 years) with life skills education and Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN). To support this, Magic Bus has established an impressive network of 30,000 schools, 343 Community Learning Centres (CLCs) and has MOU’s with 10 state governments and NITI Aayog. Notably, 52% of the participants are girls, reflecting the programme’s strong focus on gender inclusion.
 



  





 The Livelihood Programme prepares youth (18–25 years) for sustainable careers by imparting transferable life and employability skills. Magic Bus has set up 133 Livelihood Centres, built 1,130\+ college partnerships, and established Entrepreneurship Incubation Centres to nurture aspiring entrepreneurs from underserved communities. 60% of the programme’s participants are young women, highlighting a strong emphasis on empowering women through skilling.
 



  





 In addition to its urban skilling initiatives, Magic Bus has also expanded into the Peri\-Urban and Rural Livelihood Programme, focusing on empowering women in peri\-urban and rural areas. This programme equips women with leadership and business skills, enabling them to establish and sustain enterprises and move towards financial independence.
 



  





 Through its sustained efforts, Magic Bus has empowered over 35 lakh adolescents and 5 lakh youth, enabling their transition from childhood to livelihood.
 



  





**Compensation \& Structure** 




**Title** 
 : Senior Manager – Corporate Partnerships (National role for SME Vertical)
 



**Reporting to** 
 : Associate Director \- Fundraising \& Partnerships
 



**Location** 
 : Airoli, Navi Mumbai
 



**CTC** 
 : Competitive, with a meaningful performance\-linked variable component tied to revenue targets
 



 Growth path to AVP as the vertical scales to ₹25 Cr
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are building a high\-velocity corporate partnerships vertical, closing a large volume of smaller CSR deals from Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) that don't have big, structured CSR budgets but do have the intent and the mandate to give.
 



  





 These companies are almost entirely ignored by larger NGOs chasing marquee partnerships, and underserved by smaller NGOs that lack the professional infrastructure to engage them.
 



 Our target deal size is ₹5L–₹50L, high enough to be meaningful and small enough that SMEs can say yes without a lengthy approval chain.
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Manager to own, build, and scale this vertical from ₹4–5 Cr in Year 1 to ₹25 Cr over the next 2–3 years.
 



  





 This is a builder's role. You will not inherit a fully functional team or pipeline; you will create it.
 



 The right person is equal parts hunter, strategist, and innovator who can close deals, build systems, and think at the product level about what makes CSR partnerships compelling and scalable.
 



  





**Why This Role:** 




 Most fundraising roles in the sector are account management jobs dressed up as strategy. This one is genuinely different. You will be given the mandate, the backing, and the autonomy to build something: a repeatable, scalable CSR partnerships engine that can become one of the organisation's most significant revenue pillars. The playbook exists. The market is underpenetrated. If you have the relationships, the hustle, and the imagination, this is the role to make your mark.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




 Revenue \& Pipeline: \-
 



 Own the annual target of ₹4–5 Cr in Year 1, with a 3x\+ year\-on\-year growth trajectory scaling to ₹25 Cr by Year 3
 



 Build and manage a robust pipeline of SME CSR partners, focusing on deals in the ₹5L–₹50L bracket, the sweet spot that most NGOs either overlook or can't service at the volume required to make it meaningful
 



 Close deals end\-to\-end: from prospecting and pitching through proposal, negotiation, and execution.
 



 Develop account management practices, including multi\-year engagement models that map donor objectives to scalable programmes, so that renewals and upsells are a natural outcome.
 



  





**Vertical Strategy \& Scaling:** 




 Design and execute a structured SME engagement model covering segmentation, outreach channels, proposal templates, pricing, and fulfilment workflows
 



 Lead an SME\-CSR landscape mapping exercise across key growth corridors (metro and Tier 2 cities) to identify high\-potential partnership clusters, sector\-specific giving patterns, and compliance behaviors.
 



 Build and lead a lean, high\-performance distributed partnerships team (field and inside sales) as the vertical scales geographically.
 



 Drive expansion into new regional markets sequentially, with clear targets and go\-to\-market plans for each corridor.
 



 Define quarterly and annual targets, track pipeline health, and report to senior leadership with clear metrics.
 



  





**Corporate \& CSR Relations:** 




 Cultivate relationships with founders, promoters, MDs, and finance/compliance decision\-makers at SMEs, advising them on CSR/ESG architecture, Schedule VII compliance, and multi\-year engagement structures, not just pitching a product.
 



 Engage industry associations, MSME clusters, and chambers of commerce as a channel to access large pools of potential partners efficiently.
 



 Stay deeply current on CSR mandates, Schedule VII priorities, SEBI and MCA compliance updates, and sector\-specific giving trends.
 



 Represent the organisation at industry forums, CSR conclaves, and corporate events to build brand and pipeline simultaneously.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end compliance and documentation experience for SME partners (MOU execution, utilization certificates, 80G/Section 135 paperwork, impact reports, and audit\-readiness), ensuring partners feel the process is effortless so renewals become a default, not a decision.
 



  





**Product \& Innovation:** 




 Think beyond transaction: design lightweight, low\-friction partnership formats tailored to SMEs (branded giving programmes, employee engagement days, anniversary or milestone giving, thematic\-aligned funding frameworks) that fit their budgets and decision timelines without requiring a large internal CSR team on their side.
 



 Collaborate with programme teams to package organisational work into compelling, fundable CSR products aligned with Education, Livelihood, and Sustainability mandates Identify white spaces in SME CSR spending and proactively develop offerings to capture them.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 
 :
 



 Experience: \-
 



 12\+ years of total experience, with at least 6–8 years in corporate fundraising, B2B sales, or CSR partnership roles.
 



 Demonstrable track record of independently closing CSR or B2B deals at volume. We will ask for numbers, deal sizes, and timelines; a progression like ₹50L to ₹5 Cr\+ is the kind of story we want to hear.
 



 Experience building or significantly scaling a revenue vertical from scratch, including geographic expansion into new markets.
 



 Exposure to the NGO/social sector and CSR compliance landscape is strongly preferred; candidates from telecom, BFSI, or FMCG enterprise/SMB sales backgrounds with demonstrated ability to work with SME promoters and decision\-makers will also be seriously considered. The key credential is high\-volume deal\-closing and structured pipeline management, not pedigree.
 



 Skills: \-
 



 Sharp commercial instinct: can qualify prospects fast, structure deals creatively, and negotiate without discounting on value.
 



 Ability to advise SME promoters and CXOs on CSR/ESG architecture and compliance structuring; consultant mindset, not just a salesperson.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication; able to write a crisp concept note and present confidently to a founder or finance head.
 



 Data\-driven approach to pipeline management; comfortable with CRMs, funnel metrics, and financial forecasting.
 



 Ability to think at a product level and translate programme outcomes into fundable, scalable CSR offerings
 



**Mindset:** 




 Entrepreneurial: \- Comfortable with ambiguity, energized by building from scratch
 



 High ownership: \- Does not wait for leads, process, or permission Mission\-aligned: genuinely cares about the cause and can communicate that authentically to partners.
 



**Interested candidates can reach at vishal.shikhare@magicbusindia.org**

title: Copywriter (Performance & Brand)
description:
**Copywriter (Performance \& Brand)** 
**– Full\-time, On\-site, Mumbai** 




  





**About Ravel** 




 Ravel is a BSE\-listed, performance\-driven haircare brand. We don't run vanity campaigns and hope. Every creative we ship is measured on ROAS, CAC, and thumb\-stop rate. If a copy doesn't convert, we kill it and write better. That's the job.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will write the words that make our ads work, and run the engine that ships them. Scripts for video ads, copy for statics, hooks, headlines, offers, CTAs. This is pure direct response: your words have one job, to make people buy. You won't write blogs, brand manifestos, or Instagram captions for engagement. You'll write ads that go live on real budgets within days, and you'll see exactly how every line performs.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Do deep customer research: mine reviews, comments, support chats, competitor ads, and Reddit threads to find the exact words our customers use to describe their problems
* Write direct response ad scripts for UGC and video ads: hooks, story arcs, proof, CTAs, all built on research, not guesswork
* Write static ad copy, headlines, and primary text variations for Meta
* Write landing page copy and advertorials when a campaign needs one
* Produce volume: multiple hook and angle variations per concept every week, because testing is the engine
* Read performance data (hook rate, CTR, ROAS) on your own copy and rewrite based on what the numbers say, not what you like
* The content pipeline end to end: weekly content plan, briefs to the editor, delivery schedule, and the testing calendar



  





**Who Should Apply** 



* 3\+ years writing paid performance copy, D2C or e\-commerce preferred
* You've written ad copy or scripts that ran as paid ads and spent real money. Spec work doesn't count
* You do the research before you write. You know a great hook comes from a customer review, not a brainstorm
* We use AI tools. We don't ship unedited AI output. Your job is judgment, research and taste, and we'll see it in your samples
* You can write a hook in 8 words that earns the next 3 seconds
* You can write the same message 10 different ways without repeating yourself
* You're comfortable being wrong fast. Half your copy will fail. The good ones will more than pay for them



  





**Why This Role** 



* Your copy runs on meaningful budgets from day one, with full visibility into results
* Fast feedback loops: write on Monday, live by Wednesday, data by end of week
* You'll learn performance marketing from the inside, sitting next to media buying data most copywriters never see
* Pay scales with the performance you drive



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume to ayush@ravelcare.com along with 2\-3 pieces of ad copy or scripts you wrote and one line each on what they achieved. Applications without work samples won't be considered.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

 Generate and test new investment ideas and signals using market, fundamental, derivatives and alternative data.

 Turn ideas into clean, reproducible Python code and robust backtests with realistic costs and constraints.

 Present findings clearly, in writing and visually, to technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Sharp problem\-solving, intellectual honesty and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience in futures and options strategies is a plus.



  





**EXPERIENCE** 



* 2\+ years in quantitative research, systematic trading or data science; exceptional freshers with strong project work will be considered.
* Degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics, computer science or a related quantitative field.

title: Senior Travel Consultant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONCompany Name
 
**Book My Tour Now** 



 Website
 
**www.bookmytournow.com** 



 Job Title
 
**Travel Consultant** 



 Department
 
**Sales \& Travel Consulting** 



 Location
 
**\[To be filled]** 



 Reports To
 
**Sales Manager / Team Leader** 



 Company Brief
 
**Book My Tour Now** 
 is a customer\-focused Tours \& Travels company providing customized domestic and international travel packages and travel\-related services.
 



 The company focuses on understanding customer requirements, creating suitable travel solutions, managing bookings, and providing continuous support throughout the travel planning process.
 



 Our objective is to provide a smooth and professional customer experience through timely communication, customized solutions, organized booking processes, and effective coordination between the Sales and Operations teams.
 


 Job Summary
 
 The
 **Travel Consultant** 
 will be responsible for managing customer travel inquiries from the initial enquiry to final booking and handover to the Operations Team.
 



 The role involves understanding customer requirements, preparing customized travel packages and quotations, communicating with customers through calls, WhatsApp and email, conducting timely follow\-ups, handling booking and payment processes, and maintaining accurate information in the CRM.
 



 The Travel Consultant will contribute directly to
 **lead conversion, sales growth, customer satisfaction, and efficient booking coordination** 
 .
 


 Key Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Lead Management
 * Manage assigned leads and initiate customer contact according to the daily sales plan.
* Understand customer requirements and identify suitable travel solutions.
* Maintain regular and disciplined follow\-ups with potential customers.
* Update lead status, customer responses, remarks, and follow\-up dates in the CRM.


 2\. Customer Requirement Understanding
 * Understand requirements such as:
* Destination
* Departure city
* Travel dates
* Number of passengers
* Hotel category
* Budget
* Inclusions and exclusions
* Trip purpose
* Meal preferences
* Transportation requirements
* Recommend suitable destinations, packages, hotels, and travel services according to customer requirements.


 3\. Package \& Itinerary Preparation
 * Prepare customized travel packages using existing packages or create new itineraries when required.
* Develop clear day\-wise itineraries according to customer preferences.
* Review hotels, flights, transfers, sightseeing, activities, and other travel components before sharing the proposal.
* Ensure package details are accurate and commercially suitable.


 4\. Quotation \& Proposal Management
 * Prepare accurate quotations based on the finalized itinerary and available services.
* Verify package pricing, hotel details, flight information, inclusions, exclusions, and applicable terms.
* Share quotations and proposals with customers through WhatsApp and email.
* Explain package details, pricing, inclusions, exclusions, and terms clearly to customers.


 5\. Customer Follow\-Up \& Sales Conversion
 * Follow up with customers at mutually agreed times.
* Understand customer concerns regarding price, itinerary, hotels, availability, or other requirements.
* Handle package modifications and provide suitable alternatives.
* Discuss approved discounts and pricing options within company guidelines.
* Work towards converting qualified inquiries into confirmed bookings.


 6\. Booking \& Payment Coordination
 * Confirm booking requirements and collect necessary customer information and documents.
* Generate and share payment links through the approved payment platform.
* Guide customers through the payment process.
* Record full or partial payment details accurately.
* Maintain proper transaction and booking records in the CRM.


 7\. Operations Coordination
 * Coordinate with the Operations Team for:
* Hotel availability and confirmation
* Flights
* Transfers
* Sightseeing
* Activities and tours
* Guest details
* Costing
* Special requests
* Final booking confirmations
* Ensure accurate transfer of customer and booking information from Sales to Operations.


 8\. Documentation \& Customer Support
 * Share booking confirmations, invoices, tickets, vouchers, payment details, and other required documents with customers.
* Maintain complete and updated CRM records.
* Ensure all customer communication and booking information is properly documented.
* Support customers with relevant booking\-related queries before handover to Operations.


 Qualifications \& Experience
 * Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
* Previous experience in
 **Tours \& Travels, Travel Sales, Travel Consulting, Customer Service, or a related field** 
 will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of domestic and international travel processes is preferred.
* Experience in handling customer inquiries, quotations, and sales follow\-ups will be an added advantage.


 Required Skills \& Abilities
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer handling and relationship\-building skills.
* Good sales and negotiation abilities.
* Strong follow\-up and time\-management skills.
* Ability to understand customer travel requirements.
* Ability to prepare customized travel packages and quotations.
* Good knowledge of travel destinations and willingness to learn new products.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to handle multiple leads and customer inquiries simultaneously.
* Attention to detail while managing customer, booking, and payment information.
* Basic computer and documentation skills.
* Positive attitude and professional behavior.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with Sales and Operations teams.
* Target\-oriented approach with a focus on customer satisfaction.


 Tools \& Technology
 
 The Travel Consultant will regularly work with:
 


1. CRM / Lead Management System
2. Razorpay or similar payment platform
3. Zoho Email
4. WhatsApp
5. MS Excel
6. MS Word
7. Email and Internet Applications
8. Travel package and quotation systems
9. Other internal Sales and Operations tools



**CRM Discipline:** 
 The employee is expected to regularly and accurately update customer details, lead status, follow\-up remarks, quotations, booking information, payment details, and other relevant records in the CRM.
 


 Key Performance Areas (KPAs)
 
 Performance in this role may be evaluated based on:
 


* Lead response and contact rate
* Follow\-up consistency
* Lead\-to\-booking conversion
* Sales revenue generated
* Number and value of confirmed bookings
* Customer handling and satisfaction
* Accuracy of quotations and package details
* CRM data accuracy and discipline
* Payment and booking documentation
* Coordination with Operations
* Achievement of assigned sales targets


 Work Environment
 
 Book My Tour Now provides a
 **professional, supportive, customer\-focused, and growth\-oriented work environment** 
 .
 



 The Travel Consultant will work closely with customers, Sales Managers, Team Leaders, and the Operations Team.
 



 The role involves regular customer interaction, sales follow\-ups, customized travel planning, quotation preparation, booking coordination, and achievement of sales targets.
 



 The work environment encourages
 **continuous learning, teamwork, disciplined follow\-up, professional communication, and customer satisfaction** 
 .
 


 Benefits \& Growth Opportunities
 * Training and learning opportunities in the travel industry.
* Practical exposure to domestic and international travel products.
* Opportunity to develop sales and customer\-handling skills.
* Exposure to customized travel planning and booking processes.
* Career growth based on performance and skills.
* Supportive and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to build destination and travel\-industry expertise.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.


 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate should be
 **customer\-focused, energetic, disciplined, and willing to learn** 
 .
 



 They should enjoy interacting with customers, understanding their travel requirements, preparing customized packages, explaining quotations, and following up until booking closure.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable handling multiple inquiries, maintaining accurate CRM records, coordinating with internal teams, and working towards sales targets.
 



 A successful Travel Consultant should demonstrate
 **strong communication skills, customer\-handling ability, sales orientation, follow\-up discipline, attention to detail, problem\-solving skills, and a commitment to delivering a positive customer experience** 
 .
 


 Employment Details
 
 Particular Details
 



**Company:** 
 Book My Tour Now
 



**Position:** 
 Travel Consultant
 



**Department:** 
 Sales \& Travel Consulting
 



**Location: Navi Mumbai** 




**Reporting To:** 
 Sales Manager / Team Leader
 



**Employment Type: Permanent** 




**Experience:** 
 Fresher / Experienced
 



**Industry:** 
 Tours \& Travels
 



**Website:** 
 www.bookmytournow.com

**Assurance Senior Financial Consultant**
 At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior to join the Audit practice in our Hyderabad office. We are seeking someone who thrives in a growing environment and providing clients with exceptional services.
   

  

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**
* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
+ Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion (DE\&I) efforts


**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**
* Develop an understanding of the EisnerAmper audit approach, methodology and tools.
* Proficient in foundational technical concepts.
* Knows when, and from whom, to ask for assistance in solving issues.
* Complete detailed tasks accurately, timely and efficiently.
* Communicate information concisely and effectively, verbally and in writing.
* Interact with and respond to client requests professionally and responsively.
* Demonstrate awareness of services firm provides.
* Listen and ask good questions to expand own knowledge and skills.
* Participate in technical training, formal and on the job.
* Seek and is open to receiving feedback, quickly applying “lessons learnt” to improve performance.
* Able to develop internal network of peers.
* Is familiar with services and products offered by the firm.
* Demonstrate the firm values of quality, integrity, innovation, collegiality, caring and collaboration.
* Execute components of audit under remote service delivery model in an effective and efficient manner.
* Develop and enhance good relationship with U.S. audit teams.
* Demonstrate maturity, poise and self‐confidence in managing self and dealing with colleagues.
* Demonstrate positive attitude towards colleagues and work.
* Understand and adapt to the EisnerAmper corporate culture.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* 3 \- 4 years of progressive audit and/or assurance experience
* CA/CPA
* Experience with working directly with clients and/or global counterparts


 We strongly believe in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, EisnerAmper is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or protected veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law.
   

  

**About Our Audit Team:**
 In the EisnerAmper Audit Group, we’re transforming the traditional reputation of auditing. By operating on the core tenets of profound trust, professional integrity, and consistent results, we strive to create lasting partnerships with our clients based on solutions rather than simply identifying issues in their financial statements.
   

  

 To stay up to date with evolving industry processes and regulations, we place a heavy emphasis on continued education and the consistent adoption of new technologies. This enables us to effectively innovate, grow as individuals, and provide faster, more accurate solutions and due diligence for our partners.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted third party to our clients, we provide solutions that create assurance and peace of mind. Because we understand trust comes with time, we define success by the relationships we create and foster. We act as a trusted business advisor every step of the way, from a client’s first financial report to their close of business.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper:**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5,000 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India:**
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
   

  

 EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore and Hyderabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 500 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

title: SENIOR CRO & ORGANIC GROWTH MANAGER (5–10 years of exp.)
description:
**SENIOR CRO \& ORGANIC GROWTH MANAGER** 



* Experience: 5–10 years
* Location: Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai
* Work model: Full\-time, in\-office
* Working hours: 12:00 PM–9:00 PM IST



  





**ABOUT ACTION TOUR GUIDE** 
 (www.actiontourguide.com)
 



 Action Tour Guide creates GPS\-activated, self\-guided audio tours for national parks, cities, and scenic drives. Our platform helps more than two million travelers explore independently every year.
 



  





**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on website\-growth specialist who can turn qualified traffic into measurable revenue. You will own two closely connected areas:
 



**• Conversion Rate Optimization:** 
 Lead CRO in\-house—from research and funnel analysis through implementation, experimentation, measurement, and rollout.
 



**• Organic Growth:** 
 Own SEO strategy, priorities, performance, quality, and agency accountability while execution remains with our external agency.
 



 This is not a purely advisory role. You will build and manage a continuous pipeline of website improvements, landing\-page experiments, and page redesigns—working closely with content, design, engineering, marketing, analytics, and leadership.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




  





**1\. Conversion Rate Optimization** 




 • Set the website CRO strategy, research plan, quarterly experimentation roadmap, and operating cadence.
 



 • Maintain a transparent backlog prioritized by evidence, reach, effort, confidence, and expected commercial impact.
 



 • Lead initiatives from observation and hypothesis through design, implementation, testing, analysis, and rollout.
 



 • Map and optimize the complete buying journey: landing page → destination discovery → tour selection → product page → cart → checkout → purchase.
 



 • Use GA4, funnels, cohorts, events, and segmentation to identify drop\-offs by device, market, visitor type, page, and tour category.
 



 • Combine quantitative analysis with heatmaps, session recordings, on\-site search data, customer reviews, support contacts, surveys, interviews, and usability studies.
 



 • Identify the underlying causes of confusion, hesitation, and abandonment—particularly for mobile users, new visitors, and international markets.
 



 • Improve destination, category, tour, and landing pages, including navigation, hierarchy, comparison, messaging, CTAs, pricing, bundles, trust signals, and social proof.
 



 • Reduce cart and checkout friction across forms, payment confidence, cancellation messaging, error handling, and mobile usability.
 



 • Translate insights into wireframes, annotated recommendations, or clear implementation briefs.
 



 • Select the appropriate validation method, including A/B tests, multivariate tests, usability studies, staged releases, or controlled before\-and\-after analysis.
 



 • Define success metrics, guardrails, audiences, sample requirements, and test duration before launch.
 



 • Conduct functional, visual, and analytics QA; monitor live tests; investigate anomalies; and decide whether to roll out, iterate, retest, or stop.
 



  





**2\. Organic Growth and SEO** 




 • Set organic\-growth objectives, KPIs, priorities, and the SEO agency’s operating cadence.
 



 • Evaluate and challenge agency recommendations, forecasts, and deliverables using practical technical, on\-page, and content SEO expertise.
 



 • Direct indexation, crawlability, architecture, internal linking, schema, page speed, and mobile\-performance initiatives according to business impact.
 



 • Grow qualified non\-brand visibility across traditional search and AI\-driven discovery, including AEO and GEO.
 



 • Connect search intent with the right landing pages and buying journeys—from search result through purchase.
 



 • Evaluate changes to templates, content, schema, and links while protecting existing organic performance.
 



 • Independently validate results using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, or comparable platforms.
 



 • Account for seasonality, algorithm updates, market demand, and other external factors when evaluating performance.
 



 • Coordinate delivery across content, design, and engineering, including QA and post\-release impact measurement.
 



  





**MEASUREMENT AND DELIVERY** 




 • Define and validate events and funnel tracking across GA4, Google Tag Manager, and behavioral\-analytics tools.
 



 • Own page, funnel, traffic\-source, and experimentation KPIs.
 



 • Connect customer behavior and website changes to purchases, revenue, and margin.
 



 • Establish clear requirements and acceptance criteria, remove delivery blockers, and verify implementation quality.
 



 • Turn technical findings into commercially meaningful recommendations for teams, stakeholders, and leadership.
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 • A continuous CRO research and experimentation pipeline with a prioritized backlog and documented learnings.
 



 • Clear visibility into where and why customers abandon the buying journey—and what is being tested or improved.
 



 • Measurable gains in conversion rate, revenue per visitor, checkout completion, funnel progression, and customer experience.
 



 • Growing qualified non\-brand traffic across traditional and AI search.
 



 • SEO agency activity directly connected to customer, traffic, and revenue outcomes.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** 




  





**Essential experience:** 




 • 5–10 years in CRO, e\-commerce optimization, digital product growth, or comparable website\-growth roles.
 



 • Proven ownership of the complete CRO lifecycle: research, funnel diagnosis, prioritization, experimentation, implementation, analysis, and rollout.
 



 • Documented improvements in conversion rate, revenue per visitor, checkout completion, or another meaningful commercial metric.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with GA4, funnel and cohort analysis, behavioral research, and hypothesis\-driven experimentation.
 



 • Practical experience designing, quality\-checking, interpreting, and communicating A/B or multivariate tests.
 



 • Working knowledge of technical, on\-page, and content SEO, including schema and structured data.
 



 • Strong project\-management skills and experience coordinating complex initiatives across content, design, engineering, marketing, and analytics.
 



 • Independent judgment, commercial thinking, and the ability to make sound decisions with imperfect information.
 



 • Clear communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





**Preferred experience:** 




 • Managing an SEO agency, consultant, or external growth partner.
 



 • Travel, e\-commerce, D2C, marketplace, or consumer\-technology experience.
 



 • Mobile\-first or international customer journeys.
 



 • User research, usability testing, conversion copywriting, wireframing, merchandising, pricing, or checkout optimization.
 



 • Working knowledge of Figma, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or SQL.
 



 • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for research, experimentation, analysis, QA, or documentation.
 



  





**RELEVANT TOOLS** 




 Experience with comparable tools is equally valuable.
 



 • Analytics and behavior: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Looker Studio, Tableau, Excel, or Google Sheets.
 



 • Testing and research: VWO, Optimizely, Intelligems, usability\-testing platforms, and Figma or similar wireframing tools.
 



 • Search: Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Semrush, or comparable SEO platforms.
 



  





**WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR** 




 This role is suited to someone who has personally analyzed customer behavior, recommended and implemented improvements, conducted experiments, and delivered measurable commercial results.
 



 You should be comfortable partnering with performance\-marketing teams on landing\-page opportunities without owning paid\-media execution.
 



 This is a commercial website\-growth role. It is not primarily a visual UI/UX design, paid\-media, social\-media, or one\-time website\-audit position.
 



  





**WHY JOIN ACTION TOUR GUIDE?** 




 • Build the company’s CRO program with genuine ownership rather than inheriting a fixed playbook.
 



 • Influence the complete customer journey—from search discovery through purchase and post\-test rollout.
 



 • Work closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams on initiatives that directly affect revenue and customer experience.
 



 • Apply your expertise to a travel platform used by more than two million people annually.

 Director

**B. Keyword Mining \& Market Research:**

**C. Analytics \& Performance Reporting:** 



* Extract and interpret daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports using advanced Amazon metrics (CTR, CPC, CVR, and ROAS).

**What We Offer:** 




  




* Competitive monthly salary in the range of ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 (in\-hand) based on experience and qualifications.

* A collaborative, inclusive, and growth\-oriented work environment.

**Client Management**

* Support billing reconciliation by coordinating approved numbers, campaign reports, and client validations.



**Account Growth**

* Someone comfortable working in a fast\-moving, performance\-oriented environment.
