title: Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations (Individual Contributor)
description:
TRYST is a research\-to\-translation institution on the IIT Bombay campus, working across semiconductors, AI, health and bio, energy and clean technology, and related verticals. It is building the digital and IT environment for a multi\-Centre organisation that is expected to scale toward 1,000\+ people, while remaining on campus and partnering with IIT Bombay shared services.
 



 This is a founding IT role: the opportunity to design and run the function, not to inherit one.
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 Own TRYST’s IT infrastructure and day\-to\-day IT operations — identity and endpoint operations on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, TRYST cloud and overlay connectivity, devices, backups, and first\-line service.
 



 Build the function from a standing start: standards, vendors, assets and the first hires. Do the work yourself until there is a team. Coordinate campus network, licensed software and journal access with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre rather than recreating those services. Grow the role into Head of Infrastructure as TRYST scales.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Note : It's an Individual Contributor role initially and based on Org. requirements , the team can be aligned later.
 



**Infrastructure, cloud and campus overlay** 



* Design, implement and operate TRYST\-owned infrastructure: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, the endpoint estate, file and backup services, TRYST cloud (Azure as the starting tenancy), and overlay connectivity on the campus network.
* Partner with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre on campus LAN/Wi\-Fi, research computing, and software / journal catalogues. Own the TRYST overlay, the join path for a new employee, and the escalation path to Computing Centre.
* Set infrastructure standards and runbooks that will still hold as TRYST grows across Centres and toward 1,000\+ people, on a common identity and device baseline.
* Plan capacity, backup and disaster recovery for TRYST\-owned systems. Campus backbone DR remains with Computing Centre.



**Identity, endpoint and security operations**

**Service delivery** 



* Provide IT support until a dedicated service desk exists: provisioning, workstation and access issues, with a published response target.
* Establish a single, simple request channel and evolve it as headcount grows.

**Vendors, assets and budget** 



* Own vendor relationships for devices, connectivity overlays, cloud, endpoint security and any managed\-service overflow.

**Team and operating model** 



* Hire, coach and oversee the first support and infrastructure engineers as workload justifies it.
* Clarify ownership between TRYST IT, HR, Finance and Computing Centre, including where a service is TRYST\-owned, outsourced, or provided by IIT Bombay.
* Leave the organisation able to add a Head of IT, an applications lead and a security lead as TRYST scales, without rewiring this job.



**EXPERIENCE** 




**Required** 




 8–12 years in IT infrastructure, systems, network or workplace/endpoint engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership rather than ticket\-only support.
 



 • Hands\-on with cloud identity and modern workplace (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or a close equivalent): directory, MFA and device management — not only on\-premises Active Directory.
 



 • Experience designing and operating network, server/cloud and backup/disaster\-recovery environments.
 



 • Vendor, contract and budget management. Experience hiring or coaching at least one engineer.
 



 • Comfortable remaining hands\-on — imaging a laptop, resolving connectivity issues, supporting a joiner — as well as designing the environment.
 



**Preferred** 




 Built infrastructure for a growing organisation rather than only running a mature one.
 



 • Campus, academic, research\-lab or institutional environments, especially coordinating with a central computing or network group you do not control.
 



 • Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver) with an HR system such as Keka.
 



 • Familiarity with Indian vendor and procurement practice, and with Mumbai / IIT campus context.
 



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* High tolerance for ambiguity: standards will be written here, not inherited.
* Judgement that balances security, reliability and pace — research IP on one side, an early\-stage timetable on the other.
* Credibility with scientists, operators and vendors, and the ability to hold a single TRYST IT stack rather than parallel Centre\-level ones.
* A bias to hands\-on execution in the first year, with the systems thinking so the second year is not a rewrite.

**Level** 




 Manager.
 



**Compensation** 




 Competitive and commensurate with experience

**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 As a Staff Data Architect for Customer Growth, you will be the technical beacon and architectural anchor for the data ecosystems that drive our customer acquisition, retention, and engagement strategies. This is a high\-impact, leadership\-by\-influence role where you will not just write code, but design the future\-proof frameworks that empower multiple engineering squads.
   

  

 You will evaluate complex technical trade\-offs, champion engineering excellence, and foster a culture of innovation. Operating across the entire Customer Growth portfolio, you will collaborate closely with product management, data science, and business leaders to turn massive datasets into strategic growth levers.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Get To**
* Architecture \& Framework Design: Design, build, and evolve robust, scalable, and highly reliable data architectures and framework\-level designs that support real\-time personalization, marketing automation, and advanced customer analytics.
* Technical Decision Making \& Trade\-off Analysis: Act as the ultimate sounding board for complex data challenges. Evaluate competing technologies and methodologies (e.g., batch vs. streaming, self\-hosted vs. managed services, various data lakehouse architectures) and present objective, clear trade\-off analyses to stakeholders.
* Best Practices \& Governance: Define, document, and evangelize global engineering best practices, data governance frameworks, security standards, and CI/CD automation patterns across the portfolio.
* Cross\-Portfolio Collaboration: Break down silos. Work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams within the Customer Growth domain to ensure data infrastructure aligns perfectly with product roadmaps and business goals.
* Innovation \& R\&D: Stay ahead of the curve. Continually research, prototype, and introduce emerging technologies and innovative paradigms (such as Data Mesh, advanced identity resolution, or real\-time feature stores) to keep our growth engine competitive.

**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.

* Proven track record of building reusable data libraries, custom tooling, or internal platforms that accelerated development for other engineering teams.

* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Title: Chief Technology Officer (Permanent)
 



 Location: Mumbai \& Singapore
 



 Reports to: CEO
 



  





**The Mandate** 




  





 A diagnostic\-services platform is planning succession for its technology leader as volume, image size, analyser connectivity and digital ordering approach architectural limits. Current systems still deliver, but scaling through additional interfaces and manual exception teams will increase cost and clinical risk. The replacement CTO will design the next capacity model before growth turns technical debt into restricted access.
 



  





 Approximately 1,525 employees and material partners depend on collection, laboratory, imaging, pathology, reporting and customer technologies across Singapore and the wider region. The CTO owns engineering, architecture, platform reliability, interoperability, technical data, developer operations and technology suppliers, reporting to the Group Chief Executive or nominated sponsor. Authorised clinical and laboratory leaders approve diagnostic rules and release.
 



  





 The target architecture must begin with diagnostic work. Orders, patient identity, specimen events, images, analyser results, interpretation and critical communication form one traceable chain. The CTO will define canonical events and ownership so teams can understand the state of a case without reconciling several applications manually.
 



  





 Interoperability cannot be solved through point\-to\-point expansion. The platform needs governed APIs, message validation, versioning, monitoring and replay. External provider systems may use inconsistent codes or identifiers; transformations require lineage and exception handling. A message accepted technically but clinically incomplete must not disappear into a successful queue.
 



  





 Compute and storage choices will reflect clinical use. Imaging and genomic workloads may be bursty, while result access requires predictable response. The CTO will model latency, retention, data residency, recovery and cost by workload. Cloud, on\-premise and edge components will be selected deliberately rather than by a single enterprise preference.
 



  





 Automation will target constrained work, not visible novelty. Specimen routing, image prioritisation and report preparation can increase capacity, but rules and models need clinical ownership, validation, drift monitoring and human override. The CTO will ensure performance is assessed across relevant populations and uncommon conditions, not only aggregate accuracy.
 



  





 Laboratory and imaging devices create a distinctive security surface. Some equipment has long lifecycles and limited patchability. The architecture will segment, monitor and control access while maintaining vendor support and clinical uptime. Replacement decisions should consider vulnerability, continuity and integration burden alongside technical performance.
 



  





 Reliability engineering will use patient consequence. The team will define service objectives for ordering, accessioning, analysis, interpretation and reporting, with dependency maps and error budgets. Recovery must include message reconciliation and case backlog. Silent data loss is more serious than a visible short outage and requires different detection.
 



  





 Engineering release will be clinically governed where workflows change. Test environments need representative devices, data and exception cases. Each release will have acceptance, observability, rollback and communication. Emergency fixes cannot become permanent unreviewed logic; they need expiry and retrospective validation.
 



  





 Data architecture must support both operations and responsible analytics. Source provenance, consent, purpose and access will be explicit. Research or product development cannot assume that data collected for care is freely reusable. De\-identification risks should be assessed for rare conditions and linked datasets.
 



  





 Build\-versus\-buy decisions will include exit. Proprietary diagnostic components may accelerate delivery but create vendor dependence around essential workflows. Contracts should secure data portability, interface rights, continuity support and change notice. Internally built components need lifecycle ownership and staffing beyond the original engineers.
 



  





 The CTO will rationalise the roadmap. Capacity promises currently rely on several programmes with overlapping dependencies. Work will be sequenced around constraint release and clinical readiness, with total engineering capacity visible. Initiatives lacking an accountable outcome or adoption path will stop.
 



  





 Succession is part of the planned transition. Architecture and vendor knowledge must transfer from the incumbent and a small group of principal engineers. The new CTO will build documented decision records, engineering leaders and operational ownership so platform resilience does not depend on founders or a single supplier contact.
 



  





**What you will own** 



* Diagnostic platform architecture and engineering strategy.
* Order, specimen, image, result and report interoperability.
* Compute, storage, reliability and recovery engineering.
* Automation and model controls with clinical owners.
* Device security and technology continuity.
* Data architecture, privacy and permitted use.
* Supplier, build\-versus\-buy and roadmap choices.
* Engineering leadership and succession.



  





**The first 12 months** 




  





 In the first 60 days, map priority diagnostic journeys, quantify interface exceptions and identify technical constraints on capacity. Complete knowledge transfer for critical architecture and suppliers.
 



 By month six, approve the target event architecture, migrate selected interfaces to governed services and establish patient\-consequence reliability objectives. Validate one constrained\-work automation in normal operations.
 



  





 At twelve months, increase technical throughput capacity by 30% without adding manual exception roles, reduce interface\-related case exceptions by 60% and meet 99\.95% availability for critical diagnostic journeys. One hundred per cent of clinically material releases should have named approval and rollback evidence, with recovery exercises reconciling every queued case.
 



  





**What the sponsor will test** 




  




* Case state visible across diagnostic boundaries.
* Interfaces validating clinical completeness, not mere receipt.
* Automation releasing real constrained capacity.
* Workloads placed according to clinical and residency needs.
* Recovery proving message and case reconciliation.
* Architecture knowledge distributed beyond individuals.



  





**The person** 




  





 You bring 22–28 years in technology and recent CTO or major\-platform engineering leadership within diagnostics, imaging, laboratories, healthcare or another safety\-critical data environment. You have re\-architected a live platform while maintaining regulated operations and measurable access.
 



  





 Evidence should cover interoperability, device integration, cloud or hybrid compute, reliability and clinically governed automation. Singapore and regional data\-residency experience are strongly valued. The permanent onsite role includes an orderly transition from the incumbent.
 



  





**Compensation and terms** 




  





 Base compensation is SGD 420,000–570,000 plus annual incentive and long\-term participation tied to capacity, reliability, interoperability, safe automation and engineering succession. The permanent onsite Singapore appointment reports to the Group Chief Executive or nominated executive\-committee sponsor. Planned replacement permits a structured technical handover.
 



  





**Confidentiality** 




  





 The platform, patients, tests, images, architecture, devices, suppliers, models and security posture are confidential. Further technical material follows conflicts and signed confidentiality. Applicants must not contact diagnostic providers or technology partners to infer the client.

title: Manager- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's India PIPE Practice Area, you will work in a growing team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain\-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute to cases through thought partnership in your area of expertise, deliver original analyses and insights helping drive strong impact with clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.
   

  

 You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, providing insights \& advice for proposals and client workshops. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you may lead development of intellectual property \& assets for the business and mentor and guide junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
   

  

 BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area is one of the firm's largest and fastest\-growing practices, working with the world's leading investment firms across the full deal and value\-creation lifecycle — from thesis generation and commercial due diligence through 100\-day planning, hold\-period value creation, and exit readiness.
   

  

 To succeed in this environment, our teams blend deep investor perspective with digital and human capabilities, bringing rigorous diligence discipline, portfolio operating expertise, and proprietary data and tools to every engagement. You will support commercialization efforts across PIPE topics and asset classes — contributing diligence\-ready analysis, benchmarking, and insights to proposals, investment committee materials, client workshops, and marketing content
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 3\+ years consulting experience in relevant PIPE required, candidates with private equity, investment banking, or transaction advisory consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4\+ years minimum industry experience required (e.g., private equity, investment banking, corporate development, portfolio operations); 5\-8\+ years of relevant industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree, e.g., MBA or CFA, preferred)
* Fluency in English; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholders — including deal teams, investor clients, and portfolio company executives — while working in a collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g., APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the diligence and analytics landscape evolves
* Familiarity with investor workflows and terminology (e.g., LOIs, IC memos, LBO mechanics, value creation plans, GP/LP reporting) a strong plus
* Strong problem solving skills


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants in India, for India. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting\-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
   

  

 With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight \& expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
   

  

**Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)**
* Integrates into client\-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know\-how, and proprietary tools and assets


**Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool \& Data Solutions)**
* Combines deep domain insights with our know\-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co\-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients


**Research (Practice Topic and Sector\-Aligned Research and Insights)**
* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro\-economic, commodities and trade data


**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
* Solving complex investor and portfolio\-company problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions across one or more PIPE topic areas or asset classes (e.g., commercial due diligence, value creation, exit readiness, private credit, infrastructure investing)
* Engaging senior stakeholders and client team members, delivering targeted communication based on stakeholder settings \- deal partners, portfolio operating executives, and investor clients — demonstrating the ability to engage a sophisticated, deal\-focused audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance diligence quality, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable and knowledge frameworks tailored to investor workflows
* Managing projects with ability to prioritize work in a fast\-paced environment, demonstrating business sense and adaptability
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast\-paced environment


*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation
description:
**Job Description** 




  





 As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Revenue Platform Automation division, you’ll lead the engineering efforts driving our Sales, Customer Success (CS), and Finance technology stack. You’ll ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across these platforms, with a strong focus on backend and data\-driven solutions. Collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
 



 You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You’ll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.
 



 This is a backend\-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You’ll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You’ll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build \& CI/CD pipelines and cloud\-native delivery.
 



 Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You’ll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.
 



 Your responsibilities span across the Sales \& Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross\-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.
 



  





**Primary Job Responsibilities** 



* Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our revenue platforms. Ensure the highest quality code with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your back\-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices
* Ensure that our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance systems, particularly those centered around Salesforce and its ecosystem, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated
* Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
* Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud\-native delivery
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align engineering efforts with business goals. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies to drive impactful change
* Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
* Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
* Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
* Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
* Apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to enhance team efficiency and productivity
* Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company’s vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested



  





**Skills and Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of experience in Software Engineering with deep experience in software integration and workflow automation, particularly in Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technology stacks
* 7\+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
* 7\+ years of experience in hands\-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large\-scale distributed microservices architecture

title: Head of Fundraising
description:
**Head of Fundraising \& Investor Relations, West – Mumbai** 




  





 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP
 



**Vantrock is a multi\-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.** 
 Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre\-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Mumbai, Pune and Gujarat.
 



**THE SEAT** 




**Employer:** 
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:** 
 None at launch. A senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across MMR, Pune, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Nagpur and Goa
 



**Experience:** 
 10 to 16 years
 



 Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Vantrock is an operator\-led real assets platform, and it is multi\-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
 **the first strategy, not the platform** 
 , across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use with distribution below and office above.
 



 Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
 **A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.** 




 Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.
 



 Founded by
 **Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO** 
 . Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1\.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free; 200\+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.** 
 That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.
 



 We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING** 




 This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:
 



 – Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing
 



 – Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, starter and strata office
 



 – Plotted and industrial plot sales
 



 – Pre\-leased and yielding assets
 



 – A land strategy
 



 – Private credit
 



 – Data centres and senior living
 



 – In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures
 



**Multiple product lines, one channel.** 
 That is why this is a franchise\-building job rather than a product\-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.
 



 The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment through CIV, co\-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de\-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co\-investment tickets into named assets.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




**Own the zone.** 
 Build the distribution and IFA network across West India: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Nagpur and Goa. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.
 



**Not a cold start.** 
 The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 – The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform desks. Target 10 to 12 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go\-live, for both the fund and the co\-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.
 



 – Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 80 to 100 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in the West.
 



**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT** 




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.
 



**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal\-only, no return promises, ever.** 




**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Essential** 




 – 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in West India. You can name them, and they will take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.
 



 – Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



**Advantageous** 




 – A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.
 



 – Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.
 



 – An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Product\-head relationships at the Mumbai headquarters of the national distributors and wealth platforms, where empanelment decisions for the whole country are taken.
 



**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION** 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.** 




 Approve and South closes the set.

title: Test & Quality Senior Analyst - Automation
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
**Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?**
 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll adhere to the company’s quality assurance processes and methodologies.
* You'll design, implement, and manage comprehensive test plans, strategies, and test cases covering functional, regression, and non\-functional testing to ensure product quality and performance.
* You'll identify opportunities to implement and expand automated testing, maintain existing automation frameworks, and create new test scripts to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to identify, communicate, and resolve potential quality issues early in the development cycle.
* You'll collaborate with the Test \& Quality Lead to establish and uphold high QA standards across the team, driving continuous improvements in testing processes, tools, and methodologies to optimise quality and efficiency.
* You'll create and maintain detailed documentation for all testing activities, including test plans, test cases, and test execution results, ensuring information remains accurate, accessible, and up to date for all stakeholders.
* You'll regularly report on test progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders, providing clear, actionable insights to support informed decision\-making and product enhancements.
* You'll assess and prioritise testing activities based on risk and business impact, ensuring the most critical functionalities are thoroughly tested.
* You'll actively contribute to the agile development process by participating in daily stand\-ups, sprint planning sessions, and retrospectives, ensuring testing activities align with sprint goals and delivery timelines.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring 6\-8 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, with strong expertise in both manual and automated testing across web applications, APIs, and integrated systems.
* You'll leverage 6\-8 years of hands\-on automation experience, demonstrating proven expertise in Playwright and modern test automation practices.
* You'll design, build, implement, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Playwright, including framework architecture, reusable components, reporting capabilities, and CI/CD integration.
* You'll develop and execute comprehensive UI and API automation tests, including RESTful API testing, to ensure application functionality, reliability, performance, and seamless system integration.
* You'll apply strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills, along with working knowledge of Python or C\#, to develop automation frameworks, create test scripts, and enhance existing automation solutions.
* You'll contribute to test automation strategy development, automation roadmap planning, and the prioritisation of automation initiatives to maximise test coverage and delivery efficiency.
* You'll integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms, ensuring efficient and reliable deployment processes.
* You'll adopt an AI\-first approach to testing activities, using AI\-powered tools to support test case design and refinement, assist with test data preparation and analysis, and enhance defect analysis and reporting.
* You'll use AI as a productivity assistant while applying sound professional judgement and validation, continuously improving testing processes, standards, and tooling practices.
* You'll evaluate, implement, and maintain test automation best practices, coding standards, framework governance models, and quality metrics to ensure consistency and effectiveness.
* You'll apply a strong understanding of performance, security, and non\-functional testing principles, with practical exposure to relevant tools and methodologies.
* You'll utilise test management, defect management, and reporting tools to effectively track test execution, quality metrics, defects, and overall testing progress.
* You'll work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, and QA team members to define effective test strategies and deliver high\-quality software releases.
* You'll demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, investigating complex issues, identifying root causes, and recommending effective, practical solutions.
* You'll communicate quality risks, test results, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, leveraging excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* You'll operate as a self\-driven professional, capable of working independently, mentoring team members on automation best practices, and providing technical guidance without direct people management responsibilities.
* You'll adapt effectively to changing priorities and thrive in a fast\-paced Agile environment while maintaining a strong focus on quality and delivery outcomes.
* You'll ideally hold an ISTQB or ISEB certification, demonstrating a commitment to recognised quality assurance standards and best practices.


**So, why choose us?**
**We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.**
 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

**Job flexibility** 
 . We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

**Career growth.** 
 We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

**Diversity and inclusion** 
 . We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Lead Engineer - India
description:
****Driving Innovation and Trust: Ten's Journey to Redefine Service Excellence****
 Ten is on a mission to become the most trusted service business in the world. Technology\-driven Product is at the centre of our strategy to create a hugely successful service and business.  Millions of members already have access to Ten's services across lifestyle, travel, dining and entertainment on behalf of over 50 clients including HSBC, Swisscard, Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Ten's partnerships are based on multi\-year contracts generating revenue through platform\-as\-a\-service and technology fees.
   

  

 We have the advantages of already being at scale globally with a critical mass of high\-net\-worth members via stable, multi\-year revenue\-generating contracts.  We already have a market leading consumer proposition and credibility (and many integrations) with the leading suppliers/partners across our ‘big 4' service categories of restaurants/travel/entertainment and luxury retail.
   

  

 We are debt\-free, profitable and the first B Corp listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM market).

 **Engineer**

 Your role will involve leading a cross\-functional team of engineers, collaborating with product, data and platform teams to produce high quality working software released on a frequent cadence. * Strong experience building and optimising systems for performance, scalability and reliability
* Excellent hands\-on proficiency in Python
* Strong experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS and Azure, as well as Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform

**Desirable:**

We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

title: Freelance Environmental Auditor / Verifier
description:
We are seeking highly experienced Freelance Environmental Auditors / Verifiers to support audit and verification assignments across India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal. This project\-based engagement is intended for seasoned environmental compliance professionals with substantial industry and audit experience who can work independently, travel to client and supplier sites, exercise sound professional judgement, and deliver clear, accurate, evidence\-based, and defensible audit reports within agreed timelines. Assignments will cover a range of manufacturing sectors, with a strong preference for candidates experienced in the leather accessories manufacturing sector and tannery processes.
 


  

 Tasks
   

  
* Plan and conduct on\-site environmental audits and verifications at manufacturing facilities, in line with recognized standards and client\-specific protocols.
  
* Assess compliance with environmental regulations, permits, and international standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ZDHC, Higg FEM, and similar frameworks as applicable).
  
* Evaluate site\-level environmental aspects including effluent treatment (ETP/STP), air emissions, hazardous waste and chemical management, water usage, and energy management.
  
* Identify non\-conformances, conduct root cause analysis, and verify corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  
* Analyse and articulate audit findings, supporting evidence, risks, root causes, and required corrective actions in clear, concise, accurate, and defensible audit/verification reports, submitted in the required format and within agreed timelines.
  
* Liaise professionally with facility management, client representatives, and internal reviewers throughout the audit lifecycle.
  
* Maintain audit records and documentation in accordance with confidentiality and data protection requirements.
  
* Travel to audit locations across India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal as assignments require.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field.
  
* A minimum of 10 years' relevant industry experience in environmental management, EHS, sustainability, manufacturing operations, environmental compliance, or a related field.
  
* At least 5 years' hands\-on experience conducting environmental audits, assessments, or verification assignments, including site inspections, evidence review, identification of non\-conformances, and CAPA verification.
  
* Experience auditing the leather accessories manufacturing sector and/or tannery processes is strongly preferred.
  
* Familiarity with relevant certification and verification schemes, including ISO 14001, ZDHC, Higg FEM/FDM, LWG, or comparable frameworks, is an advantage.
  
* Sound technical knowledge of environmental aspects including effluent treatment, air emissions, chemical management, hazardous waste, water use, energy management, and applicable air and water compliance requirements.
  
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex information and articulate audit findings, conclusions, risks, and recommendations in clear, structured, evidence\-based, and professionally written English reports.
  
* Strong analytical, interviewing, communication, stakeholder\-management, and professional judgement skills.
  
* Willingness and ability to travel across India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal for on\-site assignments; ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet agreed reporting deadlines. Relevant lead auditor certification(s) preferred.
 **Professional Independence and Conflict of Interest:** 
 The auditor/verifier must remain independent, objective, and impartial in the performance of all assignments and must not have any financial, commercial, employment, advisory, familial, or other relationship that could create an actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest.
  
* Any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest must be disclosed in writing before accepting an assignment and promptly if it arises during an assignment.
  
* The auditor/verifier must not accept or continue any assignment where their independence, objectivity, or professional judgement may reasonably be compromised, unless the conflict has been reviewed and expressly cleared in writing by the engaging organisation.
  
* All information obtained during an assignment must be treated as confidential and used solely for the authorised audit or verification purpose.
  


  

 Benefits
   


 As per industry standard

 Generate insights. Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



 Support important decisions. As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



 Build analytical systems. Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 Any Post Graduate
 



 5\-10 Years of experience
 



 Must have proven experience solving unusually difficult analytical problems
 



 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



 What we need:
 



 Analytical reasoning\- You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



 Data fluency\- You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



 Business judgment\- You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: “So what?”
 



 Intellectual independence\- You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



 Intellectual honesty\- You are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet” and equally comfortable saying “I was wrong.”
 



 Communication\- You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



 What This Role Is NOT
 



 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.

title: Business Manager (Growth Track) – Atleisure by Roology
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Andheri West)
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Reports to:** 
 Founder
 **Team:** 
 1 intern will report to this role
 **Start date:** 
 October 1, 2026
 **Compensation:** 
 ₹25,000/month for the first 3 months, reviewed alongside the promotion decision below
 


 About Atleisure
 
 Atleisure by Roology is the newest label from Roology, a Mumbai\-based D2C womenswear brand. Atleisure is built around ease, not hustle — elevated comfort wear for women who are done performing productivity 24/7\. We're early\-stage, fast\-moving, and building the brand and the business at the same time — which means this role won't look like a "job description" for very long. It'll evolve as fast as you do.
 


 About the role
 
 We're hiring a generalist who wants to grow into a true Business Manager role — someone who can sit across operations, marketing, and finance in these early months, acting as the connective tissue between the founder, our vendors, our PR/social team, and everyone else keeping Atleisure running day to day. You'll also have an intern working under you from day one — so alongside learning the business, you'll be getting your first experience directing someone else's work.
 



 This is deliberately a
 **growth\-track role** 
 : you'll start hands\-on across all three functions, learning the business from the inside out. Based on performance, you'll be formally reviewed for promotion to
 **Business Manager within 3 months** 
 — with a compensation review at the same time — taking on greater ownership and ambiguity as you prove you can run with it.
 



 If you're early in your career and the idea of learning ops, marketing, and finance simultaneously at a founder's side — rather than being boxed into one narrow function — genuinely excites you, this is built for you.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Operations** 



* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations — vendor follow\-ups, order fulfillment tracking, inventory coordination
* Handle customer queries and support — order status, pre\- and post\-sales questions, and escalations
* Direct and check in on the intern's work, making sure their output actually moves things forward
* Act as the point of contact between the founder and external teams (PR, vendors, freelancers), making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Document processes as you learn them, so the business runs on systems, not on memory



**Marketing** 



* Own the weekly content/posting calendar in coordination with our social/PR team, keeping Instagram active and on\-schedule
* Track campaign and content performance, flag what's working and what isn't
* Support influencer and PR outreach coordination



**Finance** 



* Track expenses, vendor payments, and basic budget\-vs\-actuals
* Support the founder in monthly financial reviews and reporting
* Flag discrepancies or gaps early, rather than after they've become a problem



**Mediator, across all of it** 



* Translate the founder's priorities into action across teams, and surface what each team needs back up to the founder
* Keep multiple moving parts (marketing, ops, finance, external vendors) talking to each other instead of operating in silos


 What we're looking for
 
**Skills** 



* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the go\-between for multiple people and functions, and customer\-facing at times
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
* Organized, detail\-oriented, able to juggle several open threads without dropping any
* Basic familiarity with Instagram/social platforms and e\-commerce (Shopify) is a plus, not a requirement



**Attitude** 



* Genuinely seeks to learn — asks questions, follows up, doesn't wait to be told twice
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a startup pace where the job description shifts as the business does
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions on everything, and comfortable owning an intern's output as well as your own
* Resilient — early\-stage brands have setbacks and false starts, and we need someone who treats that as normal, not alarming



**Knowledge / background** 



* No prior experience in a specific function (ops, marketing, or finance) is required — full training will be provided
* Any prior exposure to D2C/e\-commerce, retail, or a startup environment is a bonus, not a must
* Freshers and early\-career candidates (0–2 years) are welcome to apply


 Why join
 * Direct mentorship from the founder, with real exposure to how a D2C brand is actually built and run
* Early people\-management experience — you'll have an intern supporting you from day one
* A defined growth path — a formal shot at the Business Manager title (and a compensation review) within your first 3 months, not a vague "maybe someday"
* The chance to shape a young brand's systems from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook
* Part of the Roology family — access to the learning, processes, and network of an already\-running sister brand


 How to apply
 
 Email us at arushi@atleisureculture.com

title: Creative Epicure
description:
**Creative Epicure** 




  





 Location: Andheri East. Mumbai
 



 Eight or more years of experience. On premise and remote.
 



  





  





**The role** 




  





 Ajmal Perfumes is looking for a Creative Epicure. The title is unusual because the job is unusual. This is not a role about making one beautiful film. It is a role about making sure that everything we release, at the volume and the speed that performance marketing now demands, still looks like us and still looks premium.
 



 Fragrance has become a video first category and the work is getting results. It has also converged, and a great deal of it is now difficult to tell apart. Ajmal is a premium house and intends to remain one, which means our work should be ours on sight. Building the system that makes that possible, and holding it steady while output scales, is the job.
 



  





**What you will own** 




  




* The video template system for the brand, built so that what has to stay constant stays constant and what should vary is free to vary.
* The way the brand sounds and reads on screen, authored in Hindi and in English rather than written in one and translated into the other.
* The craft standard across a portfolio that runs across several price points and several audiences.
* How we work with creators, and how their work is directed so that it carries us rather than absorbs us.
* The recurring craft decisions that make our films identifiable as ours.
* The argument for all of the above at the moments when the calendar pushes back against it.



**The core of the job** 




  





 These four are the reason the role exists. A good deal else is negotiable and these are not.
 


* You can build templates. You understand that volume and speed are hygiene in this category, and that neither is an acceptable reason for quality to fall.
* You can express brand personality and visual identity strongly enough that the work stands apart in a crowded category and is recognisable before the logo appears.
* You know that a rigid template chokes creativity and cannot carry a wide range of products, so you design flexibility into the system itself instead of granting exceptions around it.
* You work video first. You think in motion, in sound and in pacing rather than in layouts that get animated later.



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  




* Eight or more years across brand, advertising, content or production.
* An art first creative who also understands film and copy. We will consider a copy led creative just as seriously, provided the art and visual skill is strong and the video capability is real.
* A working command of film and video making. You understand framing, pacing, the edit, sound, and what is genuinely achievable inside a two day shoot.
* You love fragrance. You have opinions about scent and you can talk about a perfume without describing the bottle.
* Mastery level Hindi and English. Strength in another Indian regional language is a clear advantage.
* Mumbai based, or ready to be.



**How the role works** 




  





 The role is on premise and remote, and the balance between the two is something we will arrive at together. Parts of this job need a room, a shoot floor and an edit suite. Other parts need quiet and distance.
 



 You will report to \[reporting line to be confirmed]. Compensation is \[band to be confirmed] and we will discuss it openly and early.
 



  





**Why you might want this** 




  





 You will be handed a category that currently looks much the same everywhere, and you will be asked to make one brand inside it look like itself, at scale, without slowing anything down. If you have spent years watching good craft traded away for turnaround time, this is the role where you get to build the thing that stops it.
 



 We have said less here than we could. What you would actually build is a conversation rather than a public page, and we will be open about all of it once we are talking.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

 A purpose\-driven consumer goods company committed to creating sustainable alternatives for everyday home and personal care products. Positioned as one of India’s fastest\-growing sustainable brands, it combines innovation, consumer centricity, and environmental responsibility to deliver products that are better for people and the planet.
